932191687.name: KORG Module Pro
932191687.description: The best sounds, available to everyone. Announcing a new high-quality mobile sound module app for iOS! Achieved the #1 position*on the App Store* in the Top Paid Music App category USA, UK, Japan, Germany, France, Italy, Canada and much more! Ideal for performance and music production, KORG Module is a high-quality sound module app for iOS that contains a professional sound library. With just your iPad/iPhone and a MIDI keyboard such as the new microKEY, you can play studio-quality keyboard and grand piano sounds anywhere. You can also use the sounds of KORG Module for the KORG Gadget music production app. Maintaining its position at the forefront of mobile music apps, KORG now offers you a new style of performance and production with KORG Module for iOS. FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS ● Stunningly high-quality piano and a full range of keyboard sound engines ● Six dedicated sound engines : Acoustic Piano/Electric Piano/Clav/Organ/Multi/Hybrid ● Ultra-low latency sound engine ● AUv3 support ● With just an iPad/iPhone and the new microKEY, you can enjoy great sound anywhere ● Mobile music production in tandem with KORG Gadget ● Convenient set list function with a PDF/image score viewer and music player ● Power-up even more with expansion sound libraries: TRITON Best Selection / Ivory Mobile Grand and more! ● Easily record your performances, and share song sketches on SoundCloud ● Integrating iOS technology that's indispensable for the mobile environment Stunningly high-quality piano and a full range of keyboard sound engines *** KORG Module has five dedicated sound engines, providing a number of high-quality sounds that can be played back on your iOS using the "NATIVE ENGINE”. These engines feature technology that was developed for KORG's historic line of workstations and synthesizers including: Acoustic Piano, Electric Piano, Clav, Organ, Multi, and Hybrid. Each display has carefully selected parameters, making it convenient and easy to adjust the sounds. We’ve also carefully ensured ideal playability and designed the system for ultra-low latency. Once you experience the quality of the sounds being produced from the slim body of your iPad, you'll agree that Module is radically different than anything else currently on the market. With just an iPad/iPhone and the new microKEY, you can enjoy great sound anywhere *** KORG Module and the microKEY are the best possible combination for a mobile performance environment. With the new microKEY which supports a damper, or the microKEY Air which provides a wireless connection via Bluetooth MIDI, your iPad can transform into a high-quality sound module. In your room, in a practice studio, or performing on stage,, it's easy to set up and immerse yourself in a superb playing experience wherever you are. Of course you can also use any MIDI keyboard that can connect to your iPad via Apple Lightning - USB camera adapter. The velocity curve function conforms the sound to your playing dynamics, so you'll be able to perform comfortably using any MIDI keyboard. Even if you don't have a MIDI keyboard, you can use the apps on-screen keyboard, phrase function, or MIDI player to play the sounds. The MIDI player can load and play standard MIDI files for your listening enjoyment. Mobile music production in tandem with KORG Gadget *** You can also use the high-quality KORG Module sounds inside KORG Gadget, the mobile music production app. If you have Module and Gadget, the five tools Salzburg, Montreal, Alexandria, Firenze, and Glasgow are added inside, allowing access the same way as Gadget. These five powerful gadgets will add even more variety to your music productions, raising your music to the next level. Whether for performance or for production, both of these apps deliver ultimate sound. More info at korg.com

933997029.description: 用mi Flight Radar Pro将您的iPhone或iPad变成专属的私人空中交通雷达!在精美详尽的全球追踪地图上实时观看飞机移动,即时识别头顶上空的飞机。 无论您是航空爱好者、经常出行的旅客,还是前往机场接送家人,mi Flight Radar Pro都能将流畅、精准的航班数据直接呈现在您的屏幕上——核心功能已全部解锁。 已包含功能: 实时全球地图:实时追踪全球航班动态。 航班识别:点击任意飞机即可查看航空公司、机型、高度和当前速度等关键实时数据。 增强现实(AR)视图:将设备对准天空,通过摄像头把实时航班详情、目的地和航线叠加到真实世界中。 航班搜索:按航班号或飞机注册号查找航班和飞机。 机场洞察:直接在地图上查看全球任意主要机场的到达和出发信息。 解锁高级版: 借助可选的应用内高级升级,让追踪体验更进一步: 增强追踪:通过放大地图,查看更广区域和更多同时可见的飞机。 航班通知:实时接收延误、登机口变更及航班状态更新的推送通知,直接送达您的设备。 了解为什么航空爱好者都选择mi系列应用。立即下载,从此以不同的方式仰望天空! 免责声明 本应用仅限用于娱乐目的。这明确不包括任何可能危及您本人或他人生命安全的活动。在任何情况下,本应用的开发者均不对因使用数据、数据解读或违反本协议的使用而导致的事故负责。我们保留匿名追踪并报告用户在应用内活动的权利。 https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

935261024.description: 本软件为人力资源管理师四级考试的软件，精心准备了2024年最新考试题库。（分为不同题型，单选、多选、简答、计算题、综合题。为考试的提供了充分的复习准备，可随时随地学习练习，有效帮助顺利通过考试，学习知识通过考试必备神器！ 【功能介绍】 1、章节练习：针对考点的习题进行强化练习，并可手动将易错或未牢固掌握的题加入收藏，以便反复练习。 2、模拟考试：模拟考试试题，包含最新考题。 3、错题库：可自动加练习过程中错题加入收藏，以便反复练习。 4、收藏夹：可在练习过程中自行收录题目到收藏夹，形成自己的小题库，针对性练习，提高通过率。 5、安装后可离线浏览，不用联网也可以浏览，速度快，无广告。 6、支持同时在iPad/iphone/itouch等多种设备中安装。 7、定期更新题库。 人力资源管理专业培养具备管理、经济、法律及人力资源管理方面的知识和能力，能在事业单位及政府部门从事人力资源管理及教学、科研方面工作的公司管理学科高级专门人才。

936707382.name: FaithTime
936707382.description: Start your day with a powerful quote of "The Living Word", the source of life! Explore the secrets of "The Holy Bible" in a practical, modern and comfortable way. FaithTime is optimized for the daily use – ideal to let the Word of God affect and enlighten your daily routine. Receive a daily verse from a collection of over 800 carefully chosen Bible verses. This numerous collection of Bible passages contains a huge amount of precious treasures from the Word of God. FaithTime contains plenty of valuable and powerful words: Words of Encouragement Words of Strength Words of Hope Words of Healing Words of Life Words of Help Words of Love Words of Confidence Words of Consolation Words of Peace Words of Joy Words of Faith Words of Truthfulness Words of Wisdom Words of Salvation Moreover: As the very first App FaithTime offers you the possibility to create your own Bible verse cards. With the built-in "Creative Mode" you can choose your desired verse together with a matching picture as well as your favorite font to design your own individual verse cards. You can create as many cards as you want and save them in your favorites menu, where you can always take a look at them or share them with your friends. Features: Receive a daily quote from a huge collection of Bible passages Receive a random verse of over 800 Bible verses at any time FaithTime contains over 100 different backgrounds Choose your preferred Bible translation Individualize your FaithTime-App and read all verses in your favorite font Create as many Bible verse cards as you wish with the built-in „Creative Mode“ Add your verses to the favorites Share your favorite verses with your friends (iMessage, E-Mail, Facebook, Twitter...) With FaithTime you will receive a extensive tool to bring the holy word closer to your everyday life. Try it out by yourself and you will see how marvelous it works. The impact of this words when they are honestly spoken by your heart is absolutely stunning! There are still wonders in this age!

936966570.name: 奇妙的机械 - Tinybop出品
936966570.description: 探索工程技术有趣的一面！孩子们可以体验六种简单机械，探索这些机器是如何工作的，并研究这些机器背后的无形力量。 用杠杆摧毁城堡 - 但要当心巨龙！在弹球机游乐场用斜面来创作音乐。用一组滑轮把卫星送入轨道。用螺丝举起晃动的鱼缸。利用轮轴穿越奇妙的世界。用楔子毁坏冰山。 孩子们可以改造并测试每台机器，从而了解力与运动、作用力与反作用力、输入与输出、能量守恒、机械效益以及权衡。 这款应用还有配套资料《奇妙的机械》手册供免费下载，其中重点介绍一些活动用于展示、制造和讨论简单机械。 特点： 探索 6 种简单机械：杠杆、滑轮、斜面、楔子、轮轴、螺丝。 体验现实世界中的物理现象、作用力与反作用力、输入和输出。了解力与运动。 研究每台机器背后的物理作用。 与科学课程相结合。我们的网站还免费提供学习单和手册。 充满个性的音效设计奖励好奇心。 James Gilleard 原创的插图。 智能功能利用您设备的摄像头在应用中呈现您孩子的世界。 手册可免费下载，有 5种语言的版本，其中包含各种活动用来为学习提供支持。 好用、安全、适合儿童的设计。 大人小孩都能玩。 隐私政策 我们非常重视您和您孩子的隐私。我们既不收集或共享有关您或您孩子的信息，也不添加任何第三方广告。我们不会用市场影响手段干扰孩子的使用。 关于 Tinybop Tinybop, Inc. 是一家由设计人员、开发人员和画师组成的工作室，打造成教育性套装应用程序。我们致力于制作有沉浸感的游戏，以鼓励孩子进行探索并引发对话。我们坚信玩耍、实验、假扮和提问是学习的强大力量。 Tinybop 帮助您引导孩子加深对世界的了解。 对于新闻和新版本 访问我们的网站：www.tinybop.com 关注我们：twitter.com/tinybop 为我们打“赞”：https://www.facebook.com/tinybop 关注我们：instagram.com/tinybop 如果使用效果不如预期，请通过 hi@tinybop.com 联系我们。我们倾听用户的反馈意见。

938020489.description: 本软件为初级护师考试的软件，精心准备了2026年最新考试题库。（共计32000多道）分为不同题型，并有答案解析。以及高频考点（2300个考点），为考试的提供了充分的复习准备，可随时随地学习练习，有效帮助顺利通过考试，学习知识通过考试必备神器！ 【功能介绍】 1、专项练习：基础知识、相关专业知识、专业知识、专业实践能力等科目最新考题A1/A2、A3/A4、B型题，并有答案解析。 2、章节练习：按照章节划分的最新考题，含解析。 2、历年真题：最新真题含解析。 3、模拟押题：最新模拟押题，检测复习成果。 4、必考考点：高频考点必背知识点，包括《基础护理学》、《外科护理学》、《内科护理学》、《妇产科护理学》、《儿科护理学》等。 5、错题库：可自动加练习过程中错题加入收藏，以便反复练习。 6、收藏夹：可在练习过程中自行收录题目或考点到收藏夹，形成自己的小题库，针对性练习，提高通过率。 7、安装后可离线浏览，不用联网也可以浏览，速度快，无广告。 8、支持同时在iPad/iphone/itouch等多种设备中安装。 9、定期更新题库。 题库介绍 基础护理学A1/A2型题 基础护理学A3/A4型题 基础护理学B型题 938020489.summaryDescription: 本软件为初级护师考试的软件，精心准备了2026年最新考试题库。（共计32000多道）分为不同题型，并有答案解析。以及高频考点（2300个考点），为考试的提供了充分的复习准备，可随时随地学习练习，有效帮助顺利通过考试，学习知识通过考试必备神器！ 【功能介绍】 1、专项练习：基础知识、相关专业知识、专业知识、专业实践能力等科目最新考题A1/A2、A3/A4、B型题，并有答案解析。 2、章节练习：按照章节划分的最新考题，含解析。 2、历年真题：最新真题含解析。 3、模拟押题：最新模拟押题，检测复习成果。 4、必考考点：高频考点必背知识点，包括《基础护理学》、《外科护理学》、《内科护理学》、《妇产科护理学》、《儿科护理学》等。 5、错题库：可自动加练习过程中错题加入收藏，以便反复练习。 6、收藏夹：可在练习过程中自行收录题目或考点到收藏夹，形成自己的小题库，针对性练习，提高通过率。 7、安装后可离线浏览，不用联网也可以浏览，速度快，无广告。 8、支持同时在iPad/iphone/itouch等多种设备中安装。 9、定期更新题库。 题库介绍 基础护理学A1/A2型题 基础护理学A3/A4型题 基础护理学B型题 938026867.name: BeeLine Reader
938026867.description: Read faster and more easily with our digital reading technology, which has has won awards from Stanford and United Nations! Here's how it works: instead of using plain black text, we display text using eye-guiding color gradients. These gradients flow from the end of one line to the beginning of the next, so that when you move your eyes from right to left, they're automatically drawn to the appropriate line. Vision, literacy, and medical experts agree that BeeLine Reader improves reading speed and reading ability for readers of all ages and skill levels. It is particularly helpful for readers with dyslexia, ADD, or vision impairments—some readers are able to read over 50% faster with BeeLine. Find out how much it will help you by taking the BeeLine Reading Challenge on our website: www.BeeLineReader.com. Included app functionality: Read with BeeLine in Safari using our BeeLine Action Extension; save articles for later using the BeeLine Share Extension; and browse the web with BeeLine on select popular websites (AP News, Reuters, and Medium.com) within the BeeLine app. Never used an extension before? Find out how: http://bit.ly/1vaQaOf IAP: Add premium news sites to your reading list and read Kindle books with BeeLine (iPad only). Have epub files you want to read with BeeLine? Grab the ReadMe! app, which supports DRM-free EPUB files.

938037644.name: 世界迷雾助手--GPX生成器
938037644.description: GPX文件生成器通过简单的在地图上划线来添加地理位置信息，最后导出成GPX文件，可供其它地方使用。 支持iOS 10 和世界迷雾2 以世界迷雾为例，这是一款非常受欢迎的个人生活轨迹记录App，但它使用起来比较费电，并且在没有购买它之前到过的地方就没法记录下来，这个真是遗憾。但有了这个APP，你就可以把以前到过的地方都划出来，然后导出成GPX文件，最后在导入到世界迷雾中。 特色： 支持Google地图和苹果内建地图。 支持从照片中的GPS地理位置信息定位，快速定位到你曾经去过的地方。 记录起来非常方便。 支持Dropbox同步导出,邮件导出。 直接分享数据给其他App

938082827.name: 小马百变造型盒
938082827.description: 小马百变造型盒，是一款特别有趣又富有创意的App，你可以用成千上万种不同的方式为你自己的小马装扮和造型！ 你可以在5匹不同小马中进行选择，为它做出就像在美发店里做出来一样的搞怪发型，给它穿上衣服、装上马鞍，照相，还可以观看他们带来的令人惊叹的动画和特效表演！小马们性格各异，舞蹈动作也不同，会给你带来不同的意外惊喜哦。 开始你天马行空的设计吧！使用不同的色彩，添加配饰、发胶、指甲油和贴纸以及发夹、星星、爱心和马笼头。然后将你最有创意和最令人惊讶的小马们保存在自己的图库中。 这款App非常有趣、令人惊讶又搞怪可爱，好好玩吧！ 请另外看看我们推出的其他精彩儿童App： “晚安 马戏团”有着奇妙的设置，营造了非常特别、充满动画和缤纷色彩的睡前氛围。”孩子们发现自己身处马戏团，和8种马戏团动物做游戏，只要关掉灯或者吹掉蜡烛就可以哄这些动物上床睡觉。 “小小建筑工人”是一款为儿童推出的3D建筑工地。你可以驾驶挖掘机、混合水泥、给建筑物盖屋顶、操作吊车以及粉刷房屋。你自己可以化身为小小建筑工人，挖、抹灰泥、填土、粉刷和混合，无所不能。 “爱畜动物园”是一款为iPad和iPhone推出的非常精彩的故事书App。它主要由20多种动物迷人又有趣的互动性动画组成，绝对会受到孩子们以及各个年龄层动物爱好者们的喜爱。 如果在使用App的过程中遇到任何问题，或者有任何疑问或建议，请不要犹豫，随时和我们联系：contact@foxandsheep.com。我们很乐意提供帮助。另外，请告知我们你的设备版本以及iOS版本。有关详细信息和支持，请访问我们的网站 www.foxandsheep.com。 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

938105969.name: Real Alcázar de Sevilla
938105969.description: Una guía de mano, una audioguía y una app de el Real Alcázar de Sevilla en un único aparato ¡tu propio teléfono!. Amena e intuitiva, la única manera de conocer cada rincón y habitación de los palacios junto con sus jardines del alcázar sevillano durante tu visita. Además un recuerdo para siempre de lo que has visto y por menos de lo que cuesta un café. De funcionamiento fácil e intuitivo la aplicación permite descubrir las curiosidades e historias del monumento. Si te cansas de leer puedes utilizar los altavoces del teléfono para escucharlas al oído.

938109461.name: Hairy Phonics 3
938109461.description: The final Phonics app in the Hairies series! Learning phonics is the best way to learn to read and spell. Now introducing, vowel-r and magic ‘e’. Vowel-R When the letter ‘r’ follows a vowel, the vowel is forced to change its sound. Magic-E Magic E states when the letter sits at the end of the word it’s usually silent and strengthens the preceding vowel to say its name. Learn 9 phonemes (sounds): ar, or, er, ir, ur, a-e, o-e, i-e, o-e, u-e Guides your child through a structured sequence of learning. Phonic animations link an action with the sound. Trace the letters with your finger. Play games to blend the phonemes into a whole word and improve understanding Sound out words and understand how the digraph changes the sound of the word Release 6 new Hairies at the Yeti Igloo This is a particularly important skill for those with dyslexia. Designed for 4-6 year olds. This app is strictly educational and has no in-app purchases. REVIEWS Brilliant game. Children learn without realising. – Tina Tortoise Very good Good consolidation activities for students learning long vowels and the 'magic e' / split digraph spelling pattern. A good introduction/addition for teacher-led phonics activities. – Ceri Williams

938922963.description: pwSafe 2 offers Dark Mode, Touch ID, Face ID, Safari and apps autofill, iPhone landscape mode, adaptive text, a new design and much more on top of pwSafe 1. Easy, secure and full featured password management across devices and computers. pwSafe uses iCloud or Dropbox to keep your password databases backed-up and synced between your iOS devices and computers. It is compatible with open source Password Safe. No in-app purchases are needed for unlimited usage, including iCloud sync (see below). Now available for the Mac with iCloud Sync - https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/pwsafe-password-safe-compatible/id520993579?mt=12 This application is not related to any application developed and/or marketed by PSafe Tecnologia S/A, including PSafe Total. == What people are saying about pwSafe: "Brilliant! - Passwords in sync at last!" -- Daddio1946 from Australia "Great integration and support - PasswordSafe is great and this app makes it even better! Easy to setup and use. Their support for big fixes is great and the turn around time is short." -- Joeartz from the USA "Very good, better than it's rivals, does what it's supposed to do AND the copy-feature is EX-CELLENT!" -- WaiWera from New Zealand "I highly recommend this app for anyone who has a large number of usernames or hard-to-remember passwords." -- razor11401 from Canada "Excellent tool for multiplatform password storage - Excellent tool that enhances my online security by creating complex and long passwords without the inconvenience of retyping them time and time again." -- AmberTiara from Neaderland == List of features: TouchID unlocks Safari and apps autofill (extension) Smart Pasteboard: tilt your device face down to switch between username and password when using other apps Can open safes from any cloud service with an iOS 8 Storage Provider Extension Print a hardcopy of your data New iPad with Retina display & iPhone 5 support iCloud sync, realtime and bi-directional Dropbox sync**, fully automatic and bi-directional Password generation Passcode protection Universal binary - iPad, iPhone and iPod Touch optimized Compatible with the famous open source Password Safe desktop app Search all fields Organize entries in groups Single tap password copy to clipboard Single tap password copy to clipboard and open website Clear password from clipboard after one minute Multiple fields (title, username, password, URL, email and notes) Define custom fields Full unicode support iTunes file sharing Receives safes as e-mail attachments (please name your safes with a .psafe3 extension) Opens safes from Dropbox (free without sync, paid otherwise) Export to PDF (encrypted, of course) Password history (per safe and per entry settings) Named password policies Fully compatible with Password Safe version 3.31 file format Multiple safes Unlimited passwords Unlimited password groups Two-factor authentication using YubiKey security token Generate TOTP authentication codes (two-factor authentication) Create and use Passkeys for password-free authentication Syncing via Dropbox is an In-App purchase. Instead of trusting on a single developer security knowledge, pwSafe borrows all its encryption code directly from the famous Password Safe open source password manager (https://pwsafe.org). Password Safe has been originally created by security guru Bruce Schneier and nowadays is maintained by Rony Shapiro. Since it has been around as an open source project for more than two decades now, it has been extensively reviewed by many experts. Apple’s standard end user license agreement (EULA) applies to the pwSafe app (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) The (optional) services provided by pwSafe Cloud are subject to our Terms of Use (https://pwsafe.app/terms-of-use/)

939656123.trackName: 《小马宝莉：紫悦王国》故事书（豪华版）
939656123.description: 成为一名公主，并没有速成指南，英雄也不例外！《紫悦王国》是《MY LITTLE PONY》《小马宝莉》首款豪华版故事书应用程序。在紫悦王国，Twilight Sparkle 是小马国最新加冕的公主，她想要证明自己不虚此名。当邪恶的半人马开始到处盗取独角兽的魔力，甚至声称要耗尽天角兽公主的魔力时，Twilight Sparkle 唯一的愿望，就是找到 Tirek 勋爵的踪迹；然而，却另有人攫取了她的位置。Discord！现在，Twilight Sparkle 需要亲密好友的帮助，更需要一位能带来惊喜的盟友，一起恢复小马国的魔力，并且开创一个为公主量身打造的王国。 《紫悦王国》，改编自分为上下两部的《MY LITTLE PONY》《小马宝莉：友情就是魔法》第四季大结局，是一场完美的年终盛宴，精彩再现 Twilight Sparkle 的朋友们如何找到开启友谊之门的钥匙。这款豪华版故事书共 27 页，动画效果堪比电视品质。并且和原版动画一样，由 John de Lancie 为 Discord 配音。 《MY LITTLE PONY》《小马宝莉：紫悦王国》是一场激动人心、充满风险的探险之旅，适合早期读者和启蒙期读者，同样适合各个年龄段的小马粉丝们。加入 Twilight Sparkle 和她的好友，和他们一起挽救家园，并在此过程中获得有关耐心、忠诚和友谊等珍贵品质的宝贵经验。 特色： 首部《MY LITTLE PONY》《小马宝莉》豪华版故事书，拥有最新最详细的人物介绍！ John de Lancie，Discord 原版配音 动画效果堪比电视品质 每一页都有互动式《MY LITTLE PONY》《小马宝莉》动作和声音！ “朗读”和“跟读”模式适用于所有水平的早期和启蒙期读者 整本故事书的新词汇和高阶词汇均有高亮和发音 包含常见词练习单元

939850720.name: Tennis • Tracker
939850720.description: Tennis Tracker est la solution la plus simple pour enregistrer vos statistiques des matchs et de les analyser ensuite. Tennis Tracker maintient le score du match à chaque saisie et vous permet de consulter les statistiques de vos matchs à tout moment y compris pendant l'enregistrement d'un match ! Que vous soyez entraineur ou simple amateur, Tennis Tracker vous permettra de rapidement comprendre les axes d'amélioration de votre jeu pour les travailler ensuite à l'entrainement ! ATTENTION : pour compléter l'avis d'un utilisateur, la version gratuite de Tennis Tracker permet d'ouvrir un fichier Tennis Tracker partagé par un utilisateur PRO et d'accéder donc à toutes les statistiques. Fonctionnalités : Personnalisation du nom des joueurs Différents formats de jeu y compris les formats de jeu pour enfants Interface de saisie extrêmement efficace vous permettant de continuer à suivre le déroulement des matchs Possibilité de rajouter/supprimer manuellement des points ou des jeux pour s'aligner sur le score réel du match Chronologie complète du match Consulter les statistiques des matchs précédents Partage par mail du résumé du match Un achat intégré vous permet d'accéder aux fonctionnalités PRO : Historique de matchs illimité Statistiques de retour et analyse des stratégies d'échange Saisie du type de coups (coup droit, revers...) et statistiques associées Partage des statistiques complètes pour un autre utilisateur Tennis Tracker

942509445.name: Anna.K Tarot
942509445.description: Anna.K Tarot is set in a timeless realm of dignified royalty and humble peasants. This is a down to earth, unpretentious Tarot, inviting us to tell ourselves the honest truth. Its folkloric style portrays the familiar RWS scenes with sparkling emotional clarity, free from distracting symbolism. Many people find this deck easy to read, but Anna.K Tarot is also spiritually deep and psychologically sophisticated. The characters often look away from the viewer into the scene, pulling us into the picture, helping us see the scene through the character’s eyes. Anna.K Tarot is perfectly suitable for beginners, but the insightful twists on some of the traditional scenes make it a great choice for more advanced readers. Mirroring the lived human experience, Anna.K Tarot is a deck is for the perceptive and discerning among us. Intuitive, elegant interface is easy for beginners and experts Gorgeous full screen, high-resolution card images Full support for all current devices Sophisticated journal Includes full and unabridged book 21 spreads built in Design your own layout with Free Form Allow reversed cards or not Option to use Major Arcana only Zoom in to enlarge card details Share reading via email, Twitter, Facebook, and sharing plugins Animated shuffle & cut Optional voice prompts Customize with your own card meanings & reading cloths Many adjustable settings Book and card meanings available in English only Gently open the door to your intuition with Anna.K Tarot.

943149660.name: Heart Rate to Health App
943149660.description: Send your Heart Rate to the Health app from your Bluetooth LE Heart Rate Monitor. In addition to seeing your heart rate in-app, the app will continue to run in the background, adding your heart rate to the Health app once a minute. You can also easily export a CSV of your heart rate over time. This app has no ads, and doesn't sell (or even track) your usage to anyone, ever. Note that Fitbit devices won't work with this app, due to them locking down their Bluetooth communications.

943217887.name: 喬志先生的愛情診斷室
943217887.trackName: 喬志先生的愛情診斷室
943217887.description: 喬志先生的愛情診斷室 是從張兆志(喬志先生)的FB粉絲專頁開始 有別於一般愛情專家總是長篇大論 喬志先生對於感情總是有著一針見血的觀點 並且博得許多朋友認同 短短5個月粉絲人數已經達到90萬次 由於FB私訊機制的關係 有許多發文者都被新訊息覆蓋 為了提供更直接,更負責任的診斷方式 喬志先生於是成立”愛情診斷室”APP 是一個完全不受時空間限制的感情諮詢管道。 由於避免診斷室資源浪費 下載診斷將採取收費制 初次下載APP費用為NT$60元，並提供免費診斷一次 後續掛號診斷為每次NT$120元 請詳閱以下注意事項 診斷室注意事項 1.請填妥初診資料,第一次下載的朋友可享有一次免費診斷 2.18歲以下、或是替他人提問恕不提供診斷(謊報年齡發問後果請自行負責) 3.診斷內容只點出問題所在,不幫任何人做決定 4.問題人物請詳述,勿使用代號人稱 (例:A男B女C男) 5.不提供"如何追求異性"教學 6.不回答假設,還沒發生,只是想先問看看,或是大方向問題 (例:你好,我沒談過戀愛,請問愛是什麼?) 7.只診斷感情問題,其他人生課題不回答 8.進入法律程序,或是已有專業管道之問題不回答 (家暴,離婚,請找專業律師) 9.每次診斷,會以雙方同意進入結案,一案一問,如有其他問題請重新掛號 提醒您，若是超過30天沒有回應對話，系統將自動對當次提問結案，請別拖延自己的愛情問題歐 喬志先生祝大家開心,順心,不要因感情傷心!

943744319.name: TiltlessCamera
943744319.description: "TiltlessCamera" is a camera with a spirit level. It is used in order to take a straight photograph. When you have your device horizontally, of course, "TiltlessCamera" operates ! So you don't need to use an app which corrects the leaning photograph. If your device's "Portrait Orientation Lock" is "ON", the green ball doesn't move correctly when your device is face up. 【Usage】 If you lean a camera, a translucent green circle will move. Therefore, move the green circle to the intersection of a cross and tap camera button. You can get a straight photograph. 【Function】 Zoom control Self-timer (off, 5sec, 10sec) Back camera / Front camera Preview

943855614.name: Java SE 16 API Specification
943855614.description: This App is divided into two sections: Java SE The Java Platform, Standard Edition (Java SE) APIs define the core Java platform for general-purpose computing. These APIs are in modules whose names start with java. JDK The Java Development Kit (JDK) APIs are specific to the JDK and will not necessarily be available in all implementations of the Java SE Platform. These APIs are in modules whose names start with jdk. Thi is the latest release of Java SE 16 Platform. This release contains improvements like Local-Variable Type Inference, Parallel Full GC, Application Class-Data Sharing. Oracle strongly recommends that all Java SE users upgrade to this release. Also it include java interview question and java testing.

943882845.name: 博饼助手 - 闽南中秋传统博饼，指尖好运传承
943882845.trackName: 博饼助手 - 闽南中秋传统博饼，指尖好运传承
943882845.description: 「博饼助手」是一款致力于传承与推广闽南传统博饼文化的移动应用。无论是在中秋佳节、亲友聚会还是公司团建，无需实物骰子和瓷碗，只需轻轻一摇，即可开启一场充满欢笑与好运的博饼之旅。 核心功能： 1. **真实模拟**：精美的 3D 视觉效果与逼真的骰子撞击声，高度还原真实博饼体验，身临其境。 2. **规则详尽**：内置标准闽南博饼规则，自动判定状元、对堂、三红等奖项，公平公正，告别争议。 3. **历史记录**：自动记录每轮博饼结果，轻松回顾手气最佳时刻，分享中奖喜悦。 4. **简洁易用**：直观的交互设计，老少皆宜，一秒上手，让博饼更简单、更纯粹。 5. **文化传承**：不仅是一款游戏，更是传承千年闽南博饼文化、拉近亲朋好友距离的文化纽带。 让「博饼助手」陪伴您度过每一个欢乐时刻，把好运和福气带给身边的每一个人！ 中秋博饼，起源于泉州，传说由南安人郑成功发明，是闽南地区特有的由饼文化外延的一种民俗活动。博饼是中秋节时的一种大众娱乐活动，用六粒骰子投掷结果组合来决定参与者的奖品。传统的奖品为大小不同的月饼，共计一会，设状元1个，对堂2个，三红4个，四进8个，二举16个，一秀32个。相传这种游戏可以预测人未来一年内的运气。 在闽南地区，中秋赌饼也已成为一种商业活动和大众游戏。福建人民出版社1985年出版的《福建风物志》记载：在泉州一带，中秋节有“夺状元饼”的习俗。 在台湾中部和东部地区的一些城乡以及台湾离岛金门县（隶属泉州），至今还流行中秋博状元饼的习俗。在金门，金城镇吴厝社区发展协会每年庆祝中秋社区联欢晚会，都有博状元饼大赛。 在古代，“博”是一种棋戏，后泛指赌博运动。当然，沿袭至今，博饼不再有赌博的意味，而是成为闽南人中秋聚会的保留节目。当骰子在大瓷碗里落下，发出叮叮当当的清脆响声，当欢声笑语从人们的心底飘出，各个眼底洋溢着快乐的微笑时，那种其乐融融的感觉总是特别温馨。 【协议说明】 使用本 App 前，请您仔细阅读以下相关协议，了解服务规则与权益保障： 终端用户软件使用条款 https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 使用协议 https://www.sharezer.com/app/agreement/TermsofUse.html 隐私协议 https://www.sharezer.com/app/agreement/PrivacyPolicy.html

944118456.name: Exif Viewer by Fluntro
944118456.description: 由Apple推荐在美国和加拿大的App Store上。享受一次性购买，终身访问—无需订阅。 Fluntro的EXIF Viewer是专业摄影师和iPhone爱好者查看、管理和编辑EXIF元数据的终极工具。凭借简洁的设计和流畅的功能，此应用程序在所有iOS设备（iPhone、iPad、iPod Touch）上提供和谐的体验。 主要功能： 删除EXIF元数据和地理标签：通过轻松删除EXIF数据（包括GPS位置），保护您的隐私。 查看详细的EXIF数据：轻松访问重要的元数据，如ISO、快门速度、焦距、相机型号、镜头型号、时间戳、光圈等，适用于您设备中的任何照片、iCloud或Photo Stream。 放大大照片：享受高达80 MB的高清晰度图像。 自定义您的EXIF标签：通过重新排列EXIF标签、隐藏不需要的标签以及选择您的首选日期格式来个性化您的查看体验。 快速导航：在EXIF详细信息屏幕上，轻松向左或向右滑动即可在照片之间切换。 地图视图：通过点击每张照片，查看带有详细EXIF信息的照片在地图上的位置。 批量编辑EXIF数据：高效地为多张照片修改EXIF元数据，包括日期和位置的更改。 有或没有EXIF数据分享照片：通过电子邮件、AirDrop或其他方式轻松分享照片，无论是否带有EXIF元数据。 复制EXIF数据：轻松复制和分享元数据至不同应用程序。 保留EXIF元数据：通过邮件、AirDrop或SD卡读取器发送的照片将保留EXIF元数据，不像大多数消息和社交网络应用程序。 其他功能： 支持3D Touch：在支持的iPhone上快速访问收藏夹、相册或所有照片等操作。 针对所有iOS设备进行了优化：兼容iPad Pro、iPhone SE、iPhone 8及更新机型，并支持横向和纵向模式。 多种查看选项：根据您的偏好，选择EXIF卡片列表视图、网格视图或地图视图。 照片扩展：在原生照片应用或第三方应用中，选择照片并点击分享按钮，即可直接访问EXIF数据。 支持iMessage应用：轻松查看和分享EXIF数据到您的消息中。 编辑和删除EXIF元数据： 批量编辑EXIF数据：选择多张照片，点击“编辑EXIF”，并更新元数据，如日期和位置。 删除EXIF元数据： 1.覆盖原始照片以删除EXIF元数据。 2.创建不带EXIF数据的副本照片，并可选择删除原始照片。 常见问题解答 什么是EXIF元数据？ EXIF是可交换图像文件格式的缩写。当您使用数码相机或手机拍摄照片时，会有大量的EXIF数据被记录并存储在每张图片中。这些数据包括相机设置的信息（ISO、光圈、焦距、图像尺寸、快门速度、相机型号、镜头型号、GPS）、日期、时间、位置等。查看EXIF元数据标签对于初学者和专业摄影师都至关重要，能帮助他们了解并回顾创建和编辑照片时使用的相机设置或软件。 为什么选择Fluntro的EXIF Viewer？ 无应用内购买：仅需一次性购买，即可享受当前和未来的所有功能—无隐藏费用。 为专业摄影师设计：深入了解您的摄影作品，通过删除敏感元数据保护您的隐私。 隐私优先：您的照片安全地存储在手机上，永远不会上传到我们的服务器。详情请查看我们的隐私政策。 用户评价： 如果您对该应用感到满意，请考虑留下五星好评。您的反馈帮助我们改进并确保为所有用户提供最佳体验。

944421992.name: Ditto Keyboard
944421992.description: Whether it’s texting, dating, business, or just regular daily communication, we tend to repeat ourselves quite often. With Ditto, save your most commonly used texts, phrases, and templates, and access them easily from any app! Stop wasting time, and start saying things in a snap! DISCLAIMER: For the app’s full features to work, you must “Allow Full Access” in your device’s keyboard settings. Nothing that you say or save leaves your phone, everything is saved privately on your device or synced via iCloud securely. If you choose not to allow full access, saving dittos from inside the keyboard will not work, but the rest of the app will function as expected!

944863743.name: AGO Phonics Sound Pad Premium
944863743.description: AGO Phonics APP是跟AGO纸牌游戏-phonics系列配套使用的一个工具，适合英语学习者用来练习自然拼读方法。它既可以和AGO纸牌游戏一起用，也能单独使用。在这个APP中，用户只用轻轻一点，就可以听到非常清晰的phonics sounds以及相对应的英语单词，每个单词还配有图片来解释单词的意思。 这个app中一共有三页。每一页都含有36个目标音素（target phonemes）,点击这个目标音素，在屏幕的下方将会显示三个含有这个发音的常见单词和图片，点一下单词，也能听到相应的发音。 与AGO纸牌游戏一起使用时，这个工具可以帮助用户快速找到不认识的单词的正确发音，成为游戏中的“小法官”。特别是对于不会说英语的家长来说，有了这个工具，就不用在玩游戏的时候，担心自己发音的不标准或者不认识这个单词了。 这个APP不仅仅是简单的ABC，三个级别涵盖了200多个英语中最常见的单词和发音规则，包括长元音，短元音，字母组合，双元音，不发音的字母，r-组合等等！

945320815.name: ViewExif
945320815.description: ViewExif is a powerful metadata tool for your photos. With the help of ViewExif, you can not only view metadata of photos, but also edit and remove metadata in photo. Besides, it has an app extension, so you can view metadata right in Photos app. Being able to read exif tags can be of great importance not only for beginners, but also for other photographers who want to find out what settings and tools were used to create a particular photograph. For those people who want to protect privacy, this app is useful for you as well. When you send photos via email or share on social network, your personal information (geo location, taken date etc) is shared as well. If you upset to share those information, ViewExif is able to remove it before sharing. Features: Display EXIF tags: Dimensions, Taken Date, ISO Speed, F Number, Exposure Time, Focal Length and more. Display IPTC tags: Star Ratings, Keywords, Description etc. Display geo location on map. Add star ratings, keywords and description on photo Remove metadata from photo Supported image formats (JPG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC) and RAW formats (CR2, NEF, DNG). Share photo w/o metadata on Twitter, Facebook, email. App extension for Photos app and 3rd-party apps such as Dropbox, FileExplorer etc. Dark Mode ===== CONTACT US ===== Email: support@skyjos.com Twitter: @SkyjosApps

945334439.name: Canned Laughter Generator Pro
945334439.description: Canned Laughter Generator pro for instant laughter sounds of different types for different moments. What does it do you ask? Well, it generates canned laughter which gives the illusion something is funny and is often used in un-funny TV sit-coms. There are different styles of laughing sounds for almost any occasion, from minor chuckles (or dad jokes) to great gags and finally to huge rounds of applause for your amazing and stupendously funny stories. You also have a small selection of additional sounds. Plus! When you have finished your gags and you are leaving the room you can choose a crowd applause sound for your exit. Each time you press the button will choose randomly from a selection of that style. There are between 5 and 10 of each style. They will never play the same one twice in a row either making it sound more natural Perhaps you are a wannabe stand-up comedian that needs some helpful laughs or perhaps you need some moral support for your terrible dad jokes. Well use this app to give the illusion you are the funniest comedian alive! if not a little original. All sounds are original and recorded from genuine live stand-up gigs.

945662966.name: Storm Tracker° Pro
945662966.description: Explore the weather with Storm Tracker! At a glance you can see the current weather conditions for any location, accurate forecasts up to 10 days and a real-time animated radar. Track the weather changes on the interactive map and follow the accurate weather charts to view the pressure, humidity, and wind direction/speed among other weather details WHY YOU’LL LOVE STORM RADAR Rain and snow radar Track hurricanes Warnings on Map (floods and hurricanes) Forecast Daily & Hourly Charts for; Temperature, Precipitation & Wind UNDERSTAND HURRICANES Stay on top of the hurricane, it's predicted path (and changes of such), wind speed/quadrants, and much more. And the best part? All of this is visual! UNITS OF MEASUREMENT Fahrenheit/Celsius Miles/Kilometers Wind speed in kn, mph, km/h, Beaufort Barometric Pressure in Inches (inHG) and Atmospheric Pressure in Hectopascal (hPa) MAP SETTINGS Switch between standard and satellite background maps. Choose different forecast layers like; rain, hurricanes, warnings or locations. The rain layer quality covers high- (HD), normal- or low-resolution quality, and an option to choose between green, blue, red or grey color scheme. Customize overlays by adjusting the layer opacity, the number of frames in the future/past and animation speed (f/s). SUPPORTED COUNTRIES AND REGIONS United States, Canada, Mexico EUROPE: France, United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Netherlands, Switzerland, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark APAC: Japan, Hong Kong, Korea, Taiwan & Australia WE LOVE FEEDBACK! -- As always, we appreciate your feedback. Please keep sharing your experience to feedback@impalastudios.com Enjoying Storm Tracker and want more features? Please show us some love by giving a 5-star review, so we can keep updating with great new features! YOUR EXTREME WEATHER RADAR --

945956691.name: CS:GO Companion - CSGO App
945956691.description: CS:GO Companion helps you take your gameplay to the next level by helping you to make better decisions in-game or in training. CS:GO Companion provides you with useful information such as a bomb timer, map call-outs, weapon info, spray patterns, economy information, and tactical nade tutorials. Bomb timer: Don't guess whether you have enough time to defuse. Let our bomb timer tell you. Tap anywhere on the screen to start the timer. Audible and visual cues help you keep track of the time remaining even when you're wearing headphones. Nade tutorials: Upgrade your skills by using CS:GO Companion's nade tutorials. Take control of key points on the map by using well-placed smoke grenades, flashbangs, molotovs, and HE grenades. Map images with callouts: Communicate more effectively with your team. CS:GO Companion is loaded with images of maps that have labels for specific parts on the map. Weapon info with spray patterns: Keep missing that headshot? Check out every weapon's specific recoil pattern so that you can tighten up your aim. Weapon information such as price, ammo capacity, and damage are also provided for your convenience. Travel times: Not sure if you can make it in time to defuse the bomb? We've included a list of travel times (in seconds) from point to point on the map (ex. A Site to B Site) Level up your game, download CS:GO Companion now. What people are saying: "5 out of 5" "All pros here. No cons. With the most recent addition of nades to this app it is now leagues ahead of any other app on the market. The times between sites are great The bomb timer is great (when you remember to press screen) And the smokes are just awesome with how well they are organized between maps. I'm a beginner to cs. Only really started a few months ago and now im learning all of these smokes. This app is worth every penny." by Jayrodathome

946049965.name: Wi-Fi Info
946049965.description: Everything you want to know about your WI-FI CONNECTION but were afraid to ask. Wi-Fi Info is a small and useful utility that lets you see detailed information about current Wi-Fi connection from hotspot informations to wireless features and more. WI-FI ACCESS POINT / HOTSPOT INFO Detect hotspot type (wireless access point or ad-hoc connected device). Hotspot SSID (service set identification), MAC address, IP address and vendor informations. WI-FI CONNECTION INFO Detect and explain wireless standards supported by your device (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ad). Detect wireless speed-up features (short guard interval, STBC, HT duplicate, etc). Detect and explain wireless operation frequencies and channels. Detect and explain available antennas, MIMO config, spatial streams. Detect and explain Wi-Fi roaming (802.11k/r/v) support. Detect wireless security options and modes (WPA standards and EAP modes). Detect wireless optimization (WMM) and access features (Wi-Fi Direct, Miracast, Voice). Detect max. physical wireless speeds. Show Wi-Fi network traffic counters: upload, download, errors, quality of service (QoS) categories. COMPARE DEVICES Compare iPhone, iPad, iPod Touch and Apple TV devices. Compare supported Wi-Fi standards and frequencies Compare built-in antennas (MIMO config). Compare maximum speeds. WI-FI HARDWARE INFO Detect built-in Wi-Fi chip type. INTERNET INFO Show default gateways, IP addresses, networks. Show DNS servers, search domain names, local MAC addresses, host name resolve. Depth external address analysis: ISP name, autonomous system name, whois, ping, regional internet registry info. Full offline MAC vendor database. DEVICE INFO Detect device type and model. Detect processor type. Detect memory size. Detect storage size. Detect firmware name, version. Detect last reboot time. REACH UI FEATURES Info menu with feedback and privacy settings Use the camera icon (upper-right corner) to create and print/send/share a screenshot from the entire page. Pull down with your finger to refresh the informations. Long press on a cell to copy/print/send/open as/share the cell value. Shake your device to refresh the informations.

946783399.description: 和蒙大辞典の特徴 ■■現在キャンペーンとして期間限定価格で配信中！■■ 1.当辞典には社会、政治、情報技術、経済、法律、歴史、医学、植物、動物等、の現代日本語の単語を7万語余り、それと同様の例文と、その例文中、豊かな表現用語・慣用句・同意語を網羅しています。 2.別紙にて現代日本語に良く使われる外来語の略語句、モンゴル国政府機構組織の比較翻訳、漢字で書かれた日本の地域、都道府県、市区の名称も掲載しています。 著者は2007年に第一版の和蒙辞典を出版し、2010年に再版した。2010年に再版されたその辞典を3回目には改訂し、語彙を大幅に増やし、現代日本語で広範に使われている7万余りの語彙、複合語、派生語を充実させ、5万7千の例文がある本「和蒙大辞典」が作成された。従って、社会、文化、政治、情報技術、経済、法律、歴史、医学、植物、動物等の多種分野の専門用語を含めるのは勿論、それ以外に3000の慣用句、諺、格言、6500の外来語を含めてある。その上、日本語の特質である擬声語と擬態語をかなりの量入れている。本辞典は豊富な例文以外に同類語を大量に入れてあるのも一つの特徴である。 2012年に出版されたこの最新「和蒙大辞典」はこれまでに出版されたものと比較すると質、量ともに非常に優れており、内容的にも幅広い大規模な辞典として専門家らの評価が高い。 ЯПОН МОНГОЛ ИХ ТОЛЬ БИЧГИЙН ТУХАЙ ТАНИЛЦУУЛГА Зохиогч 2007 онд анх удаа хэвлүүлсэн япон-монгол толь бичгээ нэмж, засварлан 2010 онд дахин хэвлүүсэн. 2010 онд хэвлүүлсэн тэр толь бичгээ гуравдахь удаагаа хянан засахын зэрэгцээ үгийн санг их хэмжээгээр арвижуулж, орчин цагийн япон хэлний өргөн хэрэглээний 70 гаруй мянган толгой үг, нийлмэл ба үүсмэл үг, 57000 орчим жишээ үг хэллэг бүхий энэхүү “Япон-монгол хэлний их толь бичиг”-ийг бүтээсэн билээ. Чингэхдээ нийгэм, соёл, улс төр, мэдээллийн технологи, эдийн засаг, хууль, түүх, анагаах ухаан, ургамал, амьтны аймаг зэрэг олон салбарын нэр томьёог багтааснаас гадна 3000 орчим өвөрмөц хэлц, 6500 орчим харь үгийг оруулсан. Түүнчлэн япон хэлний өвөрмөц онцлог болох　авиа дуурайх үг　擬声語, төрх байдал дуурайх үг 擬態語 –ийг ч нэлээд хэмжээгээр багтаахыг зорьсон. Толь бичиг нь баялаг жишээ өгүүлбэртэйгээс гадна ойролцоо нэрийг　нэлээд оруулснаараа онцлогтой болно.　2012 онд хэвлэгдсэн энэ япон-монгол их толь бичиг нь өнөөг хүртэл хэвлэгдсэн толь бичгүүдтэй харьцуулахад хэмжээний хувьд ч, агуулгын хувьд ч өргөн цар хүрээг хамарсан том хэмжээний бүтээл болсон гэж мэргэжлийн хүмүүс дүгнэсэн. Түүнчлэн японы хэвлэл мэдээлэл болон ярианы хэлэнд IFM, IOC, IOC гэх мэтээр харь үгийн товчлолыг өргөн ашигладаг байдлыг харгалзан тусгайлан, мөн, Монголын төрийн байгууллагуудын нэрийн орчуулга, дэлхийн улс, хотын нэрийн зөв бичлэг, ханзаар бичигддэг Японы хот, бүс нутаг, Токио, Оосака хотын дүүргүүдийн нэрийн дуудлагыг хирагана болон кирил галигийн дуудлагыг хавсаргасан болно. Зохиогч С.Дэмбэрэл 著者について サンジーン デムベレル Sanj DEMBEREL 1945年1月15日、モンゴル国オブス県マルチン郡の生まれ。67歳、男性。 学歴: 1975年モンゴル教育大学モンゴル語・文学部卒 1977-1979年大阪外国語大学研究留学生 1979-1981年東京国語大学研究留学生 学位: 2002年モンゴル国立教育大学言語学修士課程 2009年モンゴル人文大学言語博士課程 職歴: 1975-76年モンゴル国外務省事務官 1981-89年モンゴル国外務省事務官 1989-05年在モンゴル日本国大使館現地職員 2005-10年国立人文大学日本語専任講師 2010-人文大学日本語非常勤講師で現在に至る 社会活動:2005-1月からモンゴル日本関係促進協会理事長 1996-3月からモンゴル・豊岡シルクロード友好協会を創設し、現在まで副会長兼理事長 著書に、1995年「和蒙漢字辞典」 2009年「和蒙学習辞典」 2007年「和蒙辞典」第1版発行、 2010年「和蒙辞典」第2刷 増訂発行、 2012年「和蒙大辞典」2巻 最新改訂版 2012年「日本語・モンゴル語医学用語辞典」 2012年「モンゴル語・日本語医学用語辞典」 編集で、2012年「日本語―モンゴル語、モンゴル語―日本語ポケット辞典」 翻訳で、1998年 盛田昭夫「MADE IN JAPAN わが体験的国際戦略」 共著に、1994年「モンゴル語単語集」日本語・英語対訳 1994年「モンゴル語実用会話集」 日本語・英語対訳 その他:日本及びモンゴル国と関係がある約30の記事を翻訳し、出版。

946930094.name: FineReader Pro: PDF Scanner
946930094.description: ABBYY FineReader PDF Pro - the first smart AI-powered scanner that turns your mobile device into an all-purpose tool to quickly capture docs and books, create electronic copies in PDF and JPEG, and extract texts from scans for further editing and sharing. FineReader PDF Pro - the top mobile scanner for iPhone or iPad from ABBYY, a Digital Intelligence company. Ranked #1 Business application in 98 countries *** Winner of SUPERSTAR Award in the "Document Capture" category in the Mobile Star Awards *** Use FineReader PDF Pro to scan paper documents, books, agreements, receipts, magazine articles, notes, recipes, charts, tables, slides, whiteboards, or even billboards on the street and get perfect digital copies. KEY FEATURES PDF & JPEG. Scan any text and save scans to JPEG images or cross-platform PDF documents. OFFLINE OCR. Quickly extract text from scans into TXT format on your device without an internet connection. ONLINE OCR. Recognize text (OCR) on scans in 183 languages (including Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean alphabets) and choose from among 4 output formats. SHARE & EXPORT. Send results by email, to FineReader PDF for Windows, save in cloud storages - iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Yandex.Disk, Evernote, OneDrive for Business, and more. LIVE TEXT. Make phone calls, send emails, follow the links, and more from scanned docs. ABBYY NEURAL NETWORK. The smart gallery will automatically classify documents into 7 types: A4, books, business cards, handwritten, IDs, other docs, and receipts. SEARCH TEXT ON PHOTOS. Type the text from a photo into a Search field in the gallery. FineReader PDF Pro will find photos that have this text. AR RULER. Define doc size in AR. It will be useful for non-standard documents and further printing them out in proper proportions. SIRI SHORTCUTS. Open scans with Siri and set the flow of actions with scans using Shortcuts app. ANNOTATE SCANS. Discover a set of easy-to-use tools to modify your PDFs: add your signature or a text box, use a highlighter, write with a pen, or conceal content with the redaction tool. 3D TOUCH & SPOTLIGHT SEARCH SUPPORT. PASSWORD ON PDF. Add a password for the image-only PDF files while exporting and sending via email. MULTIPAGE DOCS. Create, edit, and enhance separate images or large multi-page documents without any additional selection on the viewfinder. AUTO-CAPTURE AND FILTERS. Excellent visual quality with auto-capture of page boundaries and advanced image filters, which process scans in color, greyscale, or black-and-white versions. BUILT-IN FILE STORAGE. Save scans inside the app with tags and search capabilities. Transfer docs to your Mac or PC using Home Sharing. AIRPRINT. Print out scans directly from your iPhone or iPad. 947221959.name: 学俄语中俄双语版 -简明俄文会话
947221959.trackName: 学俄语中俄双语版 -简明俄文会话
947221959.description: 本应用针对没有俄语基础的人士而作，而这类人群却有着最强烈的学习需求。或为求职、或为留学。这是“零起点学外语”应用的一个，内容由浅入深，非常适宜初学者学习。 全应用分为俄语基础入门、日常生活会话、校园会话、职场对话、应急俄语口语，内容简单实用，旅游、生活、留学一个APP就够！ 俄语（俄语：Русский язык；英语：Russian；法语：Russe）是联合国和俄罗斯联邦的官方语言之一，也是中华人民共和国承认的少数民族正式语言之一。 俄语属于斯拉夫语族的东斯拉夫语支。主要在俄罗斯和前苏联的其它成员国中使用，在华沙条约的成员国里曾经被学校广泛作为第一外语教学。在苏联时期，俄语在其加盟共和国中被大大的强调。虽然很多前苏联的国家现在开始强调当地语言的重要性，但是俄语仍然是这些地区最广泛使用的语言，并且也是这些国家进行交流时使用的语言。挪威俄语是俄语和挪威语的混合语。 俄语入门学习，需要遵循学习规律，循序渐进。 宏伟的蓝图任您描绘，蔚蓝的天空任您翱翔。信心和决心是您的双翅，辛勤的汗水将给您带来丰厚的回报。您的眼前将矗起一座高耸云霄的大厦，您愿意吗？您准备好了吗？愿您早日为之奋起，挥洒您的智慧和力量。 1.字母的发音很重要，要是发不准，懂俄语的人听起来会怪怪的。字母发音，建议要先听一听比较标准的发音，然后自己在好好练。俄语中最难的发音是颤音р，这个要多练习。 2.单词。单词的读法不是很难，只要会字母的发音，再注意一下特殊字母在单词中的变音就能读出来，不用音标，那样会更麻烦。单词的变格，是重点。 3.对于句子，俄语中的语序不是很死板，一般可以调换。 4.认真的读一下有关俄语语法的东西，巩固。 5.说。尽可能的找会俄语的人与其用俄语交流，熟悉口语。 软件功能: 1.通用应用,同时支持iPhone,iPod touch,iPad设备 2.可以自动顺序播放功能 3.可以自动记录播放位置,不用担心下次找不到听到哪 4.支持离线播放,即使不联网也一样听,到哪都不怕 5.支持手动拖拽前进、后退播放 6.在兼顾软件容量以及更多课程的情况下,我们最大限度保证音频的高质量,每个有声读物片段都是经过我们精选和亲测 7.最最重要的功能，可以拖动字幕定位,音频随之定位

947290516.description: 本应用专门为韩语零起点初学者打造，由韩籍语言专家审校把关，强调“从零开始”这一概念，注重发音与口语的实际表达能力，循序渐进，带着你轻轻松松学好韩语。 本应用满足了初学者的所有要求。不仅软件设计大方美观，内容更是丰富多彩。从基础字母入门，到日常生活、青春校园、职场风云、特色文化等，几乎涵盖了所有你能想到的，以及你若是有机会去韩国旅游生活或是工作能够用到的所有方面。 “发音-词汇-句型-语法-口语”轻松开口说地道韩语!一点韩语都不懂？看这个APP就对了！ 想学习一门外语的原因有很多，韩语也不例外，你可能是想更轻松地看韩剧、学韩语歌、追韩星，也可能是想去韩国首尔、济州岛自助旅行，也可能是工作关系需要跟韩国企业打交道，还可能仅仅是为了学习一门外语。但是一旦你决定开始学习，就一定要找到一个简单、便捷、实用的入门方法，这样才不会被初学时的一头雾水打败，才会更有信心、更顺利地学好韩语。 韩语新手入门5大法宝 1）用最适合中国人的方法学习发音 首创汉字拼音拟音法，真人发音口型图，图片例词，字帖式书写练习，环环相扣，全面加强开口说韩语的能力。 2）1000高频单词+1000实用分类单词 词汇专家总结出1000个最常用单词，日常对话中一定会用到的必备单词；科学分类总结1000实用单词，让单词记忆更系统更方便。 3）100常用句型+400极短句+500扩展例句 精心提炼基础口语句型，场景式互动学习，掌握最核心、最具活力的口语表达法。 4）融入式语法理念 循序渐进导入常用句型，培养韩式语言思维，自然习惯韩语语法，彻底告别枯燥语法。 5）80个日常口语话题+240组地道对话 韩国人生活中最常聊到的生活话题，模拟情境再现，融会贯通，举一反三，口语表达力完美提升。 此应用软件《学韩语中韩双语版》，绝对是你最理想的选择！ 软件功能: 1.通用应用,同时支持iPhone,iPod touch,iPad设备 2.可以自动顺序播放功能 3.可以自动记录播放位置,不用担心下次找不到听到哪 4.支持离线播放,即使不联网也一样听,到哪都不怕 5.支持手动拖拽前进、后退播放 6.在兼顾软件容量以及更多课程的情况下,我们最大限度保证音频的高质量,每个有声读物片段都是经过我们精选和亲测 7.最最重要的功能，可以拖动字幕定位,音频随之定位

948090890.name: MoonCatcher
948090890.description: This is an app that allows you to easily photograph the moon at night, including its pattern. You can also zoom easily. Usage is simple. (A) Tap the moon from the menu and tap the closest moon shape among the three. (B) Point the camera at the moon and zoom. (C) Release the shutter without moving the smartphone (tripod recommended). The shutter will fire several times, so don't let it slide until the end. If you cannot take any of the photos with the moon in focus, you can try "changing the center of focus" as many times as you like below. Tap the manual mode button (second button from the bottom right) to enter manual mode, where you can manually set focus, ISO/shutter speed, white balance, and multiple exposure parameters. The features of this app are (1) Fully automatic function If you select "Moon", the exposure will be automatically darkened in response to the bright moon in the night sky, and the focus will be adjusted to the distance. Since it fires continuously while changing the focus multiple times, you can choose the best result among them. (The number of consecutive shots and the center of focus can be changed with the slider) "Change the focus center": Tap "Moon" on the shooting screen to display the moon shape selection segment, the number of consecutive shots slider, and the focus center slider. Now you can change each value. Because the moon is far away, it is difficult to focus when zoomed in. Therefore, if you take pictures while changing the focus little by little, you can expect the moon to be in focus at some point. The focus range is from 0 (nearby) to 1 (far), but in reality, the focus is shifted by 1/5 when shooting. For example, 0.7 to 0.9 (0.8 in the center). By changing the center of focus, you can shift the focus within any range and fire continuously. There are two types of night views. ・"Night Scene 1" brightens a dark night scene by one level. ・“Night Scene 2” brightens the image one step brighter than “Night Scene 1”. It fires continuously while changing the brightness 4 times. If you select "HDR", multiple consecutive images with different exposures will be combined to create a pseudo-large dynamic range. Multiple exposure 3 times. (2) Full manual function You can take photos by manually setting the focal length, exposure, white balance, photo composition method, and number of photos. ・Tap "Focus", "ISO/SS", and "WB" to select auto or manual. ・Tap "Multiple Exposure" to select the multiple exposure composition method and set the number of composite images (up to 100). The synthesis methods are as following. Bright: Screen composit (Screen Blend) Normal: Comparison(light) composition (Lighten Blend) Dark: Comparison (dark) composition (Darken Blend) HDR: Special composition (Special Blend) (３) Other camera functions ・Zoom function: Achieving a zoom ratio of 40 time ・A camera position: The LCD screen side or the back camera is selectable. ・Focus position specification ・Mesh display ・Aspect selection ・Deviation correction selection (４) Filter function just after the photography To display the photograph just after photography and the following filtering are possible by slider operation. ・Purity (sharpness) ・Comparison degree (contrast) ・Luminosity (exposure) ・Display list function The photos taken in this app is stored in the camera roll and in app itself too and you can see the list of them with the shooting date and time information. ・Image processing function When you tap the image on the list, it displays the list of filters for image processing. It has about 70 filters such as 'Brightness','Contrast','Blur','Sharpening','Sepia','Monochrome','Edge detection','Sketch' and so on. This app include the following open sources. 948090890.summaryDescription: This is an app that allows you to easily photograph the moon at night, including its pattern. You can also zoom easily. Usage is simple. (A) Tap the moon from the menu and tap the closest moon shape among the three. (B) Point the camera at the moon and zoom. (C) Release the shutter without moving the smartphone (tripod recommended). The shutter will fire several times, so don't let it slide until the end. If you cannot take any of the photos with the moon in focus, you can try "changing the center of focus" as many times as you like below. Tap the manual mode button (second button from the bottom right) to enter manual mode, where you can manually set focus, ISO/shutter speed, white balance, and multiple exposure parameters. The features of this app are (1) Fully automatic function If you select "Moon", the exposure will be automatically darkened in response to the bright moon in the night sky, and the focus will be adjusted to the distance. Since it fires continuously while changing the focus multiple times, you can choose the best result among them. (The number of consecutive shots and the center of focus can be changed with the slider) "Change the focus center": Tap "Moon" on the shooting screen to display the moon shape selection segment, the number of consecutive shots slider, and the focus center slider. Now you can change each value. Because the moon is far away, it is difficult to focus when zoomed in. Therefore, if you take pictures while changing the focus little by little, you can expect the moon to be in focus at some point. The focus range is from 0 (nearby) to 1 (far), but in reality, the focus is shifted by 1/5 when shooting. For example, 0.7 to 0.9 (0.8 in the center). By changing the center of focus, you can shift the focus within any range and fire continuously. There are two types of night views. ・"Night Scene 1" brightens a dark night scene by one level. ・“Night Scene 2” brightens the image one step brighter than “Night Scene 1”. It fires continuously while changing the brightness 4 times. If you select "HDR", multiple consecutive images with different exposures will be combined to create a pseudo-large dynamic range. 948216105.description: My Scans是iPhone和iPad最好的文档扫描仪和文档组织工具！ 这是超级简单易用。只要对着文件、发票、名片、票据、担保书、合同或备忘录拍照并保存。 My Scans会处理余下的工作。它可以检测边缘和转换照片到PDF文档。 你可以随时随地通过电子邮件发送文件或打印。 你可以使用My Scans Cloud与你的设备同步处理文件，以计算机的浏览器访问文件，使用共享文件夹他人合作，通过接收或下载链接，接收和分享文件。 从现在起，你将随时随地获得你所需要的PDF文档！ 你可以使用My Scans去扫描任何文件： 票据、发票、合同、税务、名片、白板、备忘录、脚本、信件、书籍、黑板、笔记、论文、证明文件、证书、身份证件… 现在你拥有市场上最好的移动扫描仪，你可以扫描任何文件，快速和方便的把文化转换成为PDF文档。 My Scans是让你可以在PDF文档上签名的应用程序，例如是NDA、税务表格、房地产合同、工作计划书、发票、采购订单、财务协议、租赁协议、许可单、工作单... 主要特点： 自动边缘检测 创建可搜索的PDF文档** 多页文档 注释PDF文档 使用您的设备在PDF文档上签字盖章 实用的文件和文件夹的组织工具 以图像/ PDF文件分享您的文件** 从你的设备打印文件** 搜索文件** 云协作（集体项目）* 云共享（只共享文件和文件夹的链接）* 云备份* 通过浏览器（不需要应用程序）云访问项目* 在多个设备上同步项目* 顶级云端应用程序特点： 云协作（集体项目） 云共享（只共享文件和文件夹的链接） 云备份 通过浏览器（不需要应用程序）云访问项目 在多个设备上同步项目 订阅顶级云端应用程序： 价格是$ 2.99 /月或$ 19.99/年 通过iTunes账户确认付款 自动更新订阅，除非你在订阅期结束前24小时关闭自动更新订阅功能。 在当前订阅期结束前24小时会在帐户中收取订阅费用并确定更新订阅的费用。 用户可以自由管理订阅和在帐户设置中关闭自动更新购买功能。 于订阅期期间不能取消订阅 隐私政策：http://cloud.topapp.si/legal/tos 仅适用于启动顶级云端应用程序服务后。 仅适用于当My Scans Free升级到完整版后。

948768793.name: MarkText - Markdown文本编辑器
948768793.description: MarkText 是 iOS 上的一款支持 iCloud Drive 同步的 Markdown 文本编辑器，用于做笔记和写作。支持语法高亮，转换为 HTML、PNG 或 PDF。可以把 Markdown、HTML、PNG、PDF 分享到 Evernote、Dropbox，或通过 Email 发送。同步的文件，可以在 Web 或 macOS 的 iCloud Drive 中查看。 主要特性 + 好看的 Markdown 语法高亮； + 通过手指滑动键盘上方的工具条进行移动光标； + 带 CSS 样式的 HTML 预览； + 修改主题配色、字体样式； + 通过 iTunes 导入、导出文件，转换为 HTML、PNG 或 PDF 格式； + 分享到 Evernote、Dropbox 或 Email 等App； + 全文搜索，字数统计，支持正则的查找替换; + 通过 iCloud Drive 在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 之间同步笔记。 + 通过 Mermaid & Graphviz 编辑、绘制流程图、图表。 + 通过 MathJax 编辑、预览数学公式。 Todo列表 以 [ ] 或 [x] 开头标志的列表，表示未完成或已完成。 例如： [ ] 未完成 [x] 已完成 导入 & 导出 通过 iTunes 导入 Markdown 文本文件，或通过 MarkText 创建，编辑时支持实时语法高亮显示。编辑完成之后，可以通过 iTunes 导出到电脑，或者转换为 HTML、PNG、PDF 文件并发送到 Evernote、Dropbox、Email 等第三方 App。 光标增强 辅助工具条可以让你很方便地点击按钮插入Tabs、标题、列表、代码块，或者超链接。左右滑动工具条可以迅速移动光标；双指选择可以快速选择文本。 HTML预览 HTML 预览支持 CSS 样式，语法高亮支持的特性：常规 Markdown、MultiMarkdown、脚注、图片、表格和代码块。 iCloud Drive 同步 通过 iCloud Drive，在所有设备自动同步存储所有笔记文件。 支持的文件后缀 md、mmd、markdown、markdn、mdown、mkdn、markd、txt、text。 提示 在笔记列表向左滑动，可以删除笔记；长按可以重命名。 在笔记中添加 “#Hashtag” 或 “@Mention”，可以创建标签分类，等同于文件夹。 您可以在 Mac 电脑上的 iCloud Drive 文件夹里查看同步的笔记文件。 如果您有任何问题或建议，请联系：xappbox@gmail.com

949205941.name: 小小农场 - 儿童应用程序。
949205941.trackName: 小小农场 - 儿童应用程序。
949205941.description: 你置身农场中：这里有动物、拖拉机，还有众多神秘冒险。在我们的隐藏物品游戏中探索乡间生活，畅享90多个互动故事、有趣的声音和无限乐趣！ ▶ Toddlers Seek & Find，我们开发的一款超赞的应用程序已经获得超过400万次的下载次数。 ▶ 让2-6岁的儿童快乐感受生机勃勃的田园农场生活，体验真正的互动冒险！ ▶ 四个场景中90多个隐藏的动画和故事等待你去发现，儿童和家长可以体验农场生活，同时发现众多情节丰富的故事： 场景1——游戏亮点（农场中） 帮助农夫种甜菜。 喂驴。 给小猪洗澡！ 骄傲的公鸡巡视每个人。 场景2——游戏亮点（乡间） 用联合收割机在农田收割庄稼并播种。 让树屋中的男孩滑下钢索。 弄明白绵羊为什么这么有趣。 骑小马：漫步、小跑或慢跑！ 场景3——游戏亮点（谷仓中） 给绵羊剃最有趣的发型！ 用你喜欢的颜色绘彩蛋。 给动物喂食。 帮助农场修拖拉机。 场景4——游戏亮点（夜晚的农场） 现在月亮出来了。 动物都睡觉了。 但老屋门窗后面还有什么动静？去一探究竟！ 更多亮点 + 大量农场和乡村生活主题的可爱故事。 + 为什么老奶奶对踏板车唠叨个不停？ + 山羊为什么抓所有苹果？ + 母牛喜欢吃什么？ + 和孩子们在湖边玩！ + 渔夫为什么只钓到一只鞋？ + 机器人在谷仓中做什么？ ……还有很多事等你来做： 完成每个场景中的任务，弄明白为什么绵羊和猪是亲密好友，融入我们可爱的农场世界！ 我们的承诺 + 您的孩子会发现许多相互关联的小故事。 + 父母们也会不停地寻找新的隐藏细节。 + 不仅仅您的孩子会爱上这款应用程序。 支持的语言 + 阿拉伯语 + 中文（繁体和简体） + 荷兰语 + 英语 + 法语 + 德语 + 意大利语 + 日语 + 韩语 + 挪威语 + 葡萄牙语（巴西） + 俄 + 西班牙语 + 瑞典语 + 土耳其语 技术支持说明 我们已经在所有设备上彻底测试了这款应用程序。然而，如果您遇到问题，我们无法根据评论部分中的评语提供技术支持，请谅解。请给我们发送电子邮件，这样我们可以即时回复并提供帮助。非常感谢。

949207089.name: Booklover - eBook Reader
949207089.description: Booklover is a highly responsive and robust eBook reader. It excels at handling PDFs, manga, and scanned books. The metadata-driven library management system makes it easy to organize and enjoy a large collection of books in PDF, ZIP/CBZ, and RAR/CBR formats. Seamlessly integrated with iCloud Drive, books in the iCloud Drive/Booklover folder automatically appear in the app’s library and can be downloaded on demand. In the library, you can organize books by genres and arrange them using various bibliographic details such as title, author, publisher, and more. With the search field and powerful Library Navigator, you can quickly locate a book among thousands in your collection. Customize your reading experience with settings for each book, including page layout, transition axis and style, cropping, filters, progress direction, background, and more. Booklover supports bookmarks with titles and notes, as well as PDF text annotations (highlights), text search, and a table of contents. Main Features: General Manage and view eBooks (PDF, ZIP/CBZ, RAR/CBR) Support for archived image files in JPG, PNG, GIF, HEIF, WEBP, AVIF, and JPEG XL formats Automatic syncing of book files placed in iCloud Drive/Booklover. On-demand caching (download) of the remote files Import files via iTunes (Windows), Finder (Mac), AirDrop, Drag & Drop, "Open with..." etc. Import files via apps from various cloud storage services, such as Dropbox and OneDrive, as well as other services accessible through the iOS Files app. Slide Over / Split View (iPad) Hardware keyboard support (mainly in the reader) Library Section books by genre (ON/OFF) The Library Navigator (ON/OFF) Histories of added and opened books Context Menu for individual books (long-press a book cover) Change sort order: By Title, Author, Publisher, Filename, Added Date, etc. Alphanumeric Index Labels (ON/OFF) Toggle display of cover accessories Adjust cover grid size Responsive Shadow (shows page volume with shadow) Filter books by Status, Genre, Tags, etc. Search books by various bibliographic details, file name, and tags Reader PDF text annotations (highlights) with notes, text search, and a table of contents Bookmarks with titles and notes Lists of bookmarks and PDF annotations Page transition settings: Axis (Horizontal, Vertical), Style (Scroll, Continuous Scroll, Stack, Crossfade, Zoom fade, Instant) Progress direction setting: Left to Right, Right to Left (for vertical text, manga, Arabic, etc.) Page layout setting: Automatic, Single-Page, Two-Pages (spread) Separate page layout settings for view orientation (Portrait / Landscape) Page trimming (for images only) Page sizing: Show All, Width-Fit, Height-Fit Page thumbnail view (overview, bookmarks) Image correction filters Dynamic background (When the "Background Color" option for a book is set to "Dynamic") Adjust page spread position (Insert adjuster page at the beginning of the book body) Text recognition within images (with compatible devices only) Export (share) the currently displayed page Book Management Edit metadata: Title, Author, Genre, Publisher, Published Date, ISBN, etc. Edit Tags (Can be used as filter criteria in the side menu) Extract metadata (title/author) from PDFs Extract various metadata from file names with configurable extraction rules Automatic/Manual cropping of book covers Batch modification of book settings and metadata Transfer book files: "Open with...", AirDrop, Drag & Drop, etc. Can manage the content files and data separately ("Ghost Book") ——————————————— Acknowledgments [Books used in the screenshots] "Give My Regards to Black Jack" by SHUHO SATO (Manga on Web: http://mangaonweb.com) Public domain books from Feedbooks (http://www.feedbooks.com) Public domain comics from digitalcomicmuseum.com (http://digitalcomicmuseum.com)

949290742.name: NIH Score & stroke tools
949290742.description: NEW APP FOR iOS14+ USERS*** This application helps physicians who manage patients at the acute phase of stroke. Time manager: specify the hour of symptoms onset and hospital admission to get an automatic determination of door-to-needle time ABCD2 score to calculate stroke risk for patients presenting with transient ischemic attacks CHA2DS2 VASc score to calculate stroke risk for patients with non valvular atrial fibrillation Modified Rankin Scale ASPECTS score On Apple Watch **** ABCD2 Score CHA2DS2 VASc Score Modified Rankin Scale ASPECTS score This app is dedicated to physicians working in the field of neurology or emergency. It can also be helpful for residents and medical students.

949490225.description: 完全按您的期望在页面上打印图像。以厘米为单位进行调整和裁切。在一张纸上打印多张照片。不会有意外或浪费 实际尺寸 以厘米为单位调整大小和进行裁剪。每个打印的图像将与屏幕上显示的大小完全一致。 高质量 看起来像素化？PPI (DPI)显示会告诉您。为了达到最佳效果，避免拉伸低于200-300 PPI的照片。 每个图像被以全分辨率发送到打印机，以保证最佳质量 节省纸张 将多张图像放在页面上的任何地方。填补您纸上的空白，减少使用纸张。 节省油墨 选择最经济的打印模式（照片或一般质量，彩色或灰阶）。裁剪以打印您所需要的内容，不会浪费墨水。 采用熟悉的触摸手势，直观，容易上手： 选择纸张尺寸 添加图像 在页面内任何地方按确切尺寸调整大小，进行裁剪 对齐，旋转，翻转和复制 选择您的模式（照片或一般质量，彩色或灰阶），然后打印。 需要支持AirPrint的打印机。如果没有，您可以创建一个PDF文件，然后通过其他方式进行打印。 完美适合各种家庭打印需求： 相框 贺卡 门牌 标签 徽章 打印机制造商要出售墨水和相纸，所以他们的应用程序没有被设计来帮助避免浪费。而这个程序不同，它的目的是让您第一次就打印好。立即下载，让您的墨水和纸张得到最佳的使用！

949773084.description: This app contains information on approximately 6,000 islands in Japan. Island attribute information includes the island's name, kana name, English name, location, area, coast length, population, whether it's populated, island grouping name, applicable act, designated area name, basis for territorial sea only, basis for EEZ (Exclusive Economic Zone), populated remote territorial island (RTI) area, specific populated RTI area, name of populated RTI area, included nature park, natural monument, access, and notes. 950387755.name: Burstio – Animate your burst photos
950387755.description: Burstio converts burst photos taken with the built-in Camera app into videos or GIFs. Featured on Lifehacker, CNET, Product Hunt and other websites. IMPORTANT: Compatible devices are iPhone 5s and later, iPad Air 2 and later. Features: Play a burst sequence as a regular video Trim the burst sequence to preferred frames Set playback speed — slow down or increase the frame rate (0.25–3.0x) Set playback direction — forward, reversed, back and forth Export as video or GIF to your Photo Library Share with friends or just keep it Technical Specifications: Video resolution: Full HD (1080p) or HD (720p) without cropping (adjusted width) Video format: QuickTime (.mov) GIF resolution: Large (640p) or Small (320p) Audio is not included with burst photos Requirements: Requires burst photos stored in your Camera Roll "A picture is worth a thousand words – a burst can tell a story behind."

950418754.name: The Solar System VL2 Storybook
950418754.description: The Solar System is an educational narrative in both ASL and English about our eight planets, moons, and the sun. The illustrations and the video narrative provides enhanced visual aids to create an interactive, self-directed reading and learning experience for young deaf children. The Solar System is full of scientific facts along with a fantastic collection of vocabulary words and definitions in ASL. This is made by the same team who created the award-winning ASL/English bilingual storybook app, The Baobab. VL2 Storybook Apps are designed based on research in visual learning and language acquisition for an optimal reading experience.

950606030.trackName: 大家學標準日本語：中級本
950606030.description: 【這輩子一定要有的，日語文型文法查詢指南】 本套書由具有「外國語教育教師證照」， 網路教學內容獲得數百萬人次點閱的人氣名師－－出口仁， 根據生活、工作、檢定等目的，量身打造專業課程， 完整規劃學日語必備的「127個具體學習目標」！ 【初級本】：奠定日語基礎必學的基本課程（42個「具體學習目標」） 【中級本】：發展日語能力必學的進階課程（44個「具體學習目標」） 【高級本】：活化日語實力必學的應用課程（41個「具體學習目標」） 所有的日語變化，都源自這「127個學習目標」，解決日語疑難問題，查詢後都能獲得滿意解答，堪稱【這輩子一定要有的，日語文型文法查詢指南】！ ※　提供出口仁老師的大家學標準日本語【初級／中級／高級本】教學影片，可於本App中直接購買。 ●　產品介紹： 1.【中級本】：進入最關鍵的「動詞變化」，「變化形」結合「文型」，朝更多元表達邁進！ 同系列的【初級本】是以「不需要動詞變化，就能完成的日語基本表達」為主，而【中級本】則是針對進階程度，規畫「發展日語能力必學的文型及會話」，以「掌握動詞變化、結合文型表達、擴展會話的可能性」為目標。 讀完本書，你將學會： ◎「動詞變化、現在進行、動作順序」用法 ◎「 ~と、 ~たら、 ~すぎ」用法 ◎「受身文、使役文、條件形」的說法 ◎「要求、許可、遺憾、經驗、建議、難易、能力」的說法 2. 每一課學習一個「變化形」，結合實用表達，融入「44個具體學習目標」！ 第14課【動詞て形】：「運用て形」的「要求、許可、現在進行、試行」說法 第18課【動詞た形】：「運用た形」的「經驗、按照…、建議、動作舉例」說法 第20課【動詞可能形】：「運用可能形」的「表示能力、變化、儘量…」說法 第23課【動詞受身形】：「運用受身形」的「被害受身、公共受身、創造受身」說法 3. 每一種日語的用法，都會解釋原因，不會只說「這是日語的習慣用法」！ 出口仁老師特別擅長解說抽象的文型文法，以「一定能夠說明原因」的淺顯易懂教學法，在部落格、facebook、YouTube獲得數十萬人次的熱烈迴響。 4. 精準設定「學習目標」，達成「循序漸進、步步提升」！ 作者以「由簡入繁、由基本到延伸」的概念，安排44個具體學習目標。優先出現的，一定是最基本、最常見的，再依序出現更多元的用法。 5. 明確定義「學習內容」，清楚知道「自己的實力到哪裡」！ 作者解說44個具體學習目標時，將每一個「必學的要點」和「補充的要點」做出明確定義。分別是：【要注意！】【一定要會的！】【行有餘力再多學！】【能力足夠要多記！】 ●　內容特色 1. 最完整的「日語動詞變化概論」，初學「動詞變化」就上手！ 2. 單字、文型、長篇和短篇對話，面面俱到的學習內容！ 2. 【課本】+【文法解說．練習題本】，完整學習一次到位！ 3. 日籍專業播音員錄製，最正統的【東京標準音】！ 4. 可於App中加購【教學影片】，出口仁老師授課【中級本：44個具體學習目標】精彩講解！ ●　學習功能特色 1. 提供iPhone/iPad閱讀模式：讓您在使用裝置中，擁有最好的閱讀模式。 2. 閱讀訓練：中日文顯示或隱藏模式，可設定全日文∕中日文對照學習環境 3. 聽力訓練：語音速度調整，可調整五段不同速度 4. 單字訓練：提供單字標記功能，方便背誦不熟的單字，並提供單字記憶背誦與單字測驗功能，徹底強化單字力。 5. 目錄條理分明：分12課、44個學習目標，含文法解說與練習題本，條目分明，內容豐富。 6. 搜尋：輸入關鍵字即可查找想學習了解的內容。 7. 書籤：將重要學習內容標以書籤，方便日後反覆復習。 8. 筆記：學習過程中，可做筆記。 9. 字體：可依需求調整字體大小。 ●　可在App內加購之教學影片的檔案大小如下： 第13課 223MB 第14課 108MB 第15課 128MB 第16課 95MB 第17課 103MB 第18課 118MB 第19課 98MB 第20課 113MB 第21課 236MB 第22課 18MB 第23課 111MB 第24課 95MB ●　客服聯絡：如對產品有任何想法或建議，或者使用上遭遇問題，都歡迎和我們聯絡－ 1. 客服信箱：welcome@mail.soyong.com.tw 2. 客服留言板：https://www.mebook.com.tw/iPhone/SupportTC.asp 3. 客服電話：請於上班時間來電02-77210772轉510 我們一定竭誠為您服務。

950904018.description: iOS练字app哪个最好?中文笔顺是一款针对书法爱好者量身定制的练字软件app，支持iPhone，iPad和iPad Pro和Apple Pencil 写字。 中文笔顺可以帮助你学习简体中文和繁体中文书写的写字,只要输入中文进行搜索,即可立刻展现笔顺动画,你还可以调节动画的速度。这是你学习中文的活字帖！假如你是教师或学生，这更是你学习过程的最佳伙伴，学习中文更轻松！ 特色功能: 1. 20000多字中文笔顺 2. 拼音标注 3. 真人发声 4. 简繁转换 5. 图片转文字 6. 语音转文字 7. 手写正确性检查功能 8. 多国语言字典 支持： 阿拉伯语 法语 德语 希腊语 印地语 印尼语 意大利语 日语 韩语 马来语 波斯语 葡萄牙语 俄语 西班牙语 瑞典语 泰语 越南语 ◇ 小儿难教，一个“火”字笔顺难倒家长！◇ ◎ “中文笔顺”是一款集汉字笔顺查询、汉字书写练习、翻译于一体的App。严格按照国家颁布的最新汉字笔画顺序为标准，收录20000多个常用汉字，满足广大师生、家长和小朋友检索的需要。 ◎ “中文笔顺”中的汉字笔顺和部首以《小学生笔画部首结构字级笔顺字典》、《现代汉语笔画部首结构字级笔顺规范字典》两本字典为依据。对20000多个汉字的正确笔顺做了细致的校验工作。 ◎ App支持的所有20000多个汉字中，我们对每一个汉字的每一笔笔顺，都手工配上了笔顺名称和笔顺名称读音，以及汉字拼音读音。（其中语音包需单独购买） ◎ 除了查询，我们还提供了App支持的全部汉字的书写练习功能，App会要求按照正确的笔顺进行书写。通过不断练习，大家可以慢慢掌握汉字的正确书写方法，以及了解汉字的骨架结构。 ◎ 汉字是中华民族文化的重要部分，几乎每一个汉字的背后都含有非常丰富的含义和哲理（比如：仁，意为想到自己的同时，也要想到别人）。我们衷心希望通过“中文笔顺”这款App，逐步向我们的用户介绍这方面的知识，通过生动、有趣的表现方法，传达中华民族文化之精髓，把她介绍给全世界的每一位朋友。

951251308.description: Symphony is the premiere notation app and notepad for professional musicians, composers, and students alike, allowing to you create anything from piano sheet music to large orchestrations directly on your iPhone. The Pencil tool allows you to tap anywhere on the canvas to quickly add notes and chords with the multi-staff & multi-voice editor. Powerful editing features like vertical drag to transpose and On-Screen piano lets you compose even more quickly. Switch to the other Select tool to highlight one or more notes to modify duration, transpose, erase, cut, or paste multiple tracks & bars anywhere you want. To hear your performance, choose from 100+ acoustic instruments available for live, low-latency, multi-track playback. Import an existing Symphony/SP project or a MIDI/XML file to bring your music collection to life, with an interactive score display & interface optimized for the small screen. To send your work to a different editor or to a sheet music viewer, Symphony can print your score with AirPrint, share it as a PDF attachment, or as a MIDI, MusicXML, or audio file to DropBox and iCloud Drive. More Features: Write notes using direct touch, an on-screen instrument, a MIDI input device, or even a QWERTY keyboard Notate beautifully formatted chord charts & lead sheets using the Chord Symbol and Lyric tools. Import MusicXML, MIDI, MXL, or Symphony files Export as a PDF, MusicXML, MIDI, AAC, or Symphony file Print the score from your iPad with AirPrint Edit grace notes and percussion/drum set notation Intuitive score and document navigation Up to 15 instruments, 45 staves, 4 voices/layers per score Record MIDI to notation in real-time using a click track Backup & sync scores with iCloud Edit tablature and standard music notation Large selection of articulations & dynamics in the Expressions menu Copy/Paste function can select multiple measures & staves, and cut single or multiple voices/layers Unlimited undo and redo Customizable stem directions & note beaming Transposing instruments & concert pitch options Change tempo or clef at any point in the score Stream audio or share your screen wirelessly with AirPlay Advanced document management support Customizable part groupings for SATB and instrument families Customizable chord symbol, lyric, and annotation font Loop playback between a region selection Auto-save For more info, please visit: Product overview: http://symphonypro.net/iphone Ask support questions by visiting forums.symphonypro.net Like us on Facebook at facebook.com/symphonyapp Symphony iPhone is now a paid app before download: – Free Edition users who have never upgraded can now enable Symphony: Full Edition by rating or reviewing the app

951445103.name: British Museum Audio Guide
951445103.description: The British Museum is the home of several rare and invaluable time capsules from around the world. These are all beautifully arranged inside the museum so as to stunningly recreate the past so we can relive the bygone glory. More rewarding than the visit itself would be the cherished memories that you would create as you spellbindingly walk alongside artifacts from every corner of the world under it’s magnificent roof. Take your time and be transfixed by the awesomeness of the sights that unravel like a panaroma around you. Time will stand still and hold you mesmerised and you will be dumbstruck by the sheer size and awe inspiring scale of the antiquities that fill the museum’s corridors! While the Rosetta Stone is clearly what the museum is most famous for it is only the tip of the iceberg. As you navigate the museum you will be surprised at the overall beauty and breadth of the unparalleled collection in store. Apart from the obvious highlights covered in our exclusive app the British Museum is also home to one of the most invaluable collections of ancient Egyptian history, perhaps one of thr largest outside of Egypt. The drama and magnificence of the Assyrian lion hunts will hold sway over you, while the zen like calmness of the Asian section will leave you with an everlasting feeling of spiritual uplifting. Be prepared to be left speechless as you enter the Greek galleries that hold the Parthenon marbles. After the entire Greek temple was reduced to a rubble following a Venetian bombardmemt Lord Elgin had the foresight and enterprise to shift them indoors to preserve these pinnacles of art for prosperity. Visiting the British Museum is a soul searching experience for all. You can find ways to connect to our shared heritage of thousands of years of human history. You will find unique and remarkable ways to connect to our past, discover our human ancestors, explore long forgotten belief systems and unravel a maze of cultural fabrics that has underscored our coexistence since time immemorial. No matter which country you are from, we can assure you that you will find something in the British Museum that you will instantly connect to and it will become part of your cherished memory. So come and explore world history and rediscover everything that makes you you! And.. What better way to enjoy the museum than with an app put together by experts to make your visit seamless and stress free? Do carry your head phones to plug in and remember the buddy needs your audio buds!

951495866.name: 中國佛教白話經典寶藏-題解源流
951495866.trackName: 中國佛教白話經典寶藏-題解源流
951495866.description: 一三二冊的中國佛教經典寶藏，乃彙集三藏十二部中，精選重要的大小乘經典及各宗派論書所成。經典部分，有阿含經、金剛經、法華經、楞嚴經等二十餘部；佛弟子闡釋佛陀說法內容的論著，有大智度論、中論、瑜伽師地論、攝大乘論等二十餘部；中國佛教各宗派所依據的典籍、祖師的著作，亦收錄不少，如景德傳燈錄、祖堂集、摩訶止觀、華嚴師子章、萬善同歸集等。近代祖師、高僧的撰述，有來果禪師語錄、弘一大師文集選要、星雲禪話等十餘部。這套書是白話佛典的精華集粹，是學佛者的現代版藏經叢書。尤其，透過題解與源流，解說每一部經典的主旨、重點大意，分析經典思想的形成，更能掌握經中義理，是佛教徒不可或缺的工具書。

951598770.name: iPerf - Speed Test Tool
951598770.description: This app is an iOS port for iperf3, which is the most commonly used network testing and performance computation tool. Iperf is a tool to measure maximum TCP bandwidth, allowing the tuning of various parameters and UDP characteristics. Features Compatible with iperf3 in other platforms Run as iperf3 client or server Customize iperf3 arguments Display Wi-Fi interface link speed and SSID IMPORTANT This application is based on iperf 3.21, which is not compatible with the legacy iperf (version 1.x and 2.x). And it may have some minor issues with the other iperf3 versions.

951718596.description: 简介 软件小、性能强、超好用的【全功能CAD】 兼容AutoCAD R14到2026各版本的DWG二维三维图纸 专业CAD技术团队持续维护更新 提供QQ群（956320587）技术服务 【产品主要功能】 基础功能： 支持.dwg .dxf .dwf文件格式的打开，包括加密图纸； 关联相关图纸格式，双击快速打开图纸； 支持触摸板与鼠标平移与缩放图纸； 支持天正图纸显示（限时免费）； 支持布局切换； 支持设置背景颜色； 支持加载外部参照图； 支持自动适配所缺字体，完美显示图形、字体和符号； 支持云盘空间、大文件上传、在线分享云图纸； CAD全功能支持： 直线、圆、矩形、多段线，删除、复制、移动、旋转、镜像、倒角、修剪、延伸、阵列等CAD基础功能一应俱全 文字表格： 文字插入、双击文字编辑、文字提取、查找替换等； 图纸表格插入与提取 标注： 支持相对、线性、半径、角度、坐标等常用标注； 批量打印与转出PDF： 支持一键识别图纸图框，批量打印、转出PDF和图片 测量: 支持长度、面积周长、角度等测量； 图层： 直观的查看图纸图层； 支持图层管理器，图层开关、冻结、锁定、图层匹配等所有图层相关功能 【自动续订会员说明】 订阅周期：1个月与12个月 付款：用户确认购买并付款后计入iTunes账户 取消续订：如需取消续订，请在当前订阅周期到期前24小时以前，进入“iTunes Store与App Store”，点击“Apple ID”，选择“查看Apple ID”。进入“账户设置”页面，点击“订阅”，选择对应的订阅项取消即可。 续费：购买自动续订会员的帐号，苹果iTunes会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个周期。 隐私政策:http://www.aec188.com/privacy.php 会员服务及自动续订协议：http://www.aec188.com/agreement.php 如有使用疑问或者建议，请加QQ群：956320587，邮箱：wangbinbin@52cad.com。 如果支持我们的产品，请在下方五星评论提出自己宝贵的建议或者反馈，我们会第一时间处理您的问题，谢谢。

952286893.name: FRYY - Perfect Steak Timer
952286893.description: Welcome to FRYY, the ultimate steak timer app designed to make you a steak-cooking expert! Whether you prefer rare, medium-rare or well-done, FRYY ensures your steak is cooked to perfection - and all it takes is a few taps! Key Features: Customized Steak Preferences: Choose the desired doneness level and steak thickness and you'll receive precise instructions on how to cook it just like that. Timer and Notifications: Set timers based on steak thickness and the desired doneness level. FRYY will notify you at each stage of the cooking process. Step-by-Step Instructions: Follow the app's instructions, including flip reminders and resting times, ensuring every steak comes out just the way you wanted. Temperature Guide: Access a temperature chart to understand the ideal cooking temperatures for different levels of doneness. Save Favorites: Save your favorite steak cooking settings for quick and easy access in the future. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned chef, FRYY simplifies the art of cooking steak, ensuring consistent results that will impress not just your guests but even your own taste buds. Download FRYY now and take your steak-cooking game to a whole new level!

952350873.name: iTrack Africa
952350873.description: There’s something about knowing what creatures sniffed your tent in the night or walked along the path ahead of you. And yet, so often those signs are a mystery to us. Well they needn’t be. iTrack Southern Africa is an easy-to-use digital field guide that takes our communal knowledge of Southern African mammal tracks to another level altogether. It is accessible enough for those outdoor enthusiasts with nothing more than a casual interest in the footprints they come across and yet contains enough accurate and quantifiable information to be a powerful tool for hunters, researchers and expert trackers. It breaks new ground in documenting the commonly used gait patterns of many Southern African mammals and makes use of over 2000 measurements to bring users never before published detail on track dimensions. Some of the key features of this app include: Track and sign information for 61 Southern African mammal species (this number will continue to be added to in future updates). Over 650 high quality track, sign, and animal photos with captions that point out key identification features. Scale bars with precise measurements next to many track and sign photos. Hoof, paw or foot photographs for a number species. Photographs of commonly used gait patterns. Detailed descriptions for both front and hind tracks. 952768692.name: 睡眠超人：宝宝睡眠应用程序, 白噪音设备及录音器
952768692.trackName: 睡眠超人：宝宝睡眠应用程序, 白噪音设备及录音器
952768692.description: 限时折扣***睡眠超人 可以帮助您的宝贝儿一觉睡到天亮。这是一个噪音- 激活应用程序,将为您的宝宝播放舒缓的声音，帮助他们返回睡眠中。除了内置的白噪声音，父母们也可以录制自己的声音，读书或唱摇篮曲，以在夜间安抚他们的小宝贝儿。 睡眠超人的创始人是一位父亲，他有一个三岁和一岁的孩子，并同运营一间应用程序开发公司。本应用程序是专为新生儿至3岁以上的宝宝们制作的，它兼容了一些特定功能，为宝宝培育一个良好的夜间睡眠环境： 0-1岁：白噪音可模拟母亲子宫里的声音，并为新生儿提供一个舒适的环境。 1-2岁：喜欢父母令人放心的声音，因此自己录制一些催眠曲和故事。 3岁以上：为年龄较大的孩子设置的内置贴纸奖励制度，这个年纪孩子难以通过声音安抚。 功能包括： 白噪声的音频库，包括40种舒缓的声音。 使用录音机录制自己的声音，摇篮曲和睡前故事。 循环播放睡眠计时器。 自动模式显示器：侦听哭泣声，并自动播放舒缓的声音帮助宝宝返回睡眠中。 可调节的噪音激活灵敏度。 柔和淡入/淡出。 贴纸图表奖励年龄较大的宝宝。 连接至智能手机的投影机，应用程序将会在天花板上播放影像，帮助宝宝安心睡眠（查看我们的博客，了解更多信息）。 优化，延长电池寿命。 防眩光设计，适合夜间使用。 采用最新的iOS技术构建。 白噪音包括： 飞机客舱 - 鸟鸣声 - 咖啡厅喋喋不休 - 篝火 - 蟋蟀 - 黑暗面 - 滴水水龙头 - 电风扇 - 长笛 - 喷泉 - 电冰箱 - 青蛙 - 水壶 - 发电机嗡嗡声 - 电吹风 - 心跳 - 山涧溪流 - 海洋 - 猫头鹰 - 钢琴 - 打呼噜的猫 - 雨 - 雨打落在车顶上 - 嘘 - 空间静态- 自动喷水灭火 - 飞船 - 喷火 - 潜水艇 - 雷 - 交通 - 火车 - 打字机 - 吸尘器 - 洗衣机 - 海浪 - 鲸鱼 - 白噪声 - 风铃 - 随风摆动的树 该应用程序经过一群热心家长的测试，通过他们的反馈帮助塑造出今天你们所看到的功能。因此欢迎家长们的积极反馈，您们的反馈可帮助开发新的功能，帮助您和您的宝贝儿们享受更好的睡眠。 我们建议您在使用睡眠超人时，开启飞行模式。

952769087.name: Ski School Experts
952769087.description: Ski School Experts combines inspirational, professionally produced how to ski video lessons with cutting-edge movement analysis technology to take your skiing to the next level. Pushing on from our advanced ski lessons we look at giving your skiing a high performance tune. On piste we'll look at body position, edge pressure, turn accuracy and skiing steeps to make you more adaptable and able to tackle the toughest slopes. For your off-piste skiing we look at the importance of the pole plant, line choice and difficult conditions such as variable snow and tree skiing. Finally we finish off with an introduction to jumping. Mastering all these skills will position you up there as an expert all-mountain skier. These carefully designed lessons will: Complement on-slope tuition with a qualified instructor Clarify the basics Give you the skills and techniques to tackle different snow conditions Help you explore the entire mountain. Video recording capabilities allow you to compare your skiing with instructor demos using split screen video analysis. Draw on the screen to highlight points then share on social media. Keep a diary with the notes facility and then track your progress though your ski history. Best of all it’s portable and can be used anywhere: In the chalet before a day out As a handy reminder on the lift between runs On the bus, train or plane before heading out to the mountains Once purchased, the app goes onto your device with everything included, no further uploads or costly data charges while you’re away. Just grab your phone and hit the slopes. Give your skiing the boost it deserves with the Ski School app - your portable ski instructor.

For your off-piste skiing we look at the importance of the pole plant, line choice and difficult conditions such as variable snow and tree skiing. Finally we finish off with an introduction to jumping. Mastering all these skills will position you up there as an expert all-mountain skier. These carefully designed lessons will: Complement on-slope tuition with a qualified instructor Clarify the basics Give you the skills and techniques to tackle different snow conditions Help you explore the entire mountain. Video recording capabilities allow you to compare your skiing with instructor demos using split screen video analysis. Draw on the screen to highlight points then share on social media. Keep a diary with the notes facility and then track your progress though your ski history. Best of all it’s portable and can be used anywhere: In the chalet before a day out As a handy reminder on the lift between runs On the bus, train or plane before heading out to the mountains Once purchased, the app goes onto your device with everything included, no further uploads or costly data charges while you’re away. Just grab your phone and hit the slopes. Give your skiing the boost it deserves with the Ski School app - your portable ski instructor.

952813813.name: oneSafe+ password manager
952813813.description: 还在为密码犯难吗？找不到安全储存个人机密数据的地方？ oneSafe是最安全的袖珍保险库。 NEW! oneSafe+ now supports Dark Mode, Siri shortcuts, an Apple Watch app, iOS universal (super fast) search in Spotlight, and many other iOS 13 improvements. You can even sync your secured info across various devices via iCloud Drive, CloudKit or Dropbox to have your passwords available whenever and wherever you need them. oneSafe protects your confidential information with AES-256 encryption; the highest level of encryption on mobile devices. Passwords, documents, photos, credit card numbers, bank account details, PIN codes and much more can all be locked away securely inside your safe – and at the same time be accessible whenever you need them. Plus, oneSafe adapts to your preferences allowing you to change the colors and images of your safe for maximum customization. THEY LOVE oneSafe Apple Editor's Choice, best new app in 80 countries! "oneSafe has cuter graphics than its rivals" [New York Times] "Even though oneSafe is incredibly powerful, it remains incredibly user-friendly." [iMore] "Listed in top password managers" [Cnet] "oneSafe is well built, robust, and easy to use" [Marco Tabini] "If you want to protect and secure your data like Fort Knox, oneSafe is your solution." SYNC your content, the way you want You control at all times which categories are synched and which are not. Your info is synched via iCloud or Dropbox. Take advantage of the ultra-secure built-in browser with auto-fill feature to access websites quickly and securely. Back up your data (via email, iTunes or Wi-Fi) to be sure you’ll always have a copy in storage. Change the texture, icon and color for any of your items. Flag items as 'Favorites' for quick access to your most commonly used information. Use the ‘Search’ feature to find items quickly within your database. Sync the contents of your safe between your devices using iCloud (iCloud Drive or CloudKit), and/or Dropbox. Use the bullet-proof "Secure sharing" feature to share your confidential data with your family, friends or colleagues. Store in complete security: Credit card numbers PIN codes and entry codes Social security and tax numbers Bank account details Usernames and passwords Documents in PDF, Word, Excel and more Private photos and videos
