1126976434.name: LP Sardinian
1126976434.description: Liberation Philology Sardinian helps you improve your knowledge of the Sardinian language through practice-driven memorisation. Wherever you have your phone and a free moment, it offers a continuous multiple-choice test on Sardinian vocabulary and the conjugation of Sardinian verbs. Each answer you give is immediately confirmed or corrected, and your knowledge is reinforced by repetition. Vocabulary: 200 levels, each testing your ability to match ten Sardinian words with their English equivalents. Interspersed among these are cumulative levels reviewing what has been learned earlier (giving a total of 226 levels). Verbs: Tests your ability to parse and to conjugate a range of representative regular and irregular Sardinian verbs. A further Reference module allows you to review the vocabulary word-list and verb paradigms. Orthography and grammar generally follow the norms of the Limba Sarda Comuna established by the Regione Autonoma della Sardegna, but additional levels in the Verbs module also introduce a variety of historical and regional variant form.

1127769353.name: 十三煞
1127769353.description: 本游戏无内购付费。 【游戏介绍】 《Thirteen Souls》是一款3D全景武侠格斗手游，游戏采用中国传统水墨画风，加入十二生肖武侠英雄，搭配各种宏大的中国风场景地图，让玩家亲临真正的武侠世界！ 顿帧、震屏、变身、QTE大招画风变化等战斗画面的特效体现，极大地提高游戏的打击快感！ 煞气抢夺特色玩法，不再拘束于传统格斗游戏中的伤害模式！各种强力招式无缝衔接，不给敌人喘息机会。 赶快加入《Thirteen Souls》，一起来场快意恩仇的江湖之战！ 【游戏特色】 3D全景战斗，突破次元束缚自由击杀！ 采用了3D全景战场，摆脱了2D场景中的空间束缚感。 玩家在《Thirteen Souls》中可以360°/180°全视角俯仰观景，不再受困于局部空间的视角锁定,实现了上天入地的炫酷招数对决。 1v1英雄对决，最纯粹的格斗艺术！ 多人乱斗？还未看清战场就被人群坑杀！奋力搏杀却拯救不了团队的失败！ 轮番上阵？没有背水一战的刺激体验！感受不到英雄光辉！ 让我们告别这些模式，来一场激情四溢的英雄单挑对决。像真正的武学宗师一样与高手单独切磋，论剑绝巅。 十二生肖英雄登场，各具特色等你来战！ 游戏融合了千古传承的十二生肖元素，他们化身英雄闪耀登场。 你不仅能在游戏中选择自己的本命属相英雄，还可以选择其他各具特色的生肖英雄。 比如行动机敏的猴（悟空），附带伤害加成的狗（赤天）以及自动回复煞气的兔（玉兔），还有更多英雄特色等你发现。 煞气抢夺特色玩法，带来全新格斗体验！ 攻击只夺取煞气不造成伤害，只有灌输煞气的技能才能造成一定量伤害。 全新的模式加大了对操作及技能释放的要求，只为给你带来最为与众不同的战斗体验。 组合技+QTE大招+爆气变身，极致操作燃爆全屏！ 加入飞身、格挡、闪避、连击等种类繁多的组合技，玩家需在短时间内做出反应才能成功触发的QTE大招，再加上积满能量后的爆气变身。 如此多样的指尖操作，让你可以体验前所未有的竞技快感，燃爆游戏全屏。 【联系我们】 如果您喜欢我们的游戏，欢迎随时给我们评价、留言。 官网网站：www.shisansha.com 官方贴吧：Thirteen Souls 官方新浪微博：http://weibo.com/gdshisansha 官方微信公众号：gudegame 官方Q群：434439009 客服电话：020-85623474 投诉邮箱：kefu@good321.net

1128211054.trackName: TIMER - 工作計時器與任務追蹤
1128211054.description: TIMER 是一款多功能工作計時器與任務追蹤應用程式，專為需要記錄各類工作時間的您設計。無論是追蹤專案工時、計時任務進度、管理工作時長，還是需要一個可靠的計時器，TIMER 都能完美適應您的工作流程。 v4.1 更新 - 更適合所有工作項目 Bug 修復與效能優化，讓 TIMER 在記錄各類工作項目與任務時更加穩定可靠。更流暢的體驗、更好的穩定性。 追蹤任何類型的工作 從自由接案專案、客戶工作到個人任務與日常事務 - TIMER 都能輕鬆應對。一鍵啟動計時器，分類記錄時間，讓 TIMER 幫您管理一切。 先進的分析儀表板 11 種強大的圖表類型，讓您全面了解自己的時間分配： 圓餅圖：顯示各類別時間分配 熱力圖：視覺化每日工作強度 趨勢線：追蹤工時變化 目標預測：預估達成月目標時間 每小時分布：顯示一天中最忙碌的時段 星期比較：揭示最具生產力的日子 持續時間分布：分析工作時段長度 類別×時段分析：按時段查看工時 類別×星期分析：按星期查看工時 月度比較圖：長期趨勢分析 平均統計：日均、周均、工作日平均 可自訂的時間類別 建立最多 11 個自訂類別，設定名稱和顏色。適合追蹤多個專案、客戶或工作類型。每個類別都有專屬顏色標示。 智慧取整功能 自動將時間四捨五入到最近的 5、10、15、30 或 60 分鐘。一鍵切換實際時間與取整時間。適合標準計費。 靈動島整合 在靈動島上即時顯示計時進度。不用開啟 App 即可查看目前計時狀態。 月度目標與備註 設定每月工時目標並追蹤進度。添加月度備註記錄成就與目標。資料跨月持續保存。 安全與隱私 使用 Face ID 或 Touch ID 鎖定，所有資料儲存在裝置上，絕不分享。 匯出專業 PDF 報告 生成包含所有分析圖表的精美 PDF 報告。適合開立發票、稅務準備或個人記錄。 主要功能： 一鍵計時器，全新 v4.0 介面 11 個可自訂時間類別與顏色 11 種分析圖表類型 智慧時間取整，適合標準計費 靈動島即時追蹤 月度目標設定與進度預測 Face ID / Touch ID 安全保護 專業 PDF 報告生成 本地儲存，資料完全私有 離線運作，無需帳號 TIMER 是您管理時間的最佳夥伴。立即下載，掌握您的時間！

1128242453.description: 适用于 Mac 的最快、最私密的翻译应用。 由设备端 AI 驱动,翻译在您的电脑上即时完成,任何内容都不会上传到云端。 无需 Wi-Fi,不收集任何数据。 功能特点: 支持多种语言,完全离线使用 设备端 AI - 100% 私密 语音输入与语音合成 一键粘贴并翻译 翻译历史记录 即时语言切换 便捷分享 尊重您隐私的翻译工具。 Subscription and Purchase Information: You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription or a one-time purchase through an In-App Purchase. Auto-renewable subscription: Annual and Montly with 3-Days Free Trial Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. One-time Purchase: A non-consumable purchase is available for lifetime access to Pro features. Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/site/privacycoldat/ Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

1128330932.name: 算法动画图解（面向教育机构和公司）
1128330932.trackName: 算法动画图解（面向教育机构和公司）
1128330932.description: 【使用注意事项】“算法动画图解（面向教育机构和公司）”是企业客户和教育机构客户使用VPP（批量购买计划）批量购买的版本。如果您对此应用程序不熟悉，我们建议您在App Store上使用免费下载版本的“算法动画图解”。 ==== 应用程序摘要 ==== 享受观看，尝试和学习的算法动画图解。算法的广泛领域用动画清晰简洁地解释。可以各种尝试的“测试模式”来加深您的理解。还充满了您熟悉地加密和安全等算法。来吧，让我们进入算法的世界！ ==== 类别和包含的主题 ==== [ 分类 ] 冒泡排序、选择性排序、插入排序、堆排序、归并排序、快速排序 [ 聚类 ] K-均值算法 [ 列表搜索 ] 线性搜索、二分搜索 [ 图表搜索 ] 广度优先搜索、深度优先搜索、贝尔曼-福特算法、戴克斯特拉算法、A*搜索算法 [ 数学 ] 辗转相除法、素性测试 [ 数据压缩 ] 游程编码、霍夫曼编码 [ 安全 ] 哈希函数、共有密钥加密、公开密钥加密、混合加密、迪菲-赫尔曼密钥交换、讯息鉴别码、数字签名、数字证书 [ 数据结构 ] 列表、数组、栈、队列、哈希表、堆、二叉查找树 [ 网络 ] 佩奇排名（网页排名） [ 递归 ] 汉诺塔 ==== 关于在iPad上使用 ==== 此应用程序也适用于平板电脑，可用于水平和垂直方向。 ==== 支持语言 ==== 中文（简体字） English (英文) Español (西班牙文) Português (葡萄牙文) Русский (俄文) 日本語 (日文) 한국어 (韩文) 显示语言可以在设置菜单上进行更改。

1128663988.name: 大家學標準日本語【每日一句】生活實用篇
1128663988.trackName: 大家學標準日本語【每日一句】生活實用篇
1128663988.description: 具體教學：遇到實際會話場面，『情緒反應』如何結合『文法規則』，進而說出正確日語！*** 著眼「日語如何學以致用」， 大量介紹「具體的日語會話場面」，並詳述「臨場溝通所使用的規則性文法」 每一句會話「都能呼應、驗證文法規則」 並提示日本人經常使用的「表現文型」 讓學習者透過「在日本生活的假想體驗」，學習「功能實用的生活日語」！ ◎ 內容特色 1. 延續《大家學標準日本語》「一定解釋原因」的教學特色，活用「具體學習目標」於「臨場溝通」 除了引導大家透過實際會話場面學習實用表達，並逐字、分段解說文法細節，重視徹底學好「每一句話所存在的規則性文法」。 2. 重視深度與廣度，四大途徑完整教學「每日一句」 「花30分鐘完整學習一句話所隱含的規則性文法」，並掌握「適時、適地、適人」的使用時機，達成「深入、完整」的有效學習。 透過精心安排的4單元學習途徑，有助於「複製會話中的文法規則，自我揣摩運用；並從實際應答領會日本人如何運用於臨場溝通」，達成真正的「學以致用」。 （1）【文型圖解】：圖像化的文型解說，解構句子的構成要素 （2）【使用文型】：提示日本人經常使用的「表現文型」 （3）【用法解說】：「情境式」用法說明，掌握「適時、適地、適人」的使用時機 （4）【會話練習】：大量介紹「具體的會話場面」，模擬「與日本人互動的假想體驗」 ◎ APP學習功能特色 學習功能完備，可根據自己的學習節奏與程度，進行個人化設定： 1. 【提供iPhone／iPad閱讀模式】：提供不同載具的最佳閱讀體驗。可離線使用。 2. 【閱讀訓練】：中日對照，以訓練閱讀與理解能力。 3. 【聽力訓練】： ● 會話可「逐句點選」播放，張大耳朵聽，訓練聽力語感。 ● 語音速度可調整五段不同速度（限iOS版）。 ● 有「全課語音播放」功能 4. 【搜尋】：輸入關鍵字查找標題或全文學習內容。 5. 【書籤】：將重要學習內容標記書籤，方便日後反覆復習。 6. 【筆記】：學習過程中，可做筆記。 7. 【字體】：可依需求調整字體大小。 8. 【支援藍芽耳機播放】：支援藍芽耳機的播放/暫停、上一首、下一首指令 ◎　客服聯絡：如對產品有任何想法或建議，或者使用上遭遇問題，都歡迎和我們聯絡－ 1. 客服信箱：welcome@mail.soyong.com.tw 2. 客服留言板：http://www.mebook.com.tw/iPhone/SupportTC.asp 3. 客服電話：請於上班時間來電02-77210772轉510 我們一定竭誠為您服務。

1129429340.name: RaceChrono Pro
1129429340.description: RaceChrono Pro 是一款功能多样的圈速计时，数据记录和分析app。此app专为赛车运动而设计，可以取代传统的圈速计时器及数据记录设备。 RaceChrono Pro 应用同样具有视频记录以及视频和数据合成功能。 RaceChrono具有大批追随者，目前有超过100000活跃用户。如果你在赛车或赛道日留意一下的话，你会发现总有人在用RaceChrono。据我所知，即使很多专业人士，比如车厂试车手，赛车教练都在用RaceChrono！不管你骑摩托车，开卡丁车或者赛车，在封闭道路或是赛道上，这款应用就是为你而开发的。 RaceChrono Pro 主要功能如下： 带有分段计时与最快圈标注功能 含有超过 2600 条的内置赛道资料 支持用户自定义赛道和非闭环赛道 平顺同步分析数据, 图表, 地图及视频 圈速预测及圈速时差图 支持硬件加速的视频导出，可自由配置数据叠层 多视角录像及画中画视频导出 使用内置摄像头录制视频 支持几乎所有运动摄像头的连接及文件同步 支持外置GPS接收器；Dragy Pro/DRG70/DRG70-C/Lite, RaceBox Mini/Mini S/Micro, Qstarz BL-818GT/BL-1000GT/LT-8000GT, Columbus P-9 Race, Dual XGPS 150/160, VBOX Sport, Garmin GLO 支持 OBD-II 读取设备；OBDLink MX+ Bluetooth, OBDLink CX Bluetooth, Dragy OBD, Vgate vLinker FS, Vgate vLinker/iCar BLE, PLX Kiwi 3/4, Carista OBD2 Bluetooth, Tonwon BLE 1/2/Pro, Veepeak OBDCheck BLE, UniCarScan UCSI-2000, OBDLink MX Wi-Fi, generic Wi-Fi OBD-II 支持 Bluetooth LE 心率监控设备 不限制节次时长，对 24 小时耐力赛同样适用 节次数据可以 .ODS（Excel 可用的节次数据汇总）、.NMEA、.VBO、.CSV 等数据格式导出

1130542083.name: WiFox
1130542083.description: WiFox是一个不断更新的世界各地机场和休息室的WiFi密码地图。在地图视图，在地图视图下，您可以点击任何WiFi图标，其中无线信息是可用的，并使用该按钮将密码复制到剪贴板。该地图可脱机，所以在您旅行时不需要互联网连接即可使用WiFox。 点击复制可以容易的将密码粘贴至无线网络设置中。 用户也可以添加他们在世界各地的机场找到的密码。这些密码会被发送至foXnoMad进行验证和批准，通过后会添加至我们的地图。 在“列表视图”中，您可以更新已添加的机场密码（如果您已经注意到了一些变化）。您在旅行中，也可以为Wi-Fi热点评分，让我们知道提供的详情对你来说是否正常工作。根据旅客反馈，连接信息将被更新，验证或删除。 WiFox图标显示了某个机场无线网络信息的新鲜度，可靠度以及评分情况。 WiFox会使用旅客，飞行员以及其他用户发送至WiFox应用，foXnoMad网站以及foXnoMad Facebook及Twitter帐号的信息，进行持续更新。WiFox当前有世界各地超过700个机场的无线网络信息。 地图会在打开的应用程序时自动更新（当您有互联网接入），或通过点击地图上的“更新”键，或列表视图中的刷新图标进行更新。 WiFox还会通过告诉您合适的网络名称来保护使用免费（开放）Wi-Fi的用户，这样您就不会无意中连接至欺诈或恶意访问点。

1130728218.name: Liberation Philology Friulian
1130728218.description: Liberation Philology Friulian helps you improve your knowledge of the Friulian language of northeastern Italy through practice-driven memorisation. Wherever you have your phone and a free moment, it offers a continuous multiple-choice test on Friulian vocabulary and the conjugation of Friulian verbs. Each answer you give is immediately confirmed or corrected, and your knowledge is reinforced by repetition. Vocabulary: 125 levels, each testing your ability to match ten Friulian words with their English equivalents. Interspersed among these are cumulative levels reviewing what has been learned earlier (giving a total of 142 levels). Verbs: Tests your ability to parse and to conjugate a range of representative regular and irregular Friulian verbs. A further Reference module allows you to review the vocabulary word-list and verb paradigms. Spellings follow the official orthography of the Osservatori Regjonâl de Lenghe e de Culture Furlanis.

1130735487.name: Vault: Private Photos & Videos
1130735487.description: Keep your private photos, videos, and notes locked away with Vault. Vault is a private gallery for personal items you do not want sitting in your main photo library. Import existing photos and videos, capture new ones inside the app, organize everything into albums, and unlock Vault with a PIN, Face ID, or Touch ID on supported devices. Your content stays on your device. Vault stores your photos, videos, and notes locally and does not upload them to our servers. You stay in control of what you import, whether you delete originals from Photos after import, and what you choose to share. With Vault you can: Lock private photos, videos, and notes with a PIN, Face ID, or Touch ID Import from Photos or capture new media directly in Vault Organize albums, favorites, photos, videos, and notes in one private space Keep your content stored locally on your device Share items only when you choose Delete originals from Photos after import when you want to Add extra protection after failed unlock attempts with optional Intruder Detector Vault is designed for people who want a simple, private place for personal media and notes without cloud storage, accounts, or unnecessary complexity. Whether you are saving personal memories, sensitive screenshots, private videos, or notes you want to keep out of sight, Vault gives you a clean, focused space protected by your device. Download Vault and keep your private moments private.

1130755003.name: MooCow: Hide Photos & Videos
1130755003.description: MooCow is a privacy focused app to hide your photos and videos behind a passcode and Touch ID/Face ID. Are you concerned about privacy? Then hide your photos and videos with MooCow. MooCow doesn't use an internet connection so you can be sure your data stays on your device and is only seen by you. Why the name MooCow? Because it is an inconspicuous app name that can sit on your home screen without drawing too much attention. Import photos, live photos, gifs, and videos directly from your documents, photo library, or directly from the camera. Manage your files over your local WiFi network with the built-in WiFi File Manager or locally with macOS File Sharing. Watch your videos in-app using the native video player and view your photos in a custom fullscreen swipe-able photo album browser. Supported Videos: MP4, M4V, MOV Supported Images: JPG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC, BMP, GIF, WEBP, Live Photos https://moocow.app

1131034724.name: eFiles Pro 文件管理专业版
1131034724.trackName: eFiles Pro 文件管理专业版
1131034724.description: eFiles 是面向 iPhone 和 iPad 的一体化文件管理应用：浏览、编辑、分享各类文件，连接云端存储与网络服务器，播放音乐和视频——一个快速、私密的应用搞定所有需求。 文件管理 以列表或网格视图浏览文件。按名称、大小、类型或日期排序。轻松重命名、复制、移动、压缩和删除文件。使用彩色标签分类整理，瞬间找到所需文件。一键访问最近使用的文件。 云端与网络存储 直接在应用内连接 Dropbox、Google Drive 和 OneDrive。访问 FTP、SFTP、WebDAV 和 SMB 服务器，如同管理本地文件一样。通过 Wi-Fi 在 iPhone 与电脑之间无线传输文件。 私密网页浏览器 内置快速浏览器，支持多标签页、书签、深色模式、原生广告拦截、自定义用户代理，并可直接下载文件。 媒体播放器 应用内播放音乐和视频。编辑歌曲元数据（标题、专辑、艺术家、封面），使用精准波形编辑器裁剪音频，并从 iTunes 自动获取曲目信息。 内置编辑器 支持 30 多种编程语言语法高亮的文本编辑器 图片编辑器——裁剪、旋转、滤镜、亮度调整 PDF 批注工具——下划线、文字注释、手绘 带滤镜和即时 PDF 导出功能的文档扫描仪 存储统计 通过详细的分类图表，直观了解各类文件占用的存储空间。点击任意分类即可立即管理相关文件。 隐私与安全 使用密码锁定应用。您的文件保存在设备本地，不会上传至我们的服务器。 无论您是学生、职场人士，还是厌倦了在多个应用间切换来管理文件，eFiles 都能将一切整合到一处。 立即下载 eFiles，掌控您的所有文件。

1131210331.name: Genius Jamtracks
1131210331.description: 练习爵士的新方式！ Genius Jamtracks，爵士音乐家专属的陪练应用，思考和演奏方式就像一个真正的三重奏。 凭借令人印象深刻的逼真音效和感觉，它帮助你扩展曲目、提升爵士词汇并掌握复节奏。 Genius Jamtracks 推出了 "New Standards: 101 Lead Sheets by Women Composers" - 由 Terri Lyne Carrington 领导的贝克利爵士与性别公正学院发起的一项里程碑式的出版物和努力。 “Genius Jamtracks 绝对是最好的陪练应用！特别是钢琴和弦编配比其他的陪练应用更加合乎逻辑，且更接近真实。低音和鼓不仅仅是简单的重复模式，而是运用了实际的爵士语言。你还可以让乐队忙碌起来，增加一些不可预测的变化。这就像是与真实的乐队一起演奏，算法能做到这点很不容易。强烈推荐！” ~ Paul Bollenback “这就像是一个爵士音乐家编写的。鼓和钢琴演奏方式就像真正的爵士鼓手和钢琴家一样。创造这样的应用一定不容易！” ~ Steve Beskrone 为什么它听起来如此出色： 这一切都在于动态、音符时值、间距和感觉。 Genius Jamtracks 三重奏密切关注每个要素，确保练习体验尽可能接近真实的演奏。 真实的摇摆感！ 忘记其他陪练应用的机械三连音吧。 当改变速度时，应用不仅仅是播放得更快或更慢，摇摆感也会相应改变。应用通过学习爵士词汇和大师的真实转录，真正掌握了摇摆。 实际的声部引导！ 无论你的设置是什么，只要按下播放键，钢琴家的声部引导和低音手创造优美旋律的努力始终如一，陪伴你练习。 使用 Genius Jamtracks 创建你自己的歌曲，界面简单直观。 随心编辑你喜欢的爵士标准曲目表。 可以创建你自己的歌曲播放列表。 自定义字体让和弦图表更美观、更易读。 节奏部门： 从简单的和弦伴奏开始，一步步掌握超人的复节奏！ 专注于某个特定的节拍组合、比例、复节奏或节奏偏移。你可以要求三重奏——或单个乐器——在他们加入复节奏短语时只包含你所请求的内容。由于你不知道何时或如何使用这一功能，它还可以帮助你提高反应能力，同时掌握该节奏！ 和声级别选择器： 从三和弦开始，逐步提升到高级替代和声及重新和声处理。 和弦编配选择器： 直接从新的选择器中选择你喜欢的和弦编配类型。 链接按钮： 当打开一首歌曲时，应用会自动根据歌曲风格选择最佳的和弦编配。如果链接关闭，你选择的和弦编配类型将保存为默认设置。 时间摆放： 想要演奏一首抒情曲，还是一个直率的摇摆？给三重奏一个更强劲或更自由的感觉。 准备好将你的技巧提升到新的高度了吗？

1131483169.name: 啪咔 Paca - 理财计算器
1131483169.trackName: 啪咔 Paca - 理财计算器
1131483169.description: 理财神器啪咔，协助你比较不同的利率，划不划算，一目了然！快速计算利率和月还款。 啪咔理财计算器是一款专为需要投资理财的朋友打造的手机理财计算器，轻松计算各种理财收益详细情况，帮助用户更好的投资，操作简单清晰，有需要的不要错过哦！ 手机理财利率计算，高效管理理财产品。 1、年、月、日利率相互转换，等额本息分期付款快速计算； 2、一款计算理财收益的实用计算器。例如：本金10000元，理财期限为5天，到期后本息共得10006元。则可使用实际收益计算器计算，得到实际年化收益率为4.38%； 3、除实际收益计算器外，还包括净值收益计算器和预期收益计算器； 4、投资理财好帮手，能分析你投资存款得到的利息，希望这个软件能很好的为你服务。 年、月、日利率相互转换 一次性还款利率计算 等额本息还款利率计算（根据利率算月供，以及根据月供反算利率！） 设置单利、复利模式 设置输入框是否只能输入数字

1132634656.description: 无需按任何按钮即可拍摄自拍！ 无尽定时器与简易照片管理器！深受独拍内容创作者的喜爱！ 独拍模特：将您的iPhone固定在某处，尽情摆姿势，PhotoBot将为您捕捉所有精彩瞬间！ 专为以下人群设计： 社交媒体影响者 独自旅行者 运动员 您：任何想为自己拍摄大量照片的时候 难题： 我们都知道拍摄自拍时的烦恼——那就是按下快门按钮！以及设置定时器！ 在拍摄了大量照片后，删除不需要的照片、整理照片是一项耗时的任务。 使用PhotoBot： 只需固定好手机，不断摆姿势，让应用每秒（或您设定的间隔）自动捕捉照片。告别繁琐的定时器设置，轻松享受多样化的姿势，毫不费力地创作出精彩内容！非常适合独拍模特和轻松打造惊艳内容！ 通过简单的滑动轻松整理您的照片！ 通过简单的滑动浏览和删除照片，节省设备存储空间！ 功能： 无尽模式： 自动拍摄照片 设置每张照片之间的时间间隔（例如：每2秒拍摄一张） 使用多个摄像头捕捉 多视角：自动在超广角、广角和长焦摄像头之间切换 在每次拍摄间随机切换摄像头，或 每个摄像头拍摄一张后重复 开启/关闭：仅使用选定的摄像头拍摄 后置摄像头拍摄前会有倒计时——给您时间跑到镜头前 过期模式： 捕捉几天后自动删除的照片 帮助您节省存储空间 减少照片杂乱 在工作相关照片变得无关紧要时删除 更改闪光灯模式（自动、开启或关闭） 显示照片计数 锁定焦点和曝光——长按2秒锁定 更换摄像头——前置、后置或在支持的设备上选择三摄或双摄 简单易用（iOS相机感觉） PhotoBot简单管理器™：专为快速浏览照片、删除不需要的照片和挑选最佳照片而设计 轻松删除不需要的照片——向下滑动删除 左右滑动浏览最近的照片 向上滑动添加到相册 捏合缩放 双击收藏 摇晃撤销删除 一键返回相机 为拍摄的照片添加位置信息（您可以禁用位置访问以关闭此功能） 锁屏小部件以打开过期模式和无尽模式相机 额外功能： 无广告 无应用内购买——下载应用即可享受所有功能 便捷支持——直接联系开发者

1132950396.name: CW Trainer
1132950396.description: CW Trainer — Learn & Practice Morse Code Become a real CW operator. CW Trainer takes you from your first letters all the way to real QSOs and contests, with a radio simulator that sounds and responds like the real thing. PROGRESSIVE KOCH METHOD Learn Morse code one letter at a time with the proven Koch method. Structured curriculum, per-character accuracy stats, and automatic progression when you're ready. QSO WITH AI OPERATOR Have realistic radio conversations with an intelligent operator. You call, copy, exchange RST, name, QTH — and if you miss something, the operator repeats it, just like on the air. Every QSO is with a different station from around the world. CONTEST MODE Train for CQ WW and WPX contests in Search & Pounce or Running. Pile-ups, rapid exchanges, ever-changing callsigns, and realistic error handling. MAKE IT YOURS Speeds from 5 to 60 WPM, a level system from Bronze to Legend, daily reminders, and leaderboards to challenge other operators. 73 and enjoy CW! This app uses Apple's Standard End User License Agreement: http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

1132992868.name: Flowing ~ Meditation in Nature
1132992868.description: Upgrade your sleep, focus & productivity with Flowing, the third sequel to popular Best of 2014 app Windy. Imagine you could sleep outside in nature instead and enjoy the sights and sounds of wonderful streams, waterfalls & rivers recorded in psychoacoustic 3D for headphones. As if you were there. And if you felt like it, imagine you could mix in some extra 3D nature sounds such as rain on a tent or birds in the trees around you. Get the great sleep you deserve. Flowing integrates deeply with my other apps Windy, Sunny and Away and is compatible with Thunderspace and Sleepy Fan. Over 5,000,000 people have enjoyed them so far. Many use them to sleep better, to meditate, or to focus on their work or studies. Some use them to help their kids sleep. And I believe Flowing is a fantastic addition. Flowing's natural streaming water delivers a versatile white noise ambience that drowns out the noise around you. ≈ Fantastic Audio Quality ≈ All flowing water and nature sounds in Flowing were recorded with a psychoacoustic microphone that captures sound the way you hear. The same principles that work for 3D movies and 3D glasses also work for 3D sound with stereo headphones. All audio is perfectly looped and encoded in AAC for a fantastic listening experience. ≈ Customize ≈ Flowing's fantastic nature sound mixer lets you mix in high-quality nature sounds & music. ≈ Features ≈ + Six high-quality flowing water scenes in 3D for headphones. + Three incredible musical masterpieces by Hollywood's rising star composer David Bawiec.​ + 3 guided meditations by Australian rising star Lua Lisa. + Sleep & meditation timer. + Mix in music, rain, rain on tent and birds. + Illustrations by the world's best nature illustrator, Marie Beschorner. + Motion-controlled 3D parallax sceneries. ≈ Questions? ≈ Tweet @taptanium, email franz taptanium com or send an email through the in-app contact support page.

1133083101.description: 国家天气（National weather) - 实时提供未来15天天气预报、全球雷达、台风实时路径及预报、地震、空气品质、未来15天（360小时）每小时天气预报、花粉过敏、钓鱼、室外运动、降雨概率、当前实时天气等功能。无广告免费天气App。 准确、实时、15日天气预报**** 实时更新当前天气。 定位地址精确到街道门牌号，天气精确到所在位置周边1.2KM范围内。 更新地址，实时更新天气信息。 15日全球天气预报，出行计划更保障。 15日（360小时）每小时天气预报**** 未来15日，每个小时的天气情况 每小时支持天气、温度、体感温度、气压、紫外线、露点、能见度、风向、风速、云层覆盖率、降雨概率、降雨量、降雪量、钓鱼指数、运动指数等等 更细致准确的出行规划 地震**** 支持近200年，共72万条地震记录。并及时更新最新地震信息。 地震可在地图内展示，提供地震震级、强度、深度，致死率预估、强度图、影响城市，海啸、山体滑坡、地震液化等不同等级预警。 地震数据繁杂难懂，我们提供每个指标的通俗化提示。 卫星雷达**** 提供台风等级、运动路径、影响范围等在地图内展示。 支持雷达、云图、24小时降雨量、24小时降雪量、雷电、温度、体感温度、紫外线、露点、温度、驾驶难度信息及未来预报，在地图上展示。 Apple Watch**** 支持Apple Watch，以及表盘复杂功能。 支持 Widget**** 支持桌面widget，显示当前天气、温度、体感温度、风向、风速、紫外线、湿度，未来6小时天气及未来2天天气预报 支持锁屏widget，显示当前天气、温度、体感温度、风向、风速、紫外线、湿度等。 花粉过敏预报**** 为花粉过敏用户提供未来15天的所在位置的花粉过敏信息 生活指数**** 钓鱼：支持未来15天每小时钓鱼指数 运动：支持未来15天每小时运动指数 是否携带雨伞提醒 防晒指数及提醒 穿衣指数及提醒 洗车至少及提醒 显示当前日期日历 个性、美观**** 收录各地美丽风景作为天气背景图片，更简洁美观 用户可以自定义壁纸，更有个性，将您喜爱的图片设置为天气背景 【订阅功能说明】 取消方法：请用户手动在苹果设备【设置】>>【iTunesStore与App Store】>>选择【Apple ID】>>点击即【查看Apple ID】>>在账户设置界面点击【订阅】>>取消国家天气的订阅即可。 【专业天气套餐自动续订价格】 购买3个月专业天气套餐 每3个月将以$0.99美元的价格购买和自动续费 购买6个月专业天气套餐 每6个月将以$1.99美元的价格购买和自动续费 购买12个月专业天气套餐 每12个月将以$3.49美元的价格购买和自动续费 自动续费扣款时机：定于其结束前1天自动续费延续。在订阅结束前1天取消,则订阅方案会停止。 用户使用及隐私政策：http://u3dyouxi.com/weather/term.html 自动续订服务协议：http://u3dyouxi.com/weather/subscribe.html

1133407519.name: 斗轉星移
1133407519.description: 斗轉星移是iOS /macOS紫微斗數排盤軟體，可以在任意十二地支上變換十四主星，太微賦: 「 帝居動, 則列宿奔馳。」；斗轉星移可以依據星曜取用，產生對應的變盤。 感謝恩師黃建霖老師不厭其煩的指導及提供建議－斗轉星移得以順利開發完成上架。 斗數曆： 1）斗轉星移斗數曆年份支援區間是 「 公元1203/1/1 - 3097/12/31 」 。 2）斗轉星移可以造出任意地點的斗數曆，依據日入日落日正當中的「子初換曆」。 3）斗轉星移可以依據任意地點的日入日落日正當中，得到任意地點的時辰劃分。 操作方法： 1）按命盤中間，切換 變盤／原盤。 2）長按命盤中間，可以儲存命盤到相簿／複製命盤到剪貼簿／分享命盤到其他app。 3）按12地支，可以變盤 4）長按12地支，可以自訂五鼠遁或是五虎遁。 5）銀幕左邊邊緣往右刷，會出現最近使用過的10張命盤，可以迅速切換不同命盤。 太歲入卦功能： 1）太歲入卦有流年 父親 母親 夫妻 朋友可以入卦。 2）提供干支轉換太歲功能。 3）太歲入卦，可以選擇五鼠遁或是五虎遁。 命盤檔案管理： 1）命盤要取名字才可以存檔。 2）Core Spotlight Search可以搜尋到斗轉星移裡所有的命盤檔案。 3）Today Extension(今日)可以顯示最近使用過的六張命盤，點取後就會開啟斗轉星移，排出相對應的命盤。 4）可使用Mac 或是PC的iTunes，將斗轉星移命盤檔案全部複製出來備份，或是移轉到其他iOS Device。 5）命盤檔案以PNG圖檔形式存在，任意看圖軟體都可以讀取命盤。 方位量測功能： 在斗轉星移裡，方位量測有兩種方式： 1）透過iPhone/iPad的水平儀與電子羅盤，斗轉星移具有羅盤功能，方便量出方位或是坐向。 2）透過iPhone/iPad的地圖，斗轉星移可以量測地圖上兩點相對的方位。 日曆功能： 提供斗數日曆，方便快速擇日。 針對iPad Pro ，為smart keyboard新增快捷鍵： cmd + 1 : 原盤 cmd + 2 : 變盤 cmd + C : 複製命盤圖片 cmd + S：儲存命盤圖片 cmd + O ：打開已有命盤 cmd + N ：正時排盤 ＊macOS版本請到mac app store 搜尋「 斗轉星移」 下載。 想進階了解斗數／斗轉星移，歡迎報名參加黃建霖老師的【 斗數卦理讀書會】 http://blog.xuite.net/eric.destiny/blog/318068026

1134126831.name: PhET模拟实验
1134126831.description: 通过屡获殊荣的PhET模拟应用，参与到自然科学和数学的学习中来！不管是理解原子模型，探索能量的概念还是学习算术，这是一款为初学者准备的模拟应用。它包含了超过70个基于HTML5的模拟交互程序，非常适合在家，在课堂或者在路上使用学习。 这款由科罗拉多大学博尔德分校的物理教学专家开发的应用每年被数百万的学生所使用。PhET的iPad版本应用包含以下特点： 离线使用： 可以在公交车或者公园这样的无线环境下使用。 多种语言： 应用被翻译成多种语言（同样也是学习外语的一次机会）。 收藏功能： 选择你最喜爱的模拟应用组成你自己的收藏库。 自动更新： 所有的基于HTML5的模拟应用都是最新版本。 筛选功能： 可以快速定位你想要的模拟应用。 全屏播放： 最大化地利用你的屏幕以呈现最佳的模拟体验。 对家长：这是让您的孩子参与到科学和数学学习的一次机会。 对教师：让您喜欢的HTML5模拟应用在课堂上播放，即使没有网络也能完美运行。 对校长：专为课堂使用优化设计，让您的教师团队使用最先进的教学手段。 对学生：告诉你的家长你发现了一个好玩的应用，可以学习自然科学和数学。 附注：这款应用并不包含PhET的Java或Flash模拟应用。虽然我们正在努力提高我们应用程序的无障碍访问能力，但是目前大多数的模拟应用并不包含键盘导航或者读屏功能。当这些功能被制作好以后，我们会更新我们的应用。 从应用下载得到的经费将支持我们继续开发更多的HTML5模拟应用。谨代表PhET团队和那些从中获益的学生向您表示感谢！

1134218562.name: Charles Proxy
1134218562.description: Charles Proxy for iOS lets you capture and inspect network requests and responses on your iOS device. You can view metadata, headers and bodies in the app, so you can finally debug your app’s networking issues without a computer. Charles Proxy for iOS is an from the creators of Charles Proxy for desktop. HOW IT WORKS Turn Charles on when you want to start capturing. Charles captures your network requests and responses in the background while you test your app or website. Return to Charles to inspect the requests and responses. If you also have Charles on your desktop, you can transfer recorded sessions to your desktop to explore them on the big screen. Charles creates a local VPN on your device. All of your network traffic passes through Charles on your device, and then out to the internet as usual over either WiFi or Mobile / Cellular data. There is no remote server involved, and your data always remains private to you. FEATURES SSL Proxying to view SSL requests in plain text View and share request and responses bodies Syntax highlighting for text request and response bodies Measure network performance over WiFi or Mobile / Cellular networks Block requests to nominated hosts DNS spoofing

1134805859.name: 迷失岛
1134805859.description: 苹果官方2016年度“最佳独立游戏”作品！ “迷失岛”是一座位于大西洋海域的神秘小岛，玩家需要通过层层解谜才能找出这个岛上埋藏的秘密。传统点触类经典解谜，极度烧脑的游戏解谜关卡，神秘又美丽的画面，南瓜先生大冒险团队最新力作，2017年最值得期待解密类独立游戏之一。 游戏的目的是协助玩家调查一个大西洋海域的小岛，找出这个岛上潜藏的秘密。 游戏特点： 1、超多细节的游戏场景，描绘出了一个孤独而又神秘的海岛景象。 2、鲜活的动画风格，独特的游戏人物，让人过目难忘。 3、层层嵌套的谜题，让玩家体会到解谜的终极乐趣。 4、多个精心准备的益智小游戏，挑战玩家智商，彰显小岛的神秘。 5、出人意表的对话内容，意料之外的情节发展，带领玩家探究故事的真相。 6、游戏成就系统，让玩家体会到探索的成就和荣誉。隐藏成就献给支持我们的玩家。 7、二周目的游戏内容，在增强了游戏的可玩性之外，也让整个小岛的故事更加丰满。 6、2015年IndiePlay(独立游戏嘉年华)最佳美术提名奖。 官方Q群：383441918（欢迎探险者们） 意见和反馈：contact@cottongame.com

1135876115.name: RNI Colibri
1135876115.description: SHORT: This little app has been designed by film photography aficionados to make your digital photos look nicer with minimal editing effort. Find out more at www.reallyniceimages.com and don't hesitate to email support@reallyniceimages.com if having any issues or suggestions. LONG: Use RNI Colibri to magically enhance the colour harmony of your digital photos. Make your colours pop in a subtle and intelligent manner. RNI Colibri uses the same innovative rendering engine as its sibling RNI Flashback. But unlike Flashback it has been trained on quite a narrow selection of the finest slide scans. This makes for a totally different colour rendering and allows to easily enhance the bland colours of digital. A picture is worth a thousand words, so please check image samples to find out what this mighty little app can do for you. Unlock colour. Create an emotional essence in your photography with RNI Colibri. — RNIColibri Tag your photos with #RNIColibri for a chance to get featured in RNI’s official newsletter, blog and Instagram @reallyniceimages. Find out more at reallyniceimages.com

1135992985.name: TV Cast Pro for Chromecast
1135992985.description: Watch any web video and your personal photos, videos & music on your Chromecast or Google Cast powered TV. Enjoy the show on your big screen. With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Chromecast (movies, TV shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and wait for the video link detection. The video link will appear below the browser. Tap it and the video will be sent to your big screen instantly! Streaming personal media from your device is also supported. The app only works with all Chromecast devices from Google and on devices with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in. iTunes movies and DRM-protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO Now are not supported! The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. If a specific video does not cast, please check our FAQ. If that does not help, please give us a chance to help you by dropping a mail to info@video-tv-cast.com instead of leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for your video as soon as possible. PRO FEATURES Remote Playbar: A remote control that allows you to fast forward or rewind videos while browsing. It syncs across all your iPads & iPhones that are connected to the same Chromecast. So your video can be controlled by different users in the same room. Personal Media: Cast unlimited personal photos, videos and music directly from your device or from cloud services like iCloud and Dropbox. Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud. Subtitles: Display subtitles & closed captions on TV. Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of the mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode. Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings. USER FEEDBACKS "You've brought the chromecast to life on iOS devices!! And you designed it work easily and quickly" Ryan, England “I looooove your app. It has taken my Chromecast to a whole new level.” Rosalind Romero, USA A MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPERS We want to say thank you for all your great support and kindly invite you to honestly rate our app. This helps us to keep up our app development and support for you. Please do not trust other apps that ask you for 5-star ratings in exchange for premium upgrades. This is against good developer ethics and also against Apple guidelines. If you have any feedback, feature requests or other requests, please notify us at info@video-tv-cast.com. Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google or any other trademark mentioned here. Chromecast is a trademark of Google LLC.

1136232806.name: TV Cast Pro for Google Cast
1136232806.trackName: TV Cast Pro for Google Cast
1136232806.description: Watch web-videos, online-movies, livestreams and live-tv shows and your personal photos, videos & music by using Google Cast on your Sony TV, Vizio SmartCast TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Toshiba TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player or Nvidia Shield gaming console. Enjoy the show on your big screen. With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Google Cast enabled device (movies, tv shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and send the embedded video with a single tap to your TV or gaming console. The discovered video will be shown below the browser. A tap on the video link will send it to your Google Cast enabled device immediately. Streaming personal media from your device is also supported. The app only works with devices with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, like Vizio TV, Toshiba TV, Sony TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player, Nvidia Shield gaming console iTunes movies, Flash video and DRM protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO now are not supported! The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. If a specific video does not cast, please check our FAQ. If that does not help, please give us a chance to help you by dropping a mail to info@video-tv-cast.com instead of leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for your video as soon as possible. PRO FEATURES Remote Playbar: A remote control that allows you to fast forward or rewind videos while browsing. It syncs across all your iPads & iPhones that are connected to the same Chromecast. So your video can be controlled by different users in the same room. Personal Media: Cast unlimited personal photos, videos and music directly from your device or from cloud services like iCloud and Dropbox. Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud. Subtitles: Display subtitles & closed captions on TV. Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings. A MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPERS We want to say thank you for all your great support and kindly invite you to honestly rate our app. This helps us to keep up our app development and support for you. Please do not trust other apps that ask you for 5-star ratings in exchange for premium upgrades. This is against good developer ethics and also against Apple guidelines. If you have any feedback, feature requests or other request, please notify us at info@video-tv-cast.com Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google, Sony, Philips, Vizio, Sharp, Asus, Nvidia or one of their products and trademarks.

Enjoy the show on your big screen. With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Google Cast enabled device (movies, tv shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and send the embedded video with a single tap to your TV or gaming console. The discovered video will be shown below the browser. A tap on the video link will send it to your Google Cast enabled device immediately. Streaming personal media from your device is also supported. The app only works with devices with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, like Vizio TV, Toshiba TV, Sony TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player, Nvidia Shield gaming console iTunes movies, Flash video and DRM protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO now are not supported! Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. If a specific video does not cast, please check our FAQ. If that does not help, please give us a chance to help you by dropping a mail to info@video-tv-cast.com instead of leaving a negative comment on the App Store. 1137434782.name: 恶龙传说(单机无内购)-血脉升华
1137434782.trackName: 恶龙传说(单机无内购)-血脉升华
1137434782.description: 《恶龙传说》是一款西方魔幻风格高自由度的角色扮演，冒险游戏。 ===新版本：《血脉升华》震撼来袭=== 新增血脉升华系统，每个血脉都有多条升华路径，即使同样的血脉，也可以打造出不同的战斗风格。 新增试炼迷宫玩法，玩家会以一个全新的姿态进入迷宫探险，能否深入迷宫，寻找宝藏和秘密，依靠的是经验还有运气。 新增多种全新的属性，build又会迎来新的变化。 更多新内容可以访问官方贴吧《恶龙传说吧》。 ======游戏特色====== 从宁静平和的铁炉镇，到气势宏伟的哀霜城，从诡异阴森的祖尔法祭坛，到守卫森严的血蹄城堡……还有无数未知的地域等待你去探索，来感受这个宏伟的魔法世界吧。 每个NPC都有自己爱恨情仇和世界身份，某个酒馆里面让你嫌弃的糟老头，说不定是个隐藏的高人，宗师级技能的导师。 冒险不仅仅只有杀怪这么简单，解锁宝箱，拆卸陷阱，如何使用所学技能，最有效率的冒险，这是一门学问。 开放的技能搭配，你可以一手搓着小火球，一手挥舞的利剑，魔剑士不再是梦，每个技能都有新手、专家、大师、宗师4个等级，每提升一个等级都会有质的的变化，带来新的效果，绝不仅仅只是数值的提升。 海量的装备，还有逆天的神器，或许一个冷门的技能，因为一个神器的属性，而发生翻天覆地的变化。 血脉玩法，七大血脉，不同的血脉配合不同的职业，谁才是最强搭配，由你决定！ 异世界的远征，探索神秘的异世界，走得最远的那个人，将成为不朽的传说！ 空间裂痕副本，大量魔物来袭，你能否守住神谕大陆的安全？ 五大职业，每种职业有其鲜明的特色，独特的主被动技能，战斗更加丰富多样。 隐藏职业，数量未知，开启方式未知，唯一肯定的是，隐藏职业非常强力，但不可强求，有缘人方可开启。 附魔技能和远古神器，实力再次突破。 ======玩家评价====== ——“看腻了花花绿绿的手游，还是这种黑白简洁风游戏吸引我，毫不浮躁，玩着玩着几个小时就过去了。” ——“武器五花八门（短弓长剑重锤双手斧等等什么鬼这么多搞晕了(°ー°〃) ），不同的武器还有不同的攻速、重量和攻击距离，真佩服开发，我都不知道怎么选了！哪个都觉得好啊喂！w(ﾟДﾟ)w” ——“喜欢这种屠龙故事的游戏，不禁想起上古卷轴5。怀念玩老滚的日子，抓根宝！” ——“代入感强烈的游戏背景、丰富的支线任务、极具策略性的战斗方式、不同城镇野外地图探索的乐趣，是吸引我的主要地方。” 恶龙复苏 黑夜将至 屠龙的勇士 拿你手中的利剑 划破这永夜的黑暗吧！ ======联系我们====== 《恶龙传说》官方邮箱：elcsgame@foxmail.com 《恶龙传说》官方QQ群：游戏的小齿轮点进去的设置界面可以看到群号 《恶龙传说》官方贴吧：恶龙传说吧

1137441273.description: 快速移除不想要的背景或使用钢笔选择工具来对图片进行精确裁剪。以前只能在价格昂贵的台式电脑程序上实现，但现在首次在iPhone和iPad上实现了，并根据触屏做出了优化。这个全能工具拥有独特的功能是其他应用所无法比拟的。它是专业工具盒的一部分，画家和图片编辑几十年来都在依靠它。现在你也可以使用了！你不必在一张图片上耗费大量精力，而且可能最后也不太满意。不再会搞砸了。图片的边缘不再会参差不齐或十分模糊。使用Exacto你可以做出完美的选取，因为它可以精确追寻图形的边缘，无论有多么复杂。但这并非全部！Exacto不仅局限于钢笔选择工具的传统功能，它更加自由，控制更加方便，能够在选择处删除或插入一些点，还可以重置控制点，最重要的是无限图层可以多重选取。此外，Exacto还提供其他一些提升用户体验的高级功能包括撤消/重做、项目自动保存、即时预览等等。 如何使用： 1-将选择点放在所需区域然后把他们拖入相应位置进行选取。 2-添加图层以在您的图片中选择多个物体或区域。 3-使用全屏即时预览来查看进展。 4-出现失误？撤消/重做功能使您从开始到结束的全部编辑历史都被保存了，您可以根据需要无限制地前进或后退。 5-需要紧急离开？自动保存功能让您的项目永远不会丢失，您可以随时回来继续完成。 6-所有都完成了？将您裁剪的图片保存到相册或使用其他应用打开。 剪裁出来图片有无数种有趣的用法。举例来说： 1-将它们从不同的背景下剪裁出来合在一起。 2-将它们放在您正在准备的工作或学习演示中。 3 – 将它们用作聊天表情. 4 – 设计装饰品时使用它们。 5 – 把它们打印出来做成纸版画用在特定场合。 还有其他很多! 遇到问题？希望对未来的更新提出任何的意见或建议吗？请联系我们support@exactoapp.com。

1137739981.description: 引人入胜、创新、简约的益智游戏，有数十个关卡。目标很简单：您需要穿过场地并拾取所有圆圈。问题是它们仅在两种颜色中的一种上可见 - 这就是为什么您应该使用开关来切换灯光。怎么玩*** 设计简单，有不同的关卡。一条彩色线将进入由正方形组成的区域。用户需要拖动线来收集该字段中出现的圆圈。收集完所有圆圈后，您需要退出场地。之后，您将进入下一个阶段。您还可以将线向后移动

1137913043.name: Equalizer Pro - Music Player with 10-band EQ
1137913043.trackName: Equalizer Pro - Music Player with 10-band EQ
1137913043.description: Equalizer Pro is a professional tool for adjusting the sound and multi-player. You will be able correct the sound frequency and achieve the desired sound of your favorite music. The application supports a huge range of audio and video formats. The system takes into account the specific character of the formats functioning on mobile devices (memory capacity, the number of general processor units etc.), providing a maximum productivity and comfort for working. Listen the songs, as if you were in the studio or at the concert of your favorite band. 10 band equalizer as well as professionally selected sound effects available in the app equalizer: + Flat + Acoustic + Bass Booster + Bass Reduser + Classical + Dance + Deep + Electronic + Hip-Hop + Jazz + Latin + Loudnes + Lounge + Piano + Pop + R&B + Rock + Small Speakers + Spoken Word + Treble Booster + Treble Reduser + Vocal Booster You can easily add music from the cloud and network services as well as music from your library. Application supports a wide range of audio formats(mp3, m4a, wav, wma, wv, ape, ogg, flac, aiff, aac, au ...), popular playlist formats(cue, m3u, m3u8 ...) and video formats(mkv, avi, mov, wmv, mp4, m4v, mpeg, rmvb, 3gp, divx, ts, flv ...). Equalizer Pro is not only a music player and equalizer frequency, it is also a powerful file manager folders, files and playlists. The application works with all popular archive formats(rar, zip, 7z, gz, tar ...), it is integrated with iTunes, popular cloud services (Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, OneDrive, Yandex.Disk) and network services (SMB, FTP, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV). Wi-Fi and FTP transfers available also. The additional benefits is: + Sound visualization + Background playback + Access to the library with your music + Opening files from external applications + Preview mediafiles cover + Automatic recovery bad and non standard files + Brightness and loudness control by gestures Support for popular formats internal and external subtitle is embedded into the application, so you can watch movies and videos. Sorting files (by name, extension, size, date) and quick searching files in subfolders are available in the application. With this application, you will be able to significantly improve the sound quality and get the most out of your music! Elegant design, extended functionality, high speed and stability of work will help you to spend time with maximum comfort. Already thousands of people have joined us! And you could try this tool of listening and configuration music unsurpassed in speed of work and capabilities! We are continuously working to improve the app. If you have any comments, suggestions and questions, write on our email support@develsoftware.com.

1139451804.name: Autism Toolbox - Social Skills
1139451804.description: The Social Skills Edition of the Autism Behavior Toolbox consists of strategies necessary in getting along with others. They help children become more comfortable and competent in social situations. Detailed strategies are presented in 21 areas including making friends, dealing with bullying and teasing, getting a hair cut, riding in a school bus, social problem solving, travelling and going on vacation, using leisure time, and play, going shopping, eating in a restaurant, going to the dentist and visiting their physicians as examples. Strategies are classified according to age level ranging from age 3-12. The app not only includes strategies but reading lists associated with each topic area. Users can create a note to attach to their strategies that can be exported in an attractive book format as a pdf file into iBooks, sent as a text message, attached to an email, or saved to iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or Google Drive. Parents and teachers can send copies of strategies to one another to assist in program planning and maintain good communication.

1141643447.name: Quickfem - 2D Finite Elements
1141643447.description: Quickfem, the 2D Finite Element Analysis App for Engineers and Students. FEA for Students Learn how finite elements and structural analysis works by starting out with simple models you can build directly on your phone or tablet. Play around with geometry, constraints, loads, materials and results to augment the theory. FEA for Engineers FEA is hard. Most problems are 3d and complex and require the major packages such as Ansys, Abacus, Patran, Nastran etc. But engineers have to know what to expect from these models and this insight stems from the understanding of simple mechanisms and effects. With Quickfem, you have the most convenient FEA modeller imaginable in your back pocket! Simple touch geometry creation, automatic meshing, quick mesh refinement, simple constant strain elements, and near solution instant feedback creates the tight iteration loops necessary for rapid discovery. Running on your mobile device, Quickfem gives you the freedom to create and understand structural models wherever and whenever inspiration strikes. Know what to expect. Featuring Automatic meshing 2D constant strain triangle FEM Up to 100,000 elements 3D view and edit mode Axisymmetric FEA modelling Plane stress and plane strain Thermal mechanical (thermomechanical) analysis Complex geometry, arcs, fillets, holes Fastener representations, grounded or connected to 1 or more plates Convergence checking through user defined mesh size Displacements fringe and deformation plots Strain and stress fringe plots Equivalent and principal stress fringe plots Maxima and minima Unit systems, SI, US, none or custom Default and customer material definitions Customisable modelling environment, materials, loads, units, precision, feature thickness, mesh sizes Example models Go to www.quickfem.com for more

1142120445.name: Zona traffico limitato - ZTL - Italy - avoid ticket
1142120445.trackName: Zona traffico limitato - ZTL - Italy - avoid ticket
1142120445.description: Anyone who is planning to drive in Italy needs to be aware of Limited Traffic Zones, or Zona Traffico Limitato in Italian, abbreviated to ZTL. Some historical centers of Italian cities have set up these limited traffic zones in order to reduce congestion and pollution, and there are significant fines for driving into one of these zones unauthorized. This app shows where the cameras is on a map and information about the zones.

1143470101.name: iOptigan
1143470101.description: This is the Optigan for iOS. The Optigan, short for Optical Organ, was a chord organ from the early 1970’s. It is remembered today for its unique system of sound reproduction using optical discs. These LP-sized film discs were optically encoded with 57 concentric tracks, which contained loops of musical combos playing chord patterns in different styles. Each disc contained a specific style of music (Bossa Nova, Big Band etc) which the user could control by pressing the chord buttons. Changing the discs was as simple as putting a new record on your turntable. Think of it as the 1971 version of GarageBand. Despite this novel technology, the scratchy sound of the Optigan left a lot to be desired. The iOptigan we present here truthfully recreates that lo-fi sound. 25 of the original 40 discs are included, the remaining 15 can be purchased individually or all together in the Complete Pak. Specifications and Features: Disc loading rigth-side-up or upside-down Spring Reverb (virtual) Optical Metronome Audio Demo for each Disc MIDI in/out MIDI chord detection MIDI File Import Sequencer with Record and Playback Sharing for songs as Audio and MIDI File iTunes File Sharing Inter-App Audio Smart background audio Help overlay Headphone optimised stereo (optional) Radio Mode for Chord Buttons or Keyboard Comfortable speed control in semitones or BPM

1144412117.name: Krautkopf
1144412117.description: Featuring a mixture of vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free & dairy-free recipes, the Krautkopf app contains easy to follow recipes, accompanied by mouth-watering photography. Krautkopf is an award winning food blog founded by the photographers and cookbook authors Susann and Yannic from Berlin. The recipes you'll find inside the app are inspired by produce at the local farmers market, with a focus on dishes that are healthy, fresh and seasonal. Krautkopf’s philosophy is that food should not only be something that fills us up, but should also be good for us and make us happy. Get happy with their delicious soul food recipes! 1144759699.name: tcCalc - timecode & frame calc
1144759699.description: Overview This app is a calculator specialized for timecode and frame-based calculations. It operates in the same way as a regular calculator, and can calculate timecode and convert between frames. Features Timecode calculations can be performed with the same feel as a regular calculator. Convert between timecode and frames. Supports multiple frame rates. Input values ​​and calculation results are always automatically adjusted to within the range of 0 to 24 hours. How to Use Input Enter timecode and frame count using the number buttons (0-9). The AC button clears the displayed value and all calculation progress. The C button clears only the current input value and calculation result. The Delete button deletes the displayed value one character at a time. Numbers can be entered up to 8 digits long. Calculation Calculations are performed using the +, -, and = buttons, just like a regular calculator. For example, you can use the - button to calculate the elapsed time (duration) between two timecodes. Display Mode Press the F button to convert the displayed value to frames. Press the T button to convert the displayed value to timecode. You can freely change the display format, even during calculations. Changing Frame Rate Tap the fps display in the upper left corner of the screen to display the frame rate selection screen. You can choose from 23.98fps, 24fps, 25fps, 29.97fps, 30fps, 50fps, 59.94fps, and 60fps. 29.97fps and 59.94fps use the drop frame (DF) method, while other frame rates use the non-drop frame (NDF) method. Selecting the hh:mm:ss display allows you to calculate only hours, minutes, and seconds, excluding frames. Copy & Paste Press and hold the calculation result to display a menu with the options to copy or paste. You can copy or paste numbers by selecting an operation from the menu. This allows you to copy and paste numbers between the iPhone's standard calculator app, notes app, and other apps. If the string you are pasting contains non-numeric characters, only the numeric portion will be entered in order. In frame display mode, the value will be pasted with decimal points truncated. Other Memory Function The m+, m−, and mc buttons can be used to access the memory function. Memorized values ​​are displayed in the upper right corner of the screen, and you can use them as input values ​​by tapping them. This function is equivalent to the mr button on a typical calculator. Calculation History Function Swipe up on the calculation result display to view the most recent calculation history. The most recent 20 calculations are saved. If the number of saved calculations exceeds 20, the oldest will be automatically deleted. Additional Information Press the +/− button to change the sign of the input value and calculation result. Negative values ​​are displayed as 24 hours minus the corresponding value. Timecode calculation primarily complies with the SMPTE 12M-1 standard. The 59.94fps calculation is based on the counting method commonly used in Adobe Premiere Pro and other applications.

1144789626.description: “古琴调音器”与广为流传的“古琴调音定弦”是同一款APP。据琴友反映：按习惯搜索“古琴调音器”后，却下载了别的APP，浪费了银子。由于在apple商店里，APP的名字是不能更改的，因此重新发布一个新的APP，二者同时并存。 古琴调音定弦（古琴调音器），是“大音实验室”与“天一琴茶”设计并研发，根据初学琴友不易掌握调弦以及按音取音不准的问题而提出的整体解决方案。此款古琴专业调音器完全根据古琴传统定弦的方法设计，因古琴律制复杂，严格地说属于三分损益律和纯律的混合律制，其它基于任何单一律制的调音器都无法达到古琴所需要的精度，在此背景下，我们推出了这款专业的古琴定弦软件。 特别说明： 首次使用或系统升级后，出现指针无任何反应、无 法定音的情况，请在“手机设置－隐私－麦克风”打 开选项。 特点： 1. 设计思路源自传统古琴泛音调弦法； 2. 准确度高，与古琴专家纯听力定弦结果一致； 3. 精度正负1音分.； 4. 可以用五弦散音或七弦散音作为基准音； 5. 可以直接输入基准音数值； 6. 16种古琴常用调式可选(含嗨的国乐新创作的特殊调式) ； 7. 使用简便，无需了解任何乐理知识； 8. 可以测散音、泛音、按音、偏差一目了然.； 9. 可作为学习古琴工具，纠正古琴走音的准确度。 软件内置文字使用说明，请在选项界面打开查看。

1144904592.name: Қазақ Шежіресі
1144904592.description: Қазақ халқының бай мұрасы мен рухани қазынасын зерттеп, түсіну үшін жасалған Қазақ Шежіресі қосымшасын ұсынамыз. Бұл қосымша шежіре жинақтарын, дәстүрлерді және ата-бабаларымыздан қалған асыл мұраларды сақтап, келесі ұрпаққа жеткізуге бағытталған. Қосымшада сіз таба аласыз: Қазақ халқының рулары мен олардың ерекшеліктері туралы мәлімет. Рулардың шежіре кітаптары (92 кітап). Рулардың атадан таралуы мен тарихы. Әр рудың мекендеген жерлері мен олардың тарихи мәні. Қазақтың қасиетті 7 және 4 сандарының терең мағынасы және түсіндірмелері. Дәстүрлер мен ұлттық құндылықтар туралы мәліметтер. Ерекшеліктері: Жаңа мәліметтермен үнемі жаңартылып отырады. Интуитивті және ыңғайлы интерфейс. Әрбір пайдаланушыға түсінікті және қолжетімді ақпарат. Қазақтың өткенін түсініп, болашағын жарық ету үшін Қазақ Шежіресі қосымшасын жүктеп, ұлттық құндылықтарды сақтап, қолданыңыз! Жүктеңіз, зерттеңіз, біліңіз!

Әр рудың мекендеген жерлері мен олардың тарихи мәні. Қазақтың қасиетті 7 және 4 сандарының терең мағынасы және түсіндірмелері. Дәстүрлер мен ұлттық құндылықтар туралы мәліметтер. Ерекшеліктері: Жаңа мәліметтермен үнемі жаңартылып отырады. Интуитивті және ыңғайлы интерфейс. Әрбір пайдаланушыға түсінікті және қолжетімді ақпарат. Қазақтың өткенін түсініп, болашағын жарық ету үшін Қазақ Шежіресі қосымшасын жүктеп, ұлттық құндылықтарды сақтап, қолданыңыз! Жүктеңіз, зерттеңіз, біліңіз!

1144983743.name: Putty 3D
1144983743.description: 重要：Putty 3D 需要运行 iOS 11 的 iPhone 5s、iPad Air、iPad mini 2 或任何更新的 iPhone 或 iPad 设备。 Putty 是最优秀的 3D 素描簿，艺术家和爱好者们可随时进行创作。不论您在度假、坐在火车里或只是躺在沙发上，Putty 3D 都是您的完美伴侣。 它使用您的设备强大的图形处理器，创建平滑且直观的雕塑体验，iOS 专享。 Putty 3D 支持 Apple Pencil、3D Touch 和大量颜色，并已针对 iPad Pro 和 iPhone 7 优化，这意味着它可带来更大的雕塑规模以及更加流畅的应用性能。 对 OBJ 和 STL 导出的原生支持（仅适用于 iPhone 6 和 iPad Air 2 或更新设备）让您将创意转移到您 PC 或 Mac 上的建模和动画包，您甚至还可通过 3D 打印将创意带到真实世界（取决于打印硬件和软件，细节和兼容性可能会发生变化）。 简言之，您能够： 随时随地玩雕塑，使用 Apple Pencil 和 3D Touch 进行精准且对压力敏感的雕塑。 使用原生的 OBJ 和 STL 导出功能，将您的创意作品带到 PC 或 Mac 上您最喜爱的建模、动画甚至是 3D 打印应用。 使用如塑料、陶瓷甚至黄金等材料来让您的作品更焕发光彩（有时是毫不夸张的），这一切都通过基于物理学的渲染技术来实现。 为您的作品轻松录制视频，或使用可选的相机特效获得高分辨率屏幕截图。 欲了解 Putty 的最新信息，请在 Twitter、Facebook 或 Instagram 上关注 @putty3d。如您有任何反馈或问题，请发送电子邮件至 contact@putty3d.com，我们期待听到您的声音！

1146991999.name: 童格音乐 - 为孩子及家长设计
1146991999.trackName: 童格音乐 - 为孩子及家长设计
1146991999.description: +++ Best of 2016 (AppStore) +++ Parents´ Choice Gold Award 2017 +++ 在这款精心设计的应用程序中，你的孩子将畅游于音乐的海洋，尤其是古典音乐世界。 在这里，会有一些可爱的动物和有趣的角色，并配上关于乐器、音符和音乐示例的动画故事。所有故事都是通过音频和动画来讲述，因此，所有年龄段的孩子 - 甚至是没有阅读能力的孩子 - 都可以使用这款应用程序。而且，孩子们还可以通过弹钢琴或击打乐器来制作自己的音乐。在愉悦中学习。 这款应用程序是由经验丰富的音乐教师和插图家专为幼儿园和小学阶段的孩子创作的，适合全家人一起互动。精选的古典音乐名作，令人愉悦的插图，你的孩子定会喜欢上它。 特色 12部乐器动画电影，每一部都带音讯样本（包括小提琴、大提琴、小号、贝司、吉他、长笛） 交互式琴键用来演奏你自己的曲调 通过打击乐器探索自己的节奏（鼓、定音鼓、木琴） 音乐符号：音符、高音谱号、低音谱号、音值和换声点，并有示例和简短的练习 由Deutsche Grammophon授权使用著名作曲家（包括莫扎特(Mozart)、贝多芬（Beethoven）、巴赫（Bach）、海顿（Haydn）和柴可夫斯基（Tchaikovsky））的15段高品质音乐样本。 家长须知 这款寓教于乐的应用程序将让你的孩子通过听故事、演奏乐器而学习音乐知识。我们特意将本应用程序设计成无文字说明的应用。如果你想了解该应用程序的更多信息（如作曲家和作品），请下载我们的手册（目前提供英语、德语、西班牙语和日语版本）。你可以在本软件的受保护的家长空间或在我们的网站上找到该手册。 安全和隐私 本应用程序无广告，无程序内购买。只有在受保护的家长空间里才能访问互联网。本应用程序不收集或存储用户数据。儿童使用本应用程序，绝对安全。如有疑问或问题，请与我们联系：contact@firstconcert.com 专家点评 “我对该应用程序的质量和录音感到非常满意。这款应用程序的确是由音乐家开发的！非常棒，我祝该项目取得圆满成功”（音乐家） “这款应用程序将给很多孩子带来灵感。一款精心创作，并抓住了孩子的好奇心的作品”（幼儿教师） “无需任何说明就可以自主学习，孩子们就这样爱上了古典音乐”（音乐教师）

1147558030.description: Bouncy Flip is a simple & very challenging and addictive game. As the two coloured bouncy ball flips, Match the floor's color with the landing part of the ball. 1148400332.name: Harry's Dyno
1148400332.description: Harry's Dyno is a high precision performance measuring app. It utilizes GPS and OBD sensor input to recognize arbitrary speed ranges like 0-60 mph or 100-200 km/h. Both acceleration and deceleration testing is supported. Results can be compared and analyzed in details. Using two-cursor mode, one can inspect subranges of data recorded (e.g. 80 to 120 km/h for a 0 to 200 km/h). Data is stored locally and can be filtered by speed range and vehicle used. It can be exported to various data formats too. Provided the smartphone is mounted in a position with good GPS accuracy, the internal GPS can be used for measurements. For short speed ranges, high powered vehicles, and highest precision, either external GPS or OBD sensors can be connected. OBD adapters are actually preferable as speed changes are available instantly. We have an always up to date list of compatible accessories available here: www.gps-laptimer.de/compatibility/ios For distance based performance testing (quarter mile etc), please use Harry's LapTimer currently. This mode will be added to Harry's Dyno as a free upgrade shortly. For Harry's LapTimer users! Harry's LapTimer GrandPrix has received a free feature upgrade and includes Harry's Dyno functionality now: please follow LapTimer ‣ Race ‣ Performance to use the dyno mode. In case you have used Harry's LapTimer Petrolhead so far, you may either upgrade it to GrandPrix (LapTimer ‣ Administration ‣ Add-ons), or go for Harry's Dyno as a separate app. Enjoy and let us know what you think! For questions, tipps & tricks, and support, please use our forum www.gps-laptimer-forum.de

1148414373.name: Ciro's Fin de Siècle Kipper
1148414373.description: Introducing Ciro Marchetti’s Fin de Siecle Kipper! Kipper cards are a cartomancy deck long cherished in Germany. Like the Lenormand, Europeans have been reading with Kipper decks since the middle of the 19th century. Now Ciro Marchetti has created a contemporary heir to the Kipper tradition, accompanied by card meanings from three expert Kipper readers. Ciro’s elegant interpretation retains the cards’ antique charm, while expanding the deck’s focus with three supplemental cards. Fin de Siecle Kipper cards speak to human experience across all echelons of society. Set in Victorian England, here you will find the story of the workers as well as the wealthy. Ciro’s lavish images remain true to Kipper’s core message, while addressing darker aspects of life during the early Industrial Revolution. With Fin de Siecle Kipper, Ciro has revitalized a little-known cartomancy tradition, creating cards that are relevant to 21st century readers. Intuitive, elegant interface is easy for beginners and experts Gorgeous full screen, high-resolution card images Full support for all current iOS devices Sophisticated journal Includes book and substantial card meanings 13 spreads built in Design your own layout with Free Form Allow reversed cards or not Option to use Major Arcana only Zoom in to enlarge card details Share reading via e-mail, Facebook, and Twitter Animated shuffle & cut Optional voice prompts Customize with your own card meanings & reading cloths Many adjustable settings Book and card meanings available in English only Explore the Kippergeist, the spirit of the Kipper cards, with Fin de Siecle Kipper by Ciro Marchetti!

1148526988.name: Dictionary of Nautical Terms
1148526988.description: This app provides a dictionary of nautical terms. The dictionary defines common and not-so-common nautical words and sea terms, and some which, though now obsolete, appear regularly in contemporary books and still enrich the English language. As well as de facto terms dealing with every aspect of ships and the sea - warships, merchant vessels, small craft, seamanship, navigation, weather, naval design, construction and fittings. First published in 1867, The Sailor’s Word-Book defines some nautical terms from A, “the highest class of merchant ships,” to zumbra, “a Spanish skiff or yawl.” Whether the reader is a naval history buff, a fan of nautical fiction, or a yachting enthusiast, this new edition of a classic will prove a seaworthy companion. Basic features include: ■ Terms of The day Learn 5 nautical terms daily ■ Random terms Learn random terms ■ Other features: Over 12707 nautical terms and meaning Search for a term Bookmark a term Cross reference

1148617550.name: My Jump 2
1148617550.description: Designed by sport scientists. Validation published on the Journal of Strength & Conditioning Research and Journal of Sports Sciences***** Featured by Apple under ‘Best New Apps’ in 100+ countries*** The only app which calculates the force-velocity profile using the groundbreaking Samozino’s method*** My Jump 2 is the first app scientifically developed to measure your jump height. With a great design and validated by sport scientists, My Jump 2 is as reliable as a 10000$ force platform. Scientifically probed! Pierre Samozino (PhD, sport scientist, University of Savoy): “My Jump 2 makes possible the determination of the jump height with a high accuracy, which has been validated in very recent scientific study. The other, and I think the main added value of this app is to propose the determination of the Force-Velocity-Power profile of each athlete and its own imbalance between force and velocity qualities. Very useful to optimize your strength training and improve your explosive performances.” Jean-Benoit Morin (PhD, sport scientist, University of Nice): “My Jump 2 is the cutting edge, scientifically validated and most practical application to measure athletes vertical jumping performance, and the only one to include the complete "Optimal Force-Velocity Profile" analysis we recently validated. I'm using it with athletes, students, and research subjects. The entire Jumping Force-Velocity-Power and Optimal F-V Profile approach in your pocket!” My Jump 2 gives you advanced information of your jumps using the camera on your iPhone, iPod touch or iPad. Just record a jump, select accurately its take off and landing and lets My Jump do its magic. My Jump 2 calculates the height, flight time, velocity, force and power of your vertical jumps. Also, it gives you the contact time, vertical stiffness and reactive strength index (RSI) of your Drop Jumps. Moreover, it allows you to calculate your Force-Velocity profile using Samozino's method. Complete analysis of your jumps right on your hand! FEATURES: Accurate measurement of your vertical jumps. Scientifically demonstrated! Calculate the force-velocity profile using the groundbreaking Samozino’s method. You can know your maximal theoretical force, velocity, power and how far you are from your optimal capabilities! You can even get information about which quality (force or velocity) you should work to increase your explosive performance. Record stunnig slowmo videos up to 240fps or import as much as you like from your camera roll. 1148686705.name: Fairy Tale Lenormand
1148686705.description: Explore a magical realm of peasants and princesses, dragons and daring deeds, in Fairy Tale Lenormand! With enchanting art by Lisa Hunt and a delightful guidebook by Arwen Lynch, Fairy Tale Lenormand weaves multicultural myths into the familiar structure of the Lenormand deck. These tales are drawn from Grimm’s Fairytales, The Arabian Nights, Native American legends, and Asian folklore. Each well-chosen myth provides a metaphor illuminating that card’s message, and anchoring the Lenormand images in the universal world of fairy tales. Intuitive, elegant interface is easy for beginners and experts Gorgeous full screen, high-resolution card images Full support for all current iOS devices Sophisticated journal Includes full and unabridged book 16 spreads built in Design your own layout with Free Form Allow reversed cards or not Option to use Major Arcana only Zoom in to enlarge card details Share reading via e-mail, Facebook, and Twitter Animated shuffle & cut Optional voice prompts Customize with your own card meanings & reading cloths Many adjustable settings Book and card meanings available in English only Enjoy timeless tales teaching important life lessons through Lenormand!

1149670386.name: 走遍法国第二册 -Reflets原版视听
1149670386.trackName: 走遍法国第二册 -Reflets原版视听
1149670386.description: 《走遍法国》该套教材以视听内容为基础，语法结构安排合理，融语言和文化于一体，以积极互动的教学法有效培养学生的听说能力。 本应用根据原书改编设计，原版共有三个水平等级分册，第二册共有12个单元，即12课。 每课故事分成几个部分，并由情景学习、观察人物行为、语法学习、语音、语言交际、阅读与写作、文化点滴、文学赏析等学习板块构成，介绍法国或法语国家的文化。 ■语音方面更注重语调的交际功能； ■语言交际也更强调同一种语言行为的多样表达方式的训练； ■以法语国家和地区为主题介绍了法国的几个特色地区、海外省和海外领地，以及比利时和魁北克两个重要的法语国家和地区。 《走遍法国》在法国杂志和图书出版业拥有举足轻重的地位。在法语界，法国教材REFLETS系列一向备受关注。 《走遍法国》作为法国原版的视听教材，它具备了许多其它国内教材所没有的优点。同时作为留法面签前法语培训的指定教材，它的重要性更是显而易见。 适合中国人学习法语，让读者身临其境般地体会法国文化和法语学习的魅力！

1149956692.trackName: Sensnap - 海拔,气压,运动轨迹
1149956692.description: Sensnap — 户外传感数据与轨迹记录助手 面向户外爱好者的移动应用：以卡片方式呈现手机传感器数据；在后台持续记录海拔、气压与经纬度，生成趋势图并支持表格导出；可实时绘制移动轨迹，并基于历史坐标重现地图路径；支持自定义水印模板，将多项数据叠加到照片与轨迹图上。 主要功能 数据卡片：海拔、气压、速度、方向等，一目了然 后台记录与可视化：自动生成趋势图，支持 CSV 导出 轨迹管理：实时轨迹与历史坐标绘制地图路径 自定义水印：时间、坐标、海拔等数据水印，适用于图片与轨迹图 适用场景：徒步、越野跑、骑行、露营、登山、旅行等

1150347355.description: Express yourself by sending these animated stickers of memes from rage comics to your friends trough iMessage. More than 70 animated stickers of rage faces and other internet memes. A total amount of over 100 stickers, growing with every update. Each rage face has been completely redesigned and carefully animated. Watch i became alive on your device! Just tap the sticker you want to send it in a conversation or peel and slap them on top of bubbles, dress up a photo, or even put one on another sticker. HOW TO FIND THE STICKERS AFTER INSTALLING 1. Open an iMessage chat in the Messages app; 2. Tap the '>' button on the left of the text entry field; 3. Tap the App button (it looks like an A); 4. Tap the button with the four circles on the lower left of the screen to open the iMessage app drawer; 5. Tap the Ragemotion icon and choose the rage comic you want to send!

1150898780.name: KMZ Viewer-Converter
1150898780.description: KMZ Viewer-Converter is an application provides you to load the kmz files, convert kmz files over the map. This app works for offline and online. How to Export or Import .kmz files into Application? You can view, add or import .kmz files into the application in multiple ways 1)Keep the .kmz files to the mail or any places in mobile, then long press on kmz file that shows the application icon.click to import the file over the map. 2)Share files from other apps which will be similarly supported files like Email,WhatsApp,Add to Notes,Add to iCloud Drive,Save to files and other apps. 3)Click on “Add through link” Icon on Menu bar enter .kmz files link to add the files into the application. 4)Connect your iPhone or iPad to System then iTunes will automatically opens an window.Click phone symbol on top left—>File Sharing and you can see the Kmz viewer app then click on app icon to add .kmz files. 5)Tap on the file to share or export to the other Applications. How to create Kmz Markers? 1)Long press on map to add markers. 2)You can Convert the Kmz with userDefined Names. 3)After successfully saving the file will be stored in list. 4)You can again load the saved Kmz file over the map. 5)You can share Kmz files to multiple apps similarly supported files. How to delete the Kmz file? 1)In the list section, swipe left to delete file.The file will be permanently deleted from the application. How to See marker details? 1)load kmz file on map.If the file contains markers, then tap on the marker to see the detail description of marker like Description,email id, url links,phone numbers,Images,Web site page. 2)KMZ file Info is the new features added recently, when the file loads on the map you can see file info on top left.On Clicking the full information of the file is visible. —>Connect to Internet to open the url links,web pages,Images. "Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life."

1151120599.name: 每日消耗卡路里计算器
1151120599.trackName: 每日消耗卡路里计算器
1151120599.description: 每日消耗卡路里计算器 基础代谢率计算器 体重指数计算器 每日消耗卡路里计算器 计算每天需要的卡路里。 你可以用计算器来计算你每天的热量总需求。 运用每日热量总需求来管理你的健康。 需要输入你的身高、体重、性别、年龄和活动水平。 运动水平: 久坐不动（几乎不锻炼)。 轻微运动 (每周1–3天)。 适中运动 (每周3–5天) 。 较多运动 (每周6–7天)。 很多运动 (每天两次，剧烈运动)。 计算你的热量总需求。 基础代谢率计算器 BMR计算器 - 基础代谢计算器 基础代谢率(BMR)计算器. 本应用可以计算BMR。 计算您的 BMR. 请输入您的性别、年龄、身高和体重，然后点击“计算BMR“按钮。度量单位:公制,英制。 基础代谢率(BMR)是指人体在 非活动状态 下，维持生命所需的最低能量。 BMR计算器采取 Mifflin-St. Jeor 公式来估计您的 BMR。 体重指数计算器 身体质量指数计算器 体重指数计算器 - BMI计算器 - BMI指数计算器 本应用可以计算BMI指。 身体质量指数(BMI)计算器。 输入你的身高和体重，然后点击“计算BMI“按钮。度量单位:公制,英制。 身体质量指数计算结果分析。

1151196826.name: PolyNome Pro: Drum Sequencer
1151196826.description: LEARN — Map songs and understand complex rhythms. PRACTICE — Plan, play, and track your progress. PERFORM — Build your band’s click Setlist in seconds. Designed by a musician, for musicians. Used by Vinnie Colaiuta, Peter Erskine, Virgil Donati, Dennis Chambers & more. ◆ THE BASICS ▶ Sample-accurate metronome for any time signature, with automatic and randomised tempo changes, subdivision faders, tap tempo, Big Numbers, and a classic pendulum. ▶ Choose from hundreds of sounds, including voice counting. With Premium, import or record your own samples. ▶ Use the repeat counter and timer to track your work or stop automatically at your target. ▶ Program two independent sequencers with overlapping rhythms or different time signatures. ▶ Built-in tuner with calibration (for example, A=442), plus hands-free control using Siri or Bluetooth/MIDI. ◆ LEARN › Learn songs faster and take the stress out of rehearsals with Media Tracks ▶ Import from Apple Music, YouTube, or your own audio and video files. ▶ Mark bars and sections in one pass, then jump anywhere with a tap—no scrubbing to find your place. ▶ Loop or slow down difficult passages, then create and annotate a clean, printable Lead Sheet. › Learn with interactive resources ▶ Install resources combining video, playable rhythms, scores, and notes—from the 40 Essential Rudiments to The Black Page—or create your own. › Hear, see, and understand complex rhythms ▶ Program virtually any rhythm—even irrational meters such as 4/5—and hear accents, flams, drags, rolls, and ties played precisely. ▶ Add automatic spoken and written counting, or use Stroke Guides to see the correct sticking for any rudiment. ▶ Build two- and three-way polyrhythms, hear how the parts fit together, and follow multiple animated visualizations. ◆ PRACTICE › Plan ahead. Then just play ▶ Use Goals to choose what to work on, when, and for how long—including overall targets that tell you when to move on. ▶ Build routines with Playlists, automations, repeats, and voice cues. Keep timers, charts, book pages, videos, and notes one tap away. ▶ Record the screen with a camera feed, then turn the video into a Media Track to annotate, loop, and slow down. › See the work add up ▶ PolyNome automatically logs every exercise, tempo, duration, and date. Follow streaks, spot neglected tempos, and compare practice periods. ▶ Add notes to any event and see your cumulative time on that exercise at that moment—revealing how long improvement took. ▶ Print PDF reports or export your history as CSV. Teachers can review what students practiced and read notes made while difficulties were fresh. ◆ PERFORM — Build your band’s click Setlist in seconds. ▶ Create clicks for originals, automatically find the tempo, key, and duration of covers, or import an Apple Music playlist. ▶ See the total running time as you build, and add interval or encore markers showing the duration above each break. ▶ Produce a professional printable Setlist in a couple of taps. › Take everything you need on stage ▶ Attach charts, PDFs, text notes, or forScore links so the right information appears with each click. ▶ If someone starts first, use Tap To Start to bring the click in at their tempo, or use haptics for a silent click you can feel. ◆ ORGANIZE, DISCOVER & SHARE ▶ Keep Rhythms, Clicks, Media, Playlists, Setlists, and Shortcuts organized—and find anything with search, labels, sorting, and filtering. ▶ Discover lessons and examples from Home, explore the free Public Library, or join the Practice Room for live Q&As, support, and courses. ▶ Share with PolyNome users or export MIDI and audio files. ▶ Supports VoiceOver. ▶ Send audio to other apps with Audiobus or Inter-App Audio.

1151348412.name: 通用云POS
1151348412.description: 通用云POS是一个为餐饮业设计的IOS应用,可以代替传统餐厅菜谱。用户可以在现有酒店软件平台上通过接口方式接入并构建华丽的iPad电子菜谱。本应用下载安装后默认为演示菜品,用户可以通过设置下载更新菜品和图片; 产品特点: 支持粤菜的加收、做法加价和附加项; 支持自定义界面,用户可以自行设计菜谱界面; 最新更新: 优化通讯,支持4G/5G移动手机网络 增加收银台功能，增加单品打折功能 全新基于多线程的GCD架构让点菜下单更高效便捷 联系电话：18807110335

1151401197.name: 好色相机
1151401197.description: 2015年度相机应用《菲林菲林》作者打造的又一款相机软件。 ========== 主要功能介绍 ========== 好(hǎo)色相机 —— 一款可以帮助你提高审美品味的相机 图片的整体配色是能让美感层次提升的绝佳办法，好(hǎo)色相机就是为了挖掘配色灵感而设计，让你在美丽的图片中找到最适配的颜色搭配方案。 通过拍摄或导入照片，从照片中提取出最主要的5种颜色（主色、辅色、活跃色、静态色、背景色），为你的色彩搭配提供参考和灵感！ ========== 使用场景 ========== 今天出门搭哪个包包？画哪个唇彩？用好色相机拍一下。 Bling一下给出你今天的主色调：恩，亲今天的风格是偏低对比度的黄棕色系呢，清新淡雅又不失稳重和活力。 所以通过色卡，亲会选择怎样的搭配呢？是大红包包，还是蓝色包包？还是米棕包包呢？相信你已经有了答案！ 化妆、搭配、装修、设计、PPT...凡是需要配色的场景，你都可以试试好色相机哦！记住是三声 hǎo ~~ ========== 其他功能介绍 ========== 支持从相册导入 可以将照片快速分享到社交媒体 可以查看照片的 Exif 信息 全面适配iOS13和暗黑模式自适应； 全面适配iPad，支持横竖屏实时切换； 可以在设置中设置自己喜欢的图标，并且可以恢复默认； ========== 需要权限 ========== 需要访问用户的相机和相册的权限 ========== 联系方式 ========== 我是个人开发者，纯个人爱好做的这款软件。没有宣传的资金，推广和宣传靠大家帮忙了，多谢！ support@aben.io https://colorcamera.aben.io 用户交流QQ群:8768666

1152204742.name: Super Vectorizer Pro
1152204742.description: Super Vectorizer Pro 是非常强大的，目前最好用的位图转矢量图工具。自动追踪图像格式，并根据图像边缘或者彩色或者灰度进行矢量化，从而输出高品质的AI，SVG，DXF和PDF矢量文件，支持输出透明背景图。Super Vectorizer Pro 采用全新的图像索引算法，支持高达64种颜色，使得生成的矢量图颜色更自然。 除了精确的把位图转换为矢量图片，Super Vectorizer Pro 还可轻松修复图片边缘的锯齿，让图片边缘更加圆滑。用户可选择相应的转换模式，由Super Vectorizer Pro 进行自动识别和分析，达到自已所需的效果。支持JPG, GIF, PNG, BMP, TIFF 等等到AI，SVG， DXF和PDF 的格式转换。位图转换得来的矢量图可直接共享，真正的放大而不失真。 Super Vectorizer Pro 支持导入众多的图像格式: JPG, BMP, PNG, GIF, PDF, PSD, PNT, RGB, ARW, BMPF, CUR, CRW, CR2, DCR, DNG, EPSF, EPSI, EPI, EPS, EXR, EFX, ERF, FPX, FPIX, FAX, FFF, GIFF, G3, HDR, ICNS, ICO, JP2, JFX, JFAX, JPE, JFIF, JPF, MPO, MAC, M

1152205182.name: Three Little Pigs vs The Wolf
1152205182.trackName: Three Little Pigs vs The Wolf
1152205182.description: The award-winning interactive fairy tale for children! Experience the world-famous fairy tale "The Three Little Pigs" as a lovingly designed, interactive story. Your child reads, listens, plays, and discovers the story in a whole new way. No Ads No In-App Purchases Works completely offline – no Wi-Fi or internet required AWARD-WINNING CHILDREN'S APP 50,000+ downloads in the App Store Featured on n-tv, WDR, COMPUTER BILD, and Viel Spaß Gold Winner of the Global Ebook Awards 2017 Two-time winner of the Show Your App Awards 2017 Nominated for the GIGA-Maus Award 2017 Nominated for the Independent Publisher Book Awards 2017 Nominated for the Best Mobile App Awards in the categories: Books & Reference, Education, Entertainment, Family & Children, Educational, and Family LEARNING THROUGH PLAY AND FUN Our app combines the story of the Three Little Pigs with interactive games, exciting tasks, and charming animations. Children are actively involved in the story, which playfully promotes concentration, attention, and language comprehension. The app is ideal for preschool and primary school children, as well as for reading together with parents. WHAT TO EXPECT Interactive story with numerous animations and surprises Child-friendly questions and varied educational games Active participation in the story: – House building for the pigs: Solve the charming house-building puzzle together with your child. – Interactive Wolf Action: Help the wolf blow down the houses with powerful huffs and puffs via touch control. Lively Characters: Every character in every scene is individually and specially animated. Simply tap a character during the story to trigger funny animations and witty reactions. Read-to-me or read-it-myself modes Cartoon animations and interactive audiobook features Words are highlighted in color as they are read aloud – ideal for learning to read High-quality illustrations and professional animations Lovingly composed music and matching sound effects Completely available in English, German, Spanish, and Russian DISCOVER TOGETHER Our app creates shared moments between parents and children. Reading aloud, playing along, and discovering together not only promote language development but also turn the fairy tale into a very special experience. WE LOOK FORWARD TO YOUR FEEDBACK! Your ratings and suggestions help us to continuously improve and develop our apps. MORE INFORMATION Website: https://www.deev.de/three-little-pigs-app.html E-Mail: support@deev.de Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/interactiveappsforkids YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/irenedeevthreelittlepigs

1152234483.name: MyToday - Diary
1152234483.description: MyToday is a diary you can easily write everything on. The app is for those who love writing diaries. Start with MyToday. — [Please read] My Today does not store user data on the server. The data is saved on the user's mobile phone. If My Today data is accidentally deleted for getting device capacity, the text will not be visible and cannot be recovered. In order to keep your valuable articles safely, it is recommended to periodically backup to 'Dropbox' or 'Google Drive'. (Required before device change / reset) You can Backup from the setting of the My Today App. — [How to use MYTODAY] You can create today's diary by selecting the top area of ​​the main screen. Select the camera icon to take a picture and attach it immediately. When you select the picture icon, you can attach up to 10 pictures from the camera roll. The location icon can add your current location or specific location information. If you touch the expansion icon, you can write and edit pictures on a wide screen. You can edit or delete the created list in the main screen by swiping left. You can use the full editing function by swiping the created list on the main screen to the right. On a 3D Touch-enabled device, you can edit or delete the list directly by tapping the list. You can check the diary by date by selecting the calendar icon in the upper right corner. You can find the diary by using the search icon in the upper left corner. Swipe up the calendar on the calendar screen to view the list on a wider screen. You can move the month with the left and right swipe gestures on the calendar screen, and you can see the previous year or the following year through the year view icon at the top. Dropbox backup and recovery is possible in the settings. You can back up data by e-mail in Settings. Notifications are available daily in Settings. You can check the written text only by yourself. You can make your passwords safer by setting passwords. For more information on backing up and restoring your data, please check the developer website. Thank you for using My Today. :)

1152462297.name: 加减百分比
1152462297.description: 快速计算任何税务和费用。只需输入金额，即可看到含税和扣除税率的金额。 会自动侦测剪贴板上的金额，在打开应用程序时自动完成计算 同步显示结果：含税和扣除税率的金额 储存您的税务/费用和其他花费列表 同步列表至装置和iCloud上如果您需要在考虑利息的情况下定期计算金额并且这些百分比保持不变，那么此应用程序将对您有用。 只需输入一个数字，即可立即获得添加金额和考虑此金额的金额，以及反向利息金额。 提前准备一份百分比（税、费率、利润、折扣）清单。 为它们添加名称、百分比值和类型 - 您需要将其添加到金额中，否则已包含在内。 当您需要根据出价找出金额时，选择所需的百分比并输入金额。 机会： 同时显示结果，添加的数量和包含的 确定剪贴板中是否有数字并立即用它进行计算，您可以在计算器上计算，复制结果，然后打开此应用程序并立即获得所有计算。 存储百分比、名称、费率和类型的列表 - 没有限制 使用 iCloud 同步百分比列表 应用程序中没有广告或应用内购买。

1153419320.name: Fluent English Speech
1153419320.description: The follow-up to the bestselling Get Rid of Your Accent UK1 app. Designed for learners who want to speak English fluently, clearly, and confidently—just like a native speaker. App Contents: Part 1: Master difficult speech patterns — word endings, consonant clusters, schwa, strong & weak forms. Part 2: Connected speech — learn to speak in natural phrases instead of separate words. Part 3: Improve intonation, sentence stress & rhythm — make your speech smooth, clear, and engaging. Functionality: Native model audio tracks Listen & repeat training Record your voice Compare pronunciation instantly With this app, you will: Develop English fluency and natural flow Improve pronunciation, intonation & rhythm Learn idioms & colloquial expressions to sound authentic Reduce your foreign accent and speak with confidence Boost career opportunities and personal impact through clear communication Meet the Authors: Linda James (RAM, Dip. Ed., IPD, LRAM), Speech and Drama coach, trained at the Royal Academy of Music, with 20+ years of experience teaching RP and accent reduction in London drama schools, films, and TV. Olga Smith (BA Linguistics, MBA), Linguist, public speaker, and co-author of the best-selling *Get Rid of Your Accent book series. Having overcome her own strong Russian accent, Olga brings practical expertise to learners worldwide. Visit www.batcsglobal.com to book a professional speech analysis.

1154832936.trackName: Call Ranger: 海量来电拦截器
1154832936.description: 使用 Call Ranger 屏蔽整个区号、国家代码或任意电话号码范围! 我们开发了这款通话和短信垃圾拦截器,它使用最多12位通配符的模式匹配功能,让您只用一条规则就能拦截数十亿种电话号码组合! 全球示例： 中国："+86 10 XXXX XXXX" → 拦截 +86 10 0000 0000 至 +86 10 9999 9999 美国："+1 415 XXX XXXX" → 拦截 +1 415 000 0000 至 +1 415 999 9999 日本："+81 3 XXXX XXXX" → 拦截 +81 3 0000 0000 至 +81 3 9999 9999 韩国："+82 70 XXXX XXXX" → 拦截 +82 70 0000 0000 至 +82 70 9999 9999 + 适用于全球所有国家 主要功能: 无需注册 无需订阅 无额外费用 同时拦截电话和短信 创建无限拦截规则 隐私保障 - 所有数据保存在您的设备上 使用方法： 1. 在iOS设置中启用Call Ranger：电话 → 来电阻止与身份识别 2. 在iOS设置中启用Call Ranger → 信息 → 短信过滤器 3. 点击未接来电旁的"i"按钮 → "共享联系人" → "拦截相似号码" → 选择要拦截的位数（最多12位！）即可完成！ 隐私保证： 所有数据和拦截规则都保存在您的设备上。Call Ranger不会访问或存储您的个人信息。

1156869755.description: 通过银河地图 - 恒星和行星体验迷人的宇宙奇观，这是一个交互式 3D 天文馆，由从 NASA 和 ESA 空间获得的精确数据提供支持 任务。 深入探索无限广阔的太空，在这里可以获得直接来自突破性太空研究最前沿的丰富知识。 穿越广阔的银河系，翱翔在星尘中，前往数百万颗恒星。 降落在外星行星和系外卫星上，那里令人惊叹的风景和数不清的奇观等待着您的到来。 享受跳入气态巨行星湍流大气层、到达其难以捉摸的核心的快感。 该应用程序包括“银河地图”和“星星和行星”应用程序，以及所有应用内购买（以及未来的插件）。 当您冒险接近黑洞、脉冲星和磁星时，突破探索的界限，在那里物理定律已达到极限。 借助银河地图 - 恒星和行星，整个宇宙都成为您的游乐场，为您提供无与伦比的发现和启发平台。 功能 ▶ 沉浸式航天器模拟，让用户飞向不同的行星和卫星，探索气态巨行星的深处 ▶ 登陆系外行星并指挥一个角色，探索这些遥远世界的独特表面 ▶ 每日更新多个来源的系外行星信息，无需手动更新应用程序 ▶ 广泛的在线数据库，包含太阳系中约 785 万颗恒星、7500 多个系外行星、205 个星周盘、32868 个黑洞、3344 个脉冲星和 150 多个卫星（加上系外卫星） ▶ 全面的搜索系统，可高效检索恒星和星下物体的数据 ▶ 全球可访问性，支持 100 多种语言 从各种来源导入的数据包括：SIMBAD、太阳系外行星百科全书、NASA 系外行星档案、行星宜居性实验室 加入我的不和谐服务器，这样您就可以看到未来计划的新功能，或者如果您只是想谈论与空间相关的内容： https://discord.gg/dyeu3BR 如果您有 PC/Mac，您还可以从此处的浏览器访问恒星和行星： https://galaxymap.net/webgl/index.html

1158762426.description: 根据梦工场的动画《魔发精灵》制作而成的全新亲子联宜及学习软体。专为小朋友而设的有趣音乐冒险经已上架！ 鼓励你的小朋友利用互动的阅读app，学习阅读和唱歌！在小朋友睡觉前，和他讲有关波比的冒险故事，或者调校至自动模式让他听故事，利用音高辨认和唱歌活动学习并把握音准，促进亲子关系。魔发精灵的互动冒险设有英文和普通话版，你的小朋友不单可以尽情地唱歌，更能学习生词！跟宝宝一起在《魔发精灵：波比的派对》寓教育于娱乐吧！ 故事： 和魔发精灵村里最快乐的角色一起预备和举行派对！ 波比要举办派对，她非常兴奋！帮她向魔发精灵村的魔发精灵们发出邀请信，和她的朋友（如小不点和布兰）见面。大家都非常兴奋呢！ 可是，有一个魔发精灵却不太高兴。找找他是谁，并且帮助他投入派对。也许唱歌能帮到他！ 在整个村里寻找答案，迎接尽情唱歌，跳舞和抱抱的愉快晚上！ 特点： 梦工场动画《魔发精灵》（2016年）的官方互动教育娱乐软体。 内容浅白易懂，适合1 - 3年级的小朋友自行阅读 音高辨识：试试跟着音调唱歌学习把握音准！ 由母语为英语及普通话的配音员讲故事。 自动模式：程序自动和你的小朋友讲睡前故事。 和你最喜欢的魔发精灵角色一起互动！ 有趣动画：点击或唱歌去观看角色移动和跳舞！ 有多首儿歌可供选择。 你的口袋里有阳光吗？那么，和魔发精灵村里超级开心的波比和所有魔发精灵们，一起跳舞、跳舞和跳舞吧！ DreamWorks Trolls © 2016 DreamWorks Animation LLC. All Rights Reserved.

1158767577.name: 网球 Plus : 挥杆分析器 & 活动跟踪器
1158767577.trackName: 网球 Plus : 挥杆分析器 & 活动跟踪器
1158767577.description: 用你的apple watch提高运动效率！这是苹果手表的第一个网球专门应用,提供活动追踪和挥拍分析功能。只要把你的apple watch戴在手腕上打网球, 它不断地追踪活动，记录数据，分析动作。 网球 Plus : 挥杆分析器 & 活动跟踪器特征 Simple UI & Quick start Breakdown your shot and check your style (forehand, backhand, topspin, flat, slice, volley, smash, serve) Measure your swing speed & spin Support right-hand and also left-hand grip player Real time detection of swings Energy efficient for battery life (Optimized & accurate algorithm) Working all the time you play (Even when the screen is off) Everything is synced automatically with your iPhone Check your step counts & calories during the sessions (integrated with the HealthKit) Apple Watch & WatchOS 3.0 is required but no need any other device Please feel free to send me your feedback. (use e-mail or twitter)

1159266744.name: 双子 Gemini
1159266744.description: 游戏是由回音石工作室Echostone Games 独立开发并由心动网络 XD.com 发行的一款情感体验类游戏 无需联网无内购，一次购买畅玩不尽 [简介] 在《双子 Gemini》中，没有语言与文字，也没有手把手的指南，学会飞翔，探索未知世界，都是游戏体验的一部分。 黑暗吞噬星空，孤星降临大地； 蓦然回首，一缕熟悉的光芒； 新的生命，守望一段美丽的旅途； 他们将如何划过天宇，点亮世界？ 两颗星星的旅程， 彼此心灵的羁绊， 在一起， 我们就能飞翔…… [操控方法] 操纵一颗小星，靠近同伴，一起在空中飞舞，克服困难，点亮世界。 [媒体评价] ”这是一款需要静下心来细细聆听与品味的禅式游戏，有时候几乎会让人忘了这是在手机平台上。生命中我们也需要等待那颗互相吸引、不离不弃的双子星，与TA互相围绕、互相前行，才能体会到更多的点点滴滴。牵住你的双子星，慢慢走，欣赏啊。“——机核网 阿彬 “一场魅力十足，情难自禁的旅行”——洛杉矶时报 “这是一部优雅而又华丽的游戏作品”——Polygon “在不知不觉中开始让人觉得一堆算法变得有了意义”——Kotaku [获奖荣耀] SXSW 2015 Gamer's Voice Finalist** IGF 2015 Student Showcase Winner** IndieCade 2014 Finalist** BigSushi.FM PAX Prime 2014 Golden Sushi Award** Boston FIG 2014 Awesome Aesthetics Award** Indie Prize US Showcase 2014 Official Selection** [游戏特色] 为全年龄设计，简单易上手 原创的体验式游戏玩法 没有语言与文字，用图像和音乐讲述美丽故事 抽象绝美的画面并配以精致感人的音乐 通关单人模式后会有双人模式，体验和乐趣加倍 无需联网无内购，一次购买畅玩不尽 Gemini Original Soundtrack http://music.163.com/m/album?id=35271622

1159700098.name: 去月球-To the Moon
1159700098.description: To the Moon简体中文版全新上架。这是一个像素画微型游戏，全程只有几个小时，且没有战斗，但是其凭借巧妙细腻的叙事方式，打动人心的音乐以及发人深思的主题获得了全球玩家的共鸣，同时收获了诸多好评。其中就包括了权威媒体Gamespot最佳剧本，Metacritic最佳游戏及WIRED最佳游戏等重要大奖，还获得了今年Steam“我没有哭，只是眼睛里进了点沙子”的奖项提名。 游戏是由心动网络获得授权，并负责在手机上高清重制，是一款经典剧情向RPG游戏。原作PC版由加拿大华裔制作人Kan Gao和他的独立游戏开发团队 Freebird Games 于6年前发售，好评如潮。 [关于手机重制版] 新解锁29个新的 imessage 贴纸 新增音乐盒功能，支持后台播放/下载游戏内音乐（通关后自动开启） 新增 DIY 二维码分享功能，一键分享，多设备随时同步游戏进度。 保留原版像素风格，高清化重制的全新游戏画面 完全重制的全新UI界面菜单 特别针对手机屏幕重新优化了点触操作，还新增了摇杆操作 自动随时存档，想玩就玩，无压力 [游戏特色] 一个独特的非战斗型故事的游戏体验 完美结合冒险元素和经典RPG美学的创新组合 备受赞誉的原创音乐与游戏情节的推演丝丝入扣 一个浓缩式的剧情安排让人尽情体验原汁原味的动人故事 [故事概要] 这是一个讲述两个医生借由改变记忆为弥留之际的人们完成他们人生最后愿望的故事。罗莎莉恩博士（Dr. Rosalene）和沃茨博士（Dr. Watts）有一份非常特殊的工作：他们可以给人们重活一次的机会，从人生的最开始重头来过，当然这个机会只存在于将死之人的头脑里。 由于其带来的严重后果，新的人工记忆将取代真实记忆成为病人临终前记住的事，所以通过修改记忆去满足人们最后愿望的这种技术只能对临死的人实施。 这个特别的故事让玩家跟随两位医生为实现一个老人约翰尼（Johnny）的梦想而进入他的记忆。 随着每一步时间的推移，约翰尼过去的一个个新的片段将被慢慢揭示。两位医生将约翰尼记忆中一直困扰他的许多事件重组在一起，他们试图找出究竟是何原因会让身体虚弱的老人临死前要实现这样的愿望。 而约翰尼（Johnny）的最后心愿竟是…去月球。 Languages Supported: English Français Deutsch Español (Latinoamérica) Español (Europa) Português Polski lingua italiana (Italian) Người việt nam русский(Russian) 한국어 (Korean) 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese) 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese) 日本語 (Japanese) Türk dili(Turkish) Українська（Ukraine） Facebook: /TotheMoonHD Twitter: @TotheMoonHD Service email: TotheMoon@xindong.com © 2017 X.D.
