1238778050.name: 纪念碑谷2
1238778050.description: 森林之旅，盎然新生。《纪念碑谷2》首个新内容“失落的森林”更新。 【游戏介绍】 “2014苹果年度大奖”的续作，《纪念碑谷2》将会带领你体验一场在美丽奇幻世界中的全新冒险之旅。 在旅途中帮助萝尔教导她的女儿关于纪念碑谷的奥秘，探索令人惊叹的绝美幻境以及随意操纵神奇唯美 的建筑。 《纪念碑谷2》是一扇通往新世界的门扉，将为你带来更多探索。你会再一次扭转现实，让 绝壁成为道路；再一次让想象狂奔，用高塔搭建通途。真正的道路，永远潜藏在迷途之中。 【游戏特色】 1、 一场独一无二的奇幻旅程 一个全新的故事，你无需先玩纪念碑谷，可以直接去体验纪念碑谷2 2、 充满谜题的优雅关卡 互动式角色解密，世界在角色之间动态转换，一切美好前所未见 3、 于奇境中行走 常识在此被颠覆。建筑风格、艺术运动与个人意识完美结合，构筑出令人眩目的神圣几何 4、 一步一世界 每一步都带你踏入新世界，每一段风景都妙不可言 【媒体评价】 堪称一座艺术游戏的丰碑。——游戏葡萄 让世界惊叹！——Gamelook 唯美动人的艺术迷宫，言少情深的感人故事 ——TapTap 达到了在交互、设计与故事性上优雅的平衡。——界面 令人炫目的美好—— Destructoid 更深刻，更精巧——Wired 一份惊喜——Polygon 【联系我们】 喜爱我们的粉丝们，欢迎随时与我们交流！ 中国区官网：http://mv2.qq.com 官网微信公众号：jinianbeigu2 官方微博：http://weibo.com/monumentvalley2 ===== 纪念碑谷2仅与运行iOS 9及更高版本的设备兼容

1239098425.description: Camera M 是一款专业手动相机，专为一件事而设计——帮助您使用类似 DSLR 的强大精确手动控制，以最高质量捕捉美丽照片。 亮点 支持手势操作的原生手动控制，带“微调”功能 iOS 26 优化，Liquid Glass 设计 微距摄影最小对焦距离显示 智能对焦追踪 对焦峰值显示和带平移功能的 4 倍放大镜 实时 RGB 直方图 手动灰卡校准 最大图像处理，确保最佳图像质量 零处理 RAW 支持 支持 ProRAW*、RAW、HEIF、JPEG、TIFF 和 PNG 格式 拍摄模式：单张、连拍、定时、实时、景深*、双重拍摄*、曝光包围 三重拍摄模式：同时拍摄超广角、广角和长焦* Darkroom 集成 实用摄影小组件 App 快捷方式 相机控制 – 手动对焦 – 微距和场景对焦预设 – 曝光补偿 – 手动 ISO 和曝光时间调节 – ISO & 曝光时间半优先模式 – 手动白平衡（色温和色偏） – 白平衡预设 – 灰卡白平衡校准 – 闪光灯：自动、开启、关闭 – 手电筒亮度调节 – 手动切换超广角、广角和长焦相机* – 10 倍数字捏合缩放 – 支持所有手动控制 – 锁屏拍摄支持 图像格式 – Apple ProRAW* – 带防抖 RAW* – HEIF（可选最小压缩）* – JPEG（可选最小压缩） – TIFF – PNG – Live Photo* – 支持 P3 广色域* 拍摄模式 – 单张 – 连拍 – 定时 – 景深* – 双/三重拍摄* – Live Photo* – 曝光包围 工具 – 曝光补偿计 – 智能对焦追踪 – 实时对焦峰值辅助 – 4 倍放大镜（带平移功能） – 最小对焦距离显示 – 实时 RGB 直方图 – 高光和阴影警示 – 水平仪（支持俯仰追踪和平面模式） – 三分法、黄金比例、象限和方形网格 – Siri 快捷方式和 App 快捷方式 – 相机规格详细显示，支持 PDF 导出 最大图像处理 – iPhone 11 及更新机型支持 Deep Fusion 和 Smart HDR – 为所有 iPhone 和 iPad 提供最佳图像质量，包括降噪、图像防抖和附加处理 零处理 RAW – 捕捉标准 RAW 文件，完全不处理 照片库 – EXIF 元数据显示 – 显示位置数据（含指南针和海拔） – RGB 和 RGB 亮度直方图显示 – 访问所有相册和文件夹 小组件 – 主屏幕：黄金时刻、EXIF、相机 – 锁屏：相机、黄金时刻 – 控制中心：对焦、曝光、白平衡 Apple Watch 支持 – 快门按钮控制 – 黄金时刻显示（带太阳位置指示） 人体工学 – 所有 iPhone 支持单手操作 – 横向使用时优化用户体验 无障碍功能 – 支持动态字体和粗体文本 – 支持增强对比度 技术 Camera M 完全基于原生 API 和框架开发，无任何外部依赖。这使 Camera M 从小巧的下载体积到快速启动时间都高效、响应迅速。 希望您使用 Camera M 拍摄出惊艳的照片！ 网站: www.camera-m.com 用户手册: www.camera-m.com/manual 联系方式: contact@camera-m.com 关注我们: @CameraMApp CameraM 这些功能仅在支持的设备上可用。 景深拍摄需要 iPhone X 或更新机型。 自拍景深拍摄需要搭载 TrueDepth 相机的 iPhone 或 iPad。 Apple ProRAW 拍摄需要 iPhone 12 Pro 或更新机型。 更多设备与功能兼容性信息: www.camera-m.com/compatibility

1240078041.name: 太极拳24式大全通信工程师考试总结大全
1240078041.trackName: 太极拳24式大全通信工程师考试总结大全
1240078041.description: 通信工程专业人士不可多得的好资料，给力推荐！ 内容涵盖了通信工程专业考试所有科目总结、初级职业水平考试考前必备资料总结！ 通信专业技术人员初级职业水平考试分2个科目：通信专业综合能力和通信专业实务。 通信专业综合能力考试时间为2小时，满分为100分，考试目的是检验通信专业初级人员掌握通信专业法规、现代通信技术、业务的程度以及计算机和外语应用的水平，考察其承担初级专业技术岗位工作的综合能力。考试内容包括通信管理法规与行业规章、现代通信网、现代通信技术、现代电信业务、计算机应用、通信专业外语。 通信专业实务考试时间为3小时，满分为100分，考试目的是检验通信专业初级人员掌握通信专业业务流程、业务技术熟练程度，考察其承担和解决初级专业技术岗位工作实际问题的基本能力。考试内容包括电信网、帧中继网、数字数据网、宽带交换技术、智能网、移动通信网、因特网、接入网及接入技术、下一代网络、传输网、支撑网、电信技术专业技能。 本应用包括了： 1.通信工程师 2.新技术新业务 3.通信专业知识 4.专业实务 5.综合能力

1240380955.name: Life Application Study Bible
1240380955.description: The Life Application Study Bible: Trusted by Millions, Refreshed for Today Discover how to put God’s Word into practice in your everyday life. For over 30 years, the Life Application Study Bible has been the #1-selling study Bible, treasured by millions of readers. Now thoroughly updated and expanded, this new edition offers even more relevant insights and spiritual guidance for navigating God’s Word in today’s world. Why It’s the #1 Choice The Life Application Study Bible doesn’t just explain the original meaning of the text; it brings it off the page and into your life. Using the accurate and easy-to-understand New Living Translation (NLT), this Bible helps you understand Scripture in its original context and provides practical, powerful ways to apply those truths to your daily walk. What’s New in This Edition Refreshed Design: A brand new app design to help make your Bible study easier and powerful. Updated Content: Meaningfully revised study notes and features ensure the application is as relevant as ever. Key Features for Deeper Study 10,000+ Life Application Notes: Verse-by-verse commentary that transforms understanding into lived truth. 100+ Personality Profiles: Learn from the accomplishments and mistakes of key biblical figures. 500+ Maps & Charts: Conveniently placed for quick reference, plus 16 pages of full-color maps. Comprehensive Overviews: Introductions, vital statistics, outlines, and timelines for every book. Specialized Resources: Includes a Harmony of the Gospels, a dictionary/concordance, and an extensive cross-reference system. Christian Worker’s Resource: A unique supplement designed to enhance your ministry effectiveness. Default Translation: New Living Translation (NLT) 2015 edition with Jesus’s words in red letter. More Features Morning Inspiration: Start every day with a Verse of the Day, a Daily Devotional, or a Daily TouchPoint—addressing life’s most pressing questions. Massive Devotional Library: Choose from over 36,000 devotionals and 600+ topics including faith, anxiety, marriage, and spiritual growth. TouchPoints Series: Access the best-selling TouchPoints series for free, featuring over 350 topics with engaging questions and answers straight from Scripture. One-Tap Insights: Instantly find the meaning behind any verse with the "Explain" feature or see how it reads across different versions with "Compare." Split-Screen Study: View your Bible text alongside study notes, maps, or personal notes simultaneously. Audio Bibles: Study on the go by listening to your favorite translations. Personalization: Highlight in custom colors, create rich-text study notes, and sync everything across all your devices so you’re never without your insights. Top Translations: Stream or download NLT, NIV, ESV, KJV, NKJV, and more for offline access. Premium Study Library: Explore 100+ Study Bibles and Commentaries, including the LASB, MacArthur, and Cornerstone Bible Commentary. Group Plans: Read and discuss a reading plan together with family and friends. Flexible Reading Plans: Choose from the One-Year Bible, The Bible Recap, or create your own custom 3 to 30-day plan. "TYNDALE", "New Living Translation", "NLT", the New Living Translation logo, and "Life Application" are registered trademarks of Tyndale House Publishers, Inc. "Life App" and the Life App logo are trademarks of Tyndale House Publishers, Inc. Are we missing any features you would like to see? Have any suggestions? Feel free to email us at biblesupport@tecarta.com

1241383990.name: Baby Sensory Signbook
1241383990.description: The Baby Sensory Signbook app teaches you all signs you need, so you and your baby can start communication and language development. Learn to communicate long before the development of speech, using our simple Babysigns. FEATURES All official Baby Sensory baby signs right in your pocket. Find a sign super fast with our easy interface. Make a list of favourites, for the signs you're learning. Learn to sign 'Say Hello' and 4 other songs with music. Looping videos, so you can easily see how it’s done. Slow down the video, to better view the hand shapes. ABOUT THE APP With the Baby Sensory app, you can easily learn all official signs to make early communication possible. This creates a stronger parent-child bond and stimulates early language development. Even the youngest baby wants to tell you what they need and how they feel. But they’re unable to express themselves verbally and may cry if their needs are not met. Signing helps your baby to express his or her needs and takes the guesswork out of parenting. ABOUT US Baby Sensory was the first baby programme to offer a complete approach to learning and development from birth to 13 months. Designed to stimulate, educate and provide precious memories during the all-important first years of life, the programme has won multiple awards both nationally and internationally since 2008. Everything we do is backed by over 35 years of expert research in childhood development. If you have any questions regarding the app, please let us know. 1241761757.description: 宝宝哭了怎么办？换尿布，抱抱，喂奶...还是哭！ 抱着不睡觉，拍着不睡觉，自己都快睡了宝宝还是哭泣不止，年轻的爸爸妈妈有没有过这种经验？ 本APP帮助你让宝宝不哭，让宝宝安安静静地睡觉！ 根据大量实验，宝宝在不明原因哭泣的情况下，效果音能够让宝宝安心并停止哭泣。虽然这些音效在大人听起来就是噪音，但对婴儿来说这些白色噪音类似于妈妈肚子里的声音。 睡觉的时候，一些轻音乐也可以让宝宝安心入睡，对疲惫的爸爸妈妈也会有一定效果。 设计简单，抱着宝宝单手也可以一键操作，进入屏保后不解除屏锁也可以停止播放。 １．宝宝止哭 收录了23个宝宝止哭音效，可以根据效果设定顺序或者不显示。 ２．宝宝睡眠 收录了让宝宝安静入睡的7曲音乐，可以根据效果设定顺序或者不显示。 ３．录音功能 可以录制，修正爸爸妈妈，或者其它对宝宝哭泣和睡眠的有效声音。

1241909999.name: WorkOutDoors
1241909999.description: WorkOutDoors is the most advanced and most configurable workout app for the Apple Watch. It's perfect for running, cycling, hiking and any other indoor or outdoor activity. Note: WorkOutDoors requires an Apple Watch Series 4 or later. It is not necessary to have your iPhone with you during a workout. The app uses Apple’s workout system, so all workouts are saved to the Health system. However it also provides many extra features over Apple's app, such as: a super-smooth vector map that can be shown during a workout; multiple configurable screens with metrics and graphs from a pool of 800+ data fields; route files can be imported and used for navigation (including turn by turn directions); dozens of configurable alerts (e.g. every mile; high heart rate; low pace; off-route etc); interval schedules can be created using the larger screen of the phone app; climbs and descents are supported with notifications and on-screen data and graphs; waypoints can be created, navigated to, and exported; use shortcuts to associate operations with gestures (e.g. double tap to hear configurable metrics); compare pace against a target or a previous workout (using metrics and a dot on the map); show zones for pace and power as well as heart rate (with optional coloured backgrounds); auto-pause is available for all outdoor activities; shows GPS and heart rate before starting a workout, so that you can wait for good signals; configure distance and pace for running / walking to come from Apple’s pedometer or from GPS; workouts can be exported in FIT / TCX / GPX files, or automatically sent to Strava; workouts created by the app can be analysed in great depth in the iPhone app. The app also has many more features. The map is a particular highlight. It uses OpenStreetMap, which provides worldwide coverage and includes the trails necessary for outdoor workouts. It also has several features that help you navigate during a workout: maps can be smoothly panned and zoomed, and can rotate according to the compass; a breadcrumb trail of your whole route is displayed on the map during the workout; topographic data can be shown, with configurable contour colours and hill shading; map-only mode is provided for when you don't want to start a workout and just need a map; a circular scale is shown when you zoom, making it easy to see the distance to features; maps can be stored on the watch for use when offline (they are downloaded as required if online); a red compass points north and a green compass points to the start; choose a waypoint to see a compass and distance to it in the corner of the map; you can also navigate to waypoints on the map, such as hospitals, sights, cafes etc. If you load a route from a GPX / TCX / FIT file then navigation is even easier: your position is shown on an elevation profile of the route; the remaining distance, time and ascent can also be displayed; you can get alerted when you go off-route; when off-route then a compass is shown which points to the nearest part of the route; if the route contains turn by turn directions then these can be used like a sat nav; if there are no directions then the app can use “bend detection” to generate them; the next direction is shown as an icon and distance in the corner of the map; the map can automatically zoom in when you are approaching a turn; you can use shake gestures to hear the distance to the next turn or the end of the route; routes are coloured by gradient: from red for steep uphill to blue for steep downhill; you can configure what information is displayed during a climb or descent. All this is included for a single one-off payment. No extra in-app purchases or subscriptions are required (although there is a completely optional in-app tip jar which was requested by long-term users). If you own an Apple Watch and do any form of exercise, then WorkOutDoors is the app for you. Give it a go!

1242654932.description: 《放置江湖》是一款武侠风格高自由度的角色扮演，冒险游戏。 江湖五载，风起云涌。重光入侵，烽火连天，武林动荡，血雨腥风！ 《放置江湖》七周年之际，江湖中有一股神秘组织力量名为重光教的教派，他们一边不断地发展壮大，一边开始威胁到中原的各大门派，以让重光教一统江湖，江湖中人人自危。武林动荡时局已定，我等特邀诸位侠士齐聚江湖，联手抗敌！ 侠之大者，为国为民，群英荟萃，歃血为盟...... 新资料片“重光入侵”强势来袭！ =====七周年版本更新内容===== （以下为整个暑期7月-8月版本更新内容，具体更新日期依据游戏内公告为准） 【全新剧情】 ※更新《重光入侵》全新剧情、支线剧情和日常任务。 【新版战斗及多人战斗】 ※新增多人对多人的战斗，战场上同时存在多个目标。 ※新增多目标武学招式，可同时影响多个目标。 ※新增防御反击，某些武学可以通过反击打断对方当前攻击招式。 ※调整核心战斗机制，伤害机制更趋向平衡。 ※调整轻功及招架战斗机制。 ※修复部分战斗BUG。 【江湖笔录】 ※新增江湖笔录系统，根据笔录内容会逐步引导学习与探索整个放置江湖的玩法。 【先贤书案】 ※新增先贤书案，玩家在传承前可以透过先贤书案，把自身学会的武学记录，便于后人在传承后付出一定条件进行学习。 (书案记录是终身记录，不需要多次重复记录。) 【烂柯棋局】 ※新增烂柯棋局玩法，玩家可以透过此棋局提前体验新版战斗里面的全新内容，并且使用指定门派提前体验突破后的武学形态。 （烂柯棋局中玩家也可以获得梦境呓语。） 【五周年称号】 ※玩家可以通过五周年彩蛋任务，进入彩蛋副本处获得五周年纪念称号。 【神兵优化】 ※玩家可以锻造并容纳更多神兵。 【江湖情报】 ※新增关于周年庆内容相关的江湖情报和小技巧。 【面具升级】 ※新增升级面具，玩家可以对部分指定面具进行升级，升级后的面具会变得更加华丽。 （李魔头面具重绘更新上线。） 【其他优化及更新内容】 ※新增平安小镇日常任务。 ※优化界面切换卡顿问题。 ※优化书箱卡顿问题。 评价: ——“前期功能看似很少，可随着一步一步了解游戏，解锁功能后才发现，这个游戏太丰富、大庞大了！！” ——“不是简单的放置类游戏，也不是无脑卡牌游戏，这样的武侠太少了，光凭这两点就值得一试。” ——“我坚持玩了5分钟，然后几个小时就过去了。” ——“游戏内战斗的对白和招式挺有意思的，很有武侠小说的感觉。” ——“看腻了各种仙侠，修真，真的有点审美疲劳，还是这种纯武侠味的更真实更有血性。” =====游戏特色===== 依凭文字游走江湖。细心探索NPC对话，发掘隐藏任务，揭秘NPC小秘密，江湖的故事绝不止一点。 28个门派任君选择，更有一些隐藏门派等你发现。 几百种武功应有尽有。镇派绝学、江湖武学，更有绝世神功等待有缘人。 海量地图，构造一个庞大的江湖，行走江湖无止境。 简化基础成长，离线也能练功。想快人一步？没问题，有更丰富的事件等你解决。 打造属于自己的专属兵器。起一个帅气的名字，让它和你一起名扬天下。 江湖会因为你的行为而产生改变。如果你杀死了NPC，那可要小心NPC的后代复仇噢。 江湖之大，穷尽一生也走不完。当岁月催人时，你可以选择退隐江湖，而以自己的后人的身份继续游戏，而江湖上到处都是过去你的传说。 开启家园，在江湖中建一间大宅，有一方偏安江湖之隅。招募门客、怪客拜访，多种玩法，等你前来。 自创武学，成就一代宗师，问名江湖天下无敌。 梦境，光怪陆离，一梦犹如人生百年，体验不一样的江湖。 =====历史更新===== 【家园系统】 新购屋宅，在江湖中种田耕农、招募门客，何不快哉。 【跨服副本】 和来自不同江湖的人士比武论剑，到底谁才是真正的天下第一。 【新章节剧情】 铁掌海鲸摩擦不断，各派人士蠢蠢欲动，朝廷江湖牵扯不断，到底谁才是搅弄武林的真正黑手？只要顺藤摸瓜，江湖隐秘必将大白天下。 【师门地图】 各门各派都拥有了属于自己的地盘，同门切磋、挑战师父，全新师门任务等你开启。 【科举考试】 从乡试、省试、殿试一步步成长，一展才华，金榜题名。 【制作组】 挑战游戏制作组的机会来了！全新地图，全新任务，彩蛋等你发现。 【自创武学】 自创属于自己的专属武学，开创属于自己的打法流派。 【梦境】 一门与梦相关的武功。种种谜团，纷繁往事，皆等少侠在梦境之中。 ======联系我们====== 《放置江湖》微信公众号：放置江湖 《放置江湖》官方QQ：800184002 《放置江湖》官方邮箱：service@mkjump.com 《放置江湖》官方网站：http://fzjh.xiaohoutiaotiao.com 《放置江湖》攻略资料站：https://wiki.biligame.com/fzjh/ 《放置江湖》玩家交流QQ群：821429732

1242808815.name: TimeSignal Alarm clock
1242808815.description: This alarm will wake you up with sounds and time chimes that you can't ignore. Doorbell...can you ignore it? Repeated Doorbell...can you ignore it? It will repeatedly tell you the elapsed time at one-minute intervals. It will also tell you the time on the hour and at times divisible by five. It's simple to use. Just set the alarm time and close the app. When the time is up, you will be notified by voice. The alarm will continue to ring for 30 minutes if you leave it alone, so start the app to stop the alarm. The way to stop the alarm is to match the pictures. Match the pictures, top and bottom as a pair. Match all three pairs and wait 2-3 seconds. A button to stop the alarm will be displayed. Please note that the alarm will not stop if you match the same pictures in a horizontal row. You can change the difficulty of the picture matching. You can also set it to stop with one button. You can check the difficulty of the game in a test. It would be helpful if you could check the operation once before using the alarm. You can register up to eight alarm settings. It is convenient to set the times you frequently use in advance. Notes about this app: ※ Uses the voice notification function of the iPhone/iPad itself. If you do not allow notifications, the alarm function will end when the app screen is closed. This app sleeps according to the iPhone settings, so the app will essentially be unusable. ※ Sleep is disabled when the alarm stop screen is displayed. Please note that no sound will be heard if you are in silent mode or have the notification function of the iPhone/iPad suppressed. ※ If you leave the alarm on the lock screen for 30 minutes, the next alarm will not sound. In that case, please launch the app. (The next alarm will be automatically reset when the app is launched.) Don't expect music from this app. There is no music at all. The time signal of this app is not suitable for any purpose other than as an alarm. It is a powerful alarm, but it only sounds for 30 minutes. Humans sleep in 90-minute increments, with deep and light sleep alternating, and an alarm app cannot wake you up during deep sleep with sound alone. If you really want to wake up at that time, it would be helpful to use multiple alarms so that you are aware of it before the time you want to wake up. If you want to wake up 30 minutes earlier than usual, it would be helpful to go to bed 30 minutes earlier than usual. To Apple Watch users We apologize for the inconvenience, but please select the Notifications tab from the Watch app on the iPhone home page and set it so that "T.Signal Alarm" notifications are not forwarded to your Apple Watch. If this is not set, notifications will be forwarded to your Apple Watch and the app will not work properly.

1243343380.name: Sunny: Mind & Body Coach
1243343380.description: Sunny helps you care for your whole self—mind, body, and daily rhythm—in one calm, encouraging place. Instead of asking you to track everything, Sunny helps you focus on a few foundations that make the rest of life work better: restorative sleep, hydration, movement, and guidance for what matters to you right now. PERSONAL GUIDANCE Choose the areas of life where you want support, including purpose, self-belief, discipline, ambition, love, identity, calm, happiness, relationships, community, integrity, time and money, and letting go. Sunny selects relevant guidance and delivers it through gentle notifications, so the experience stays fresh without making you choose each message yourself. Use the 60-second check-in to pause, reflect, and give your attention a direction for the day. SMARTER SLEEP PLANNING Start with the time you want your day to begin. Select your ideal sleep duration, add your morning routine and commute, and Sunny works backward to calculate your wind-down and wake-up times. The moon-to-sun timeline makes your plan easy to understand at a glance. HYDRATION THAT FITS YOU Set a personalized daily water target and watch the cup fill as your goal changes. Choose a reminder window and frequency that fit your schedule. MOVEMENT THAT FITS REAL LIFE Create a realistic movement window and receive supportive reminders that help you reset during the day—without turning wellness into another demanding task. SEE WHAT IS HELPING Your whole-self score brings sleep, hydration, movement, and guidance together in a clear 100-point daily view. Seven-day trends help you notice momentum and understand which foundations are supporting you most. SUNNY INCLUDES Personalized guidance topics Gentle guidance notifications A focused 60-second daily check-in Sleep planning based on your routine and commute Personalized hydration goals and reminders Flexible movement reminder windows A daily whole-self score Seven-day progress trends Simple reminder management with familiar iOS interactions Sunny is designed to support everyday well-being and healthy routines. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

1245063271.name: Daily Blends Recipes
1245063271.description: Over 1 million people blend our smoothie recipes and LOVE them— which is why we had to create the #1 best-selling smoothie recipe app! Daily Blends is packed with the BEST healthy recipes that'll help you take control of your health, gain energy, lose weight, eat more fruits and veggies, and finally get that glowing skin. "This isn't a diet. It's a lifestyle." - Jen Hansard, creator of Daily Blends and Simple Green Smoothies Healthy habits can (and should) taste good— and they start with a daily smoothie. Our recipe app is often #1 Food & Drink App and has incredible reviews too. It's packed with 200 + quick, simple and tasty smoothie recipes to experience transformation from the inside out. All recipes are vegan, gluten-free and 100% plant-based awesomeness. New smoothie recipes are added all the time to keep you motivated to fuel your passion. Jen Hansard, Simple Green Smoothies DAILY BLENDS FEATURES Over 250+ tasty smoothie recipes that focus on energy, beauty, kid-friendly, detoxing, workouts and desserts Filter recipes based on ingredients you have on hand, food aversions or sensitivities Easily search for recipes thanks to ingredient keywords or by recipe title Mark your favorites for easy accessibility Custom shopping list based on your favorite recipes Swap options within each recipe Access to shopping staples like the Dirty Dozen list + our meal prep guide Access to our popular Smoothie Challenges for FREE TESTIMONIALS I'm loving this app so far! I like the grocery list function. The size and spacing of the text is perfect for on-the-go reference at the store. The app is very intuitive and I love how they've categorized the types of smoothies. Green smoothies have improved my health and given me so much more energy. My toddler loves them too! -Joanna Joy I am so glad to finally see a SGS app since I love all of their recipes. I also am SUPER excited to see an ingredient checklist that allows you to choose what you have on hand to get recipes with those items. Thank you for this beautiful app :) - Jounie235 I LOVE this app from the Simple Green Smoothie people. The app is gorgeous and easy to use. I love that they give you options to swap out ingredients if you don’t like something. The Random Recipe is fun...just give your smartphone a little shake to see what you get (reminds me of the magic 8 ball). This app makes blending easy and fun. The recipes are delicious! You won’t be disappointed with this app. I highly recommend it...Cheers! -PreludeK8​ WHO IS SIMPLE GREEN SMOOTHIES At Simple Green Smoothies, we believe YOU were meant to do great things. We also know that in order to have the energy and confidence to make this a reality, you have to fuel your body properly. And it starts with a daily smoothie. Simple Green Smoothies helps by creating and sharing delicious green smoothie recipes + plant-based meal plans to inspire and encourage you along the wellness journey. Jen Hansard, owner of Simple Green Smoothies, struggled with exhaustion and a serious Starbucks addiction in 2011. She was forced to take matters into her own hands when her family hit hard times - unemployment, WIC and no health insurance after moving across the country. Armed with a daily green smoothie she'd blend for her husband, two kids (ages 1 1/2 and 3) and herself, they were all able to boost their immune system, have more energy and thrived during one of the most difficult time of their lives. Jen know how to make healthy accessible to everyone- with price, taste and health benefits because she's been there. Healthy can (and should) taste good… and become an enjoyable part of your lifestyle. Today, Jen shares that passion as creator of Simple Green Smoothies.

1245261765.name: Universal Tarot
1245261765.description: Universal Tarot is an elegant, modernized interpretation of the beloved RWS images. Drawn with Italian flair, the classic scenes are depicted more dynamically, and with sharper focus. The symbolism remains very faithful to the original, but the art is more refined. The deck’s palette of colors is both lighter and brighter than the RWS. Subtle shadings and occasional changes in perspective give the images a more photorealistic appearance. Universal Tarot offers a more polished, sophisticated interpretation of the RWS deck. It is ideal for people who do not like Pamela Colman Smith’s art, but do wish to work with a deck designed to follow RWS very closely. Intuitive, elegant interface is easy for beginners and experts Gorgeous full screen, high-resolution card images Full support for all current iOS devices Sophisticated journal 18 spreads built in Design your own layout with Free Form Allow reversed cards or not Option to use Major Arcana only Zoom in to enlarge card details Share reading via e-mail, Facebook, and Twitter Animated shuffle & cut Optional voice prompts Customize with your own card meanings & reading cloths Many adjustable settings Includes unabridged compact book in English Includes introduction and brief card meanings in Spanish, French, Italian, and German User interface available in English and Spanish Explore the elegance and refinement of Universal Tarot!

1245475416.description: 使用 Amperes 4 掌控电力 不再猜测手机充电慢的原因。Amperes 4 是一款终极诊断工具，旨在帮助您测试充电配置、识别故障硬件，并以专业级的精度监测设备健康状况。 核心功能 实时充电速率： 获取精确的 mA（毫安）和瓦特数据，实时查看流入电池的电量。 硬件性能对比： 对有线/无线充电器、移动电源以及不同类型的充电线进行横向对比测试。 深度数据图表： 通过详细且可交互的图表将充电过程可视化，追踪性能随时间的变化。 全球基准测试： 将您的充电速度与在线用户进行对比，查看您的设备是否发挥了最佳性能。 智能电池警报： 在电池达到预设电量时立即获得通知，助您延长电池使用寿命。 系统状态监测： 在查看电池指标的同时，追踪发热状态、内存占用及磁盘空间。 专业测试工具 自定义日志： 在测试中添加关于线缆品牌或充电器型号的备注，以便日后查阅。 颜色标记结果： 直观的界面通过颜色立即反馈充电器表现是“优秀”、“普通”还是“极差”。 数据导出功能： 需要原始数据？导出您的测试结果以便进行外部分析或存档。 为什么选择 Amperes 4？ 无论您是想测试全新的氮化镓（GaN）充电器、验证“快充”线的真伪，还是排除移动电源的故障，Amperes 4 都能为您提供透明的数据，确保您的设备高效运行。 告别劣质充电线。掌控数据，尽在 Amperes 4。

1246038894.name: 军用坐标 - 专业版
1246038894.description: 本软件为"军用坐标"的专业版本 1.支持使用GPS或者网络进行定位,获取当前位置信息并提供地理坐标和高斯坐标显示. 2.支持显示地图,在地图上长按选点并显示选择点的坐标. 3.支持以关键词进行搜索并显示搜索结果列表.还能给出搜索点的坐标. 4.可以进行不同坐标之间的转换.并将对应点在地图上显示. 本软件所采用的投影为高斯-克吕格(Gauss-Kruger)投影简称“高斯投影”.软件主要应用环境是部队人员进行军事地形学相关作业,也可以用于部分大地测量工作人员使用. 为结合军事地形用途,本软件采取的坐标系为北京54坐标系6度带分划,请使用时加以注意. 基于以上,通常本软件的使用范围应当为赤道以北,中央经线以东,否则对应数值为负数并且有可能出现错误.

1247126900.name: Simplest Workout Tracker
1247126900.description: I made this because too many workout apps seemed to expect a full performance review every time I exercised. Some days I want detailed stats. Most days I just want to mark that I worked out and get on with my life. That's what I made this for. If you exercised, log the day and what you did. If you missed a day, that's fine. Open the calendar again tomorrow. Tap a day to log an exercise or two and see how close you are to your yearly goal. As you log more, the app starts suggesting the activities you usually do, so most days take a couple of taps. If you already track workouts on your Apple Watch or in another app, they can show up here on their own. Turn on Apple Health in settings and the days you exercised appear in the calendar, counting toward your yearly goal, without retyping anything. It only reads from Health, and everything still stays on your iPhone. It's simple, but it still covers the basics. Open a logged day to review or edit it, add another exercise, jot down a short note, or delete it if you tapped the wrong day. You can log one exercise or several in the same session, and activities from your own history show up as soon as you start typing. The suggestions adapt to you. Your most common activity for that weekday is filled in automatically, familiar exercises sit underneath, and anything you haven't done in a few months drifts down the list. Mostly the calendar just lets you see how you're doing. If streaks keep you going, they're right there. If they don't, ignore them. The idea isn't to be perfect, it's to make it easy to keep track and easy to come back. I originally built it because my employer helped pay for workouts and wanted to see what I'd been doing. They no longer check, but I kept using it. Turns out it's just satisfying to watch the streaks build up on a quiet calendar. Everything stays deliberately simple: Tap any day to log a workout in seconds View and edit logged workouts instead of deleting them by accident Log several exercises for the same day Add a short note when you want the context Get weekday suggestions based on what you usually do Have your most common exercise filled in automatically Autocomplete from your own history Bring in workouts from Apple Health and Apple Watch automatically Choose which Apple Health workout types count, and turn off the ones that aren't exercise to you Let suggestions shift as your routine changes Set a yearly goal from 1 to 365 workouts See your progress fill a circular ring Spot your rhythm and streaks in the calendar Browse a clean month view and jump back to the current month anytime Find today and your logged days at a glance Generate a plain annual summary and share it No account, no feed, no complicated setup Your data stays on your iPhone It's a small exercise log from a solo developer who wanted a simpler, kinder way to keep track. No hype, and no pressure to turn into someone else.
1247126900.fullDescription: I made this because too many workout apps seemed to expect a full performance review every time I exercised. Some days I want detailed stats. Most days I just want to mark that I worked out and get on with my life. That's what I made this for. If you exercised, log the day and what you did. If you missed a day, that's fine. Open the calendar again tomorrow. Tap a day to log an exercise or two and see how close you are to your yearly goal. As you log more, the app starts suggesting the activities you usually do, so most days take a couple of taps. If you already track workouts on your Apple Watch or in another app, they can show up here on their own. Turn on Apple Health in settings and the days you exercised appear in the calendar, counting toward your yearly goal, without retyping anything. It only reads from Health, and everything still stays on your iPhone. It's simple, but it still covers the basics. Open a logged day to review or edit it, add another exercise, jot down a short note, or delete it if you tapped the wrong day. You can log one exercise or several in the same session, and activities from your own history show up as soon as you start typing. The suggestions adapt to you. Your most common activity for that weekday is filled in automatically, familiar exercises sit underneath, and anything you haven't done in a few months drifts down the list. Mostly the calendar just lets you see how you're doing. If streaks keep you going, they're right there. If they don't, ignore them. The idea isn't to be perfect, it's to make it easy to keep track and easy to come back. I originally built it because my employer helped pay for workouts and wanted to see what I'd been doing. They no longer check, but I kept using it. Turns out it's just satisfying to watch the streaks build up on a quiet calendar. 1247914988.name: Romanian Verb Blitz
1247914988.description: Learn and practise Romanian verbs with this interactive verb reference and drill tool. With over 160 core verbs, Romanian Verb Blitz is a clear and effective way to refresh and revise your grammar skills as well as expand your everyday vocabulary. As well as a verb reference, there is a set of intensive verb drill activities to quiz your conjugation knowledge, including: Infinitive quiz: do you know the meaning of the each verb? Conjugation quiz: can you select the correct verb form for the English translation? Snap quiz: can you spot when the Romanian and English sentences match? Try to get ten in a row! Gapfill: can you spell out the missing word in the conjugated sentence? In the settings, you can select which tenses to drill in the games. So whether you're a beginner, or already on the way to mastery, there's a level for you! The app will track your scores throughout the games, so you can check in the Performance section at any time to see the entries you're finding trickiest. The verbs selected represent some of the most commonly used Romanian words, so Romanian Verb Blitz is a great way to increase and practise your everyday vocabulary, too! Made by language lovers for fellow language lovers, Romanian Verb Blitz is a great way to improve your language skills. Happy learning!

1249488898.name: BPM & Chords Live Analyzer - DJ and Musicians Tool
1249488898.trackName: BPM & Chords Live Analyzer - DJ and Musicians Tool
1249488898.description: Find the BPM and Chords live for any song you're listening to, using your device's mic. Let your device listen to the music around you to analyze the BPM, the key chord (Major or minor), the peak and the loudness value in dB. You can also import any song from your music library, iCloud Drive or Dropbox to quickly analyze it. Finally you can simply tap on the screen to measure the beat BPM. DJ's can use the app to analyze the songs and create great playlists, and musicians can find the chords and the tempo to play along any track. They can also analyze in real time their playing to check the timing on the beat. To get better live results let the device listen to a song longer (the longer the best). For info and requests please write to: info@elliottgarage.com

1249652296.name: Italian Verb Blitz
1249652296.description: Learn and practise Italian verbs with this interactive verb reference and drill tool. With over 100 essential regular and irregular verbs, Italian Verb Blitz is a clear and effective way to refresh and revise your grammar skills as well as expand your everyday vocabulary. As well as a verb reference, there is a set of intensive verb drill activities to quiz your conjugation knowledge, including: Infinitive quiz: do you know the meaning of the each verb? Conjugation quiz: can you select the correct verb form for the English translation? Snap quiz: can you spot when the Italian and English sentences match? Try to get ten in a row! Gapfill: can you spell out the missing word in the conjugated sentence? In the settings, you can select which tenses to drill in the games. So whether you're a beginner, or already on the way to mastery, there's a level for you! The app will track your scores throughout the games, so you can check in the Performance section at any time to see the entries you're finding trickiest. The verbs selected represent some of the most commonly used Italian words, so Italian Verb Blitz is a great way to increase and practise your everyday vocabulary, too! Made by language lovers for fellow language lovers, Italian Verb Blitz is a great way to improve your language skills. Happy learning!

1250144822.description: 此風水工具能協助風水大師利用衛星地圖遠端測量陽宅之九宮飛星佈局定吉凶。 重點功能一覽： 玄空飛星二十四山電子羅盤。 衛星定位飛星立極尺，支援坐向測量。 從裝置選取建築平面圖測量九宮分佈。 風水曆，查閱對風水師極不利之時日、神佛誕期。 雙星斷事速查。 風水命卦速查。 八宅遊星盤、 飛星配卦等選擇性功能… 還有更多強大功能即將登場。 在購買前請確保裝置所使用之地區沒有受限制使用 Google 或 Apple 服務，以免無法使用 Google 地圖及未來之雲端同步功能。

1250406581.name: Piping
1250406581.description: Piping App is an excellent handy tool for Piping Engineers, Designers, Mechanical Engineers, Pipe Fabricators, Pipe Fitters, Pipe Inspectors, Purchasers, Sales and Engineering Students. It can help user quick easy obtain the dimensions, tolerances, weights, volumes, surface areas, PT-Ratings and other piping design information, increase efficiency and lightens the burden of looking up piping information. Piping App provides all dimension, tolerance and PT-Rating data for piping components compliant with ASME, API, EN and JIS relevant Standard. Display unit can be set to Metric and US Customary for ASME and API piping components. Now it contains: ASME-- ● Pipe ASME B36.10M ASME B36.19M ● Fitting ASME B16.9 ASME B16.11 ● Flange ASME B16.5 ASME B16.47 ASME B16.36 ASME B16.24 ASME B16.1 ● Gasket ASME B16.20 ASME B16.21 ● Line Blank ASME B16.48 API-- ● Flange API Specification 6A ● Gasket API Specification 6A EN-- ● Pipe EN 10220 EN ISO 1127 ● Fitting EN 10253-1 EN 10253-2 EN 10253-3 EN 10253-4 ● Flange EN 1092-1 EN 1092-2 EN 1092-3 EN 1092-4 ● Gasket EN 1514-1 EN 1514-2 EN 1514-3 EN 1514-4 EN 1514-6 EN 1514-7 EN 1514-8 JIS-- ● Pipe JIS G3452 JIS G3454 JIS G3455 JIS G3456 JIS G3457 JIS G3458 JIS G3459 JIS G3468 ● Fitting JIS B2302 JIS B2311 JIS B2312 JIS B2313 JIS B2316 ● Flange JIS B2220 JIS B2239 JIS B2240 JIS B2241 ● Gasket JIS B2404 Piping App provides extra high quality drawing for all piping component complaint with above standard. User interface is very friendly with adding the gesture and animation. Main user interface is presented group by standard system for easy access to each page by sliding the screen. Piping App is continually updated to remain compliant with changes in each piping standard, more data and functions relevant piping will be added to this app in the future.

1250601531.name: RAW Power
1250601531.description: 概览 — 先进的 RAW 处理：借助易用的控件，解锁 Apple RAW 引擎的力量。利用与 Apple 的专业照片处理应用 Aperture 同样出色的 RAW 处理功能，增强你的照片。独特的增强可以帮助你通过其他应用程序无法媲美的方式改进照片品质。 — 整理：RAW Power 是一款功能齐全的照片应用，可以整理和管理你的照片图库。全面兼容 iCloud 照片图库，因此所有更改都可保持同步。每一张照片和每一项功能，都可供你的 iPhone 或 iPad 上的每一个应用访问。 — 评级和筛选：按照文件类型、评级、标记和编辑状态筛选相簿。评级和标记可通过 iCloud 照片图库同步！ —“文件”应用：在照片图库或“文件”应用中存储照片。使用新的共享扩展，直接从其他应用导入到 RAW Power 的文件容器中。使用同样的非破坏式编辑、评级和筛选功能！（不支持 iCloud 同步）。 — 不仅仅是 RAW：RAW Power 能够完美处理 JPEG，提供“照片”应用中缺失的诸多工具。更有创新的景深效果，适用于具有双摄像头系统的 iPhone 拍摄的照片。 — 跨平台编辑：在 iOS 中编辑，而后在 Mac 上使用 macOS 版 RAW Power 3 继续（或反之）。 — 批处理：对多张照片应用预设、粘贴调整，以及执行导出。导出到照片图库或“文件”应用。 整理和显示 — 最多可放大 800%，进行极致精确的调整。 — 创建和重命名相簿，从相簿和图库删除照片，以及将照片移入相簿中。完整访问你的文件夹层次结构。 — 显示文件名、曝光信息、闪光灯状态以及位置地图。 实时编辑 — 齐全的非破坏式编辑功能。所有更改多存储到 iOS 照片图库和 iCloud 照片图库中，你可以在一台设备上编辑，而后到另一台设备上继续处理，不会丢失任何细节。甚至 Mac 和 iOS 之间也可接力！ — 小屏幕优化。选择要默认显示的调整以及显示顺序 — 通过加强和复原滑块进行无与伦比的亮部复原。实时控制 Apple RAW 引擎，包括噪点去除、黑色点和色域图等 — 自动增强、自动白平衡、自动色彩水平和自动色调曲线。一次性应用到多张照片！ — 针对一张或多张照片，应用预设和复制/粘贴调整 — 带有裁剪指示框和热像素叠加的色阶分布图 — 含有内置外观和胶卷模拟的 LUT（查找表）。也可自己添加！ — 裁剪和摆正，旋转和翻转，以及带有取样器和自动调整的白平衡功能 — 亮部、阴影、鲜艳度、局部对比，以及令人称绝的浅色和深色滑块 — 色调曲线和色彩水平色调曲线具有线性和实验模式，以及取样器 — 景深效果可借助双摄像头系统来增强拍摄的照片 — 可校正镜头失真的彩色边缘，以及变形、黑白和带有可调整中心点的晕影等 — 所有滑块都可实时应用，并通过 GPU 加速 — 高精度深度彩色成像引擎 — 导出 JPEG、PNG 和 TIFF（8 位和 16 位）到“文件”应用或“照片”应用 兼容性 — 兼容数百款相机，包括 iPhone RAW 照片（iOS 14 - 列表见 https://www.gentlemencoders.com/extended-raw/index.html）。RAW 支持由 Apple 在后台下载。你的设备必须连入 WiFi 并接通电源，才能获得更新。 — 完美处理 JPEG、TIFF、PNG 和大多数 DNG — 视频教程 (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7l78rOzFxaHG-e5AT-MGWQ) Mac 版 RAW POWER RAW Power 也可从 Mac App Store 获得，提供照片应用扩展和独立应用（带照片图库支持）两种形式。全世界评分都在 4.5 星以上！ 关于 GENTLEMEN CODERS Gentlemen Coders 由 Apple 前任高级工程总监成立。如需更多信息，请访问 www.gentlemencoders.com。

1252122327.name: Eos 2
1252122327.description: Description:** Eos 2 is Audio Damage's studio-quality algorithmic reverb, now with five custom reverb algorithms designed in collaboration with Sean Costello of Valhalla DSP. Available as an AUv3 App Extension for hosts like AUM, AudioBus, GarageBand, Cubasis, and Auria Pro, and as a standalone application. Five algorithms give you a broad palette of reverb for any production context. Three plate algorithms cover everything from tight, dark vintage plates to wide stereo ambience. The new Random Plate algorithm produces organic, evolving reflections that never quite repeat, and is beautiful on pads, keys, and vocals. SuperHall delivers the incredibly long, densely modulated hall sounds that Eos has always been known for: Eno-style ambience that simply isn't possible with convolution reverbs. The streamlined interface makes it easy to dial in exactly the sound you need, from a short, dense room on your drum bus to an infinite wash of sound on a synthesizer pad. Features** Five reverb algorithms: Mono Plate, Stereo Plate 1, Stereo Plate 2, Random Plate, and SuperHall Full control over pre-delay, room size, decay time, attack, and diffusion Rate and depth modulation for lively, animated reverb tails Three-band EQ with adjustable crossover points to sculpt the tonal character of the reverb Infinite mode for drones and sustained textures Mix lock preserves your wet/dry balance when browsing presets Resizable interface with real-time waveform display Factory presets included, with full cross-platform user preset management AUv3 App Extension and standalone application Note: Eos 2 is a dense, heavily modulated algorithmic reverb. For best results on older devices, use a single instance as a send effect.

1253069666.name: Dubstation 2
1253069666.description: Dubstation has been a fixture in dub, electronic, and pop production for nearly twenty years. It emulates the analog bucket-brigade delays of the 1970s and 80s, with their pitch-bending, warmth, and gradual high-frequency loss intact, then adds things those circuits could never do: true stereo dual-time delays, ping-pong, a stereo LFO, and a clean digital looper with overdub and reverse. Sound and Character The bucket-brigade model is the real thing: the high-cut frequency tightens as delay time gets longer, exactly like the original hardware. A low-cut filter trims the bass for the thin echoes of early Jamaican dub. A saturation stage on the feedback path adds analog-style breakup as repeats stack up, and the LFO modulates delay time for chorus, flange, and pitch swoops. Looper and Reverse The LOOP switch turns Dubstation into a clean digital looper that holds the buffer indefinitely and accepts overdubs. This is different from cranking the feedback, which degrades and distorts the signal over time. The REVERSE switch flips the delay memory backwards, and combined with the looper produces reverse loops that hold their fidelity indefinitely. Features Single, dual-time, and ping-pong modes Tempo-synced or millisecond timing, with dotted and triplet values 4 ms to 2 second delay range with X2 switch Bucket-brigade modeling with delay-dependent high-cut filter Low-cut filter from 100 Hz to 1.5 kHz LFO modulation of delay time, 0.01 to 5 Hz Saturation on the feedback path Tempo-synced stereo looper with sound-on-sound and reverse Stereo width control Factory and user presets, shareable with the desktop version via XML Optimized for low CPU usage on older devices Full manual at audiodamage.com

This is different from cranking the feedback, which degrades and distorts the signal over time. The REVERSE switch flips the delay memory backwards, and combined with the looper produces reverse loops that hold their fidelity indefinitely. Features Single, dual-time, and ping-pong modes Tempo-synced or millisecond timing, with dotted and triplet values 4 ms to 2 second delay range with X2 switch Bucket-brigade modeling with delay-dependent high-cut filter Low-cut filter from 100 Hz to 1.5 kHz LFO modulation of delay time, 0.01 to 5 Hz Saturation on the feedback path Tempo-synced stereo looper with sound-on-sound and reverse Stereo width control Factory and user presets, shareable with the desktop version via XML Optimized for low CPU usage on older devices Full manual at audiodamage.com

1256218493.name: KORG iMono/Poly
1256218493.description: Reviving a classic KORG analog synthesizer. The iconic 4VCO synthesizer, reborn on iOS. The Mono/Poly analog synthesizer appeared in 1981 at the same time as the acclaimed Polysix. Not only was it a fat-sounding four-VCO monophonic synthesizer, it featured a revolutionary design that allowed it to also be used as a four-voice polyphonic synthesizer, which helped cement its legendary status. The long-awaited “KORG iMono/Poly” iPad/iPhone app completely reproduces all features of the original Mono/Poly. Four VCOs and a rich array of modulation allow a wide range of detailed sound design. New functionality such as two multi-effects units and eight virtual patches are also provided. In addition, the seamless integration that you expect from KORG’s iOS apps will fit perfectly into your music making process. The Mono/Poly has been reborn for today’s world, bringing you a unique and legendary sound. Due to differences in CPU speed of iPads / iPhones, iPad 3rd gen/2/iPad mini/iPhone 4s are not supported, only iPad Air/iPhone 5s or later is recommended. [ Features ] Deep 4VCO sound. A complete reproduction of the classic Mono/Poly The Mono/Poly synthesizer featured four VCOs, a dedicated envelope generator for the VCF, and also sync and cross-modulation, earning it a reputation for its detailed sound-shaping potential and its distinctive character. Powerful virtual patches, and the latest presets to catch the scene Eight virtual patches provide the ultimate expansion of the Mono/Poly’s distinctive sound-design potential. Two multi-effect units are also provided, allowing you to create complex and broad-ranging sounds with complete freedom. Quick access to all panels Although iMono/Poly provides a vast number of parameters, it’s designed with a screen structure that provides quick and seamless access to all of them. With a single tap, you can rotate between the main synth & key assign screen and the virtual patch & effect screen. There’s no need to open individual screens for specific functions, or to move back and forth between them. Produce music in conjunction with KORG Gadget iMono/Poly can be used in conjunction with “KORG Gadget,” the music production DAW app that has won numerous prizes within Japan and around the world. When you install both apps, iMono/Poly appears as the “Montpellier” gadget within KORG Gadget. More info at korg.com

1256626606.name: iTHUMP/Toxic+
1256626606.description: iTHUMP has two versatile tools for magicians and mentalists in one powerful app updated for iOS18. iTHUMP is a remote viewing device for TOXIC+ and can also be used as a secret thumper to send vibrations from Apple Watch to iPhone, iPhone to Apple Watch, iPhone to iPhone, iPhone to iPad or iPad to iPhone. Toxic+, is the original and most powerful Magic Calculator. A number forcing tool that mirrors all entry and results to the magician's Apple Watch, iThump interface, Bluetooth earpiece, Bluetooth display or stand alone peeks. You can perform many different types of number forces, book tests as well as lookups from up to 20 custom lists. Multiple Birthdates, Celebrities, Special days, Zodiac and Chinese star signs, Magic Squares, ACAAN and lots of data can be derived from the information being input. I'm sure you will find many uses in your magical and mentalist effects. You can create and import in your own background graphics or screenshots so you can make it can look exactly the way you want it to. The majority of it features can also be used stand alone so don't worry if you don't have an Apple Watch or a second device. ONLY FOR MAGICIANS Menus are in English only **** You can customise most outputs to your own language. Internet not required for normal use. When using multiple devices connection is achieved via Bluetooth and/or WiFi. You can use BlueTooth alone and/or connect to the same WiFi network. Apart from being a remote interface for TOXIC+, iThump can be used to send vibrations, playing cards, zenner cards, colours, and short text messages as well as text to speech voice messages. You can create a custom list of frequently used messages or use the keyboard for one off texts. Optional interfaces for Prevision, Cesaral CUPP, UTP & UWP, Bluetooth BLE devices, WikiTest, Earworm, Inject, Flitch, PeekSmith 1, 2, 2B & 3, Oblivious notifier, SCI, Sigaba, Bluetooth remotes, Motherboard, Glyphs and Pitata Time Hacker via In-App Purchase. Included interfaces for Apple Watch, Bluetooth earpieces, The Stranger, Nexus, Diverter, DFB-X, Lumen, Hybrid Watches, David Penn’s Pi and a handy Cryptext and Sigaba converter. Install on as many of your own Apple devices as you like. See our website for full features and instructions. Please Note: TV & YouTube rights are reserved. Please contact support for written permission prior to use. Charges apply.

1257281849.name: SkySafari
1257281849.description: SkySafari 8 是一个功能强大的天文馆，它可以装进你的口袋，让宇宙触手可及，而且使用起来非常简单！ 只需将设备对准天空，即可快速定位彗星、行星、星座、卫星以及数以百万计的恒星和深空天体。无论你是初学者还是资深天文爱好者，SkySafari 8 都是你完美的观星伴侣，它拥有互动式的信息、丰富的图形和精美细致的界面。 第 8 版的新功能 UI 主题 - 使用五种新的 UI 颜色主题自定义你的体验。用全新的视觉色调瞬间改变应用程序的外观。 图像库 - 通过天文摄影探索宇宙。浏览和查看图像，或直接从 AstroBin 导入图像。 Sky Tonight (今晚星空) - 跳转到新的“今晚”部分，查看此时此刻你的天空中可见的内容。扩展信息旨在帮助你规划夜晚，包括月亮和太阳信息、日历精选以及位置最佳的深空和太阳系天体。 高级图像导入 - 通过可选的高级订阅 (Premium Subscription)，你现在可以将自己的个人图像导入图像库。 如果你是 SkySafari 8 的新用户，你可以做这些事： 指向和识别 - 将设备对准天空，即刻识别恒星、星座、行星、卫星等。星图会随你的动作自动更新。 OneSky - 实时查看其他用户正在观测的内容。此功能会在星图中标出天体，并显示有多少用户正在观看它们。 轨道模式 - 离开地球，飞向行星、卫星和恒星。 银河视图 - 可视化恒星和深空天体在我们银河系中的 3D 位置。 语音导览 - 收听超过四小时的语音解说，了解天空的历史、神话和科学。 发音指南 - 学习如何正确发音数百个天体的名称，从恒星到星座和行星。 模拟天空 - 查看过去或未来的日食/月食！从地球上的任何地方向过去或未来模拟多年的夜空。 夜视模式 - 在天黑后保护你的视力。 SkySafari 高级订阅 (Premium Subscription) 通过可选的高级订阅解锁惊人的功能，包括： 海量数据库 - 访问海量的深空数据库。 自定义图像导入 - 在图像库中上传和管理你自己的天文摄影图像。 增强工具 - 获取精选新闻、事件、互联观星功能、光污染地图等。 如需望远镜控制和更多高级功能，请查看 SkySafari 8 Plus 和 SkySafari 8 Pro！ Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy:

1257359875.trackName: 魔法时光 for 上海迪士尼乐园
1257359875.description: 程序简介 最简洁和最实用的上海迪士尼乐园游乐设施和娱乐演出信息，以及地图导航功能，给游玩的小伙伴最好的帮助！ 功能介绍 查看乐园的游玩攻略和游记内容，并可以分享至社交媒体软件； 可以从当前位置直接导航至游乐设施和娱乐演出，显示最短的路径和提供指南针指向，快递达到目的地； 在地图上显示游乐设施和娱乐演出的排队时间信息； 列表显示游乐设施和娱乐演出的排队时间信息； 收藏游乐设施和娱乐演出，可以优先显示器信息； 给每个娱乐演出设置提醒，在开始之前提醒不会错过每场演出； 地图显示当前的天气预报和 AQI 空气质量信息； Widget 快速查看收藏项目的信息。 建议反馈 亲们如果有什么反馈和建议，可以点击关于里面的邮箱图标联系作者。 另外请各位亲在 App Store 评论区 5 星好评支持下哦 :)

1257415655.name: TrailTool
1257415655.description: TrailTool supports creating map from within the app from publicly available OpenStreetMap data. So wherever you plan for your next adventure, your map can always be up to date. It does not require wireless connection to work in the field or outdoor. It respects your privacy, any saved tracks or locations are always stored on device, no data is ever uploaded to the cloud. So your data is safe. Main Features Record GPS tracks or mark point of interest on screen for trip planning or actual location while in the field Create map dataset from OpenStreetMap data (PBF) directly. Support option to use native language (default) or English as place names or labels. Support data exchange format: PBF, GeoJSON/JSON and GPX Support data sharing via AirDrop or standard iOS share functionality for any data used within the app For device without GPS (such as iPad without cellular service), the app can be used for trip planning to review map, existing tracks, point of interests etc. Maps, tracks or point of interests from one device can be shared with other devices via AirDrop. Map Data The app comes with one sample map and one sample OpenStreetMap PBF file. For additional data, you can go to OpenStreetMap web site or within app, choose About -> Additional Data… Hope you’ll find this app useful in your travel or hiking adventure!

1257573007.name: RV Dump Stations
1257573007.description: This app shows over 7,100 RV dump stations, most throughout the US. and Canada. Includes rest areas, truck stops, KOAs, campgrounds, RV parks and more. Dump station locations are displayed even when offline! NO SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED. A one time fee and that’s it. Dump station information is obtained from crowd-sourcing and are therefore subjective in nature. What one person describes as working another may describe as broken. Features: Location database is included with the app, so all locations are visible when offline. Filter what type of location to display. For example, list only free dump stations from the filter. Show a route between your location and the selected RV dump station. View the dump stations in list view; easily search the list. Get the local weather for the location. Internet searches and more for each location. Database is updated monthly, subject to user submissions. Import routes from GPX files. This makes it much easier to find RV dump stations along a route you've created in another app such as Road Trip Planner. Send a dump station location to our app Road Trip Planner. This helps in routing your travels (requires separate purchase of the Road Trip Planner app). We want to expand our RV dump station database as much as possible, so we have made it easy for you to easily submit a new RV dump station - simply tap the + button below the map. To correct or update dump station information, tap “Location Comment” in the detail view. We will be updating the database often. Due to the nature of dump stations constantly changing their status it's recommended you contact the dump station prior to using it to verify its status.

1257590915.description: Tempi 是一款实时 BPM 计数器和节拍追踪应用。可以把它想象成一个反向节拍器——它不是为你打拍子，而是聆听音乐并实时检测节奏。 无论你是音乐人、DJ 还是 VJ，Tempi 都能为你提供一个实时节奏追踪器，随着你的演奏同步跟进，在各种音乐风格中都能保持出色的准确性。 在你（或整支乐队）演奏时进行监听 实时以极高的准确度报告演奏的 BPM（每分钟节拍数） 分析你的演奏片段，精准定位并改善问题所在 通过 BeatSync 功能让屏幕随节拍闪烁 通过 Ableton Link 将踏板、循环器和应用同步到节拍 使用"点击测速"功能随时快速获取 BPM 读数 切换主题，方便夜间使用或彰显个人风格 保存录制片段以供日后分析 通过 Ableton Link 将灯光、视觉特效及其他设备同步到节拍 以图表呈现演出曲目的 BPM 随时间的变化 内置均衡器可视化工具 精细调节响应速度、频率滤波器及检测灵敏度

1257642395.description: 截骨神器 - 用于高胫骨截骨术(HTO)和股骨远端截骨术(DFO)的手术前术前规划工具。 特征： 1. 测量骨骼的解剖或力学軸角度，只需通过相机或照片库输入图像。 2. 计算术前负重线(WBL)和规划目标WBL。 3. 自动计算截骨矫正角度、楔块高度、切锯深度与脚长变化。 4. 设定期望WBL，矫正角度，缺口高度，MPTA或LDFA 5. 提供開放(open)或閉合(close)、内侧(medial)或外侧(lateral)截骨。 6. 模拟截骨调整后结果。 教学視頻：https://v.qq.com/x/page/h0527kc4vj1.html 簡体用户指南：http://pan.baidu.com/s/1nuB7GZv

1257651611.name: Decibel X PRO - 专业噪声计和声压级
1257651611.trackName: Decibel X PRO - 专业噪声计和声压级
1257651611.description: “Decibel X” 是市面上为数极少的具有高可靠性和预校准测量的测噪计/测声计应用。 它可将您的 iOS 设备变成专业测噪计/测声计，精确测量您周围的声压水平 (SPL)。 这款工具非常有用，而且设计精美。它不仅仅是一个有着多种用途的工具，而且会给您带来很多乐趣！ 您有没有想过测量房间的安静程度、音乐会或体育比赛的吵闹程度？ "Decibel X" 可立即帮您回答这些问题。 本应用有哪些与众不同之处： 经过测试和校准，可用于绝大多数 Apple 设备。 精确性可媲美顶级应用和真实 SPL 设备 “健康”App集成：将噪声级别直接导出到“健康”App。 频率加权滤波器：ITU-R 468、A、B、C、Z 漂亮直观，精心制作的用户界面设计 WAVE FFT 和 BAR 图可显示实时 FFT。 这些功能对频率分析和音乐测试非常有用。 还可显示实时主频。 InstaDecibel 可在照片上捕获您的 dB 报告并通过热门社交网络（Facebook、Instagram、Messages等）轻松分享。 支持 Apple Watch 支持竖屏或横屏布局 其他精彩功能： 时间加权（响应时间）：慢（500毫秒）和快（200毫秒） 微调校准从 - 15 dB 至 15 dB 标准测量范围为 30 至130 dBA 可用直方图来绘制所记录数据的历史 实时刻度水平图 在美观清晰的数字布局和模拟布局中，显示当前值、平均值/ Leq 和最大值 快速参考文本可帮您比较现实生活中的各种实例 记录和导出数据（最多 24 小时），用电子邮件发送，以进行进一步分析 “让设备保持唤醒状态”选项可用于长时间录制 随时重置并清空所有数据 随时点按最大值，可将其重置 可随时点按“暂停/恢复”工具 注： 请不要期待安静房间里读数为 0 dBA。 30-130 dBA 为标准可用范围。平均安静房间约为 30 dBA。 虽然所有设备均已进行预先校准，但对于需要更高精度和准确度的用户，建议进行自定义校准。 您需要一个真正的外部设备或已校准的测声计作为参考，然后调整微调校准，直至读数与参考值匹配。 多种订阅选项可供选择。我们的标准订阅选项为： 订阅 1 个月 订阅 1 年 在您确认购买时和每个续费周期开始时，我们会从您的 iTunes 账户中收取订阅费用。 包含免费试用期的订阅将自动续订为付费订阅。 在免费试用期结束前至少 24 小时，您可以在 iTunes 设置中取消您的订阅或免费试用。 取消订阅将会在当前订阅周期最后一天后生效，您将会被降级为免费服务。 请注意：在免费试用期内，当您订阅高级版后，任何未使用的免费部分（如果有的话）将会作废。 隐私政策: http://www.skypaw.com/decibelx/privacy_policy.html EULA: http://www.skypaw.com/decibelx/terms.html

1259300819.description: App Store 商店完整版爆款长简介（主展示高转化文案） 标题：职称计算机考试题库大全｜初 / 中 / 高级职称全模块通关备考工具 副标题：考点笔记 + 全真操作题库｜零基础一次通关职称计算机 黄金开篇直击职场痛点 评职称卡在计算机考试，操作步骤死板、总踩扣分点？ 上班族时间碎片化，纸质习题厚重，没法随时刷题复盘？ 网上题库广告多、分模块收费，全套复习成本高？ 一次性买断职称计算机全套备考库，覆盖全部必考模块，在职人员快速刷题稳过及格线！ 【全主流考试模块全覆盖，适配各地职称评审要求】 完整收录职称计算机高频必考科目，满足初级、中级、高级职称报考需求人力资源和社会保障部： Windows 操作系统、Word 文字处理、Excel 电子表格、PPT 演示文稿 Internet 互联网应用、WPS 办公套件 Access 数据库、Photoshop 图像处理、CAD 制图、用友财务软件等专业模块 覆盖教师、医护、工程、财会、科研等所有行业评审必考科目，按需针对性刷题。 【考点笔记 + 全真操作题库双合一，精准踩准考试得分点】 精简考点笔记：梳理考试标准操作流程，标注考场扣分陷阱，明确考试规定操作路径，避开快捷键、右键扣分误区； 海量全真题库：还原上机考试原题题型，单选、多选、判断、实操步骤题全覆盖，每道题附带分步标准操作解析； 易错专项汇总：整理考生高频丢分题型，集中攻克冷门操作步骤，大幅提升一次通过率。 【离线缓存无流量，上班族碎片时间高效复习】 全部笔记、题库支持离线下载，上下班通勤、午休、值班间隙不用联网随时刷题。 不用占用整块休息时间，利用碎片化时间反复记忆标准操作步骤，轻松应对机考死板答题规则。 【15 元一次性买断，纯净无广告无任何内购】 仅需一次付费 15 元，永久解锁全部模块题库与考点笔记，无月度会员、无弹窗广告、无额外充值，刷题界面干净不被打扰。 2017 年上线老牌职称备考工具，2025 年 3 月全新更新适配最新考纲，5 位真实考生 4 分口碑，长期稳定更新题库。 【四类人群专属备考场景】 职场零基础小白：零基础分步笔记，从零吃透标准操作流程 中年职场考生：记忆力偏弱，题库反复刷，牢记考试固定步骤 多模块备考人群：中级 4 模块、高级 6 模块分科目专项练习，逐个通关 考前冲刺人群：整套真题模拟，快速查漏补缺，稳拿合格分数 不用囤积厚重纸质习题、不用多次付费买单科题库，一部手机装下职称计算机全套复习资源。吃透考场标准操作，避开扣分坑，一次通关顺利评职称！

1260183195.name: Hungarian Verb Blitz
1260183195.description: Learn and practise Hungarian verbs with this interactive verb reference and drill tool. With over 120 core verbs, Hungarian Verb Blitz is a clear and effective way to refresh and revise your grammar skills, as well as expand your everyday vocabulary with some high frequency words. As well as a concise verb reference, the app features a set of intensive verb drill activities to quiz your conjugation knowledge. These include: Infinitive quiz: how well do you know the meaning of the each verb? Conjugation quiz: can you select the correct verb form for the English translation? Snap quiz: can you spot when the Hungarian and English sentences match? Try to get ten in a row! Gapfill: can you spell out the missing word in the conjugated sentence? You can test yourself on the whole set of verbs, or mark verbs in the reference list as 'learnt' by swiping left on list entries to build up a 'personal bank' of learnt words. In the settings, you can select which tenses to drill in the games, as well as choose whether to drill indefinite or definite forms. So whether you're a beginner, or already on the way to mastery, there's a level for you! The app will track your scores throughout the games, so you can check in the Performance section at any time to see the entries you're finding trickiest. The verbs selected represent some of the most commonly used Hungarian words, so Hungarian Verb Blitz is a great way to increase and practise your everyday vocabulary, too! Made by language lovers for fellow language lovers, Hungarian Verb Blitz is a great way to improve your language skills. Happy learning!

1260277664.description: LUXROOM – 终极复古胶片相机应用 捕捉胶片摄影的永恒魅力 LUXROOM 将复古胶片相机的魔力带到您的手机上。无论您是怀旧的胶片爱好者，还是充满创意的摄影师，这款应用都能让您的普通照片变成令人惊叹的复古杰作，搭配真实的胶片效果、逼真的纹理和丰富的艺术工具。 核心功能 真实胶片滤镜 – 赋予照片经典而永恒的胶片色调，营造出复古氛围。 双重曝光艺术 – 无缝融合多张照片，创造梦幻般的艺术合成效果。 独家胶片特效 – 添加胶片叠加、可爱贴纸，让每一个瞬间都与众不同！ 哈洛效应（Halation Glow） – 复刻经典电影的红色光晕，带来独特的复古电影质感。 复古闪光模式 – 再现90年代胶片相机的高对比度闪光效果，让画面更具层次感。 柔光氛围 – 为照片增添电影级朦胧光晕，营造温暖梦幻的视觉效果。 复古电视风格 – 轻松将您的照片变成80、90年代的老式电视画面，附带微妙的扫描线和色彩失真效果。 真实胶片颗粒 – 让您的照片拥有真正的胶片颗粒质感，回归胶片摄影的原始美感。 LUXROOM 不仅仅是一款相机应用，更是您通往胶片黄金时代的时光机。我们精心打造的每一种特效，都在追求经典胶片相机的极致复刻。 Terms of use link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQfOiAZ3_WQ3nEs59-B27-3D6WtDWAf_zvaOAjNLtPf8Lk4_AXCxLT0XHXaWfkUA5Mx4ytkJNIpIn86/pub Privacy policy link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vTxDUkxDz484CS8ktibv1Lf3ZcArOUV6u5Mp1qqSHKip65mM_6qf9LJqnzHEHj9G2PIxTxekvWaJAlf/pub

1260311003.trackName: 五线谱照片扫描仪 - 乐谱图像识别
1260311003.description: 一款强大的五线谱识别软件、乐谱OCR工具，只需对着纸质乐谱拍个照片即可听到美妙音乐。在服务器端进行整个识别过程，所以相比较其他软件可以识别更多的乐谱元素，更真实的还原乐谱数据。它同样也是一款好用的乐谱浏览器及播放器，把你的所有纸质乐谱统一在手机上进行管理以便随时随地查看。支持百余种不同类型的乐器，且拥有很好的音质效果。 Features: Scan the whole sheet at once using the built-in camera or a picture from your image library. Tap a bar to play the song from. Support multi-page and reorder them as you wish. Support up to 8 systems. Support for changing tempo speed. Turn up/down the voice of each part. Export MusicXML, MIDI, PNG and PDF files.

1260470447.name: 超级艺术家DeepStyle
1260470447.description: ＊不要错过“超级抠图”，一键抠图工具，从此告别PS的蜗牛抠图。现正半价促销。需要的快下手！ DeepStyle 是一款将人工智能（AI）与神经网络相结合的革命性图像编辑工具。它可以将照片瞬间转化为艺术作品。这套系统不是简单地模仿艺术大师，而是要创造出全新的艺术品。 软件内置了多种多样的滤镜和风格样式，包括中国画，古典，动漫，漫画，现代，传统，抽象，卡通等等。您还可以创建自己的风格。然而， DeepStyle远比别的滤镜软件有创造力。它可以做地更多，更多……不只是绘画，它可以创造出奇特又不失美感的艺术效果。 独特的功能： 多样化的滤镜和样式供选择： 古典， 动漫， 漫画， 抽象， 动画片， 传统的， 现代， 版画， 彩色铅笔， 水彩 油画 中国画 质地 … … 无需编程经验 使用该软件非常简单。任何人都可以轻松使用，并得到让人惊艳的艺术效果。 最新的深度学习技术 DeepStyle 使用深度学习算法来训练深层神经网络，将艺术风格与图像结构分开，并将一幅图像（纹理，外观和颜色）的风格与另一幅图像的结构相结合，看起来就像是由着名艺术家画的。通过这个效果将你的照片发到朋友圈，一定效果爆棚，简直是各种装逼界的一股清流，秒杀各种修图ps，而且可以完美的掩饰掉一些瑕疵，又比ps更自然，更有逼格，是不是很酷？ 制作您自己独有的风格 Any DeepStyle 允许您训练自己的模型。自定义风格这一功能将赋予您无限的潜力来创作一切美秒的艺术品。 人人都可以成为艺术家！来试试把你的照片变成棒棒的艺术品吧。 有任何意见，请联系我们：market@effectmatrix.com

1260649184.name: Helios - 日月追踪器
1260649184.description: 探索完美天光的魔力，就从 Helios 开始——它是你捕捉震撼户外照片与视频的必备伙伴。无论你是专业摄影师、热爱徒步的冒险者、追寻完美画面的旅行者，还是单纯喜欢用手机记录生活的人，Helios 都能帮你找到那些自然光将平凡瞬间变得非凡的神奇时刻。 什么是魔法时刻？ “黄金时刻”是在日出后不久或日落前，天空洒下温暖柔和的光线，非常适合拍摄人像和风景。“蓝色时刻”则在日出前或日落后，将万物笼罩在宁静的暮蓝色中，是营造情绪感与氛围感照片的最佳时间。 这些魔法时刻是你摄影真正闪光的时段，而 Helios 会确保你永远不会错过它们。应用在全球任何地方都能使用，即使没有网络连接，也是所有注重光线表现的用户不可或缺的工具。 精美设计 Helios 采用现代化设计风格，以精致的“液态玻璃”美学呈现，在你的 iPhone、iPad、Apple Watch 和 Mac 上显得格外协调。界面直观优雅，配备精致的深色主题，让你在规划拍摄时更加舒适、护眼。每一个细节都经过精心打磨，让你在探索光与时间的同时，也能体验到如同影像般纯粹的美感。 你所需要的一切 Helios 将所有必需功能整合在一个流畅一致的体验中。主界面为你呈现今日太阳与月亮事件的完整概览，并以逼真的可视化方式展示；同时还提供内置日历，方便你提前规划。你的当前位置与所有已保存的地点都集中在同一视图中，让你可以快速查看任意收藏地点的光线条件与相关信息。 内置的地图探索器让你可以搜索新地点，并随时查看全球任意位置的太阳与月亮位置。你可以精准查看太阳的升起与落下方向，跟踪黄金时刻与蓝色时刻的时间，并通过细致的线性可视化工具精准规划你的拍摄。 为了提供实时指导，Live View（实时视图）会将天体信息直接叠加在你的相机画面上，为你带来更具空间感的沉浸式体验，让你能够在增强现实中追踪太阳和月亮在天空中的运行路径。曝光计工具（Light Meter）会在相机画面旁显示详细信息，帮助你精准掌握最佳曝光。 当你查看某个地点的情况时，会看到包含地图视图和 Look Around（视情况提供）的信息卡，这能帮助你更好地了解地点，并规划出拍摄的最佳位置。你还可以设置个性化通知，随时掌握即将到来的魔法时刻，让你在光线最完美的时候始终从容应对拍摄时机。 受到数千用户信赖 Helios 已拥有超过 50,000 次下载，全球平均评分达 4.7，曾登上 App Store “今日推荐”页面，并被 TechnoBuffalo 和 Apple User 评为最佳 iOS 应用之一。加入摄影师、旅行者和户外爱好者的社区，与他们一起依靠 Helios 发挥自然光的最佳效果，捕捉更出色的画面。 Helios 不只是一个应用——它是你掌控时间与光线的指南，确保你总能在对的时间、对的地点捕捉到最好的光。 使用条款（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 隐私政策：https://tryhelios.app/privacy

1260874657.name: Ascension Assist
1260874657.description: Each time you play this app, your etheric and physical bodies, especially your brain is activated and layer by layer obstacles are removed as you align your intention to be assisted in this way. This first app allows you to better know your life’s purpose, your higher source support team (including masters, teachers & guides) and accelerate your ascension progression. As energetic obstacles are cleared you will notice these benefits appearing more and more frequently in your life: Greater mental clarity Relief of stress Easier knowing of what the best choices are you can make in each moment More direct alignment with your life’s purpose Awareness and using of your higher source support (your masters, teachers & guides) Accelerated ascension. As the energy refines, you will likely experience more extensive activation of neural brain pathways which result in improved memory and expanded brain capacity. The following benefits are possible from this expanded capacity: Improved memory More harmonized balance between the right- and left-brain hemispheres Expanded use of your brain capacity Increased telepathic perception into your multidimensional nature. The Ascension Assist App Clears negative entities from the Auric Field Harmonizes and balances the left and right hemispheres of the brain Activates the neural pathways in the brain resulting in enhanced brain functioning – such as improved memory, expanded usage of brain capacity, increased telepathic function and strengthened awareness of our multidimensional reality. This results in: Clearer thinking Diminished brain chatter Being at peace and centered This is the first in a series of eight apps that helps you harness the magnetic energies of sacred geometry and the capable consciousness of Grandma Chandra’s 12th dimensional masterhood. Sacred geometry magnetic energies are invaluable in that they assist you in attracting more light to you as energy and information. Each interaction with this first app dynamically adapts to where you currently are on your ascension path, helping you to remove negative energies, focus your mind to make clearer decisions and expand your brain usage.

1260915283.name: Yoink - Improved Drag and Drop
1260915283.description: Yoink for iPad 和 iPhone 可以让你轻松快速地保存你拖移、拷贝、共享或下载的内容，以便稍后使用。 这样，你就可以把内容集中到一个地方，而不必在来源 App 和目标 App 之间来回切换。 App 几乎支持所有文件类型，例如网页图片、文本片段、网页 URL、电子邮件和文稿等内容——无论你是通过拖移、拷贝、共享还是下载的方式添加它们。 以下是用户对 Yoink 的评价： “iOS 上最棒的临时收纳 App” - Igloouk，英国 App Store “iOS App Store 里最实用的 App，简直是宝藏。” - noway170，奥地利 App Store “简直是救星。现在就下载。” - mr chairboy，美国 App Store 在 iPad 上，Yoink 可作为 Slide Over 或 Split View App 使用，无论你当前使用什么 App，它都随时准备接收你拖入的内容。只需调出 Yoink，然后完成拖放操作即可。 在 iPhone 上，可以使用 Yoink 的共享扩展，或者直接将内容拷贝粘贴到 Yoink 中。 内容会保存在 Yoink 中以供日后使用，并提供丰富预览方便识别，大多数文件类型还支持完整预览。 包含多个项目的拖移内容会自动组合成一个堆栈。 Yoink 与系统深度集成： 剪贴板监视： Yoink 的剪贴板监视会保存你拷贝或剪切的所有内容，即使 Yoink 在后台运行也没问题。 使用“画中画”浮层可以选择 Yoink 应该保存的数据类型，也可以随时暂停或停止监视。 “画中画”不只是视频： 除了视频之外，Yoink 还可以在“画中画”浮层中显示图片、PDF、电子邮件甚至网站，并允许你直接在其中滚动浏览文稿页面。 iCloud 同步 通过 iCloud 在你的设备之间同步 Yoink 中的内容 Handoff 通过 Handoff 在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 之间传输文件（需要单独的 Mac 版 Yoink App） 操作/共享扩展 几乎所有可以通过系统共享表单共享的内容，都可以直接发送到 Yoink 键盘 Yoink 自带键盘，让你无需启动 Yoink 也能快速插入保存在其中的内容。 Spotlight 集成 Yoink 中的任何内容都可以通过 Spotlight 搜索到——搜索结果还支持拖移。 今天小组件 在通知中心访问 Yoink 中的内容，并将剪贴板内容保存到 Yoink 快捷指令 / Siri 建议 Yoink 提供 Siri 快捷指令和建议，让你可以自动化处理流程，例如将剪贴板内容添加到 Yoink、从 Yoink 拷贝内容或在 Yoink 中开始下载。 文件 App 集成 在任何支持 iOS 11 文稿浏览器的 App 中访问 Yoink 文件 以下是媒体对 Yoink 的评价： “Yoink 是 Apple 本该做出来的临时收纳 App。” - Federico Viticci，MacStories.net “Yoink 是必备 App” - Jeff Benjamin；9to5mac.com “高级用户不可或缺。” - Craig Grannell；techradar.com

1260980663.name: Export Audio
1260980663.description: Extract audio from QuickTime (.mov) and MP4 videos with this easy-to-use audio extractor app. Select a QuickTime or MP4 video from the Photos app or Files app. Set the start and end time for extraction, enter a custom audio file name, and choose your preferred output audio format. Extract and save the audio clip in the format you selected. You can also add custom artwork and artist metadata to your extracted audio files when using formats like AIFC, AIFF, FLAC, M4A, MP3, MP4, or WAV. Easily open or share your extracted audio files with other apps. All extracted audio files are saved and accessible from the Files app: On My iPhone/iPad → MovieToAudio → Audio 【Supported Audio Formats】 AIFC AIFF CAF FLAC M4A (recommended) MP3 MP4 WAV 【Additional Notes & Troubleshooting】 Need more features or have suggestions? Just leave a review; I will do my best to improve. Troubleshooting Tips:** If your extracted files don't appear in the Files app, try restarting your device. If you encounter extraction errors: Restart your device Move the video from the Photos app to the Files app, then open it from there If the issue persists, send the video file or a downloadable link to the support email so I can investigate and improve the app If you enjoy using this app, please leave a review or rating—thank you for your support! 【About IN APP PURCHASE】 Removing ADs is available via an auto-renewable yearly subscription. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Privacy Policy: https://nobu-y-dev.web.app/export-audio/privacy-policy.html Terms and Conditions: https://nobu-y-dev.web.app/export-audio/terms-and-conditions.html

1260990597.name: 月子餐
1260990597.description: 老婆大人辛苦了！ 本app献给坐月子中的老婆及所有辛苦怀胎10月的妈妈们。 完成了历史任务后应该享享福了，用本app选择想吃的菜，发给老公让他们按食谱去做，体验下当主子的感觉^_^。 功能 1.130道月子餐按阶段排序。 2.附上食谱做法，对方做不做就是态度问题了。 3.月子笔记记录下心情和状态

1261232451.name: English Learner's Thesaurus
1261232451.description: This app provides English Learner's Thesaurus To really write and speak like a native speaker of English, you have to learn to use English synonyms and antonyms. Do you know what is the difference between "get", "obtain", "secure", "acquire", and "gain"? How to distinguish between "prevent", "hinder", "preclude", "forestall", and "obviate"? This thesaurus will explain each word's meaning and usage. It will show you the right word to use in a given context. ● Thesaurus Over 10200 entries Detailed explanation Built-in dictionary: long-press any word and tap "Look up" Translation: long-press any word and tap "Translate" Pronunciation: long-press any word and tap "Speak" ● Create custom wordlists Create a wordlist Add entries into a wordlist Review a wordlist using flashcards ● Notes Write note for each entry Review your notes ● Basic features: Voice search Search feature: search by text or by meaning Bookmark feature Built-in dictionary: Long-press a word to look it up Learn 10 entries daily

1261910446.name: HMI Viewer
1261910446.description: HMI is the view only version of our HMI system (HMI and HMI Editor). With the HMI Editor app integrators create efficient, advanced, highly responsive "Human Machine Interfaces" and deploy securely to end users's devices who are able to run projects specifically designed for them. As an end user you can download your projects with a single tap of your finger and interact with your Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) controlled processes as you never did before. The HMI Editor and HMI apps are fully native and support all major Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) brands.

1262734151.name: DroneMate
1262734151.description: DroneMate是一个定期更新的地图，提供全世界每个国家的休闲无人机法律法规。信息来自于官方资源和联系人，这样您可以了解在哪些地方允许无人机飞行，需要遵循哪些规则，哪些地方不能携带并使用无人机。DroneMate可以帮助您节省时间，金钱，避免在很多禁止无人机的国家的海关遭遇麻烦(甚至是主要的旅游目的地)。这个地图可以离线使用，这样一来您在旅行时无需网络连接也可以使用DroneMate。 U.S. 州法律也包括在内。 本信息获取自官方渠道 - 关于无人机规则和法律，网上流传着很多误解和不实信息 - DroneMate可以向您提供清晰的清单，包括法律，规则，以及还没有做出完整规定的地区。 针对具体的城市、旅游景点显示信息，还可显示某些对无人机使用有着特殊规定和限制的地区的信息。 DroneMate会定期实时更新，这些更新信息获取自一系列官方渠道。 DroneMate还有一个用户评论系统，在这里游客们可以添加他们的经验，包括在各个国家的无人机驾驶，进口，以及与有关机构打交道的经历。在某些地区，有关当局本身对无人机相关法律的认识就比较模糊，这时候评论系统就非常有用，还有些罕见情况，还有其他奇闻异事也会帮助帮助到其他游客。 用户也可以在评论区发表问题，向其他游客或者管理员提问。 所有评论将由其他用户进行评价，所以最有用的，最有信息价值的回复会在其他回复的顶部突出显示。

1263389963.description: OneBoard 是一个把常用短语、剪贴板和实用插件都装进键盘的自定义输入工具。 无论是回复客服、填写地址、粘贴邮箱，还是发常用的祝福语，OneBoard 都能让这些内容随时一键就出，不用反复打字。 升级到 OneBoard 高级版，可以解锁更多个性化能力： 更多快捷语分组与条目 更多插件与模板 剪贴板历史 数据导入导出 iCloud 数据同步 持续功能更新 基础功能也足够日常使用： 快捷语 把常说的话保存为快捷语，用分组整理客服、地址、邮箱、祝福语等内容，在键盘里点一下就上屏。 剪贴板 自动记录复制过的内容，需要时在键盘里直接点选粘贴，再也不怕复制丢失。 插件与模板 内置搜索、计数、繁简转换、引用等实用插件，并提供模板中心按需添加。 中英文输入 内置英文键盘与拼音连拼输入，支持候选词与下一词联想，一个键盘搞定中英文。 数字、符号与表情 数字页、符号页与表情面板与系统键盘操作一致，切换顺手。 跟随系统外观 键盘配色对标主 App，并随系统深浅自动切换，白天黑夜都好看。 多设备使用 iPhone、iPad 与 Mac 共用同一套 OneBoard，会员两端共享。 所有用户都可以继续享受核心功能的免费更新。 如果你有任何建议，欢迎通过邮件告诉我们：hi@onenice.tech OneBoard 提供月度订阅、年度订阅，并在可用时提供永久解锁选项。 付款将在确认购买时从你的 App Store 账户扣除。 除非在当前订阅周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续订，否则订阅会自动续订。 账户将在当前订阅周期结束前 24 小时内收取续订费用。 购买后可以在 App Store 账户设置中管理或取消订阅。 如果你没有购买订阅，也可以继续使用应用的免费功能。 隐私政策： https://docs.onenice.tech/#/cn/OneBoard/privacy 使用条款： https://docs.onenice.tech/#/cn/OneBoard/terms 联系我们： hi@onenice.tech

1263758108.name: 事业单位公务员面试题大全
1263758108.trackName: 事业单位公务员面试题大全
1263758108.description: 本软件为事业单位面试考试题库的软件，精心准备了最新考试模拟题库（共计2500多道）。试题类型包括综合分析题、自我认知题、人际关系题、情景应变题、组织管理题、 言语表达题，时政类问题、无领导小组讨论题等，以及最新各省历年面试真题。为考试的提供了充分的复习准备，可随时随地学习练习，有效帮助顺利通过考试，学习知识通过考试必备神器！ 综合分析题中的哲理类题目包括名言俗语、事例故事、原理效应等多个小题型，但从云南省事业单位的考察频率来看，名言俗语考察的比重比较大，尤其以“有人说、名人名言”这两类的形式来考察，考官通过考生对此类题目的作答，来考查考生的价值观和道德素质是否符合事业单位的录用标准。这也是在提醒我们广大考生，在关住时政的同时，不要放松对名言俗语题目的练习。 (二)自我认知题 从考察形式来看，主要以直接考察和间接考察的形式来命题，题目设置不会太难，考官通过题目的设置想直接、有效地了解考生过去和现在对工作的态度，更换工作与求职的原因，对未来的追求与抱负以及考虑本单位所提供的岗位或工作条件能否满足面试者的要求和期望等，直接考查考生的基本认知和岗位匹配。另外在间接考察中，题目还会结合考场应变的形式来考察考生与所报岗位的匹配度，这就要求考生在备考时，也要对所报考的岗位有所了解，做好充足的准备，才能做到临危不乱。 (三)人际关系题 良好的人际关系是做好工作的基础，掌握沟通技巧，协调各部门之间的关系是事业单位工作人员的基本素质。云南省事业单位面试题目对人际关系的考察一般设置的情境较复杂，有很多棘手的人际关系问题。特别是人际关系处理中往往涉及情境的处理，这对考生的要求相对提高。而且对于工作中可能产生的人际关系，并不局限于一个人或某几个人，有可能是一个群体或团体，题目中应对的对象可能是“领导”、“同事”，也可能是“群众”或者“下属”，因此考生在处理问题时，应注意“以工作为重”、“以和为贵”，应分清各种利害关系，切忌处理好一方，得罪另一方。 (四)情景应变题 情景应变题通常会设置一些特定的场景，要求考生以特定的身份去合理、有效地解决问题，以考查考生解决实际问题的能力以及应对突发事件的能力。在云南省事业单位情景应变题目的考察，题目中常融合人际关系成分，因此考生在处理这类问题的时候，要全面把握，明确自己的角色定位，了解自的职责所在，进而找到答题的方法和重点。而且考生要谨记，在处理问题时，既要坚持原则性，也要有一定的灵活性，二者有效结合才能达到事半功倍的效果。 (五)组织管理题 考察内容一般为机关事业单位日常工作的处理和组织。 (六)言语表达题 面试会以其他形式如演讲、串词等的形式来考察，因此，考生也要对此类题目予以重视，完善备考计划。

1263774579.name: 一体-传统运动养生教练
1263774579.trackName: 一体-传统运动养生教练
1263774579.description: 特别推荐您中国传统的养生运动APP，适合30岁以上的办公室人群，不需要通过激烈的运动，就能实现维护健康、增强体质、延缓衰老的目的。 传统运动，都是以中医的阴阳、脏腑、气血、经络等理论为基础，以养精、练气、调神为运动的基本要点，通过形体动作来进行锻炼，用整体观念说明运动健身中形、神、气、血、表、里的协调统一。 运动养生是通过锻炼以达到健身的目的，因此，要注意掌握运动量的大小。运动量太小则达不到锻炼目的，起不到健身作用；太大则超过了机体耐受的限度，反而会使身体因过劳而受损。 传统的运动养生法是中国劳动人民智慧的结晶。千百年来，人们在养生实践中总结出许多宝贵的经验，使运动养生不断地得到充实和发展，形成了融导引、气功、武术、医理为一体的具有中华民族特色的养生方法。源于导引气功的功法有：五禽戏、八段锦、六字诀等；源于武术的功法如：易筋经、太极拳、太极剑等。 核心特点-------- 无需中医基础 手把手带你运动 针对不同的人群，我们提供了不同的传统运动系列。零基础也能快速参与。 随时随地运动，为您节省时间 不需要器械，在家里、办公室就能开始进行养生运动。 针对身体亚健康 运动处方调理 颈椎病 头疼 上班困倦 情绪急躁等问题 十分钟缓解不适，把健康交给自己。 热门养生运动-------- 八段锦 五禽戏 颈椎病自救操 颈部工间操 排毒减肥 经络调理 健脾养胃 疏肝理气 清心养肺 养肾固本 减肥 祛寒除湿 肩背调理 腰部调理 关于一体-------- 【一体】是由一支热爱健康和中国传统的团队倾力打造，希望带给更多的朋友健康。

1264340985.name: 记住圆周率 - 3.14π
1264340985.description: 圆周率，定义为圆的周长（即圆周）与直径的比值。一般以π来表示，是一个在数学及物理学普遍存在的数学常数，是精确计算圆周、圆面积、球体积等几何量的关键值。 世界记录是100,000位，由日本人原口证于2006年10月3日背诵。 普通话用谐音记忆的有“山巅一寺一壶酒，尔乐苦煞吾，把酒吃，酒杀尔，杀不死，乐而乐”，就是3.1415926535897932384626。 另一谐音为：“山巅一石一壶酒，二妞舞扇舞，把酒沏酒搧又搧，饱死啰”，就是3.14159265358979323846。 这应用能帮助你快速学习背诵圆周率。 添加网络对战模式，如果所有设备都连接在同一的区域网络上。你可以发起多达5人同时玩的网络对战比赛。

1264769388.name: EoEbooks
1264769388.description: An encyclopedia of information about essential oils, blends and their application for wellness benefits. The primary content is a listing of over 350 health concerns and included with them is a brief description of the health concern, what essential oils are suggested, how to apply them and the experiences others have had. Beyond this there are included an overview of what essential oils are and where they come from, a summary of how essential oils are used, a glossary of terms associated with essential oils for those new to their use and details on how to use essential oils safely.

1265408945.name: 六爻排盘专业版
1265408945.description: 作为一名六爻爱好者，我发现目前许多六爻排盘工具在手动起卦和爻位调整方面操作不够便捷，因此开发了这款应用。 本应用采用全新的界面设计和交互方式，支持拖动爻象快速生成卦例，并通过颜色区分纳甲地支，让用户能够更加直观地查看卦象结构。 适合具有一定六爻基础的用户进行卦例记录、排盘研究和学习使用。 如有使用问题或建议，欢迎联系： 邮箱：lswlester@hotmail.com 使用说明 1. 拖动爻象快速起卦 长按阴阳爻象进入拖动模式，将爻象拖动至对应爻位即可快速完成卦象创建。 2. 快速选择卦象 点击“上卦”“下卦”，即可快速选择对应卦象。 六爻排盘专业版 新版本特点 全新界面体验 全新视觉设计 优化卦盘展示方式 更直观查看爻位、六亲、地支关系 排盘功能 支持卦象起卦、卦名起卦 自动根据纳甲法排布地支 纳干纳支自定义显示 自动显示空亡信息 支持夜子时干支切换 支持数字起卦（河图数） 显示卦身爻位 显示宜变之爻 卦例分析辅助 显示卦辞及译文 显示爻辞及译文 分析爻位在日月组合下的旺衰状态 分析动爻与变爻之间的关系 显示三合局相关爻位及组合关系 显示爻位墓库、日墓、动墓信息 卦例管理 支持断卦结果及反馈记录 支持卦例备份功能 方便长期整理个人研究资料

1265645837.name: JSY2
1265645837.description: JSY2 continues Jonny's foray into spreading his teaching and knowledge of Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga with instructional audio and visual material exploring the Ashtanga Vinyasa Count of the Second Series. The source material comes with Jonny's official approval and combines newly recorded material and teacher training course notes in a portable format. The application focuses on the Vinyasa Count, the mantra of the Ashtanga practice, with Jonny's instructional audio track playing over his instantly recognisable glyph images (Asana pictures are included where available but more of these will follow in future free updates) This Universal Application features:- Jonny's video 'After 30 years of practice...' Second Series vinyasa count merged from two classes that Jonny taught Extended Teaching Mantra, Focussed 12, Morning Stretch and Practice Mantra with Jonny Sanskrit numbers and terms covering the Asanas from Second Series Audio scrubbing for quick access to instructional information Asana details from Jonny's personal manual notes Access to Jonny's online website Access to Jonny's Facebook page Asana Flipcards for second series Asana states for each asana Asana Quick Review: Quickly review the Vinyasa for each asana at the touch of a button. Not sure where each Vinyasa lie then this new feature will allow you to quickly scroll through and see where each one is, along with a brief instruction to keep your count on track* This version presents the Ashtanga Second Series for review for existing students and as an introduction to those with an existing Ashtanga Practice who may be new to Jonny's teachings. The application is not meant as a means of learning Yoga postures though it is presented as a means to extend the student's understanding of the Vinyasa Count for Second Series. Students who practice Primary Series only are strongly recommended to use Jonny's Primary Series application though Jonny welcomes those with an inquisitive, playful mind who want to learn more about the Second Series to utilise this app to begin their journey of enquiry. We do not recommend this group practice directly with the app - please find a qualified teacher who can correctly guide you through this more advanced series. In all instances Jonny's highly recommends you find the guidance of a qualified teacher to help with your practice. Second series is an advanced practice so consider this material only as reference only, not as an instructional guide or otherwise replacement for a good teacher. Some material for this feature will be released in a future free app update

1265892516.name: Calendar 366
1265892516.description: 轻松管理所有日程安排！ "My Must-Have iOS Apps" - Federico Viticci (macstories.net) "Conquer your calendar" - The Daily List (App Store) "Our Favourite Apple Watch Apps" - Editor's Choice (App Store) 预约会面、待办事项、会议、截止日期、生日和约会 —— 拥有 Calendar 366，你将可以高效安排你的时间！ 日历可以做的任何事情......Calendar 366 可以做得更好 —— 其所有功能均可轻松直观地进行调整。 跟牙医的预约与好友的婚礼是不一样的，你的日历需要懂得它们之间的不同之处。 对于重要的事情，你想要收到怎样的提醒，以及每隔多久收到提醒？ 打造一个符合你喜好和优先事项安排的日历。 个性化界面 挑选你喜欢的显示风格 —— 年或月、周或日、列表或日程、以及从浅红色到深蓝色，任你挑选…… 简单易用 通过自然的文本输入方式创建你的约会，例如： “明天会议，10:30-12:00，梅尔罗斯大街/工作”，或者“桑拿！下星期天下午3点 - 360”，或者只是简单的“明天该读书了”—— 任何一种你喜欢的方式。 轻松查找和更改活动和提醒，设置为重复，添加附件*和创建便笺。 多种多样的应用方式 通过 iCloud* 轻松同步所有设备中的文档和附件。 轻松发送、接受或拒绝邀请。 随时随地找到地点：只需搜索，保存，然后在 Apple、Google 地图、HERE WeGo、Waze 或 maps.me 中打开。 通过 Spotlight 查找你的活动。使用日历设置，管理你的活动和待办事项…… 综述 使用 Calendar 366 Today 插件，查看当天的所有重要事项。 适用于 APPLE WATCH 毫无疑问，Calendar 366 也适用于 Apple Watch —— 在手表中即可查看完整日历概况。 使用语音输入，即可轻松创建新活动或提醒。 主要特色功能一览 Apple Watch 应用 (iPhone) Apple Watch 界面组件：模块化（小组件和大组件），实用表盘（小组件，平面小组件和大组件），以及圆形、超大型、图形（尖角，边框，圆形，矩形） 支持 Siri Watch Face 支持 Siri Shortcuts 轻松一览所有活动和提醒 8 款视图，9 大主题 整合了 Spotlight 日历组 为活动和提醒自定义颜色 自定义字体大小 基于地点的提醒 支持旅行时间（计算旅行时间：驾车，步行） 多种提醒方式（贪睡模式，完成模式） 通过邮件、WhatsApp、Messages、Signal 等分享你的活动和提醒 外部键盘的键盘命令 可使用拖拽方式，轻松、直观地创建、复制和移动约会和提醒 轻松邀请与会者和管理邀请 无须进行特别设置（所有 iOS 支持的日历服务均可用：iCloud，Google，Exchange，Outlook，CalDAV） 兼容所有 Apple 设备（iPhone，iPad，Mac） 添加或修改日历和列表 为横屏和竖屏的所有视图界面进行了优化 支持时区 英语，德语，法语，日语，意大利语，波兰语，中文 复杂的重复规则 周数 完整的提醒，且配有小提示 支持超视网膜高清显示屏 ... 如有任何疑问，请联系： support@nspektor.com, @nspektorapps, https://nspektor.com/support Calendar 366 或 Calendar 366 II 须有 macOS 和 iCloud 帐号

1266131734.name: Yellowstone Geysers - Upper
1266131734.description: Visit the world’s largest concentration of geysers with info, map and predictions all in one app! The very famous Old Faithful is here, but so are many others. In Yellowstone National Park’s Upper Geyser Basin, you will find cone and fountain geysers of remarkable power and beauty. This app has information on over 40 geysers in the basin. An offline map is included to help guide as you explore. A few geysers erupt with regularity. For these, we’ve included eruption predictions in the app. Yellowstone National Park is a destination to experience and learn. Load the app, take your time and enjoy this amazing place!

1268238258.name: 家庭名录
1268238258.description: 1、记录家人名字和家庭组成，记载家庭成员在出生、读书、工作等各阶段的重要事件和成长故事。 2、自动制作家庭图谱和家庭年鉴。汇集家庭概览、家庭图谱、成员信息、大事记、长辈观点、童言趣事和荣誉榜等重要信息。 3、家庭成员生日/结婚纪念日自动提醒。 4、页面支持屏幕缩放展示。用户只需通过手指缩放屏幕，就能随时放大和还原显示页面内容。 5、数据自主安全保护。所有数据在用户手机端本地存储，数据安全完全由用户自行掌控。支持数据的备份、恢复，也可在恢复时选择合并功能，实现多个家庭数据合并形成家族数据。 本 App通过以上功能和特色，可助力记录、分享和承传家庭和家族故事。

1268701944.name: CellarView Wine Cellar Tracker
1268701944.description: Quickly create and interact with 3D models of your cellars and wine racks! Select a bottle with a single tap or tap on a cellar location to store your wine. Choose a vintage from the Wine List and CellarView will show you exactly where the bottles are stored! CellarView tracks the effective age of your wines based on the temperatures at which they've been stored, so you'll always know when to best enjoy them. The software also records your purchase, inventory and consumption history. CellarView Charts will help you spot trends and make the information easier to digest. Other key features include: Have a cellars or wine lockers in more than one location? CellarView supports multiple locations and multiple cellars/wine racks at each location As you move from one location to another, CellarView can automatically filter your Wine List and display the primary cellar for your current location Add Varietal or update Category Aging Profiles to fine tune aging and drink date calculations Use Wine List Filters to focus on a subset of your collection and select the perfect bottle for your occasion. Automatically backup your data and easily restore it. Learn how to get the most out of the software by viewing Walk Through tutorials built directly into CellarView. Import/Export your bottle and cellar data via .csv files CellarView runs on iPhone and iPad; data and settings automatically synchronize across all of your iOS devices via iCloud. Cheers and happy cellaring!
