1300697619.name: CamToPlan PRO
1300697619.description: 使用CamToPlan测量一切！水平和垂直都可以！长度、距离、任何表面的面积……使用这款借助增强现实技术和ARKit的虚拟量尺和卷尺测量一切。 现在测量长度比使用激光测量仪或任何其他测量工具更容易。借助手机或平板电脑上的视频摄像机，你可以绘制3D测量线。你以PNG或DXF导出平面图。CamToPlan是AR测量应用程序，“从拍摄到平面图”，给出测量结果！ 无论是个人还是专业用途，都可以像专业人士一样衡量。借助虚拟现实（VR），你可以在几秒钟内测量地板、墙壁尺寸、窗户、门或整个住宅。无需卷尺或量尺！ 这个应用程序为每个人提供无限应用： 个人使用：喜欢自己动手的手巧之人的长度测量应用程序！ 房地产专业人士（房地产经纪人、室内设计装饰师或设计师、建筑师、地形图师、能源顾问……）：这个应用程序将帮助你制作房屋、公寓、公寓特定房间的平面图。 建筑工人可以用它快速进行工作测量：混凝土、瓷砖层、地毯装配工、油漆工、石膏板工人、泥水匠、建筑工人、木匠、电工、水管工、石板瓦工…… 园丁、园艺师、游泳池建设者以及维护、挖掘、运土、挖土：这个应用程序在户外也可使用。 成本估算专业人员：这个长度测量应用程序可以进行定价估算，是工料测量师、价格研究技师、经济学家等人士的好助手。 建筑行业：工头、现场经理或工程师可以进行快速测量检查，无需卷尺和量尺。 请注意： 你可以用公制（米、厘米）或英制（英尺、英寸）单位进行测量 应用程序可以测量水平距离（即地面）和垂直距离！ 无需从房内移除家具进行测量。应用程序可以确定地板和目标之间的交汇，即使是隐藏的亦然。 应用程序可能不太适应某些类型的瓷砖。 准确性无法保证。 你可以在执行测量时移动以更接近目标点，以获得最大精度，即使它不可见并通过外推计算。

1300717402.name: 晚安森林里的动物们
1300717402.description: “晚安森林动物”是我们晚安故事系列包括“晚安”和“晚安马戏团”中最新的 App。全球超过 800 万家长使用我们的晚安 App 陪伴他们的孩子入眠。第三款晚安 App 中的一切都是围绕着森林展开的。 这是一款十分适合在日常睡前仪式中使用的应用，有可爱的动物、甜美的摇篮曲和引人入胜的故事。 孩子们在梦幻般的森林里发现自己身边有7种不同的动物，可以通过关灯来让他们睡觉。 每种动物都会做几个有趣和令人惊讶的动作，并希望在睡觉前展示给孩子。 屡获殊荣的艺术家Jeremy Kool为您带来了“晚安森林动物”，他将三维造型、照明与二维插图和纹理相结合，付诸了很多激情与心血来打造这令人惊叹的场景。 亮点： Jeremy Kool令人惊叹的设计和动画 7种互动动物（亲爱的、臭鼬、啄木鸟、花栗鼠、鼹鼠、狐狸和熊） 自动播放模式 处处都有隐藏惊喜 定制音效设计和音乐 长短合适，适合在日常睡前仪式中使用 16种语言的故事，包括英语、德语、西班牙语、法语、荷兰语、瑞典语、意大利语、挪威语、巴西葡萄牙语、俄语、土耳其语、中文、日语和韩语 适合2-5岁的孩子 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

1300752897.name: 紫白飞星万年历
1300752897.description: 紫白飞星是一个「风水布局」专用的工具，可以详细列出「年、月、日、时」的紫白飞星九宫图，并提供紫白飞星条件式搜寻，更多功能如下： 》紫白飞星： ●日紫白算法：提供四种日紫白算法参数设定。 ●月历：可上下滑动来调整月份。 ●提供直接输入「阳历、农历、干支」来显示内容。 ●提供快速调整日期「加／减月，加／减日，加／减时」功能。 ●显示内容包括：年月日时紫白飞星、阳历、农历、节气交接时间、四柱。 ●提供年月日时紫白飞星「综合盘」显示。 ●提供「方盘、圆盘」切换显示。 》条件搜寻： ●指定起始日期～结束日期之范围来搜寻。 ●例如想要找「日、时」飞星「６、８」数在「艮」宫，请设定条件如下： ●选取「日、时」这二个项目。 ●选取「艮」卦。 ●选取「６、８」飞星。 ●再按「搜寻」即可快速找到符合的日期。 ●搜寻到的日期列表内，会提示宫位内符合的飞星数。 ●显示搜寻到日期，会在宫位内以黄色底标示出所找的飞星数。 》偏好设定： ●周首日：设定一周开始的星期。 ●夜子时：提供夜子时设定。 ●语言地区：可随时切换介面语言，提供繁体中文、简体中文。 ●介面字型：提供字型大小调整。 ●萤幕锁定：不锁定可长时间使用，萤幕不会关闭。 ●万年历提供：西元 1600 ～ 2200 年。 ●操作介面：繁体中文、简体中文。 ●同时支援 iPad 大萤幕任意方向显示。

1302054775.name: Komandant Mark - ZS 3/7
1302054775.description: Za sve nas koji smo odrastali uz stripove 70-ih i 80-godina, Komandant Mark i Vukovi s Ontarija su sada i na zaslonu vaših iPhone i iPad uređaja! Aplikacija pokriva 40 stripova Komandanta Marka iz Zlatne Serije, kao 3. od 7 kolekcija. Za istinske kolekcionare, dostupan je i paket (bundle) u koji su uključeni svi stripovi Komandanta Marka iz pomenute serije, ukupno 276 stripa, izašlih u vremenu 1971 - 1992. Stripovi sadržani u aplikaciji: ZS 224 - Dijadema od perja (1974.) ZS 226 - Zagonetni sat (1974.) ZS 228 - Markov dvojnik (1974.) ZS 230 - Gnev Kajuga (1974.) ZS 232 - Tajna Belih Lisica (1974.) ZS 234 - Zloglasna jama (1974.) ZS 236 - Očeva sablja (1974.) ZS 238 - Zaseda na moru (1975.) ZS 240 - Lažni grob (1975.) ZS 283 - Mark na lomači (1975.) ZS 286 - Naručeni izdajnik (1975.) 1304075165.name: Textile: minimal notes
1304075165.description: Textile is the iPhone notes app for people who actually want to write. No login. No cloud accounts to manage. No half-built checklists. Just elegant typography and simple, rock-solid functionality. Here’s what it has that other apps don’t: Simplicity. If you want an app that does everything, look elsewhere. Seriously. We believe that a tool should do one thing perfectly, not ten things tolerably or a hundred things badly. Typing a note to save for later is something your phone should be able to do instantly, easily, without drowning you in ads, cryptic screens, and unnecessary features. Textile has no user login, no cloud storage, no complicated formatting, no drawing, no half-baked checklists — the list goes on. It’s made for people who want to use their phone as a tool, not a distraction. Typography. Typefaces have a huge effect on how we think and feel about the written word, so Textile comes loaded with a carefully curated selection of elegant fonts to make your notes look the way they were meant to look, including sans-serif, serif, and monospaced fonts. Quality. That means Textile has exactly zero known bugs at time of launch. We take quality incredibly seriously, since we want Textile to be a tool you can rely on. Textile’s quality and its simplicity go hand in hand: a smaller feature set means we can make every feature rock solid. Get Textile, and let your phone get out of your way. ○ ○ ○ Send us feedback! We’re dedicated to simplicity, but we also want to add the features that our users want and need. Use the feedback form in Textile’s settings menu or email lukebradfordapps@gmail.com to send us questions, comments, requests, and any issues you find.

1304177471.name: Superimpose X
1304177471.description: Superimpose X 是一款完整的创意工作室，适用于照片编辑、图像合成和 AI 驱动的视觉创作。 使用图层、蒙版、混合模式、画笔、特效、调整、阴影、文字、模糊、变形、透视工具等功能，制作复杂的编辑效果。然后借助强大的 AI 功能进一步释放你的创意：生成图像、编辑照片、替换背景、扩展图像、增强细节、重新布光、创建头像、交换人脸、将草图变成完整图像，以及从静态照片创建 AI 短视频。 无论你是在制作社交媒体帖子、缩略图、设计、艺术作品、产品图片、个人头像、表情图、照片编辑，还是专业级合成作品，Superimpose X 都能在一个应用中同时提供手动精细控制和 AI 高速创作能力。 从一个想法、一张照片、一幅草图或空白画布开始。抠出人物和物体，组合多张图像，绘制蒙版，调整颜色，添加层次感，创建阴影，应用特效，并打磨每一个细节。当你想更快获得结果时，可以使用 AI 来生成、转换、修复、扩展或让图像动起来。 Superimpose X 专为希望获得强大编辑能力、但不想使用复杂桌面工作流程的创作者而设计。 主要功能： 基于图层的照片编辑，最多支持 24 个图层 高级蒙版工具，包括魔棒、魔术套索、画笔蒙版和形状蒙版 AI 人物蒙版 通过文字生成 AI 图像 AI 图像编辑和局部重绘 AI 背景创建和替换 AI 外扩绘图和图像扩展 AI 图像增强 AI 重新布光 AI 草图转图像 AI 头像生成 AI 换脸工具 AI 图像到图像转换 AI 图像到视频生成 18 种混合模式 16 个调整图层 非破坏性图层模糊和调整 63 种照片特效 清晰度、颜色、色调和细节控制 文字和弯曲文字工具 运动模糊、缩放模糊、旋转模糊、镜头模糊、选择性模糊和渐变工具 变形、透视变换和扭曲工具 绘画、涂抹、仿制图章和特效画笔 内置阴影和光线包裹工具 相机填充，支持实时蒙版和混合模式 蒙版库，可保存可重复使用的抠图和贴纸 会话库，可自动保存你的项目 带图层的 PSD 导出 访问超过一百万张免版税图库照片 Superimpose X 既让你拥有手动创作的自由，也在需要时提供 AI 的速度，并让你掌控每一个结果，使作品真正属于你。 如果你已经在使用经典版 Superimpose app，可以将已保存的蒙版转移到 Superimpose X： 1. 打开原版 Superimpose app。 2. 在“主页”屏幕上点击“?”按钮。 3. 选择“Transfer masks to Superimpose X”。 4. 你的蒙版将会出现在 Superimpose X 中。 使用条款：https://www.superimposeapp.com/superimposex_terms_of_use.html 隐私政策：https://www.superimposeapp.com/privacy2.html

1304231334.description: 这是专业版，支持速度和气压显示，没有广告！数据更精准！ 【产品简介】 这是一款喜欢户外的人士必备的一款APP，可以准确实时测量海拔高度,经纬度,方向等，还可以把带着海拔等信息的照片分享到社交网络！ 【特色功能】 1、海拔表：准确实时显示当前海拔信息。 2、指南针：准确实时显示当前方向。 3、气压计：准确显示实时大气压力。 4、定位仪：显示当前经纬度和地址信息并在地图上显示。 5、速度计：准确实时显示当前实时速度。 6、社交分享：可以把相册里面或者相机拍摄的照片印上海拔等信息水印并分享出去。 【联系方式】 cnmaps@qq.com 【官方微博】 http://weibo.com/cnmaps 【官方网站】 http://www.cnmaps.net

1304488725.name: MyScript Calculator
1304488725.description: MyScript© Calculator 2 让日常数学变得简单又有趣！ Calculator 2 将您的设备变成可交互的纸张。只需书写一个算式，即可实时为您计算出结果。使用编辑笔势或者通过在任何位置添加新元素来进一步展开计算。通过拖放操作重新使用此前的结果。Calculator 2 可动态解释您所做的一切。 Calculator 2 基于 MyScript Interactive Ink®，它是数字笔画的下一步。它是屡获殊荣的第一款手写计算器的继任者。 优点与功能 无需键盘，以直观、自然的方式书写算式。 使用勾除笔势删除符号和数字，轻松擦除。 从版面、记忆栏甚至外部应用程序来回拖放数字。 将您的结果复制到剪贴板或导出到其他应用程序。 分数：使用小数、分数或混合数字来显示结果。 多行：在下一行继续同一个算式，或者在多行书写多个算式。 记忆：保存计算结果，之后可随时将其重新用于计算。 历史：检索所有过去进行的计算，可重用和导出。 支持的运算符 基本运算：+、-、×、÷、/、·、: 乘方、开方、指数：7²、√、∛、e³ 其他运算：%、|5|、3! 括号：( ) 三角函数：sin、cos、tan、cot、cosh、sinh、tanh、coth 反三角函数：asin、acos、atan、acot、arcsin、arccos、arctan、arccot、acosh、asinh、atanh、acoth、arcosh、arsinh、artanh、arcoth 对数：ln、log 常量：π、e、phi

1304819562.trackName: 家庭教育--智慧父母必备经典故事和家长课堂
1304819562.description: 什么是教育？ 教育就是一颗树摇动另一棵树， 一朵云推动另一朵云， 一个灵魂唤醒另一个灵魂。 教育就是父母用自己的言传身教、 以身作则去唤醒一颗幼小的种子， 用自己的真实行动来慢慢影响它， 让它生根发芽、枝繁叶茂。 真正的教育不是什么都管， 也不是什么都不管， 在管与不管之间还有一个词叫：唤醒。 我们的软件致力于改变孩子要先从改变父母开始。父母改变，孩子才能改变。家庭是孩子的第一所学校，父母是孩子的第一任老师。好父母都是学出来的，好孩子也都是教出来的。您在哪里付出就会在哪里收获。父母再大的成功也弥补不了教育孩子的失败。让我们共同学做卓越父母，培养优秀孩子。 我们的软件内容包含三个模块： 1、阅读父母规系列一百天（知道不等于做到，重复100天，内化于心） 2、吸取经典父母课堂内容（言传身教、以身作则、终身学习、父母先行） 3、品味智慧教子故事（家庭教育的最高境界： “润物细无声”的无痕教育。就是要在教育过程中把教育意图隐蔽起来，以一种自然和谐的方式实施教育，让孩子在不知不觉中获取真知，学会做人，提高学习和自我教育的积极性，主动性、自觉性，掌握学习和自我教育的本领。） 软件里面所包含的这些教育内容，您可以收藏，也可以分享给亲朋好友。 希望通过这款软件内容的学习可以帮助您解决生活中遇到的一些教育孩子方面困惑与难题。

1304908187.name: 牛津少儿英语Let’s Go 1/2 -最佳初级小学教材
1304908187.trackName: 牛津少儿英语Let’s Go 1/2 -最佳初级小学教材
1304908187.description: 【爱贝】APP系列，移动课堂，随心所享！精致学习，精致生活！ 有限的时间，发现您无限可能。世界因你而变，唯有行动，梦想才能起航！ 语言，沟通你我！ 爱贝，陪伴左右！ ■■■ 完美同步配套《牛津少儿英语Let’s Go》（1/2)最新课本。 ＊通过预习，认知，掌握，内化四个步骤，让您轻松而高效的学习。 ＊阶段性学习目标，科学规划方案，多样化课程满足您的需求。 ＊定制化的学习体系，听说读写能力全面提升，终成学霸。 ＊长期巩固知识，课程反复学习，重点难点轻松掌握。 《牛津少儿英语Let's Go》专门为非母语国家研发，Let’s Go Professional获得全球 Best Early Elementary ESL奖（最佳初级小学英语教材），目前该套教材在中国培训机构有较广泛的应用。 这套软件专为低龄学童（6-12岁）设计，根据儿童心理特点，通过Sam和Ginger两只顽皮可爱的小猫——他们在整套课程中通过歌曲、游戏、对话以及多姿多彩的练习来教授英文发音、词汇和语法，让学童在游戏中学习，寓教于乐。 这套教材一共有7个级别，精心设计的教材充分利用儿童“语言学习关键期”这一得天独厚的优势和儿童学外语时表现出好奇、好动、好玩、好胜、好表扬的"五好"心理，运用大量运用LET'S GO独创的、生动活泼的外语教学游戏，消除了儿童外语学习时易产生的畏惧、害羞、紧张等不良心理状态。 Let’s go starter 熟练拼写26个字母，达到见字母会读，见单词能拼，认读单词并养成大声说英语的好习惯，为将来的英语学习奠定了良好的开端。 Let’s go1 熟练表达简单对话，熟练拼写100个英语单词、掌握58个动词短语；掌握问候、介绍、感谢、询问天气等语言交流项目；常用的单词到达会听、说、读、写；书中涉及的动词短语、句型达到会听、说、读。听力达到15个单词/分钟到达国家英语课程9级标准第1级水平。 学员在听、说、读、方面能够达到国家英语课程9级标准中的第1级标准。 Let’s go2 熟练掌握可数名词的单复数、There be句型和事物基本方位的表达；掌握一般现在时的表达方式，了解现在进行时的表达方式和实意动词的现在分词形式，能够运用询问职业、住址、食物等语言交流的功能项目。 学员英语水平达到国家英语课程9级标准第1级。 Let’s go3 熟练掌握不可数名词的基本用法、第一、第二人称和第三人称单复数以及它们在句子中与do/does的搭配、现在进行时和动词的现在分词、一般过去时和动词过去时的变化规律。能够写作短篇英语作文，听力达到25个单词/分钟。（相当于国家英语课程9级标准2级水平的听力和写作 ）。 学员英语水平达到牛津英语4B水平，能够参加国家英语课程9级标准2级水平考试。 Let’s go4 能够描述生活中的一些简单事物；能够读懂一些简单的短文；能够利用字典辅助学习，听力达到28个单词/每分钟（相当于国家英语课成9级标准第3级水平）。 Let’s go5 能够与外教进行简单对话；能够阅读相对长的文章；写作短篇英语作文。掌握现在完成时的基本构成、动词过去分词的变化规则、一般将来时的两种表达方式，熟练拼写600个英语单词；掌握50个短语。 Let’s go6 能够自由的运用英语进行思维，对一些事物发表个人的想法和建议。英语水平相当于国家英语9级标准第3级。在此基础上，经过新概念1册学习和比较系统的训练，学员可以参加公共英语（PETS）的考试. 牛津少儿英语获的国际荣誉如下： 法国教育部认可唯一在全国推广的儿童多媒体教材。 美国少儿英语优秀出版刊物。 国际最佳少儿ESL艾迪课程奖。 国际少儿最佳科技学习奖。 日本多媒体教学课程最高级别奖项目 中国教育部认定为“牛津英语第二课堂”教材，最适合英语培训学校学习的教材。 牛津少儿英语学员能学多少？ 小学阶段是让您孩子学会流利英语会话的关键时期。Let’s go儿童英语培训课程分为七个阶段，涵盖并远远超过了小学英语的所有方面，从英语词汇积累到习惯用语英语写作，特别强调英语口语发音。 【特色功能】 学习神器，提分超速。 内容丰富，逐一掌握。 有效预习，复习巩固。 操作简单，功能强大。 语音清晰，播放灵活。 即点即学，随时随地。 纯正发音，口语流利，即学即用。 朗诵配乐，怡情养性，陶冶情操。 后台播放，锁屏状态可继续听读。 原版教材，完美同步最新版课本。 ■■■ —【爱贝】APP系列 — 可移动的专属外教课堂！ 专注青少儿、成人语言教育。独创多元教学法，丰富多彩的课程，帮助您有效达成学习目标。 从预习、学习、复习、到应用，打造高效学习闭环。 您学到的不仅仅是知识！ ■想学随时学 方便快捷，随点随学，零碎时间充分利用。 只要你想，哪里都是课堂，多种课程任你挑选， 随时随地学习。 ■因为专业，所以简单 学语言，从未有过如此简单轻松。 全浸入式学习环境，活学活用会说会考，突破瓶颈自信掌握。 打破地域限制 Anytime,Anywhere! 改变从现在开始 Make changes from now on! 2）目录： Unit 1 Unit 2 Let's Review Unit 3 Unit 4 Let's Review Unit 5 Unit 6 Let's Review Unit 7 Unit 8 Let's Review Let's Go 2 Syllabus Word List

1305681046.name: Airway Triage
1305681046.description: The Airway Triage App can be used for airway assessment and risk stratification by health care professionals in any clinical situation in which airway management is needed. It is a must have app for all airway managers. With the easy to use PHASE and HELP-ET checklists the airway of your patient can be triaged within a minute into basic or advanced. This is the best airway assessment method to clearly define basic airways that can be managed with basic airway management techniques by a trained person. Advanced airways should be managed by medical personnel with advanced airways skills and special equipment may be needed. Complexity factors that can make airway management challenging can be found, discussed and mitigated to make an airway management strategy and reduce risk at complications. This is the first airway assessment method that implements human factors, vital signs, clinical experience, the surgical procedure, equipment and time pressure. The app can be used in pre-assessment clinics, in the operating room environment, in the ICU and emergency department for patients > 12 years old or prior to procedural sedation. With the Circles of Life Approach you can check if you are “fit-to-fly" with this patient for this airway management procedure. Airway Triage App has great cognitive aids, for example the voice guided stop & go airway time-out procedure and the surgical airway rescue drill. The Airway Triage App is developed by the founder of the Airway Management Academy, a leading international non-profit airway organisation. This app is available in 15 languages, the default language is English.

＊阶段性学习目标，科学规划方案，多样化课程满足您的需求。 ＊定制化的学习体系，听说读写能力全面提升，终成学霸。 ＊长期巩固知识，课程反复学习，重点难点轻松掌握。 《牛津少儿英语Let's Go》专门为非母语国家研发，Let’s Go Professional获得全球 Best Early Elementary ESL奖（最佳初级小学英语教材），目前该套教材在中国培训机构有较广泛的应用。 这套软件专为低龄学童（6-12岁）设计，根据儿童心理特点，通过Sam和Ginger两只顽皮可爱的小猫——他们在整套课程中通过歌曲、游戏、对话以及多姿多彩的练习来教授英文发音、词汇和语法，让学童在游戏中学习，寓教于乐。 这套教材一共有7个级别，精心设计的教材充分利用儿童“语言学习关键期”这一得天独厚的优势和儿童学外语时表现出好奇、好动、好玩、好胜、好表扬的"五好"心理，运用大量运用LET'S GO独创的、生动活泼的外语教学游戏，消除了儿童外语学习时易产生的畏惧、害羞、紧张等不良心理状态。 Let’s go starter 熟练拼写26个字母，达到见字母会读，见单词能拼，认读单词并养成大声说英语的好习惯，为将来的英语学习奠定了良好的开端。 Let’s go1 熟练表达简单对话，熟练拼写100个英语单词、掌握58个动词短语；掌握问候、介绍、感谢、询问天气等语言交流项目；常用的单词到达会听、说、读、写；书中涉及的动词短语、句型达到会听、说、读。听力达到15个单词/分钟到达国家英语课程9级标准第1级水平。 学员在听、说、读、方面能够达到国家英语课程9级标准中的第1级标准。 Let’s go2 熟练掌握可数名词的单复数、There be句型和事物基本方位的表达；掌握一般现在时的表达方式，了解现在进行时的表达方式和实意动词的现在分词形式，能够运用询问职业、住址、食物等语言交流的功能项目。 学员英语水平达到国家英语课程9级标准第1级。 Let’s go3 熟练掌握不可数名词的基本用法、第一、第二人称和第三人称单复数以及它们在句子中与do/does的搭配、现在进行时和动词的现在分词、一般过去时和动词过去时的变化规律。能够写作短篇英语作文，听力达到25个单词/分钟。（相当于国家英语课程9级标准2级水平的听力和写作 ）。 学员英语水平达到牛津英语4B水平，能够参加国家英语课程9级标准2级水平考试。 Let’s go4 能够描述生活中的一些简单事物；能够读懂一些简单的短文；能够利用字典辅助学习，听力达到28个单词/每分钟（相当于国家英语课成9级标准第3级水平）。 Let’s go5 能够与外教进行简单对话；能够阅读相对长的文章；写作短篇英语作文。掌握现在完成时的基本构成、动词过去分词的变化规则、一般将来时的两种表达方式，熟练拼写600个英语单词；掌握50个短语。 Let’s go6 能够自由的运用英语进行思维，对一些事物发表个人的想法和建议。英语水平相当于国家英语9级标准第3级。在此基础上，经过新概念1册学习和比较系统的训练，学员可以参加公共英语（PETS）的考试. go儿童英语培训课程分为七个阶段，涵盖并远远超过了小学英语的所有方面，从英语词汇积累到习惯用语英语写作，特别强调英语口语发音。 【特色功能】 学习神器，提分超速。 内容丰富，逐一掌握。 有效预习，复习巩固。 操作简单，功能强大。 语音清晰，播放灵活。 即点即学，随时随地。 纯正发音，口语流利，即学即用。 朗诵配乐，怡情养性，陶冶情操。 后台播放，锁屏状态可继续听读。 原版教材，完美同步最新版课本。 1308057201.name: pCAM Pro - Camera Tools
1308057201.description: Plan shots, choose lenses, calculate exposure, and pre-visualize the frame in seconds. 27 pro tools. 2,000+ camera formats. Every result illustrated. I've deliberately kept pCAM Pro a one-time purchase, with none of the subscriptions that have crept into so many apps. Universal app for iPhone, iPad, Apple Silicon Mac, and Apple Vision Pro Depth of Field (hyperfocal, total depth, near and far, image circle) Field of View (and angle of view) Field of View Preview in both Portrait & Landscape camera positions (8 images to pre-visualize & size shots by distance & focal length) Focal Length (lens) Matching — match to horizontal, vertical, or diagonal dimensions Relative Size (compares sensors) Exposure calculations HMI Flicker-free (safe shutters & safe camera speeds) Reference (technical charts, lists & tables. Cine film stocks with film can labels, cine lens specs, false color/exposure change, diopter distance table, miniature shooting, safe panning speeds, zone system) Insert Slate (4 font colors plus white or black backgrounds) Splits — Aperture Finder calculation Speed Booster® Adapter — calculate reduced Focal Length & Boosted Aperture with various adapters. Also create camera format profiles with attached adapters for use in other tools Eye Light & VFX with Chroma Key (color-adjustable VFX tracking markers for green/blue screen) Light Effects for handheld light or via Apple AirPlay to HDTV. Includes templates for: fire, television, siren, neon, strobe, flashbulb, lightning. Create unlimited custom animations Mired Shift — Gel Selector Conversion calculator 4 Test Charts (incl. Siemens Star) Triangulate calculation (calculate distances, image circle, etc.) Film Running Time to Length Shooting to Screen Time Color Correction (chooses color correction filters) Time Lapse (shooting interval, event duration, screen time) Scene Illumination (beam intensity) Light Coverage (width/distance) Underwater Distance Diopter (lens focus, diopter power) Macro (object distance, magnification, corrected stop, DoF, object size, image size, fill percentage) Built-in user guides on each screen Calculates instantly & automatically as each entry is entered 2,000+ camera formats plus unlimited customizable, user-defined camera formats, CoC & filters Designed by a working camera technician who understands that calculations must be done simply and on-the-run AND ONE THING THAT ISN'T A CALCULATOR Crew Wheel — spin to settle who's buying the coffee. Not a tool, just a small gift for the standing-around time. Every long day needs one. TRUSTED WORLDWIDE BY DPs, Photographers, Camera Assistants, Camera Operators, Production Designers, VFX, Videographers, Gaffers, plus Film, Television, and Digital Media students. INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Membership in the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (Production and Technology Branch). 75th Primetime Emmy Awards — Emmy® for "Outstanding Achievement in Engineering, Science & Technology" from the Academy of Television Arts & Sciences. 62nd Primetime Emmy Awards — Engineering Plaque for "Outstanding Achievement in Engineering Development" from the Academy of Television Arts & Sciences. Technical Achievement Award from Society of Camera Operators — "For outstanding contributions to cinematography through the design and development of the pCAM Film+Digital Calculator."

Universal app for iPhone, iPad, Apple Silicon Mac, and Apple Vision Pro Depth of Field (hyperfocal, total depth, near and far, image circle) Field of View (and angle of view) Field of View Preview in both Portrait & Landscape camera positions (8 images to pre-visualize & size shots by distance & focal length) Focal Length (lens) Matching — match to horizontal, vertical, or diagonal dimensions Relative Size (compares sensors) Exposure calculations HMI Flicker-free (safe shutters & safe camera speeds) Reference (technical charts, lists & tables. Cine film stocks with film can labels, cine lens specs, false color/exposure change, diopter distance table, miniature shooting, safe panning speeds, zone system) Insert Slate (4 font colors plus white or black backgrounds) Splits — Aperture Finder calculation Speed Booster® Adapter — calculate reduced Focal Length & Boosted Aperture with various adapters. Also create camera format profiles with attached adapters for use in other tools Eye Light & VFX with Chroma Key (color-adjustable VFX tracking markers for green/blue screen) Light Effects for handheld light or via Apple AirPlay to HDTV. Includes templates for: fire, television, siren, neon, strobe, flashbulb, lightning. Create unlimited custom animations Mired Shift — Gel Selector Conversion calculator 4 Test Charts (incl. Siemens Star) Triangulate calculation (calculate distances, image circle, etc.) Film Running Time to Length Shooting to Screen Time Color Correction (chooses color correction filters) Time Lapse (shooting interval, event duration, screen time) Scene Illumination (beam intensity) Light Coverage (width/distance) Underwater Distance Diopter (lens focus, diopter power) Macro (object distance, magnification, corrected stop, DoF, object size, image size, fill percentage) Built-in user guides on each screen Calculates instantly & automatically as each entry is entered 2,000+ camera formats plus unlimited customizable, user-defined camera formats, CoC & filters Designed by a working camera technician who understands that calculations must be done simply and on-the-run AND ONE THING THAT ISN'T A CALCULATOR Crew Wheel — spin to settle who's buying the coffee. Not a tool, just a small gift for the standing-around time. Every long day needs one. TRUSTED WORLDWIDE BY DPs, Photographers, Camera Assistants, Camera Operators, Production Designers, VFX, Videographers, Gaffers, plus Film, Television, and Digital Media students. 1308106679.name: 牛津少儿英语Let’s Go 5/6 -最佳初级小学教材
1308106679.trackName: 牛津少儿英语Let’s Go 5/6 -最佳初级小学教材
1308106679.description: 【爱贝】APP系列，移动课堂，随心所享！精致学习，精致生活！ 有限的时间，发现您无限可能。世界因你而变，唯有行动，梦想才能起航！ 语言，沟通你我！ 爱贝，陪伴左右！ ■■■ 完美同步配套《牛津少儿英语Let’s Go》（5/6)最新课本。 ＊通过预习，认知，掌握，内化四个步骤，让您轻松而高效的学习。 ＊阶段性学习目标，科学规划方案，多样化课程满足您的需求。 ＊定制化的学习体系，听说读写能力全面提升，终成学霸。 ＊长期巩固知识，课程反复学习，重点难点轻松掌握。 《牛津少儿英语Let's Go》专门为非母语国家研发，Let’s Go Professional获得全球 Best Early Elementary ESL奖（最佳初级小学英语教材），目前该套教材在中国培训机构有较广泛的应用。 这套软件专为低龄学童（6-12岁）设计，根据儿童心理特点，通过Sam和Ginger两只顽皮可爱的小猫——他们在整套课程中通过歌曲、游戏、对话以及多姿多彩的练习来教授英文发音、词汇和语法，让学童在游戏中学习，寓教于乐。 这套教材一共有7个级别，精心设计的教材充分利用儿童“语言学习关键期”这一得天独厚的优势和儿童学外语时表现出好奇、好动、好玩、好胜、好表扬的"五好"心理，运用大量运用LET'S GO独创的、生动活泼的外语教学游戏，消除了儿童外语学习时易产生的畏惧、害羞、紧张等不良心理状态。 Let’s go starter 熟练拼写26个字母，达到见字母会读，见单词能拼，认读单词并养成大声说英语的好习惯，为将来的英语学习奠定了良好的开端。 Let’s go1 熟练表达简单对话，熟练拼写100个英语单词、掌握58个动词短语；掌握问候、介绍、感谢、询问天气等语言交流项目；常用的单词到达会听、说、读、写；书中涉及的动词短语、句型达到会听、说、读。听力达到15个单词/分钟到达国家英语课程9级标准第1级水平。 学员在听、说、读、方面能够达到国家英语课程9级标准中的第1级标准。 Let’s go2 熟练掌握可数名词的单复数、There be句型和事物基本方位的表达；掌握一般现在时的表达方式，了解现在进行时的表达方式和实意动词的现在分词形式，能够运用询问职业、住址、食物等语言交流的功能项目。 学员英语水平达到国家英语课程9级标准第1级。 Let’s go3 熟练掌握不可数名词的基本用法、第一、第二人称和第三人称单复数以及它们在句子中与do/does的搭配、现在进行时和动词的现在分词、一般过去时和动词过去时的变化规律。能够写作短篇英语作文，听力达到25个单词/分钟。（相当于国家英语课程9级标准2级水平的听力和写作 ）。 学员英语水平达到牛津英语4B水平，能够参加国家英语课程9级标准2级水平考试。 Let’s go4 能够描述生活中的一些简单事物；能够读懂一些简单的短文；能够利用字典辅助学习，听力达到28个单词/每分钟（相当于国家英语课成9级标准第3级水平）。 Let’s go5 能够与外教进行简单对话；能够阅读相对长的文章；写作短篇英语作文。掌握现在完成时的基本构成、动词过去分词的变化规则、一般将来时的两种表达方式，熟练拼写600个英语单词；掌握50个短语。 Let’s go6 能够自由的运用英语进行思维，对一些事物发表个人的想法和建议。英语水平相当于国家英语9级标准第3级。在此基础上，经过新概念1册学习和比较系统的训练，学员可以参加公共英语（PETS）的考试. 牛津少儿英语获的国际荣誉如下： 法国教育部认可唯一在全国推广的儿童多媒体教材。 美国少儿英语优秀出版刊物。 国际最佳少儿ESL艾迪课程奖。 国际少儿最佳科技学习奖。 日本多媒体教学课程最高级别奖项目 中国教育部认定为“牛津英语第二课堂”教材，最适合英语培训学校学习的教材。 牛津少儿英语学员能学多少？ 小学阶段是让您孩子学会流利英语会话的关键时期。Let’s go儿童英语培训课程分为七个阶段，涵盖并远远超过了小学英语的所有方面，从英语词汇积累到习惯用语英语写作，特别强调英语口语发音。 【特色功能】 学习神器，提分超速。 内容丰富，逐一掌握。 有效预习，复习巩固。 操作简单，功能强大。 语音清晰，播放灵活。 即点即学，随时随地。 纯正发音，口语流利，即学即用。 朗诵配乐，怡情养性，陶冶情操。 后台播放，锁屏状态可继续听读。 原版教材，完美同步最新版课本。 ■■■ —【爱贝】APP系列 — 可移动的专属外教课堂！ 专注青少儿、成人语言教育。独创多元教学法，丰富多彩的课程，帮助您有效达成学习目标。 从预习、学习、复习、到应用，打造高效学习闭环。 您学到的不仅仅是知识！ ■想学随时学 方便快捷，随点随学，零碎时间充分利用。 只要你想，哪里都是课堂，多种课程任你挑选， 随时随地学习。 ■因为专业，所以简单 学语言，从未有过如此简单轻松。 全浸入式学习环境，活学活用会说会考，突破瓶颈自信掌握。 打破地域限制 Anytime,Anywhere! 改变从现在开始 Make changes from now on! 6）目录： Unit 1 Unit 2 Let's Review Unit 3 Unit 4 Let's Review Unit 5 Unit 6 Let's Review Unit 7 Unit 8 Let's Review Let's Go 6 Syllabus Word List

这套软件专为低龄学童（6-12岁）设计，根据儿童心理特点，通过Sam和Ginger两只顽皮可爱的小猫——他们在整套课程中通过歌曲、游戏、对话以及多姿多彩的练习来教授英文发音、词汇和语法，让学童在游戏中学习，寓教于乐。 这套教材一共有7个级别，精心设计的教材充分利用儿童“语言学习关键期”这一得天独厚的优势和儿童学外语时表现出好奇、好动、好玩、好胜、好表扬的"五好"心理，运用大量运用LET'S GO独创的、生动活泼的外语教学游戏，消除了儿童外语学习时易产生的畏惧、害羞、紧张等不良心理状态。 Let’s go starter 熟练拼写26个字母，达到见字母会读，见单词能拼，认读单词并养成大声说英语的好习惯，为将来的英语学习奠定了良好的开端。 Let’s go1 熟练表达简单对话，熟练拼写100个英语单词、掌握58个动词短语；掌握问候、介绍、感谢、询问天气等语言交流项目；常用的单词到达会听、说、读、写；书中涉及的动词短语、句型达到会听、说、读。听力达到15个单词/分钟到达国家英语课程9级标准第1级水平。 学员在听、说、读、方面能够达到国家英语课程9级标准中的第1级标准。 Let’s go2 熟练掌握可数名词的单复数、There be句型和事物基本方位的表达；掌握一般现在时的表达方式，了解现在进行时的表达方式和实意动词的现在分词形式，能够运用询问职业、住址、食物等语言交流的功能项目。 学员英语水平达到国家英语课程9级标准第1级。 Let’s go3 熟练掌握不可数名词的基本用法、第一、第二人称和第三人称单复数以及它们在句子中与do/does的搭配、现在进行时和动词的现在分词、一般过去时和动词过去时的变化规律。能够写作短篇英语作文，听力达到25个单词/分钟。（相当于国家英语课程9级标准2级水平的听力和写作 ）。 学员英语水平达到牛津英语4B水平，能够参加国家英语课程9级标准2级水平考试。 Let’s go4 能够描述生活中的一些简单事物；能够读懂一些简单的短文；能够利用字典辅助学习，听力达到28个单词/每分钟（相当于国家英语课成9级标准第3级水平）。 Let’s go5 能够与外教进行简单对话；能够阅读相对长的文章；写作短篇英语作文。掌握现在完成时的基本构成、动词过去分词的变化规则、一般将来时的两种表达方式，熟练拼写600个英语单词；掌握50个短语。 Let’s go6 能够自由的运用英语进行思维，对一些事物发表个人的想法和建议。英语水平相当于国家英语9级标准第3级。在此基础上，经过新概念1册学习和比较系统的训练，学员可以参加公共英语（PETS）的考试. 牛津少儿英语获的国际荣誉如下： 法国教育部认可唯一在全国推广的儿童多媒体教材。 美国少儿英语优秀出版刊物。 国际最佳少儿ESL艾迪课程奖。 国际少儿最佳科技学习奖。 日本多媒体教学课程最高级别奖项目 中国教育部认定为“牛津英语第二课堂”教材，最适合英语培训学校学习的教材。 牛津少儿英语学员能学多少？ 小学阶段是让您孩子学会流利英语会话的关键时期。Let’s go儿童英语培训课程分为七个阶段，涵盖并远远超过了小学英语的所有方面，从英语词汇积累到习惯用语英语写作，特别强调英语口语发音。 【特色功能】 学习神器，提分超速。 内容丰富，逐一掌握。 有效预习，复习巩固。 操作简单，功能强大。 语音清晰，播放灵活。 即点即学，随时随地。 纯正发音，口语流利，即学即用。 朗诵配乐，怡情养性，陶冶情操。 后台播放，锁屏状态可继续听读。 原版教材，完美同步最新版课本。 ■■■ —【爱贝】APP系列 — 可移动的专属外教课堂！ 专注青少儿、成人语言教育。独创多元教学法，丰富多彩的课程，帮助您有效达成学习目标。 从预习、学习、复习、到应用，打造高效学习闭环。 您学到的不仅仅是知识！ ■想学随时学 方便快捷，随点随学，零碎时间充分利用。 只要你想，哪里都是课堂，多种课程任你挑选， 随时随地学习。 ■因为专业，所以简单 学语言，从未有过如此简单轻松。 全浸入式学习环境，活学活用会说会考，突破瓶颈自信掌握。 打破地域限制 Anytime,Anywhere! 改变从现在开始 Make changes from now on! 1308118507.description: V2EX 是一个汇聚了数十万创意工作者的社区，大部分来自互联网行业、游戏行业和媒体行业。V2EX 上的用户分享和讨论各种创意、想法和技术，无论是独立开发者，创业团队，还是职业设计师，都可以在这里找到一群志同道合的人。 V2er 第三方客户端，是一款可以帮助您更方便地浏览 V2EX 内容的 iOS 应用。如果您是 V2EX 的用户，这款应用可以让您更容易地参与讨论和发布主题；如果您刚刚接触 V2EX，这款应用也可以帮助您了解社区中的话题和流行趋势。 希望能够为您提供一个更高效、更愉悦的 V2EX 使用体验，并让您更完整地融入这个充满创意和灵感的社区。请注意，如果您无法正常访问 V2EX 或者并不了解这个社区，购买本应用可能会无法为您提供实际的帮助。

1308866691.description: 海豚记账本 - 懂记账，造就美好生活！ 海豚记账本Pro是海豚记账本的专业版，提供功能更全、最新、无广告的极致记账体验。 海豚记账本，最简洁的随手记账软件，百万财务用户的共同选择！您的财务管家！ 极简的记账操作流程，让您轻松上手！ 手势指纹密码保护，保护您的数据隐私。 无限制的一键账单导出功能，方便打印或备份。 年度趋势、月度分析、日历等可视化的数据展示，让您的账单一目了然！ 多账本支持单独设置记账分类、共享账本自定义分类支持多人同步，和朋友、家人一起玩转极致记账体验。 财务中经常遇到的问题： 工作太忙经常忘记记账，也没有人提醒，数据不安全同步？ 市场上的记账软件流程太复杂，界面不友好？ 纸上或者电脑记账，数据没有统计、归纳总结，以及开销账单？ 「海豚记账本」解决的方式： 提供数据加密、同步上传、云备份，保障数据安全，同时贴心的提醒服务再也不会忘记记账了。 3秒闪电记账，极简的记账操作流程，让您快速上手，简洁的交互让您的记账轻松有趣。 智能账单分析，让您的资金流向一目了然，每日开销明细一清二楚。 「海豚记账本」核心特点： 智能资产分析 囊括现金、微信钱包、支付宝、信用卡、储蓄卡等最前沿的资产账户。 智能资产分析，让您的资金流向一目了然，分类统计，每日每周每月开销明细一清二楚。 家人共享记账 一键邀请家人、朋友、同事共同记账，账单实时同步。 共睹每笔账单，告别糊涂账。 3秒快速记账 一键记账，记账就是这么简单，多种账目分类，让您的账单轻轻楚楚。 囊括日常生活、旅行、装修、校园、生意、投资等多类型账本。 不同类型账本不同主题，告别审美疲劳。 高效日历查阅 高效快捷日历查阅每一笔账单，每日开销明细一清二楚。 支持全资产查阅，也可以单个账本查阅。 金融级加密保护 账单数据实时云备份，金融级数据加密保护，安全可靠。 账单数据和账号绑定，换手机也不用担心账单数据丢失了。 [自动续费VIP套餐说明] 订阅周期:1个月(连续包月产品)，3个月(连续包季产品)，12个月(连续包年产品)。 订阅价格:连续包月产品为每月 8 元;连续包季产品为每季24元;连续包年产品为每年 86 元。 付款:通过用户的iTunes账户扣款，用户确认购买后即付款。 取消续订:如需取消续订，请在当前订阅周期到期前24小时以前，手动在iTunes/AppleID设置管理中关闭自动续订功能。 续订:苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期。--订阅可以由用户管理，并且可以在购买后在用户的账户设置里关闭自动订阅。 隐私政策:http://account.ftoutiao.cn/app/privacy.html 会员服务协议:https://book.haitunwallet.com/app/vipAgreement.html EULA服务协议:https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ @联系海豚记账本 官方网站：https://www.haituncard.com 商务邮箱：db@haitunwallet.com 反馈邮箱：feedback@haitunwallet.com QQ 官群：630331850

1309134227.name: 小医院
1309134227.description: 医院体验 见医生、护士、牙医和花店店主。尝试X光、驾驶救护车以及救助滑滑板摔倒的儿童。 发现&探索 在小医院，儿童可以发现充满惊喜的忙碌的医疗中心——从前台、手术室到X光。小医院是专门给儿童设计的丰富有趣的隐藏物品游戏。可以探索和发现：儿童可以自由从一间房间走到另一件房间，按照自己的速度体验这款应用。医院不同的房间有很多动画以及有趣的小游戏，比如：物品上色或拼图。 非常适合儿童 操控非常简单：点击物品，滑动进入另外一个场景——因此，即使很小的儿童都可以操控这款应用。 亮点： 操控简单，专门给3-5岁的儿童设计 探索 5间独特的房间以及大量的物品 2个小游戏 用救护车完成不同的救援任务 收集品和任务确保长时间的内容和趣味性 有趣的角色和快乐的动画 原创造型和音乐- 无需互联网或WiFi - 任何地方都可以玩耍 发现、玩耍、学习 我们的愿望是以趣味温和的方式将孩子引入到数字世界中，从而给他们打开全新的世界。 通过我们的应用，儿童能融入游戏、开始冒险、自由发挥创造力。 小医院在德国柏林精心制作。 关于 Fox & Sheep： 我们是来自柏林的儿童 App 工作室，为 2-8 岁的儿童开发高品质的游戏。 同样身为父母，我们带着对我们产品的热情和心血工作着。我们为我们的 App 选择全世界顶尖的插画师和动画师，为了能开发最美的 App 呈献给孩子们，以及带给我们和你们的孩子更丰富多彩的生活。

1309398796.name: 哈密顿图
1309398796.description: 【设计思路】 这个APP的设计灵感来源于哈密顿(Hamilton)图。 APP里每一关都是哈密顿图，需要找到一条哈密顿回路，才能通过关卡。 然而，寻找哈密顿回路是一个“NP完全问题”——世界7大难题之一。 【世界7大数学难题】 黎曼猜想 霍奇猜想 BSD猜想 庞加莱猜想 NP完全问题 纳卫尔-斯托可方程 杨-米尔斯存在性和质量缺口 这7个问题都被悬赏100万美元。 其中有一个已被解决（庞加莱猜想），还剩6个。

1309752471.name: Superpowers by SYPartners
1309752471.description: Nominated in 2018 for a Webby Award and a Webby People’s Voice Award for Best Lifestyle App. Unlock your superpower. Everyone has one—a unique capability you bring to a team. Something you do better than anyone else. What’s yours? Superpowers is a fun and simple tool designed to help you and your team discover your individual superpowers—and learn how to use them to perform at your best. The next time you have a team kick-off or are preparing for one, try Superpowers. Superpowers distills decades of SYPartners’ team-building research into a playful, fast-moving exercise. Inspired by patterns observed in high-performing teams—where each member’s unique role is made explicit—the cards were refined through real-world consulting and field testing. You can also find physical cards in our store and use them casually or as part of a facilitated team exercise. ______ ABOUT SYPARTNERS Since 1994, SYPartners has helped leaders of some of the world’s most iconic organizations lead into the unknown. Headquartered in New York, with an office in Abu Dhabi, SYPartners is a founding member of kyu. To discover additional publications and tools inspired by SYP’s consulting work, visit our website.

1310344709.name: 成人身高计算器
1310344709.description: 身高70%由基因决定，30%由营养、健康和锻炼等环境因素决定。还有很多其他变量，所以身高预测并不是100%准确的。然而，有两种方法可以给您很好的估计，如下所示。应用程序使用中亲值法和更准确的Khamis-Roche法来预测成年身高。用这款应用来追踪孩子的身高，可以显示出您的孩子是否发育正常。 中亲值法 如果您的孩子还不到4岁，那么这个方法可以使用。源于1948年Horace Gray在儿童发展杂志上发表的一篇的文章，至今仍被广泛使用。误差的范围是+/-4英寸或10.16厘米。这是一个简单的公式，其中孩子的成年身高是根据父母的身高和孩子的性别来计算的。 Khamis-Roche法 这种方法适用于4至17岁的儿童。这一方法是由Khamis博士和Roche博士开发的，准确率大约为90%。它使用孩子的年龄、性别、身高、体重、父母的身高以及一些比例因子和方程式来预测孩子的成年身高。 骨龄法 骨龄法比Khamis- Roche方法更准确，但它需要手的x光片。显然，成人身高计算器不能拍x光片！也许未来的智能手机可以:)

1312646149.name: First Grade Math Trainer
1312646149.description: First Grade Math Trainer transforms early math learning into a fun, interactive experience. With intuitive handwritten input, kids can practice addition and subtraction by physically writing numbers on-screen. The app features two modes – a self-paced Math Trainer for mastering facts without pressure and the engaging Math Shot mini-game that adapts to each child's skill level. Whether solving simple addition up to 10 or more complex subtraction problems, young learners enjoy hands-on practice that builds confidence and fluency in essential math skills. With First grade Math Addition you can practice and improve the following skills: Addition up to 10 Addition up to 18 Addition up to 20 Add a number to a multiple of ten Add two multiples of ten Add doubles Add three numbers up to 10 each Relate addition and subtraction With First grade Math Subtraction you can practice and improve the following skills: Subtraction facts - numbers up to 10 Subtraction facts - numbers up to 18 Subtraction facts - numbers up to 20 Subtract multiples of 10 Subtract a multiple of ten Relate addition and subtraction Subtract one-digit number from two-digit number Subtract two two-digit numbers With Addition Skill Builders you can practice and improve the following skills: Adding 1 Adding 2 Adding 3 Adding 4 Adding 5 Adding 6 Adding 7 Adding 8 Adding 9 Adding 10 With Subtraction Skill Builders you can practice and improve the following skills: Subtracting 1 Subtracting 2 Subtracting 3 Subtracting 4 Subtracting 5 Subtracting 6 Subtracting 7 Subtracting 8 Subtracting 9 Subtracting 10

1313164055.name: EE35 Film Camera
1313164055.description: EE35 film camera simulates a retro mechanical camera around the 1960's. This camera app is made in Japan. Basic usage (1) Pull the film advance lever (2) Press the shutter There are two types of film, color and black&white. It's easy to take 12 shots. Development ends immediately after taking a picture, and the image of the film is also saved. The timer is about 7 seconds. Multiple exposure can be done by shutter charge without film advance. Please enjoy retro camera life.

1314144281.name: RCam Pro - 专业手动相机 & RAW照片
1314144281.trackName: RCam Pro - 专业手动相机 & RAW照片
1314144281.description: RCam Pro 是专为 iOS 设备精心打造的专业视频录制、照片拍摄应用。它提供众多先进特性---对焦峰值、虚色、扩展对焦，斑马纹和直方图，支持Flat 与 Log 曲线，支持支持PRORAW / RAW拍摄--DNG照片导出。它为您提供音频控制、音频计量、自定义分辨率、帧数和录音格式。能充分发挥你的设备潜能。打造八种专业模式，其手动模式拥有极快的响应速度，让你对拍摄参数控制自如。 支持30多种模拟胶卷 支持手机广角，超广角，长焦，双摄像头的切换 ---- 适应不同场景。 支持Flat 与 Log 曲线记录更广色域 --- 让视频在后期获得更大创作空间 相机八大模式： 1. 慢动作 --- 支持24，30，48，50，60不同帧率 2. 延时摄影 ---- 支持24~60不同帧率的设置，可调节快门间隔与设置自动摄影时长 3. 视频 --- 支持1080P, 3k,4K 视频拍摄, 24~60不同帧率的设置, 5种画质的个性调节，最高支持 100 Mb/s 的编码率，自拍定时器，美颜 4. 照片 -- 支持PRORAW / RAW，HDR，AEB，自拍，美颜和纵横比（4:3 / 3:2 / 16:9 / 1:1） 5. 夜景 -- 支持1s,2s,4s等慢快门速度的设置 6. 动态模糊 -- 轻松生成个性特效照片如水雾效果 7. 光绘 -- 支持感光度的调节 8. 光场 -- 轻松先拍照后对焦，每一细节都保留 相机功能： 三种伽马曲线：自然，FLAT， LOG 对焦峰值和扩大对焦范围（用于手动对焦辅助） 虚色，斑马纹曝光辅助 实时直方图 --- 反应视频颜色的平衡和曝光 实时美颜 手动曝光和对焦控制- 选择单独的焦点和曝光度，拖动即可调节 手动控制调节：曝光，快门速度，对焦，变焦，ISO 对焦、曝光与白平衡 (WB) 锁定 防抖 - 主动式视频防抖消除拍摄时发生的晃动 支持水平及竖直拍摄 支持可自由设置的延迟摄影 支持 HEVC（ iPhone 7 及较新设备／需 iOS 11 ）和 H.264 视频编码 支持JPEG ，TIFF, HEIF（ iPhone 7 及较新设备／需 iOS 11 ）和 RAW格式的照片 支持 HDR, AEB 功能 支持照片多种画幅的设置: 1:1 / 4:3 / 3:2 / 16:9 支持视频多种分辨率的设置: 720P , 1080P, 1440P, 3k, 4k 视频分辨率：帧率 24， 25， 30， 48， 50， 60 手机空间计数器与手机电量显示 慢动作视频模式，6 种播放速度（60 fps / 50 fps / 48fps / 30fps / 25fps / 24fps) 6 倍数码变焦 音量计 ( 级别 平均 / 峰值) 地理位置标记 对齐网格 支持前 / 后置摄像头 闪光灯设置（自动 / 开启 / 关闭 ） 视频照片分享： 使用 iTunes 文件共享功能将视频拷贝至电脑 支持将视频照片导出到手机相册 支持RAW照片分享与导出为DNG格式 AirDrop分享 联系我们：1242296736@qq.com

1314415052.name: 短信过滤+
1314415052.description: 这是一款安全、高效、专业的短信过滤器，通过自定义过滤器，能帮助你过滤来自陌生电话号码的垃圾短信和彩信，免受其骚扰。 主要功能： 自动归类短信，过滤垃圾短信，让你在工作、休息和操作手机(例如游戏、阅读)期间免受垃圾短信打扰。 在意隐私： 所有过滤器均运行在由 iOS 提供的封闭和安全的环境中，全程无需连接网络，「短信过滤器+」不会读取、收集或标记你的短信。 进阶功能： 过滤器提供检查电话号码、短信内容、同时检查多个关键词、是否以关键词开始/结束、匹配正则表达式等高级功能。 过滤规则： 当收到短信时，「短信过滤器+」首先运行允许、交易和推广过滤器，当短信匹配任一过滤器时，短信会被归类在相应文件夹下。当以上过滤器均不匹配时，「短信过滤器+」继续运行垃圾短信过滤器，当短信匹配任一过滤器时，短信会被归类为垃圾短信。 注意事项： 短信被识别为允许、交易或推广后，你仍会收到通知和未读角标，短信会分类存放在相应文件夹。 短信被识别为垃圾短信后，你不会收到任何通知，消息 App 也不会显示未读角标。短信将静默存放在垃圾短信文件夹，你可能需要定期清理这些短信。

1315337618.name: Tipease
1315337618.description: Tip calculator: completely free and private. Tipease is a no-frills tip calculator. Launch Tipease and one screen does everything. No ads. No in-app purchases. No sign-in. Choose between a basic slider to rate your service experience or an advanced sliding scale rating of your service speed, accuracy, attention and hospitality. Change your minimum and maximum tip in Settings, and Tipease automatically customizes the app to match your personal tipping habits. Subtract the tax and service fee or add the value of a discount or coupon with no trouble. Effortlessly split the check up to 10 ways. Round your total or your tip. An advanced setting provides the option to round to the nearest ten for totals more than 100 and the nearest 100 for totals more than 1,000.

1315356547.name: WordUp!
1315356547.description: Picture the scenario: You're visiting a new city on a weekend break. You don't speak the local language and you don't have time to learn. What do you do? Download WordUp, a language cheat sheet app. Filled with just the useful words and phrases you need to get by. WordUp is a super simple way to learn essential words & phrases, perfect for when you're travelling to a new city or destination. Think of it as a handy cheat sheet of hundreds of items available offline anytime. You likely don't have the time or resources to learn a new language. Sometimes, knowing just a handful of simple phrases can help you get by much easier. Perhaps it'll help you recognise items on a food menu, or better understand destinations on a signpost. Are you ready to take your first steps in a new language? WordUp is a free app provided by Trip Noodle - www.tripnoodle.com Emoji graphics licensed under Creative Commons 4.0 https://github.com/twitter/twemoji

1315583528.name: ForceData
1315583528.description: ForceData is a very simple app that uses the sensors of the iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch to measure acceleration, velocity and force. Also, it exports filtered data to a CSV file. This CSV file is already prepared to plot force-time, velocity-time and acceleration-time curves easily. Very useful for simple sport biomechanics analyses in exercises like the countermovement jump or the squat!

1316142612.name: Paleontologas
1316142612.description: This application is dedicated to people eager to discover the world around them, explore Earth's history, and become real paleontologists. All content has been reviewed by university professors and members of the paleontological community. 15 geological periods with detailed information on major events, interactive paleomaps, images, and facts about life forms. 236 plant and animal species with concise descriptions and facts. Clear and reliable information for both general audiences and university students. A quiz with 1555 questions to help reinforce your knowledge! Learning progress meters next to each geological period and eon (0–100%). No internet connection required! The application can be freely used for educational purposes. Multilingual support: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Lithuanian, and Slovenian!

The mass media is tuned to the concert pitch of A=440hz, but recent research shows that this pitch might be disharmonious with our bodies and minds. The 528hz is believed to resemble a code underlying our very universe in all aspects - light, time, gravity, magnetism, DNA, and sacred geometry, among others. As sound (vibration) influences the mind and body immediately, even the slightest constant dissonance can bring confusion, inner chaos, and a blind eye to what is going on around. That's why there is a movement in the music world that aims to bring the 528hz pitch into our lives. The 528 Player allows you to pitch shift your music to the C5=528hz tuning which is A=444Hz tuning. It offers no ads, full access, EQ, no limitations, and no in-app purchases. By using this player, you can enjoy the brighter feeling it brings while experiencing the healing qualities for your body and mind. Please note that the app won't play Apple Music files and will only work on music tuned to A=440 Hz. Also, make sure that you have songs on your device; otherwise, the app won't have anything to play. If something is not working, send an email to contact@appums.com, and we'll try to find a solution. Join us on this journey to explore the benefits of tuning to healing frequencies. Love, light, and meditation. P.S. We strongly recommend doing your research on this matter and not relying solely upon our opinion and research.

1317618609.name: Lighting Check
1317618609.description: Having correct light intensity in a cattle is very crucial in maximising the financial gain. This app measures this using the light sensors in the camera of phone. Lighting Check app provides a set of standards for various locations in a cattle farm, to help the farmer have a better understanding that on each location how the lighting of the area is close to standard or not. The accuracy of this app is in direct relation with the quality of the camera of your phone. Thus, newer iPhones could provide more accurate reading of the lighting intensity. In order to maximise the quality of the output, this app only uses the camera of the back of your iPhone.

1318137375.name: 心脏病急救ABCDE
1318137375.description: ABCDE 评估与处理的特点： 1. 不仅仅适合儿科病人，除了心跳骤停患者外（按照心肺复苏指南），几乎所有急诊患者都适用。 2. 不仅内科医生、外科医生、儿科医生、妇产科医生应该掌握，其他医护人员都应该掌握。 3. ABCDE 五个方面应该同时不间断进行。 4. 要评估周围环境是否安全，然后再进行。 5. ABCDE 仅仅是初步评估与处理，待病情稳定需要进一步诊治。 A(Airway)：通畅呼吸道。将病人抬至通风的地方，解开衣领扣子。戴假牙的病人一定要取下假牙。使病人处于仰卧体位，躺在坚固平(地)面上。用手按压病人额头并稍加用力，另一只手的食指和中指置于病人下颌将其上提，使头部后仰以保持气道通畅。 B(Breathing)：口对口吹气人工呼吸。救护者深吸一口气，用压病人额头的拇指、食指捏住病人鼻孔，双唇将病人嘴包严，再进行口对口吹气。每吹气一次，放开捏病人鼻孔的手，使其将气呼出。救护者侧转头，吸入新鲜空气，并观察病人胸部起伏，再进行第二次吹气。一般以吹气后病人的胸廓略有隆起为宜。 C(Circulation)：胸外按压。就是在体外对心脏区域部位胸廓施加压力，促使心脏工作，维持血液循环。这里要特别指出，应将病人置于硬板床或平整地面上，否则将会影响效果。将手的中指对着病人颈部下方的凹陷处，手掌贴在胸廓正中，另一只手压在此手上，两手掌根重叠，手指相扣，手心翘起，离开胸壁，两臂伸直垂直向下压，使胸廓下陷3～5厘米，然后放松，反复进行，每分钟100次为宜。胸外按压和人工呼吸同时进行时，每按压30下吹气2次为宜。左前胸捶压，5～6秒一次。 D(Defibrillation)：除颤。一般是指医院的电除颤，但在家里发生紧急情况，病人出现呼吸心跳停止，意识丧失，四肢抽动时可进行徒手心前区叩击。将一手中指对着病人颈部下方的凹陷处，手掌贴在胸廓正中，另一手握成拳头较为有力地叩击病人胸前的那只手。 E(Early)：早期。就是一切都要尽早进行。

1318230573.name: Digital Force Bag
1318230573.description: Digital Force Bag (DFB) is a joint release from UK Magicians Nick Einhorn & Craig Squires, and developed by Marc Kerstein. This app is a unique digital tool for the serious mentalist or magician and is available for entertainment purposes only. DFB has been designed to allow the user to force any one of 100 items. It is easy enough for an eight year old to operate but useful enough for the world’s greatest magicians! Two effects are included to get you started immediately and an option to fully customise DFB for your own personal use is currently included free! Key Features ● Easy to learn and remember ● Fully customisable for your own routines and languages ● Your audience will never suspect you are using a magic app ● Fun for the aspiring beginner and and an absolute essential for the professional ● Result can be different every time ● Export option allows you to share your routines with friends worldwide

1319191852.name: 熊猫吃短信 - 旧版
1319191852.description: App Store 多次推荐 * 少数派年度应用 * 最美应用年度应用 * 「熊猫吃短信」使用 Core ML 机器学习框架在设备端离线过滤垃圾短信，能准确的通过语义识别垃圾短信，不需要手动配置任何过滤规则，开箱即用。 隐私 我们非常在意您的隐私，并且通过行动（而不只是口头承诺）来保证这一点：熊猫吃短信是一个非常少见的完全离线的应用，甚至都不会请求网络权限（直到您第一次主动向我们举报垃圾短信）。我们依靠广大的用户群体主动向我们举报垃圾短信来建立机器学习的样本库。 集体智慧 熊猫吃短信使用基于统计学的机器学习算法从几十万条各类短信样本中学习而成。无需用户配置任何关键词，它通过识别一个短信的语义特征，自己就可以精准的判断收到的短信是正常短信、公益短信还是广告骚扰短信等等。 如果熊猫有判断失误的时候，大家可以在 App 里面投喂新的短信样本帮助熊猫进化，喂养越多熊猫越聪明。 我为什么要做「熊猫吃短信」？ 我曾深受垃圾短信的困扰，直到 iOS 11 发布了短信过滤的接口。作为一个涉足数据领域的工程师，我导出了几年里收到过的几万条短信，使用机器学习训练了一个垃圾短信的识别模型，就有了这个 App 的雏形。在后续的开发中很多热心的用户又投喂了几十万条短信样本，教会了熊猫识别更多更广阔的场景。 隐私条款：熊猫会收集哪些信息？** 「熊猫吃短信」不会收集您的任何信息，更不会上传您的短信内容，如果您足够细心就会发现熊猫都不会请求网络权限，完全离线运行。 如果您自愿向熊猫提交短信样本，那么会收集脱敏后的短信文本以及一个您标注是否是垃圾短信的数字，仅此两项数据。

1319447211.name: Vigilance Buddy
1319447211.description: Vigilance Buddy by Research Buddies This application is based on the ‘psychomotor vigilance task (PVT)’ which measures the speed of which users respond to the given visual stimulus. Edit the number of rounds per test, maximum time between tap and start of the timer and much more. Collect & Send the results directly to your personal email address. With our focus on usability the application can be used easily by anyone. Because of this it doesn’t matter if your subjects are digital natives or people with zero to none tablet experience. Happy researching!

1320700548.name: Sight Words 5A5B -220个神奇的常用字
1320700548.description: 必学！专为初学英语孩子而设计的常用字学习工具！ 超级实用！学好英文常见字，为孩子进行英文独立阅读打好坚实基础！ Sight Words常用字教程，220个神奇的常用字，带领孩子提前进入英语阅读领域！ 全套5级，每级分A、 B两册。每册能学习到20个左右常用字的用法，而不是简单的背诵记忆，对英语阅读能力提高带来极大帮助。 不单单是复读，【E-Learning】应用系列让您的iPad和iPhone变成学习机！ 学生通过它随时随地完成课前预习、课后复习，学习能力更胜一筹！ 完全匹配教材，操作简便，哪里不会点哪里 ***** ＊根据教材配套，此应用为《Sight Words》（5A、5B）完全最新版。 ＊涵盖教材全部内容，让您全面掌握单词、短语、句子、语法及课文内容。 ＊全套原版录音和教材完全同步，助您成为英语大明星。 ＊操作简便、携带方便，从此抛弃磁带和光盘。 Sight Words可以帮孩子掌握在初级英文中出现频率极高的220个神奇的常用字，增进阅读流畅度，激发孩子英语阅读兴趣！ 由浅入深、循序渐进地学会220个阅读常用字。 漫画情境、融入式生活对话。 有趣的念谣，结合教程，琅琅上口记得牢。 字卡游戏，从游戏操作中记忆阅读常用字。 Sight Words (常用字)是什么？ 在儿童英文中，出现频率很高的单词。 百分之五十到八十在会话或阅读上都会用到的单词。 助词或文法上的一些用字，还包含了不少的介词或代名词。 许多不规则发音的单字，如：are、go、 to... 为什么从小就要学Sight Words？ “Phonics 字母拼读”与“Sight Words常用字” 是英语学习最重要的两大基石，完整学习后，才能为孩子在英语路上堆叠起最成功的步骤。 常用字是依据美国学者Dolch按文字在童书中出现的频率及难易度，归纳出五个级数，共220个Sight Words。 学习 Sight Words 仅靠强制性的记忆是不够的，而是可以通过情境、念谣、游戏等加深孩子的印象，通过活动和练习学习到常用字的用法。 【E-Learning】应用系列同步教材制作，内容完全一致，您可以使用它来进行课文学习，播放教材配套音频，发音纯正地道，寓教于乐，让学习更高效和有趣！ 此应用将成为孩子自学的专属外教，把家长从繁琐的辅导解答中解放出来！能点、能读、更能说，是学生的好老师、好家长！ So easy！妈妈再也不用担心我的学习了，哪里不会点哪里！ 功能特色 中英文双语对照，同步语音，准确清晰。 内容与录音质量放心，地道纯正、原汁源味。 语音播放灵活，快速翻页，目录跳转。 任意位置即点即学，复读模仿随时随地。 完全同步教材制作，内容完全一致。 支持后台播放，锁屏状态可随身听读。 界面简单大方，意图明了，功能实用，操作方便。 —【E-Learning】应用系列 — 适用于多种教学场景，您可以更加便捷地进行碎片化学习，期待您的使用！ 致力于为中国K12教育提供最优秀的互联网教育应用软件！ E-Learning乐园，伴随青少年健康快乐的成长！ 软件功能***** 1.通用应用,同时支持iPhone,iPod touch,iPad设备 2.可以自动顺序播放功能 3.可以自动记录播放位置,不用担心下次找不到听到哪 4.支持离线播放,即使不联网也一样听,到哪都不怕 5.支持手动拖拽前进、后退播放 6.在兼顾软件容量以及更多课程的情况下,我们最大限度保证音频的高质量,每个有声读物片段都是经过我们精选和亲测 7.最最重要的功能，可以拖动字幕定位,音频随之定位 本应用与《Sight Words 》（5A、5B）课本同步 新版（5A）目录： Uint 1 draw,six Unit 2 small,grow Unit 3 today Review 1 Unit 4 hot,drink Unit 5 long Unit 6 seven,full Unit 7 bring,burt Review 2 Unit 8 much,better Unit 9 keep,clean Unit 9 keep,clea Unit 10 try,together Unit 11 never,myself Review 3 Big Review 1 Big Review 2 Translation Answer Keys Cards 新版（5B）目录： Unit 1 Eight,fall,laugh Unit 2 carry,About Unit 3 only,own Review 1 Unit 4 If Unit 5 Shall,far Unit 6 cut,ten Unit 7 light,warm Review 2 Unit 8 kind,slow Unit 9 Hold,start Unit 10 pick,done Unit 11 got Review 3 Big Review 1 Big Review 2 Translation Answer Keys Cards

1320750997.name: 迷失岛2：时间的灰烬
1320750997.description: 《迷失岛2：时间的灰烬》是一款非线性剧情推进式的点触解谜游戏，复古独特的2D手绘画面，丰富烧脑的益智谜题，脑洞大开的神秘剧情，设置二周目玩法，并融入众多科幻电影和书籍彩蛋。让你在解谜的过程中，揭开一段关注这个小岛不为人知的历史... 本作是由《南瓜先生大冒险》《迷失岛》《小三角大英雄》的制作团队胖布丁打造的迷失岛系列续作《迷失岛2：时间的灰烬》。更加卓越的美术画面、加量不加价的烧脑线索和随机谜题、时空变化脑洞大开的剧情、延续前作的二周目玩法以及各种科幻书籍科幻电影致敬彩蛋。 我是谁？为什么会在这个神秘的小岛上？带着这些疑惑，我将探索这个小岛的每一片地方，工厂工厂、轮船、小屋、火箭、灯塔...和每一个岛上的居民对话，有灯塔看守人、船票检查员、老奶奶、工厂研究员...发现一个又一个秘密，当我获得开启时间机器的密码，我将了解这个小岛的前世今生，了解一段不为人知的往事... 【游戏特色】 探索大西洋海域上的神秘小岛，解开这里潜藏的古老秘密 复古独特的2D手绘画面，令人过目不忘的人物性格 非线性剧情推进的点触解谜玩法，多样烧脑的益智谜题 和每一个人物对话，是解开谜团的关键 解锁成就系统和二周目玩法，不容错过 隐藏科幻电影和书籍的致敬彩蛋

1321932608.name: Pediatric Blood Pressure Guide
1321932608.description: The latest guidelines for child and adolescent high blood pressure are difficult to parse in their table form. Now, with three clicks, you can get your answer in less than five seconds. This utility is for physicians and support staff to determine where their patient falls in the normative pediatric blood pressure tables, based on normal-weight children. The current dataset is from Pediatrics August 2017 publication "Clinical Practice Guideline for Screening and Management of High Blood Pressure in Children and Adolescents", Flynn et al.

1323914943.name: ScanMaster for ELM327 OBD-2
1323914943.description: ScanMaster is an application for vehicle diagnostics to OBD-2 standards, communicates with an OBD2 / OBDII / ELM car interface device How to use: 1. Plug ELM327 WIFI Scanner into vehicle's OBD2 port. (Port is usually found on the driver side dashboard under the steering wheel.) 2. Turn ON ignition. (This is one step before engine is powered.) 3. Launch your ScanMaster App. Click "Settings" for scan list OBD2 device and select correct your OBD device for diagnostics. (default is 192.168.0.10 or 192.168.0.123) We would greatly appreciate the feedback on the app. Please send us an email about your experiences, opinions or suggestions.

1324977953.name: OneCalc+: 多合一计算器
1324977953.description: 多合一计算器是一个免费的iOS版应用程序，包括70多种计算器和单位转换器，覆盖了财务，健康，施工，生活方式和日常数学等方方面面。 这款多合一计算器简单但功能强大，一个应用内置了以下所有功能：- 标准计算器 包含一定百分比计算键，负号，括号和浏览器的历史。 高级模式包括存储键，科学计算其中还有三角函数，根式运算，指数运算和对数运算。 单位转换器 支持温度，长度，重量，面积，体积等等度量单位。 货币换算。 财务计算器 支持简单利率和符合利率的复利的计算器 贷款还款和分期摊还日程表 带有财务目标规划器的储蓄计算器 分式/百分比计算器 三方百分比计算器，折扣价格，利润率，税率，小费&账单分摊 加法，减法，乘法，除法，小数 健康 BMI 和卡路里计算器，以帮助您跟踪体重情况。 施工计算器 计算器来估算水泥，沙子，石子数量混凝土块，粉刷和放大器;砖工作。 区域和普通的几何形状体积计算器。 不规则的土地面积计算 使用直角三角形计算器解决高度和距离的问题。 生活方式 年龄和日期计算器

My Brain Anatomy gives users an in depth look at the heart allowing them to select , xray view, hide and show parts of the heart as well as view real time animation, draw or white on screen and share screenshots, Audio pronunciation for all anatomy terms and more. 1326676651.name: Photo Album Watch Face
1326676651.description: Select your favorite pictures on your phone as a Photo Album Watch Face on your Fitbit or Garmin smartwatch. The watch will automatically cycle through the pictures in your Photo Album or you can tap left/right to see the next picture. Please watch the video and read the FAQ: http://www.PhotoAlbumWatchFace.com/ On your watch: tap the "..." button and then the Download button to download new pictures from your phone. The Photo Album Watch Face can be used without connection to your phone. But you need this iPhone app to download new pictures to your watch. Please be patient when you tap the Download button on your watch, the Fitbit connectivity is slow and unreliable. The Fitbit phone app "Sync" step, shown in the video, is very important. Don't skip it and make sure that the watch app Photo Album Watch is closed during the Sync. Please read the FAQ: http://www.PhotoAlbumWatchFace.com/faq/

1326943979.name: ABA Wizard
1326943979.description: This BCBA® exam prep app is designed for any behavior analyst who wants to master the content on the BCBA (Board Certified Behavior Analyst®) or BCaBA® exam. Recently updated, the app now has around 1000 practice questions covering all of the essential principles of applied behavior analysis (ABA) centered on the current 6th edition Test Content Outline. You will be prepared to pass the BCBA or BCaBA exam! HOW MUCH DOES THE APP COST? This is not a subscription. You are given complete access to our entire ABA practice question library for the minimal price of the app. HOW IS THE APP ORGANIZED? The layout of this comprehensive app is organized following the BCBA/BCaBA Test Content Outline (6th Ed.) with a 10 question quiz for every task list item. You will learn quickly with immediate feedback, an explanation, and references for each question. This is the highest value ABA test prep out there! Behavior analysts around the world have downloaded and are loving this program. HOW WERE THE QUESTIONS CREATED? All questions in the app were created by Board Certified Behavior Analysts referencing scholarly texts commonly used in ABA. 1328280479.name: 甲子時空飛吊
1328280479.description: 「甲子时空飞吊」是堪舆择日法的一种工具，它结合了天（时间）地（方位）人（命主）三种关系，找出吉的应用方位。 主要功能： ●四柱：年、月、日、时之甲子入中飞吊九宫。 ●甲子： ●输入命主干支入中，排出分布于九宫的六十甲子。 ●显示年、月、日、时干支入中，排出分布于九宫的六十甲子。 ●显示甲子的「编号」，甲子为1顺数至癸亥。 ●显示甲子的「纳音五行」（并以颜色区分纳音五行）。 ●显示甲子的「圈数」，即飞布九宫的圈数。 ●神煞： ●显示吉神：真禄、阳贵、阴贵、驿马、文昌、天官、红鸾、天喜、桃花。 ●显示凶神：五黄、伏吟、命破、劫杀、灾杀、岁杀、命刑、命害、旬冲、偏冲、正冲。 ●顺逆： ●自动：夏至逆排、冬至顺排（需视参数略有不同）。 ●顺排：全部顺排。 ●逆排：全部逆排。 ●飞吊规则一（环环相扣）： ●选取命主按钮，以命主干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●选取流年按钮，以流年干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●选取流月按钮，以流月干支飞吊「流年」神煞。 ●选取流日按钮，以流日干支飞吊「流月」神煞。 ●选取流时按钮，以流时干支飞吊「流日」神煞。 ●以上一环扣一环，达到环环相扣。 ●飞吊规则二（单独飞吊）： ●选取命主按钮，以命主干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●选取流年按钮，以流年干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●选取流月按钮，以流月干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●选取流日按钮，以流日干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●选取流时按钮，以流时干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●以上单独与命主飞吊。 ●飞吊规则三（自柱飞吊）： ●选取命主按钮，以命主干支飞吊「命主」神煞。 ●选取流年按钮，以流年干支飞吊「流年」神煞。 ●选取流月按钮，以流月干支飞吊「流月」神煞。 ●选取流日按钮，以流日干支飞吊「流日」神煞。 ●选取流时按钮，以流时干支飞吊「流时」神煞。 ●以上单独与自己干支飞吊。 搜寻功能： ●提供指定一个日期范围，并指定搜寻飞吊的项目、卦位及不可含的神煞，即可快速度到符合的日时。 ●指定搜寻飞吊的项目：可以只找年，或只找年月，或只找年月日，或找年月日时。 ●指定搜寻的卦位：可指定某个方位。 （建议全选比较容易找到可用的方位） ●指定吉卦位内不可含的神煞。 （可依自己用事需求，选取想使用的神煞） 偏好设定： ●周首日：设定一周开始的星期。 ●四柱顺序：时日月年／年月日时。 ●年柱交接：提供立春／冬至交接年柱。 ●夜子时：提供夜子时设定。 ●日紫白(五黄排法)：提供沈氏玄空、选择求真、选择求真 (近甲子)、选择求真 (近甲子顺排)、玄空紫白诀精解 (顺排)等排法。 ●时紫白(五黄排法)：提供取吉通鉴、选择求真、玄空紫白诀精解 (顺排)等排法。 ●语言地区：可随时切换介面语言，提供繁体中文、简体中文。 ●介面字型：提供字型大小调整。 ●萤幕锁定：不锁定可长时间使用，萤幕不会关闭。 ●操作介面：繁体中文、简体中文。 ●同时支援 iPad 大萤幕任意方向显示。

1328806990.name: 熊熊专注计时器：番茄钟
1328806990.trackName: 熊熊专注计时器：番茄钟
1328806990.description: 把手机翻过去，把注意力留给真正重要的事。 熊熊专注计时器是一款由小熊汤姆陪伴的番茄钟。选择专注时间和声音，将 iPhone 屏幕朝下放置，一段专注便开始了。学习、工作、阅读或处理个人项目时，让汤姆陪你暂时放下手机；完成后，他会送上一张表扬卡。 翻面开始专注 选择专注时长后，把 iPhone 屏幕朝下放置即可开始 再次拿起手机时，汤姆会用表情提醒你回到正在做的事 简洁的操作，让开始一段专注更有仪式感 番茄钟：专注与休息 通过专注和休息时段安排自己的节奏 可分别调整专注与休息时长 适合学习、工作、阅读和个人项目 白噪音与自然音 选择森林风格的白噪音和自然音，为专注时段营造舒适的声音背景。根据所在环境和自己的习惯，挑选适合当下的声音。 来自汤姆的表扬卡 完成专注时段后，汤姆会送你一张表扬卡。你可以把喜欢的卡片保存到照片 App。表扬卡文字目前提供英语、韩语和日语。 支持 Apple Watch Apple Watch 版本让你也能在手腕上使用专注计时器。手表上的声音、触感和通知表现可能受到 Apple Watch 与系统设置的影响。 准备好后，选择时间和声音，把 iPhone 翻过去，和汤姆一起开始吧。 联系：BearFocusTimer@gmail.com

1328847392.name: 进程监视器 - Process Monitor
1328847392.description: Process Monitor是Mac的监控软件，可显示实时系统，进程/线程和注册表活动。 此应用程序具有先进和安全的过滤，全面的事件属性，带符号支持的完整线程堆栈等等。 ■ 基于用户，组和父进程，以不同形式完成隔离。 ■ 不断描述流程以更好地理解流程。 ■ 如果进程未识别，则不会标记它们，如果已识别并且描述可用，则它们将标记为绿色。 ■ 同时跟踪应用程序，文件和文件夹位于MAC上。 ■ 直接从菜单栏获取正面和背景中运行的应用程序的所有详细信息。 ≈ PRO特征：≈ ◉ 残留清洁程序：卸载应用程序后，删除剩余的文件和文件夹。这是剩下的垃圾。 注意：如果您发现任何进程未定义（空白）并且您知道进程详细信息，那么是!!您可以撰写描述并提交以供审阅。您的贡献将在检查后记入您的姓名和其他详细信息。 如果您有任何建议或遇到任何问题，请发送电子邮件至support@appyogi.com。 想要贡献，请不要犹豫与我们联系。

1329272684.name: My Skin Anatomy
1329272684.description: My Skin Anatomy app for studying human Skin Anatomy which allows you to rotate 360° , Zoom and move camera around a highly realistic 3D model. My Skin Anatomy app gives users an in depth look at the human Skin structure allowing them to select ,individual skin parts as well as , draw or white on screen and share screenshots, Audio pronunciation for all anatomical terms and more. User can select each part separately to view name of the part or read related information. These apps can be of great help for medical students or to anyone who needs to explore Skin Anatomy in detail with high quality graphic and features of the app. FEATURES User friendly interface. Simple navigation - 360° rotation, Zoom and Pan Selection Mode Animation Mode Search options. Audio pronunciation for all anatomy terms. Draw or white on screen and share screenshots. Info panel Highly realistic Skin 3D model.

1329468824.name: HipDysplasiaApp
1329468824.description: Hip dysplasia leads to premature osteoarthritis of the hip and accounts for many of total hip replacements in patients. The early diagnosis is extremely important and is based mainly on the radiological findings. In a radiographs correctly performed measurements of Indexes like the Acetabular Index (AI), the Center-Edge (CE), the Acetabular Depth-Width Ratio (ADR), the femoral head extrusion index or Reimer Index (RI), the Congruity Index (CI), the Sharp’s angle (SA), Tonnis grade of dislocation (TG), the Acetabular Index of the Weight-Bearing Zone (AIW) or Horizontal Toit externe angle (HTE), and Congruence Index (CG) are important for an the orthopaedic surgeon who wants objectively to asses and monitor optimally on standard radiographs the hips. These measurements usually performed in one X-ray by the traditional way which is time-consuming and cumbersome. We offer this new app, in which simply by marking five points at each hip you measure in an instant, all these indexes. The app also compares the results with normal age, gender and side specific reference databases retrieved from the international literature. The Hip dysplasia App is medical software aimed for orthopaedic surgeons, providing tools that allow doctors to: Securely import medical images directly from the camera or stored photos Offers a very convenient way to determine the most accurate possibly way nine Indexes of hip dysplasia at once. By inserting the gender the age and marking five points at the same X-ray, at each hip, the App calculates the nine above mentioned indexes (AI, AIWB, CE, RI, ADR ,CI, SA,TG, CG) without to have to repeat each measurement separately. You measure all radiographic Indexes in one picture. Gender age and side-specific normal reference databases are used and in cases where values are out of normal ranges, the hips are categorized according the measured Index normal categorisation. Save the planned images, the measured values and results compared by normal reference databases, for later review or consultation. The app also is independent from errors produced by image inclination. Especially developed module allows the user to measure accurately without to worry about the tilting of the picture or the X-ray. Measured data are exported as txt file, ready to print or to input as cells to excel for research. All information received from the software output must be clinically reviewed regarding its plausibility before patient treatment! Hip dysplasia App indicated for assisting healthcare professionals. Clinical judgment and experience are required to properly use the software. The software is not for primary image interpretation. In a busy everyday practice, measuring in X-rays in clinical settings it is time consuming and cumbersome. Accessory instruments like protractors, goniometers, well sharp pencils, rulers or even transparent papers must be available. In case you have a packs system usually you don’t have the reference data. The app offers a very convenient and also accurate way to perform most common radiographic measurements for hip dysplasia, in a blink of an eye in front of your screen. The build in feature of the app, allows results to be compared and categorized according to gender, age and side-specific normal reference databases and help decide what could be considered normal or pathologic. The app is not a simple goniometer, is an enhanced product which helps to monitor objectively the course of the treatment and evaluate optimally the remodeling of the hip. This App is particular useful especially in clinical settings without losing time. Please see tutorial videos at the developer’s web site. Reference databases 1.Wiberg G. The anatomy and roentgenographic appearance of a normal hip joint. Acta Chir Scand. 1939;83:7-38 2 .Tönnis D. Normal values of the hip joint for the evaluationX-rays in children and adults. Clin Orthop Relat Res 1976; (119):39-47

1330269027.name: KQ Dixie Legacy
1330269027.description: THIS IS A DEPRECATED PRODUCT. Get KQ Dixie 26 instead. ### If you bought this app recently, you can request a refund. KQ Dixie is a 6-Operator FM synthesizer that is modeled on the synthesizer which appeared on the 1980s. FM synthesizers make sounds with Frequency Modulation. FM brings rich and brilliant sounds which are impossible to create with analog one. It makes very complex waves with simple modulations. The same method is used for radios. The synthesizer gained much popularity in the 1980s. This app lets you make sounds freely with 156 voice parameters. Almost all parameters but multi-timbral, filter, and delay are compatible with DX7. Audio Unit v3 compatible. Multiple-Out is supported when you use "KQ Dixie Multi". Audiobus compatible. Inter-App Audio compatible. 32 algorithms included. You can manage the hardware DX7 when it is connected with external MIDI cables. Supports DX7 System Exclusive Messages (SysEx) and syx files. Supports Zip files. Place Zip files at the app folder instead of extracting them. Supports micro tuning. The app can load Anamark/Scala tuning files (TUN/SCL). Supports external and virtual MIDI. Supports Volca FM. You may be able to find a lot of patches on the internet. Multi-timbres and Unisons functions are there. Yamaha DX7 is a trademark of Yamaha Corporation. Volca is a trademark of Korg Inc. I have no business relations with Yamaha and Korg. If you encounter a bug, please send me your Dixie Performance file. https://www.kiraqtech.jp/blog/contact-en/ Machine translated text is included in this application and description. Terms of Use: https://www.kiraqtech.jp/termsofuse/

1330314351.name: 微剪辑-微视频编辑助手
1330314351.trackName: 微剪辑-微视频编辑助手
1330314351.description: 微剪辑（Videdit）是一款视频编辑应用，拥有30多项丰富的视频编辑功能：EXIF、剪切、裁剪、擦除（去水印）、色度键、拼接、打码、字幕、滤镜、截图、变声、配音、音效、速度、倒播、缩放、旋转、压缩、转GIF、画中画、加边框、贴纸、拼贴、绘画、BlingBling、粒子、放大镜、哈哈镜、倒影、混合……。微剪辑能够让您轻松玩转视频，给您带来惊喜的视频编辑体验。 === 简单易用 === 选择相册中的视频，再选择一项视频编辑功能，简单处理，实时预览，最后可以保存或分享。 === 功能丰富 === + 【视频信息】：可以查看、修改或删除视频文件EXIF属性信息：主要包括视频文件名称、文件大小、创建日期、时长、分辨率、码率、帧率、编解码器、GPS、设备类型、作者等信息 + 【视频剪切】：把视频不需要的片段剪切掉，支持头尾剪切和中间剪切两种模式； + 【视频裁剪】：可以灵活地把视频裁剪成特定的规格尺寸； + 【视频拼接】：支持视频与图片的拼接、支持100多种转场动画特效； + 【视频打码】：独家首创动态移动打码技术，选择好打码的形状和码型，设置好模糊强度和打码速度，拖动手柄进行移动打码，非常方便地给视频的某个部位打上马赛克，可以反相打码区域； + 【视频文字】：可以为视频添加多个不同时间段的文本，可以灵活设置文本的字体、颜色、背景色、边框、阴影、描边、下划线、左右对齐方式等等多种属性，支持对文本全程三个阶段（进入、主体、退出）进行多种动画配置； + 【视频滤镜】：可以为视频添加几十种可选的滤镜效果； + 【视频截图】：可以方便地从视频中截取一幅图片； + 【视频变声】：通过灵活调节声音的pitch值，可以变成男声、女声、小孩声等不同音高的声音；提供多种声音扭曲失真设置，可以让声音具有机器人、外星人、回声等效果；提供多种声音混响效果设置，如小房间、大房间、教堂等等； + 【视频配音】：为视频某个片段添加自己的配音； + 【视频音效】：为视频某个片段添加特殊的音效，应用内提供了丰富的音效素材，还可以从本地音乐库中选择音乐，或者从其它视频采集音效，并支持音效的截取； + 【视频速度】：支持视频快放、慢放，可以灵活地调整视频某段的播放速度； + 【视频重放】：可以方便把视频中的某段进行重复播放，能够灵活设置重复播放的次数和速度； + 【视频倒播】：可以生成倒序播放的视频； + 【视频缩放】：可以对视频的宽度和高度进行任意缩放； + 【视频旋转】：支持快速地顺时针/逆时针旋转、水平/垂直翻转；支持任意角度对视频进行3D旋转微调； + 【视频压缩】：可以通过分辨率、帧率和比特率对视频进行压缩； + 【视频转GIF】：可以方便地把一小段视频转成GIF文件，可以设置帧速和循环次数，支持对每帧的编辑和图片替换； + 【画中画视频】：能够对画中画视频进行多种形状设置，能够灵活调节画中画视频的位置，还可以进行任意缩放； + 【视频加边框】：可以设置边框的颜色和宽度，可以添加形状边框，还有很多精致的边框图片可供选择； + 1332273123.name: ChoreoRoom
1332273123.description: ChoreoRoom provides an elegant way of creating and sharing dance formations with ease. Quickly set your dancers and then preview their transitions between formations. Tweak your piece by assigning names, adding colors, designating dancers as off-stage, and rearranging the order of your formations. 1334194279.name: 肩颈放松训练
1334194279.description: 办公室肩颈放松  缓解 上班族肩颈僵硬、 疼痛的 亚健康状态。上班族的肩颈僵硬、疼痛基本都是长时间伏案使用电脑引起的。颈部肩部肌肉被过度使用，逐渐丧失了弹性和延展性。疼痛感其实就是身体劝你放松休息的信号。这套训练会通过拉伸和相关肌肉的激活让肩颈肌肉恢复原有的活性，不仅可以缓解疼痛，还可以让肩颈的姿态更加美观。 训练可以让你的肩部更有力量、紧实和生长，你需要做的是确保每一次训练都变得有意义，并不断的超越。换句话说，想拥有强大的肩部，你不得不举的更重、挥洒你的汗水、激发你的潜力。 我曾经在肩部训练也遇到过很多问题，总的来说，我更喜欢用最简单有效的方法和动作，例如增加试举重量、降低每组次数等。 我的肩部训练通常包括6个动作，每个动作4-5组，每组6-15次。每周在我的健身计划中加入两次这样的肩部训练。

1334681716.name: Dictionary of Word Family
1334681716.description: This app provides the dictionary of word family. Word family is a group of words that share the same root but have different affixes, for example ’help’, ’helpful’, ’helpless’, ’helper’ and ’unhelpful’. This dictionary is will help you to increase your vocabulary. Each entry consists of a base word followed by words that are derived from that base word. Concise definitions and examples in full sentences are given to show the main meanings and uses of every word that is included. For example, if you know the meaning of "advantage", you will easily learn the meaning of "advantageous", "disadvantage", "advantaged", "advantageously". ● Academic word list List of academic word list extracted from the dictionary ● Groups The entries in the dictionary are divided into different groups for easy learning. ● My lists You can create a list and add a new word into that list Use this feature to create a list of difficult words or list of words that you already know ● My notes You can write note for each entry Use rich text editor to style your note or add your own images to each entry Use this feature to note tips and tricks to remember a word or write a sentence ● Other features Bookmark an entry Search an entry Words of the day (If you enables notification, it will send you 5 words to learn daily) Pronunciation: Learn how a word is pronounced Translation: translate a word into other language ● If you want to give feedback or suggest a new feature, please send us an email. We love getting feedback from users.

1335336436.name: 满文书写及满汉词典
1335336436.description: 让我们学习满文书写! BEAUTIFUL MANCHU LANGUAGE SCRIPT! LET'S LEARN HOW TO HAND-WRITE THEM ! THIS APP BREAKS THEM DOWN STROKE BY STROKE ! 旋转轮 操作直观, 只需拇指, 既直观又简单和自然。 SPIN THE WHEEL TO EXPLORE It's so easy and natural. 满汉词典 MANCHU-CHINESE DICTIONARY Easy to find the word you want. 添加到收藏夹 ADD TO FAVORITES Save the word you like for the future use. 满族文化与艺术 MANCHU ARTS & CULTURE Emperors of Qing Dynasty(清朝) portraits and their Manchu names. Also the coins and seals in Manchu language. 离线独立APP - 无需互联网 OFF-LINE INDEPENDENT Once downloaded, you don't need internet to use the app. All audios and pictures are integrated within. The App uses the adjusted romanization according to the system devised by Paul Georg von Möllendorff (穆麟德). e.g. |ʃ| is denoted as "x", |tʃ| is denoted as "c", |dʒ| is denoted as "j". You can also select the word in alphabetical order by clicking “manchu” in the menu bar. The Manchu language uses the Manchu script, which was derived from the traditional Mongol script. When you get a hang of the Manchu handwritings, your understanding of the Manchu culture will improve naturally.

1336486618.name: Pure Piano - Instrument & AUv3
1336486618.description: Pure Piano is a professional, multi-sampled concert grand piano with a unique Morph Pad that allows you to explore a multitude of sounds ranging from mellow and intimate tones to surreal, cinematic textures. Similar to an XY pad in its flat, tactile nature, the Morph Pad offers up nine different core timbres of the piano including percussive, cinematic, bright, and intimate, to name a few. The “pure” piano sits untouched at the heart and center of the space, surrounded by eight more presets for you to explore as you guide your finger seamlessly through the wide-ranging tonal palette of the piano. As you do so, the various timbres blend together allowing you to create your own sounds comprising combinations of neighboring presets for you to save and recall. It doesn’t stop there either. The Morph Pad is linked to the app’s inbuilt EQ, reverb, and delay and so operates as a macro control adding even more to the experience by way of ever-changing texture and atmosphere, all from just one single piano. 1338225107.name: CobbAngleApp
1338225107.description: Cobb method is considered the standard for measuring curve size in scoliosis. Cobb angles are always measured from the superior end plate of the most cephalad end vertebra to the inferior end plate of the most caudal end vertebra in the curve. Meticulous line drawings and precise measurements is paramount importance in order to quantify the magnitude of spinal deformities and monitor the success or failure of treatment for scoliosis. The CobbAngleApp is medical software aimed for orthopaedic surgeons, providing tools that allow doctors to: Securely import medical images directly from the camera or stored photos. Offers a very convenient way to determine the most accurate possibly way at once. By marking four points at the same X-ray, at each spine the App calculates the Cobb angle. In cases where values are out of normal ranges, the scoliosis is categorized according to measured angle as mild, moderate, severe. To simplify the process and to minimize inter-observer errors usually by not selecting the actual end vertebra, the app offers also in ext mode the ability to draw the vertical reference line through the patient’s sacrum and to identify more easily the end vertebrae s (ext method). Save the planned images, the measured values and results compared by normal reference databases, for later review or consultation. The app also is independent from errors produced by image inclination. Especially developed module allows the user to measure accurately without to worry about the tilting of the picture or the X-ray. All information received from the software output must be clinically reviewed regarding its plausibility before patient treatment! CobbAngleApp indicated for assisting healthcare professionals. Clinical judgment and experience are required to properly use the software. The software is not for primary image interpretation. In a busy everyday practice, the examiner have to draw lines in X-rays or in clinical settings, this it is time consuming and cumbersome. Accessory instruments like protractors, hinged goniometers, well sharp pencils, rulers or even transparent papers must be available. The app offers a very convenient and also accurate way to perform most common radiographic measurements for spine, in a blink of an eye in front of your screen. The build in feature of the app, allows results to be categorized may help decide what could be considered normal or pathologic. The app is not a simple goniometer, is an enhanced product which helps to monitor objectively the course of the treatment and evaluate optimally the spine. This App is particular useful especially in clinical settings where you need a quick results without losing time. Please see tutorial videos at the developer’s web site www.orthopractis.com Reference databases 1. Cobb JR. Outline for the study of scoliosis. The American Academy of Orthopedic Surgeons Instructional Course Lectures. Vol. 5. Ann Arbor, MI: Edwards; 1948.

1339325092.name: Raildar
1339325092.description: Raildar – Live UK Train Tracking See the UK rail network come alive in real time. Raildar accurately plots the live location of trains across the entire UK rail network, giving you a clear picture of where your train is right now - not just when it was scheduled. Whether you’re commuting, waiting for a connection, or just a rail enthusiast, Raildar lets you: View live positions of trains across the UK Search for a specific service and follow it on the map Check where your train has been earlier today Pan around the map to explore rail activity nationwide Simple, fast, and built for anyone who wants to know what’s really happening on the rails. Raildar Subscription (Optional) Keeping live train locations up to date for the entire UK network is data-intensive and keeps our servers busy. To keep the app free for everyone, Raildar uses a short live-update timeout in the standard version. With Raildar Subscription, you unlock a smoother, more powerful experience: Extended live tracking without frequent timeouts No adverts Extra train details, including headcodes A more seamless, uninterrupted map experience Subscriptions are available monthly, or for 6 months at a discounted monthly rate. You can try Raildar Subscription free for 7 days before committing. 1339418001.name: Minimoog Model D Synthesizer
1339418001.description: The Minimoog Model D App is a software transmutation of the world’s first portable synthesizer, the Minimoog Model D®. Anyone can jump in and play with over 160 included presets or lay fingers to the controls and begin exploring vast magical realms of creative potential for iPad, iPhone, iPod Touch and Mac. The Minimoog Model D App incorporates a number of inspiring sound creation tools and capabilities not present on its analog antecedent. New functions include the ability to play chords with up to four-note polyphony, an easy-to-use arpeggiator for rhythmic pattern creation, a real time looping recorder with unlimited overdubbing capacity, a tempo-synchronizable stereo ping pong delay module, and the Bender -- a wide-range stereo time modulation effect module. The Minimoog Model D App also supports AUv3 Audio Unit extensions, which allows multiple instances of this powerful instrument to be used simultaneously within compatible iOS apps supporting AUv3. A BRIEF HISTORY Introduced by Moog in 1970, the Minimoog Model D served as the archetype for all electronic keyboards that followed. It gave users the ability to design their own sounds, translating imagination into reality. The Minimoog’s portability, affordability and accessibility made it the go-to instrument for musicians looking to expand beyond the traditional sounds of the time. Bernie Worrell used the Minimoog Model D to establish Parliament Funkadelic’s futuristic funk sound. Kraftwerk employed the Minimoog Model D on the successful concept album Autobahn, sparking an entirely new genre. Gary Numan replaced his live band’s guitars with Minimoog Model Ds, creating the prototype for industrial music. The classic sound of the Minimoog Model D can be heard on Bob Marley’s Catch A Fire, Michael Jackson’s Thriller and Dr. Dre’s The Chronic; Detailed in the mini-doc series “A Brief History Of The Minimoog”. FEATURES Ships with over 160 presets (hundreds more available in the Minimoog Model D App Store) Up to 4-notes of polyphony Easily share presets and audio recordings with friends Arpeggiator module with note-hold and chord latch capability Stereo ping-pong delay effect Bender time modulation effect Real-time looping recorder with overdub and immediate sharing Selectable envelope shapes and triggering behavior Effortless MIDI CC mapping Seamlessly backup presets to iCloud Play mode for easier panel and keyboard interaction A new take on the classic feedback/overload path SUPPORTS All 64-bit iOS devices AUv3 Audio Unit Extensions (Including GarageBand) MPE Controller Support Ableton Link Inter-App Audio and Audiobus 7 and 14-Bit MIDI MIDI Program Change Support Bluetooth LE MIDI controllers Share over AirDrop, Mail, or other iOS applications

New functions include the ability to play chords with up to four-note polyphony, an easy-to-use arpeggiator for rhythmic pattern creation, a real time looping recorder with unlimited overdubbing capacity, a tempo-synchronizable stereo ping pong delay module, and the Bender -- a wide-range stereo time modulation effect module. Bernie Worrell used the Minimoog Model D to establish Parliament Funkadelic’s futuristic funk sound. Kraftwerk employed the Minimoog Model D on the successful concept album Autobahn, sparking an entirely new genre. Gary Numan replaced his live band’s guitars with Minimoog Model Ds, creating the prototype for industrial music. 1341298455.description: 隐藏摄像头检测器应用程序可帮助您检测酒店房间、更衣室中隐藏的间谍摄像头并检测闭路电视摄像头。 无论您是旅行、入住酒店客房、Airbnb 甚至在更衣室试衣服，使用此应用程序扫描针孔有线摄像头、无线摄像头以及红外摄像头。 应用程序有多种方法来检测隐藏的摄像头- 1. 检测有线摄像头 - 在此模式下，应用程序分析可疑物体周围的磁活动，如果发现类似于摄像头的磁活动，它会发出红色状态的哔哔声，以便您进一步调查。 如何使用 - 将 iPhone 的左上角移到离可疑物体非常近的地方。它可能是螺丝、花盆、淋浴喷头或任何你觉得可疑的东西。如果应用程序在靠近物体时发出哔哔声，并且在远离物体时发出哔哔声，请停止哔哔声，进一步检查相机镜头。 2. 检测红外摄像头 - 您还可以检测红外摄像头。只需关闭所有灯并打开红外摄像头模式并扫描移动的 iPhone 360​​ 度，如果您看到肉眼看不到的白光或蓝光，则它是红外光，可能是红外摄像头。 3. 镜头检测器：从 v1.5 开始引入镜头检测器功能。此功能使用人工智能来检测移动摄像头、闭路电视、电子设备等。您现在可以配置自己的帧速率并切换手电筒以获得更好的处理。如果您的 iPhone 丢帧，请选择较低的帧速率。如果您拥有具有良好处理器的最新 iPhone，请选择更高的帧速率。 4. 检测蓝牙摄像头 - 应用程序扫描附近的 BLE 设备，如果发现任何设备可疑，应用程序将显示相应的消息。应用程序有完整的商业蓝牙连接端点列表来检测蓝牙摄像头。 5. 检测 wifi 摄像头 - 按照应用程序内的分步指南检测 WiFi 摄像头。 隐藏的相机检测器应用程序还提供提示和技巧，以便您可以通过一些简单的技巧和黑客来保持保护。 如果您喜欢我们的应用程序，请评分，评论。

1341392811.name: InstantWeather App
1341392811.description: A customizable weather app for iPhone and iPad that lets you select backgrounds for different weather conditions. Main features: Take a picture using your device's camera or select an existing one from your album to use as your background Add filters, add blur, or change the brightness of your background Change the color for text and icons Swipe right to access daily summaries for the next week Swipe left to access detailed forecast for the next 48 hours Share any screen from the app directly to social media The app also includes a Today widget that lets you check the weather conditions right from your lock screen or home screen. Powered by the Dark Sky API, the Today widget shows current temperature, the day's min and max temperatures, and hyper-local rain forecasts. The widget can also be expanded to show extra details for the next 12 hours.

1342124199.description: 潮汐极简版，开启一段美好的专注时光。 为什么需要潮汐极简版？ 总是被各种琐事和诱惑打断，无法长时间专心投入 因为拖延和懒惰，明明很多事情，却无法开始 时间无情流逝，不知道如何开始新的一天 试过很多时间管理法，却依然效率低下于事无补 事情越来越多，时间越来越少，压力越来越大 如果你有以上困扰，试试「潮汐极简版」，让你暂时放下手机，开启你的专注旅程。 潮汐极简版是什么？ 「潮汐极简版」是一个让你可以暂时放下手机、专心投入的 App。每当你想开始一段专心投入的时光，你可以在「潮汐极简版」中选择一个自然场景并开始专注。接下来的时间里，伴着海浪、雨声、森林、冥想或是咖啡厅的环境声音，你会心无旁骛专心投入。之后，你可以休息一小会儿或是继续下一段专注。每一天，都有成千上万的人在潮汐开启专注旅程，和时间做朋友，遇见更好的自己。 让你专心的计时器： 基于番茄工作法，每次专注 25 分钟，间隔休息 5 分钟 支持时长与休息模式自定义，定制顺心顺手的专注计时器 大自然的声音旅程： 精选 5 种声音旅程：海浪、雨声、森林、冥想和咖啡厅，随时随地回归自然 独创音乐融合播放功能，一边听歌一边聆听大自然 计时过程中，点击计时圈可以暂停播放白噪音 一天一张潮汐日帖： 每日精选美图金句，献给每一个认真专注的人 精心设计的日帖卡片，方便你与好友分享在潮汐的专注旅程 随时间变化的问候语，给你一句亲切的问候 极简设计的强大功能： 极简优雅的界面设计，自然多彩的情境颜色 精心挑选的排版字体，中文字体来自造字工房™的匠心之作 所获荣誉： 苹果官方「最佳新 App」首页推荐 少数派（sspai.com）编辑推荐 爱范儿旗下 AppSolution 重点推荐 好奇心日报「今日应用」推荐 36 氪 NEXT 重点推荐 爱屁屁 APPNZ 报道 什么是番茄工作法？ 一种最为简单易行的时间管理方法，使用定时器（比如潮汐）来分割出一个 25 分钟的工作时间和 5 分钟的休息时间。 什么是心流？ 英文为 flow，一种将个人精神力完全投注在某种活动上的感觉，心流产生时同时会有高度的兴奋及充实感。 ———— 联系我们： 微信公众号：潮汐时刻，搜索 tidehour 添加 邮箱：talk@moreless.io

Planets orbits can also be hidden and shown. If you like our app please rate & leave reviews. If there is a feature please state in the comments, we are constantly checking reviews. We will be happy to develop our app with the new features that you requested. Please note that this app uses the camera to create an augmented reality experience of the solar system, overlaying planets and other celestial objects onto the real world. Thank you very much for using our app & your support motivates us to work more :)

1344470087.name: tardigrain
1344470087.description: Tardigrain is a granular synthesiser for iOS that runs standalone or as an AU plugin. Sounds are created by taking smaller fragments of a sample and playing them back in a non linear fashion, with settings for grain size, direction, step size and more. Process the sound further through effects like reverb, wave shaper and sample crush. Tardigrain supports connections with AudioCopy, AudioBus, Inter App Audio and AUv3. Plus all audio parameters can be modulated by MIDI, as AU parameters and by aftertouch on the build in keyboard. Now also a selected set of parameters can be modulated by LFOs och notes triggered by a new sequencer/arpeggiator. +++ Record your own samples or import using AudioCopy/drag'n drop +++ Chromatic granualar playpack +++ Effects (Wave shaper, Reverb, Sample crusher, Pitch and stereo spread) +++ Resonant filter (low, band and high pass) +++ Keyboard and MPE modulation of any audio parameters +++ Note trigger sequencer/arpeggiator +++ 4 LFO sources for modulating a selected set of parameters +++ Multiple factory presets to get you started +++ Save and load your own settings and samples +++ Inter App Audio, AudioBus and AUv3 +++ Core MIDI, Inter App Audio MIDI and AUv3 MIDI

1344694994.name: 封神榜演义-哪吒冒险记
1344694994.trackName: 封神榜演义-哪吒冒险记
1344694994.description: 封神榜传奇是一款经典单人RPG角色扮演游戏。 主要人物为哪吒，小龙女，杨戬，姜子牙。 哪吒是殷商末年陈塘关总兵李靖的第三个儿子，金咤、木咤的弟弟，是灵珠子投胎。母亲殷夫人怀孕三年六个月，生下一个肉球。李靖以为是妖怪，就用剑劈开，里面的婴儿正是哪吒。后来，仙人太乙真人登门道贺，收他为徒，取名“哪吒”。一次哪吒在东海玩水，和东海龙王的三子敖丙起冲突，不但将其打死，还抽他的龙筋做为腰带要送给李靖。 东海龙王到天宫上本，又在宝德门遭到他的痛打，还被他抓下四、五十片鳞甲，鲜血淋漓，狼狈不堪。闯下这“灭门绝户”的大祸，他毫不在意，还轻描淡写地说是由于“一时性急”。 当四海龙王敖广、敖钦、敖闰、敖顺联名奏准玉帝来拿李靖夫妇问罪时，哪吒说： “‘一人行事一人当’，我打死敖丙、李艮[gèn]，我当偿命，岂有子连累父母之理！”为了不累双亲，他断臂剖腹，剜肠剔骨，还于父母。他的孝道感动了龙王，李靖夫妇亦因此得赦。 龙王到陈塘关兴师问罪，为了不连累父母，哪吒三太子割肉还母、剔骨还父，当场自戕。但李靖却总不能谅解，对他的魂魄继续进行无理逼迫。这使哪吒无法容忍。而后，哪吒三太子在被其父李靖阻挠，复活不成的情形之下，太乙真人用莲花莲藕给哪吒造了一个新的肉体。 重生后的哪吒助姜子牙讨伐纣王。凭著高强的武功和法宝（风火轮、乾坤圈、混天绫）多次立下奇功。更因为其是莲花的化身而对感染人类的病毒能够免疫。

1344801139.name: Stuarts' SA Mammals
1344801139.description: Discover and explore all 537 southern African mammal species with this comprehensive app by experts Chris and Mathilde Stuart. Fully updated, this app now extends coverage to Angola, Zambia, Malawi and northern Mozambique, featuring all southern African mammals, from aardvark, shrews and bats to the dolphins and whales that inhabit coastal and deeper waters. Detailed species entries, photographs, videos, calls, distribution maps and search-by-country functionality enable quick identification, making this app the go-to field tool for students, scientists and all nature lovers. Now with improved location data functionality and new Smart search parameters. FEATURES INCLUDE: Covers all 537 southern African mammal species Detailed species descriptions offer insight into key ID points and typical behaviour Calls and videos of mammals in their natural environments More than 3700 photographs and illustrations, including animal-to-human size comparisons Easily identify mammals by their tracks or droppings Improved Location data functionality New Smart Search filters – search by activity, habitat, track length, track shape and dropping shape The most recent research and taxonomy Keep track of your sightings in a Life List Search by country Compare two species side by side Search and sort by English, Afrikaans, French, German or scientific names JOIN OUR GROWING COMMUNITY If you’ve got a few comments or great suggestions to share, we’d love to hear from you at www.mydigitalearth.com ADDITIONAL NOTES Uninstalling/reinstalling the app will result in the loss of your list. We recommend that you keep a backup from the application (My List > Export).

1345154822.name: MIDImorphosis 2 Tune+Tone+Tab
1345154822.description: Many musicians use simple tuner apps on their phones to tune their instruments -- they're convenient, accurate, but often slow to detect the correct pitch. MIDImorphosis uses an advanced Fast Fourier Transform, coupled with noise filtering and harmonic sequence analysis, to detect the pitch of any note quickly and accurately. The fast pitch detection allows the app to generate MIDI notes to control synthesizers, so that you can use an ordinary guitar as a MIDI controller. With an amplifier simulator app and a synth app, you can mix the sound of your guitar with the synthesizers to create any tone you like. The app includes a full featured tablature editor; use your guitar or bass to jot down the notes from a solo you're figuring out, or a riff you came up with. You can keep your hands on the instrument and just play, instead of searching for a pencil and paper. The app will export to PDF, MIDI, and MusicXML. You can import your transcriptions into Logic Pro, Reaper, GuitarPro, and hundreds of other DAWs and sequencers. MIDImorphosis can also help you understand and sculpt the tone of your guitars. Guitar strings vibrate at a base frequency (the "pitch" of a note), as well as multiples of that base frequency. The "tone" of a guitar is determined by all of the harmonic frequencies; the new ToneScope display shows you which frequencies are present, and which are missing. Get rid of wishy-washy terms like "bright," "warm," and "muddy." The harmonic analysis of MIDImorphosis will show you exactly what's going on, with mathematics and science. Why does a Tele sound like a Tele? The neck pickup is at 1/4 of the scale length, resulting in a "dead spot" for the 4th harmonic frequency. Fret the string at the 5th, and then the neck pickup is at 1/3 of the scale length, resulting in a "dead spot" for the 3rd harmonic. You use a tuner to get the guitar in tune. Use the ToneScope to adjust pickup heights, and shape the tone of your guitar. With any pitch-to-MIDI system, there is a bit of latency, and some glitches in the note detection. To get a perfectly timed take, with rapid fire notes, transcribe by playing slowly and cleanly, then clean up any errors with the tab editor. MIDImorphosis features an innovative tap-to-play approach, which can play back the notes in your tab as fast as you can tap the on-screen button. Unlike conventional guitar MIDI controllers, where you're limited to soft ambient pads to back your notes -- you can use the playback feature to get precisely timed notes with sharp attacks. MIDImorphosis has full MIDI support; you can use the app as a MIDI controller. There's also a built-in SoundFont synthesizer, with hundreds of tones to choose from. More details and demonstration videos are available at www.midimorphosis.com.
